4FFDE9BF43A27FBF02A9EDB5BF236E9B:
<Heading>Challenges</>

<stronger>Challenges</> are special, repeatable quests that increase in difficulty every time you complete them.

Each <stronger>Challenge</> quest line has <stronger>20 Stages</> to test your mettle!
29D49AE344F4D138F995ABB7B93F4CDB:
<Heading>Collection Book</>

Move extra people and schematics to your <stronger>Collection Book</> to earn <stronger>Collection Book XP</>.
Items in the <stronger>Collection Book</> can be leveled up and evolved for additional <stronger>Collection Book XP</>.
Collect rewards every time the <stronger>Collection Book</> levels up!

You can spend <stronger>Flux</> to unslot items from the <stronger>Collection Book</> and return them to your <stronger>Armory</>, but you will lose <stronger>Collection Book XP</> when you unslot items.

New heroes can be recruited from the <stronger>Collection Book</> with <stronger>Flux</> and <stronger>People Manuals</>. 
New schematics can be researched from the <stronger>Collection Book</> with <stronger>Flux</> and <stronger>Schematic Designs</>.
2C50E0AC4C33501D2FE523B0CEE9909E:
<Heading>Daily Quests</>

Every day, you are assigned a <stronger>Daily Quest</>. Completing the <stronger>Daily Quest</> will reward you with <stronger>X-Ray Tickets</> or <stronger>V-bucks</> and <stronger>Gold</>.

You can have up to 3 active <stronger>Daily Quests</> at a time and you can abandon 1 per day if you want to try something new.

In order to get new <stronger>Daily Quests</>, you'll need to complete your active quests.
E63399814FEEB79592758B8DAED442AA:
<Heading>Defenders</>

Need a hand on your current mission? <stronger>Defenders</> can be summoned during the mission to fill in for any missing players in your party to help take out those pesky husks.

Build <stronger>Defender Pads</> while you're in a mission, then activate them to call a <stronger>Defender</>. In a Storm Shield Defense mission, you can summon additional <stronger>Defenders</> to create a small army!
C3A87A814DB1C2F0CB0B02BC2315D28E:
<Heading>Expedition Squads</>

Don’t leave your <Heading>Heroes standing around idle, send them on an <stronger>Expedition</> and watch the rewards roll in!

Select an <stronger>Expedition</> with rewards you like.

Choose <stronger>Heroes</> to send on your selected <stronger>Expedition</>. The chance of success depends on how the combined <stronger>Power</> of the <stronger>Heroes</> match with the <stronger>Expedition</> requirements.

Your <stronger>Heroes</> will return later with rewards! 

<stronger>Heroes on an Expedition will be unavailable elsewhere until they return.</>
7FD6FB6A4ED790F286293DB7F57BF842:
<Heading>Gadgets</>

Earn <stronger>Homebase XP</> by completing quests, side missions, and earning badges in game. The more activities your team completes within a mission, the more XP you will receive. Every time you fill up your <stronger>Homebase XP</> bar, you gain a <stronger>Homebase Level</>. 

Upon reaching specific <stronger>Homebase Levels</>, new <stronger>Gadgets</> will be awarded and existing <stronger>Gadgets</> will be leveled up.
E282E6C24C3F13B362FAF287BA7048CC:
<Heading>Hero Loadout</>

Select and assign a <stronger>Hero</> as your <stronger>Commander</> for your next mission. Up to 5 <stronger>Heroes</> can be assigned to the <stronger>Support Team</> and each of them adds 8% of their health, shield and ability damage stats to your <stronger>Commander</>.

<Heading>Hero Perks</>

The <stronger>Commander</> and each member of the <stronger>Support Team</> have <stronger>Hero Perks</> that may boost the <stronger>Commander's</> combat performance in different ways.

<Heading>Team Perk</>

Assign a <stronger>Team Perk</> to the <stronger>Team Perk Slot</> to further improve your <stronger>Commander's</> combat performance. With the right <stronger>Heroes</> assigned to the <stronger>Support Team</>, the bonuses granted by the <stronger>Team Perk</> can be further increased.
869D091E4A78446D919837A4AF602312:
<Heading>Power</>

Your <stronger>Power</> is a measure of your overall combat effectiveness and is calculated by the following.

1. <stronger>F.O.R.T Attributes</>  awarded when gaining <stronger>Homebase Levels</>.

2. <stronger>Commander Rating</> and <stronger>Support Hero Rating</> in your current <stronger>Hero Loadout</>.

3. <stronger>F.O.R.T Attributes</> determined by the ratings of your <stronger>Survivors</> in your <stronger>Survivor Squads</>. 

4. Your three highest rated <stronger>Schematics</> or <stronger>Weapons</> in your backpack.
591F637D4C540C367646A7947DCEB1DB:
<Heading>Quest Log</>

Your <stronger>Quest Log</> keeps a record of all your current quests and challenges, including those that you have completed in the past.

Complete quests to earn rewards, including special event exclusive or limited time rewards.

<stronger>Pin Quests</> to track your progress in game.
74C8052A440E4197BC0D40B2553905BA:
<Heading>Save The World</>

<stronger>If you're out there, we need your help!</>

The storm came, and the monsters followed.  They took everything: our towns, even our families.  The few of us left are in serious danger... 

<stronger>Now it's time to fight back!  All we need is a leader.  And that's you.</>

Sure it'll be dangerous. I mean, yeah, there's monsters (a lot of monsters!) but we've got massive forts, killer traps, and piles of loot.  If we stick together, they don't stand a chance.

<stronger>This is our world, and it's time to take it back!</>
669678BC42CE2062409FF6B2DA0AB0B2:
<Heading>Schematics</>

<stronger>Schematics</> give you the ability to <stronger>craft items</> that can be used on missions.

Level up and evolve your schematics to increase the power of crafted items and unlock their <stronger>special perks</>.

Keep in mind that items from evolved schematics require rarer resources to craft.
D8DC49A547416FD2E7C9218882989EB0:
<Heading>Side Quests</>

<stronger>Side Quests</> are optional quests that you can choose to pursue if you're looking for an extra challenge!

Complete <stronger>Side Quests</> to receive high value rewards like <stronger>X-Ray Tickets</> or <stronger>V-bucks</>.

Each <stronger>Side Quest</> can only be completed once, but completing one may unlock access to a new, more challenging <stronger>Side Quest</>.
B501AAD540A5A77B2CC7A186D934DCD3:
<Heading>Storage</>

If you earn items as a mission reward, or collect resources on an Expedition, but don't have room in your backpack, items will instead be placed in <stronger>Storage</>.

As long as there is open room, you can move items freely between your backpack and your Storage. You will unlock more storage space as you gain <stronger>Homebase Levels</>.

Your <stronger>Storage</> can also be accessed from your <stronger>Storm Shield</>.
69A31AE04F25882840CF499392A0B87E:
<Heading>Survivor Squads</>

Add <stronger>Survivors</> to your <stronger>Survivor Squads</> to increase your <stronger>Power</> and <stronger>F.O.R.T. Attributes</>. The more powerful the <stronger>Survivor</>, the more they benefit your squad. Level up and evolve your <stronger>Survivors</> to increase their power! 

Match Leaders to their <stronger>Job Type</> and <stronger>Squad Personalities</>, and pair up <stronger>Survivors</> with similar <stronger>Traits</> to gain additional bonuses.
BF3E91F64E65515D0B6A2183284EDC54:
<Heading>Ventures</>

Welcome to the <stronger>Venture Zone!</> Complete <stronger>Venture Zone</> missions to earn exclusive rewards. This <stronger>Venture Zone</> is only available for a limited time, so dive in while you can!

You can use your heroes and trap schematics in the <stronger>Venture Zone</> but your normal inventory won't be available. Make sure to find and repair weapons when facing new challenges in the <stronger>Venture Zone!</>

Earn <stronger>Venture XP</> by completing missions in the zone. Every level gives a reward!

Your <stronger>Venture Level</> determines your power level and <stronger>F.O.R.T. Stats</> within the zone. No need to worry about <stronger>Hero Rating</>, <stronger>Survivors</>, <stronger>Schematics</>, or the  <stronger>Weapons</> in your backpack!
FD097A024FDA13EFFDEE54BFD0FD40B4:
<Heading>XP Boosts</>

When an <stronger>XP Boost</> is active, you will receive <stronger>Homebase XP</> at an increased rate.  There are two different ways to boost your XP: You can apply an XP Boost from the <stronger>Profile</> menu, or you can be boosted by (or send a boost to) a <stronger>teammate</>.

Additionally, everyone receives <stronger>Daily Bonus XP</> just for playing the game.  Every point of XP you earn will be doubled until your Daily Bonus XP is exhausted, and the boost resets once per day.

Dialogue.09B8F1784C6A9BC94D2543A1342204AE_06FC410: The goal is to protect the Storm Shield from any attackers.
Dialogue.64D54ED146BF3CC5F2AB0DA413D3AC69_CC240C1: Let us play with your gadgets!
Dialogue.CA03A4C0436C7F91DBDE3BB73E883FD5_06FC410: "'Ha! As if the Jackal's mighty air armada could stop Octane Sparks and his Wheels of Flame!'"
Dialogue.EBD578B6440A2D43C7D22FB2B96CE566_06FC410: "'If you can hear me, I need your help! I'm all alone out here!'"
Dialogue.3B50AFA54EFCD2F3D34C519E599BFF0B_06FC410: "'The Viscount of Onver has been summoned!'"
Dialogue.40F752874FD00221171BD2A77FD12082_06FC410: "...making a fake head to appease a Christmas monster..."
Dialogue.7E10B87448BD97762F718B93F13F3CCE_97A9259: "A Homebase Hero must be able to live off the land."
Dialogue.C84F24B343FC6D488E7822B981EE1417_47CFF90: "A Most Pleasant Pirate." Now that is promising.
Dialogue.5E129B6045484E6AA03B9AAF810F9F1E_06FC410: "A Step-by-Step Guide to Reducing Employee Interaction."
Dialogue.1A0E32EF4B2C6478A58BA6B2315BA1B5_06FC410: "A cure for the Moonlight Wolf disease." Hm.
Dialogue.4228893B4AD5508EDB9546B1CAC228C9_06FC410: "A herd of monsters chases our hero when CZZT... a radio crackles."
Dialogue.3011372C481C7160A33C45A3587E8C86_97A9259: "A partial list of incurable kissing related diseases?"
Dialogue.18249EF8441EA8E7D39520B87FD1BAD1_06FC410: "A rebel teen blares romantic music into his crush's window to prove his devotion."
Dialogue.CCA9B6684D4410D398F8FCAE6FD0496E_06FC410: "A story of the unbreakable bonds forged in conflict and the heroic acts that would forever change the world."
Dialogue.64E9DB074503344A7931908B32E7D5FC_97A9259: "ATM pin numbers, lock combinations, and so much other secret knowledge goes to the grave with our loved ones. But Dr. Howitzer is here to help, for the low, low price--"
Dialogue.4FB9BD8D4219809862FF71AEA954514A_06FC410: "After seeing someone who pretended to be helping the less fortunate take huge piles of money..."
Dialogue.20F328B64C5AEE30D09815BD52946A3E_EAAE146: "Ahoy, geocaching enthusiast. Ye found Rowdy Jack's treasure..."
Dialogue.410A7FA9476AA37642692A80F661662F_06FC410: "All around me I see evidence of love. Couples holding hands. Couples professing their undying affection."
Dialogue.A49E9DC84C44351FADB02C99B1E954B3_06FC410: "All with the mission of giving people a helping hand."
Dialogue.AD3E3E4E4A41A212F329CE80E03F8C47_06FC410: "An elderly woman looks back at her long and thrilling li--"
Dialogue.FFF0D21846BD86FA6F9C82A7B8F116B2_D87E161: "An item?" What year are you from?
Dialogue.455FDDD44B9FA91CC0C632B7AE1DC85B_AB3C42C: "And I am her captain, Azalea Clark."
Dialogue.9CBDDE104CDF422B6C4CCF9AFA14C702_97A9259: "And I noped out of that situation right quick."
Dialogue.BA79C9364B0F18766498E1AA6FAD1E1C_97A9259: "And I'll never know, because I don't even know if you survived. Not that I care, but sometimes I think about it."
Dialogue.7D5C62F84C1588CBA93904BC7055A65F_97A9259: "And a pathological obsession with authority figures and positions of power."
Dialogue.11FF19764484225D395862995C90A8BA_7712BEE: "And challenged us to take steps outside of the campsites we know and love..."
Dialogue.09C9B55A4381EA2F8198C0821E547380_06FC410: "And forgot I was there until well after the tide came in..." Eugh.
Dialogue.F25371464B657F3A740B5480EF03F680_861A10F: "And here I am, fearing everyone is upset with me once again."
Dialogue.39D627E643E0D086CF75A9A29A7649D8_97A9259: "And in that light, I saw my mother..."
Dialogue.D9844BDA44B318EA47E4718E3FC75C39_06FC410: "And on the glorious day of the revelations, the final sign will manifest.
Dialogue.27E55CAE464C5F2EE1079691E82FD39A_06FC410: "And so with that, please feel like you can move on. I find myself doing the same. This is Phoebe, signing off."
Dialogue.D6917BDB48B2E3B76945C19585DE0B84_7712BEE: "And soon... our people will be free."
Dialogue.756416D4463F1BBBAC4B5AB597ED64AC_06FC410: "And we hope to fill your heart with warmth and light for years to come."
Dialogue.4F2D89434441CF6FA47A98A41AFFB2AC_06FC410: "And yes, all you love seekers, he's single."
Dialogue.BEE5FEBB4677D1BAFABA969B17E1577C_06FC410: "And you're being chained to the boiler and left to die by the campers of Owl Troop."
Dialogue.482287E340351E0B8CC0D4BF5E981BF2_87F0BBB: "Archaeology from A to Z: A Primer in Paleo."
Dialogue.5CD1F28645DACFCD6269A2A3FA9BB695_765440C: "Are they really a villain at all?"
Dialogue.32E6B66C4108FB8AB8F65DB2B0F73280_FB122F8: "Are you sick of other Homebases being too dry and too small?"
Dialogue.5C03B4EE478DF8CF85AD38A75F7E482E_DB7CBEB: "Are you the dude from Batquake? Say the thing!"
Dialogue.2E5CD59C439BA50C675A33AC720B6C70_06FC410: "As the last embers of your golden years fade away, one by one..."
Dialogue.EBF86F1842882B3BD2B0CB9F29E04053_D87E161: "Ask yourself what life would be like if everyone you know could enjoy the same Homebase at the same time."
Dialogue.9374485848728F04E5A899A83C7097B4_06FC410: "Because of that, how I affected him, in a way I live on through him. And it's okay for him to keep going."
Dialogue.41A12A4447D91DE1ADB2A4BFBBAC7122_861A10F: "But I know you will run from me."
Dialogue.32AC9820447DEE7E50A4E2939CC1534D_06FC410: "But my fate is my own. I can change my path..."
Dialogue.81134AAC4F04ADB23956EB87A4348F42_06FC410: "But the campers could never see past my hook hand."
Dialogue.0234A788449468002B5D7BB81E010702_06FC410: "But the older kids tied me to the dock as a prank..."
Dialogue.F5D00F9D4ED155087BEF99AB9B1FAFFE_06FC410: "But then your friends are getting married, having kids of their own..."
Dialogue.7BAAE08449E86DBFC8637A9B1E61A8F0_06FC410: "But your hair is yours. Keep it as short or as long as you want."
Dialogue.C825D06D45C098B6E5C6A48CA3FD54B4_06FC410: "But, I love you. If you tell anyone, I will cut you. Jess."
Dialogue.A871F66947E2E413AA486B9AF0730CE5_47CFF90: "By promptly activating your local reality destruction device."
Dialogue.BE48E4E440C154FF65013AAA13B2CF79_CC240C1: "Can you shoot fire out of your hands? Or water. Possibly wind?"
Dialogue.B15A8CAD49B08FAFC00767897F202D72_87F0BBB: "Chapter One - Advanced Archaeometry: A Philosophical Approach."
Dialogue.C94B07264847F23702779E8EA62692B5_06FC410: "Chilling Tales of Cowboy Suspense." Here you go, SEE-Bot.
Dialogue.5FC0163047D80867C8EF859157923349_06FC410: "Copyright by Gigantic Red X Map Company, Canny Valley."
Dialogue.BD145A02494378ACA855E785765648C7_47CFF90: "Cower in fear! We be comin' for ye treasures. Yours in plunder, Blakebeard and Keelhaul."
Dialogue.846759534CE794EBF834869D13042CF1_97A9259: "Dear Dennis Jr... smiley face, lobster, lightning bolt, lightning bolt, cat face, dancing girl... camel."
Dialogue.890557704A16FB199610ACA7C4CFAA93_97A9259: "Dear Dennis, I love my boyfriend Dennis, but I think I'm ready for a change."
Dialogue.06E500424A4E0858D9762BBAF3B8133D_861A10F: "Dear Diary.  It's in the evening, I think. The big circle in the sky has been scared away by the dark."
Dialogue.7D8F18454338F69FF085E1AB1BCCAFD9_861A10F: "Dear Diary. I am so excited, because I finally met someone."
Dialogue.7ED5A68A4FD58350BB5EA3B34DFFB9A6_861A10F: "Dear Diary. This new world is so big and frightening."
Dialogue.21BCBEBE48ACACB0873B6AACC1A5B3B6_861A10F: "Dear Diary. Today I thought I had finally made a friend."
Dialogue.8EB0EDCE4938993B3D763B8C949111B7_861A10F: "Dear Diary. What pains me the most is that my life is secret."
Dialogue.12A1C8DF4A34D63B08406690A1C0597F_06FC410: "Dear Phoebe, I lost my husband. It's the hardest thing ever and I don't know how to move on. Sincerely, Lost."
Dialogue.31BC676B424A117C924D7398889614B1_06FC410: "Dear Phoebe. My girlfriend doesn't like my hair short. How can I get my hair long quickly? Sincerely, Wigging Out."
Dialogue.50A060154B4F96EF4C1D8E95D7A27EB7_06FC410: "Dear Phoebe. My son doesn't think he needs a job. What should I do?"
Dialogue.38E7B9B4474F930C9C491F95959BE92A_97A9259: "Dennis, it's four in the morning. I have a family." And, "I'm throwing this phone away because of you."
Dialogue.B64CF62B432506555FAF9F819188A666_EC1949E: "Dinosaurs were big. Dinosaurs had skeletons. Skeletons were big."
Dialogue.F596DF0C4C99CC1898AA709151166AEE_FB122F8: "Disrupting Cyclogenesis in a Test Environment." Live from Rigour Fest. Remember that?
Dialogue.00D10A9F4756DD539561C5901E17052D_06FC410: "Distance runner Cassie Day learns there's no running from friendship, teamwork, and romance..."
Dialogue.25C5B58B4BCBCCB3441F35B3D8A02E11_06FC410: "Do you like me? Yes? No? Circle one."
Dialogue.4944F7A84B1C0D26507D72A3848AD134_D87E161: "Don't limit yourself to lifting your son. A daughter or even a neighbor can also be hoisted above your head."
Dialogue.5B010FDD4026DD30819FB285E629A0B7_FB122F8: "Don't think about the most direct route to Homebase, or the combined firepower of Homebase."
Dialogue.ACEABFAD4F399CD86342D9804C8D6AF9_47CFF90: "Don't worry. We'll hold down the fort."
Dialogue.8E070A034BCA1AA7B93ADC943E9FE7F4_47CFF90: "Drilling a hole in the patient's head to let the evil out, or in. Dealer's choice."
Dialogue.1D92AB9D4B5093A879FF0AA80935B70E_06FC410: "Due to my tendency to quote, 'stick my nose into things,' unquote... today I must leave you with one final column."
Dialogue.A7868B8B487BCCCB717E2492289198FB_97A9259: "ED-EE Stays the Course." "ED-EE Steers the Ship."
Dialogue.5C2DC87B4023177227748F84FC55AC40_FB122F8: "Econo-Lobe Standard Issue Brain-Smoothing Brine Powder. Just add water!"
Dialogue.CAEEAE0942F1D4DECCD4D291DD0E7831_97A9259: "Emotional soul-bonding as trusted caregiver and friend."
Dialogue.4F3E9B214A2338855D4DAFA84FF932B6_06FC410: "Enter WarBear ForgeForth, three-headed Elder of the NetherVoids."
Dialogue.DB74DC6B4DC56C4B0746B9B2881E06D3_06FC410: "Even building an entire unit of affordable housing he calls 'Clean Slates'."
Dialogue.8292553E4F8CE6C8929943B905A9B225_06FC410: "Exterior, dusk. A rippling mass of purple clouds swirl to cover the skies of a planet that is now nearly empty."
Dialogue.148660D7455F4FAEA690918B522DF133_06FC410: "Extermination is the sincerest form of flattery."
Dialogue.C2D73A12421A87006E7F99B275570025_06FC410: "Finally, a bat-based poisoning solution for your enemies and loved ones."
Dialogue.F05892A14F6EECBA4020FCA1D97971AC_47CFF90: "Find somewhere, anywhere else to be that's not near that crazy Christmas guy."
Dialogue.6A977B724A4B54F81BB213BA29B1EF2C_06FC410: "Flip the switch, the light comes on, and watch the bugs scatter toward their hidey holes."
Dialogue.2036C6064D921E291CC5A1AB8A0CF081_06FC410: "Football brought them together, but love isn't a game."
Dialogue.45B610DB40D3580660EBDC8A9CDF8B51_06FC410: "For restorative juicing and guided exploration of the lives you've ruined..."
Dialogue.C25CC40F48599D477621C3A43D0CCB47_DB7CBEB: "For the last time, they don't hang upside down."
Dialogue.C6A71F6C4EC0E95CD9AA719886993B71_97A9259: "For what it's worth?" It's worth everything!
Dialogue.2BA6A4BD470C09916D22FBA425738C9D_72190CE: "Fortune will truly shine on the buccaneer who finds it.”
Dialogue.658D5874461C0408EAB119875FF17B19_47CFF90: "Go on vacation," you said. "Take a little time to unwind," you said.
Dialogue.808F908E434059C80164BFA7A4FD07D8_72190CE: "Good for Blakebeard! He really found all that treasure he was looking for."
Dialogue.AF0DAFA74A8242EF2072B5B22592A8F2_B25EA52: "Have you seen my keys? A mid-surgery checklist."
Dialogue.AB2C1DC8463C944D663D74B963F38DDC_861A10F: "He really understands what it's like, to be a fish out of water..."
Dialogue.430549AE4604BA1363840399047998D5_861A10F: "He turned the fire on to something and it smelled so good! I could not help myself."
Dialogue.0ADBAF9444D273B5667F0DB5B3E9C9F7_B25EA52: "Heart surgery: It's not brain surgery." That's a classic.
Dialogue.10E17C8A44A8BA420F23588491F9F60A_FB122F8: "Here Lies Lars"... Whoa, you have me pegged to live 350 years?
Dialogue.E3AA95EB4E690A0940D76082D6EE21B1_89ED452: "Hexylvania: A Magical, Tragical History." It looks like a profile written for the town's anniversary or something.
Dialogue.37749D6E4947108A2929BB9E4BBB549F_06FC410: "Hey Hexsylvanians, you can run, but you can't hide for long! We're coming for you!"
Dialogue.14C93FBD437CE89CC74CB5812A55AC61_D87E161: "Hey hun," she said. "How would you like to make your own hours and be your own boss?"
Dialogue.A53F0F9C4BC13532FE28AD85E0D8FAB5_B222EAD: "Hi?" That's a hacky way to start, isn't it?
Dialogue.1E0ED99E4B0C435B673B1D97CD32CCA7_97A9259: "His application should be denied and he should be removed immediately."
Dialogue.43DABB7C425BA17A03A5E48A907495E1_06FC410: "His multi-horned translucent dragon Bartleby swoops in, landing with an icy roar."
Dialogue.D20F30A047CA023BCAA858B16ECD1012_06FC410: "How I long for the day I can once again raise my machete..."
Dialogue.32BC7C464D1BD6128E360392605E58D5_06FC410: "How to Be Concise: Volume 8 of a 12 Volume Set Regarding the Many Ways to Be Concise."
Dialogue.2442DB5E4BDCE904D6E0F5B814644C7C_DB7CBEB: "I am a bat scientist and a quake engineer... and I'm saying this is madness!"
Dialogue.027B52884031E6956FB1ECB0DBAD6FD3_06FC410: "I am a child of darkness and evil..."
Dialogue.FFA3B046421F0E268C64B48F463B77C7_06FC410: "I am a scourge of the seven seas and inspire fear in the hearts of stout, seafaring scoundrels."
Dialogue.65BABB0148EDE192AEE39B8D285F8719_861A10F: "I ate it. And then everything else in the room!"
Dialogue.7AB1201A4FBD72F0F7972FA4B54015E1_861A10F: "I can only share my thoughts with you in writing my words."
Dialogue.9688295E4CCB24C4ADDD56BA01C0A8BB_06FC410: "I did not dream of becoming a camp maniac."
Dialogue.4DB6E62B4CE37C453C4A0997DF99D569_21EB734: "I don't have super speed, but I am able to move so slowly that it looks like I am standing still."
Dialogue.289C7D024509DB4DEA4BBA94328E63C1_06FC410: "I dreamed of seeing the world. And becoming a veterinarian."
Dialogue.D3EF1A7546644CBEFDF0579B1057F91B_B222EAD: "I knew the Headless Horseman. Let me tell you about Napoleon. Blah, blah, Caesar."
Dialogue.583971AE4FAF57019791728F95AAD420_861A10F: "I know! I will devise a way to take him on a romantic trip in a rowboat for two. Classic. X O X O."
Dialogue.4965981547248073BDB02FA837C6AD16_06FC410: "I nearly broke up the band and blew it all." Lars continues, "But I learned to back off, and really listen to the guys."
Dialogue.949ACCC84925A8AC7C228BB365AAC3F6_06FC410: "I never asked to carry this machete bag."
Dialogue.AD794F514A45FA83CBF136846190B912_06FC410: "I poured my heart and soul into these campgrounds."
Dialogue.A125421743560D729C1C59B32D44DEA1_97A9259: "I think about moving on every day."
Dialogue.97F431304925B189CAC786BD640A700B_861A10F: "I try. Oh, Diary, I do try and want to make everyone happy but I just don't know how."
Dialogue.C65487014D584473DCB665940EC369AD_861A10F: "I want you to see behind my mask."
Dialogue.C6A4078D447569913793B78472E97B5C_06FC410: "I was born under a bad sign in the light of a blood red moon."
Dialogue.B243F611405CC688B6D26CB45A2B7641_06FC410: "I was the caretaker of Camp Shady Acres for fifteen years."
Dialogue.9E04688845BEC11C64DD04A7FD601E0D_97A9259: "I'd give zero stars if I could."
Dialogue.9B15919A4DEACA9D5634F1A2D86BE493_06FC410: "I'd want him to know that our time together changed me and I know it changed him, too."
Dialogue.D7AF27174EC82FE068C6758B491CCB42_06FC410: "I'm Sorry You Feel that Way: A Manager's Collection of Non-Answers."
Dialogue.BF7B1CBD43CAC1327761D8A9FAE4782F_06FC410: "I'm not comfortable in the spotlight." He finally says, his long brown hair rippling impishly in the wind.
Dialogue.8E8B5605471A8BA2D0B9D0BE1CA4A120_B222EAD: "I'm so spooky! Watch me throw things!" Pfft.
Dialogue.83C71C01432B2E17822BC09C6239A93F_06FC410: "If You've Got Time to Lean: Management Phrases Designed to Befuddle and Enrage."
Dialogue.FEF1A59F4B1CA786E5A5FF8C71C11497_765440C: "If a villain stokes trickery and strife and there are no citizens around to beg for mercy..."
Dialogue.53A401FB4AA0BB5894B19C835C7A7E8C_06FC410: "If anyone so much as flirts in my general direction, I will unleash my killing blade."
Dialogue.FA8EA5724089655216A63893F5EAF1DD_97A9259: "If lost civilizations had health and safety policies... their civilization might not have been lost."
Dialogue.2EB3181B4BD3A1427D535F971F402876_06FC410: "If something happened to me, I would want him to know that mourning me every day will not bring me back."
Dialogue.E584805D4DF59771713DBB9594A25552_CC240C1: "If you can control the elements, we need you!"
Dialogue.61EBA5C749899C529F5CDF8221984A07_47CFF90: "If you have flipped to this chapter to learn if workplace romances are acceptable, we have a three part answer."
Dialogue.EB7EA70944032F028E067B87A7859D76_97A9259: "In my professional opinion, Knox poses an immediate threat to the population of Homebase."
Dialogue.1E7E34C34AE1AA75E730EC92E25B4836_06FC410: "Including the cutting-edge VR experience, 'You're breaking your poor mother's heart.'"
Dialogue.95DE3F814E4FB43CFA020188D0A2E183_06FC410: "Intentionally have a terrible Christmas." There's a difference, heh.
Dialogue.16A9316344A32313968C509870F83C2A_06FC410: "Is It Five Already? The Power of Passive-Aggressive Leadership."
Dialogue.200C24734D6212F21995DDA3465D4DB6_06FC410: "It makes things brighter, but light also let's you see all the roaches you didn't even know were there."
Dialogue.2B206C804FAA9542A56C78BE1A9C4ABC_06FC410: "Keeping the town safe and happy with well-maintained local parks and picnic areas."
Dialogue.3CF2CF624ACB72F4A66193AD24FCB42F_97A9259: "Knox's choice of profession signals a total lack of empathy..."
Dialogue.D720B7FA427D0670042BEC9E037CCD28_21C1927: "Let me just pull it up on my phone."
Dialogue.054751CB4A2C411AB6E21FA279EFF4E8_06FC410: "Listen, Wigging Out. If your girlfirend doesn't like short hair, tell her she can grow her own hair as long as she wants."
Dialogue.DB1020564D9D107EDC44E3B18D384466_06FC410: "Love Potion." Oh! That could be something!
Dialogue.1B2AFFD348BA4562A0528CAF7FF959DB_21C1927: "May I take your coat?" What do you do?
Dialogue.C70AEE78499F75C2AA598AA0BCDE7A1F_861A10F: "Maybe I'll sit at an empty table," he thought.
Dialogue.8D682A5145F3048C67AE008BA43AD3DE_861A10F: "Misunderstood, like me. Oh, but when I get around him I don't know what to talk about."
Dialogue.A880756B4F9A538FAD63408616DA1024_06FC410: "Monsters of your creation?" What does that mean?
Dialogue.374305514BC75969C05873B745420E14_06FC410: "Mr. Burdette has gotten quite the reputation for aiding those in need..."
Dialogue.B1760EFB418C3536CCEC69894365C802_06FC410: "Must?" No one says "Must." You're doing a bit.
Dialogue.E8814B3A41AB82F5D98C9FBFA4D47CD3_87F0BBB: "My Truck Broke Down and So Did My Faith in You," or...
Dialogue.A1302A0A46B2BF7CA6869694FC08F5F3_06FC410: "My dearest Summer. Hello. It's your secret admirer, Dennis."
Dialogue.85F27F504101DDE422742EA3330D27F8_06FC410: "My mission was to spread positivity, but now your faithful Phoebe is mostly positive people are fighting a war."
Dialogue.18853BF04CC4FE4E4B134AAA63417074_06FC410: "No judgements. No rules. No consequences. Juice cleanse included."
Dialogue.AE1831BD43F505C1051119966F5C672A_06FC410: "No one sets out to become a slasher."
Dialogue.287A1D944182C0EF902925A8F2D3340A_97A9259: "No" was the better answer. Let's remember the "no," and forget the "not yet."
Dialogue.B0A43F694A8D3E6CFC2114AE665AC448_B222EAD: "Not even to save everyone I've ever known from oblivion?"
Dialogue.8BAC9A1C4027E630991689A133150860_06FC410: "Now both my ego and my clothes are stained!"

Dialogue.71659B1D42B55D2786AB91B4A545DC73_06FC410: Ha! I should have done this years ago!
Dialogue.9DA2BDC54A5F8C688F9A2E87F4947361_97A9259: Ha! Love having it rain something *useful* for once!
Dialogue.428C400543BE3C437559C4A0F1C668B1_06FC410: Ha! Not any more it isn't.
Dialogue.DA669D7544BD505D305263A6377D23B3_97A9259: Ha! Okay, that felt pretty good! And as the good feeling is being… replaced… yeah! By "Sour-Empty-Stomach." There it is!
Dialogue.822C0BD8413F135431E5A0960B1BF289_72190CE: Ha! She's gonna to be so jealous!
Dialogue.474071334C2375E51FF893AC0D5A817A_06FC410: Ha! They can't get rid of her that easily!
Dialogue.E8A088E04585CE3FB3AA448C1B6BBD5B_724DAF1: Ha! You're more than your past!
Dialogue.5C79C85C40754F770E160593F18794BE_94F2B66: Ha, exactly like I would’ve done it. Congrats, soldier.
Dialogue.E1C6100745EAAFF8E12BD0B48E54C92C_97A9259: Ha, excellent! Time to get to work.
Dialogue.84FAA1A841D68D3C2E0152BD3DFAF37D_97A9259: Ha, sorry. Gotta wait out the ad.
Dialogue.794296DF43518B3FD0773093224AB248_06FC410: Had him listen to all the albums, dress in the clothes,
Dialogue.766BA6624FF7F31D35D0D7B62E1FEA87_DCC8D4F: Hah! Another one feels my wrath!
Dialogue.3167659242A73A5EB3ECEEAF14CBA771_579B086: Hah, got my name on it.
Dialogue.7E823EED4B2696D41915A59EADA525CB_EAAE146: Hah... We found it. We found it!
Dialogue.C9D42F384AFE97029D90808EEA99FFC0_06FC410: Haha! How'd ya like them peaches, husk?
Dialogue.3851B24A4ECD40434B304C9DD9D10584_7D2960E: Haha! I know that pleases the court!
Dialogue.309EE0AD4B095B6F04A5E8A757F9A1A7_D87E161: Haha! It's good to be back.
Dialogue.0DC5592A44389DF99E0E82822251A18D_37EFC25: Haha! Let's see the Easter Bunny do that! Stupid Easter Bunny.
Dialogue.DCFB348946D6199FCA22E4A880CDCFCC_47CFF90: Haha! That's how you do it!
Dialogue.16B0DF8F4FF7C645EF2892B6EFA1D6BF_1D2FE88: Haha! This is box office gold! Someone take notes.
Dialogue.CB6907554743EB07926056BD94426503_DA0538A: Haha! You haven’t seen the last of Saint Nicholas yet.
Dialogue.A554A97445F65552778A2FB78D3ECD28_C0E27E7: Haha, bullets. I'm halfway to a well-regulated militia.
Dialogue.B2C098444A2878653DDFF299D6957B33_CC9154B: Haha. Hahahaha. Ahaha... ah, I miss gravity.
Dialogue.57CE4DB24B29883B32F8618184F1D724_06FC410: Hahaha! You gotta be ready for anything.
Dialogue.A217E8A844581AD211A98E814EE4EB7E_94F2B66: Half the time they can't even remember their own names…
Dialogue.5DA311514A6C446A225C34B09CCD578E_84C369E: Hammers, saws... (gasp) There's even a level!
Dialogue.91FCC0044F848ECCD7A07A81C79CA2B8_72190CE: Hand over the gold before we cut you some ribbons!
Dialogue.911C87BE4279A4C7DCF3AF93F2D5FE4B_FB122F8: Hands up if the Homebase Bee called you "Leading Man Material."
Dialogue.B0EFCA3C4900682EFE11D7B03D91D263_910A467: Hands up if you're still in space but don't want to be.
Dialogue.B9B506F44906FE3A922B35A0E954B0B9_DB7CBEB: Hands up if you've been called "Comedy's Newest Shining Star!"
Dialogue.6E1663FE4B8BD1CB2AF64D8B2B05D362_AB3C42C: Hands up if you've been called "Our Greatest Living Treasure!"
Dialogue.2E8FF83B422FD782C9A1E99C82845212_06FC410: Hang in there, Pop. We're coming!
Dialogue.D5051AE7442626473CDB24A5151D0092_06FC410: Hang in there, buddy. We'll find you.
Dialogue.152188E64FB4E0826E6BEEAE65CC4138_21523A0: Hang me by the chimney with great care!
Dialogue.C4D0C2474256F1EA49C9FFA23439E5BD_FB122F8: Hang on! If your team completes the job, you're back in the game!
Dialogue.6464ED5B4DB19721DE751E9AB4AC7AF7_861A10F: Hang on, someone’s left a note. In a bottle, naturally.
Dialogue.E27AE3264879405A5F680DB856B2C816_06FC410: Hang on, your voice sounds weird.
Dialogue.99E1A27444026F0AAE7A6C8289061E66_FB122F8: Hang on. It's not just the portals that are stabilizing. I think the curse field dispersed a little bit, too.
Dialogue.6F5F6FC24281DCBF042721975F46974A_47CFF90: Hang on. Let me open the door first.
Dialogue.EDCC19484952DD58416B07AB50C69561_06FC410: Hang on... he has analog to mechanical out.
Dialogue.5FF0057C4DD900FEEB741D982E1AE81B_06FC410: Hang tight, Commander. I'll figure something out.
Dialogue.9052480C4913F1298EA952A7A98C683A_3D2D55D: Hang tight. We're gonna take care of it.
Dialogue.6609EA2F481E9C31082D3087D825F28C_FB122F8: Hanging out. Hitting the beach. Maybe hitting some summer parties together.
Dialogue.9336F7524472CF0F7529EBBFE538293C_861A10F: Happy Christmas! No more bombs, alright?
Dialogue.3F5BF6454B7EB68D6B6F65A5DBB026CB_47CFF90: Happy Holidays from all of us at Homebase.
Dialogue.F5FF5E304C8290851987D6A26C5307CC_B222EAD: Happy Holidays! Here's a gift for you!
Dialogue.E6F6B3774F8A82F7415798989956033A_47CFF90: Has anyone at Homebase passed the psychological profile?
Dialogue.589B43C14D75A38485DB53A9664B4CF9_FB122F8: Has anyone read the script? It is unfilmable and shockingly R rated.
Dialogue.792FA9644584CABF44323DADA6643CD8_06FC410: Has it been longer than ten minutes?
Dialogue.B6804D5F48DF0944473200BC5A0A2D8F_FB122F8: Hate to break it to you but this actually says, "The Rest of Dennis."
Dialogue.42E63E3147271899DAC75994D645921D_97A9259: Have I gone fully meta? Am I in a time loop?
Dialogue.51E2455A4B98A0DB190907AF4C758EE2_B222EAD: Have him meet me by the shore, and tell him to come alone.
Dialogue.BED06EA6434830E9C5F8EF8D83BD2287_1FCF39D: Have my squire fetch some ammo.
Dialogue.D8E7F96949ACFD4845557CB91026665B_910A467: Have we considered that flinger’s point of view?
Dialogue.C78B796D41E4FC3F6AB3F38365D1B72C_E090F2A: Have we reached the scary part yet?
Dialogue.FAE7C51D4FC0AD735A5B6291D8624874_06FC410: Have you been robbing everyone and dumping their things in the garbage?
Dialogue.EE04E831438DE66A46E7ED836DD0950E_47CFF90: Have you considered making the caravan a convertible?
Dialogue.B74E09EC42AE94DC9F0F0F9958EC7600_1D2FE88: Have you died with us before? No?
Dialogue.6ADEBF9B4238D4131FD70ABE64FBFDB8_14FBFB1: Have you even tried looking in the shadows?
Dialogue.FE9D8F8148DEB474B90756ADA4D08B98_8106785: Have you ever seen a husk? I haven't.
Dialogue.B361908C41BC2C34B714BEA8C1C47009_47CFF90: Have you ever thought about being a hero?
Dialogue.1025A5424116DE79BE34188B5143EC2E_94F2B66: Have you filed the Tidings Distribution forms?
Dialogue.5F8DF8824D7434575D5CA1A3E8011AC2_CC240C1: Have you or a loved one been exposed to radioactive bees?
Dialogue.8963E84F488CB9F22977C684957B9533_06FC410: Have you seen the numbers for Radio Free Plankerton?
Dialogue.3F0D250C40C0F01D6007A789AC9CDED7_B222EAD: Have you seen the people I'm around?
Dialogue.0E7D065A4F01E4CF1D2FD18FC7B1F440_06FC410: Have your tried the Storm Shield Endurance simulation accessible from the computer?
Dialogue.0D4E611F4D49D3BE8DA26F9E377ADF72_21523A0: Have yourself some shiny little presents.
Dialogue.B1A6F6F84319CFD10B391EBD51204441_87F0BBB: Haven't you ever heard that saying, "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail?"
Dialogue.DBD1234C4C54244B96D5DE955F587BEA_47CFF90: Having a range of peg legs that look suitable with a tuxedo or cocktail dress is essential for making sure you're not turned away.
Dialogue.C730F40A4BCCF5C9DF7CC18022F181D4_06FC410: Having secrets isn't what's making everyone sick. It's the holding them in that's doing it. The shame.
Dialogue.7065852140AF01F72FA147BF12740F9D_21C1927: He ain't shot nobody in weeks, and he is feelin' real jumpy,  ha!
Dialogue.D77ADFC9445FFDA33F56A58A6779856C_06FC410: He also decreed that all trees of a paper bearing age must be burned.
Dialogue.5EE2D5BB45B65CB661A3DEB5AA5A7468_861A10F: He breaks down my fort... I rebuild it, heh.
Dialogue.48ED24D141A0AE4D5F11399B222E4A46_97A9259: He brightens your day, and he curdles your milk.
Dialogue.29990370425E3249E16BA6A5961E83BE_06FC410: He brought us together for a reason.
Dialogue.CDEE2B284ECDA148793C908C70986586_06FC410: He can interface with abacuses, slide rules, and player pianos.
Dialogue.306BF85C42E5F9CB57085B9D2597D2CF_861A10F: He clips his toenails in the middle of the room no matter who is around.
Dialogue.6F74FE5F4F122687A035C6BCB1ED7725_06FC410: He commissioned statues, works of art, and even created two daily papers.
Dialogue.93E860A147E9019AFD117EB992007452_06FC410: He could build them all into a tall tower and lord his collection of cherry pie filling over everyone else.
Dialogue.ABA86D254B9F52F571493D9062C18A0D_72190CE: He couldn't find it, but we will.
Dialogue.AF9327074037C950DDE1D4B635AA53D3_B222EAD: He couldn't see me... but I was mature about it.
Dialogue.DE3B786C4489894DD03650953D09456C_D87E161: He cried. But you can't hide on the roof of a car. We've explained this how many times?
Dialogue.260126314D8DA9F9A59E0E955D5BC9B1_47CFF90: He crossed the road for help, Lars. Help never came.
Dialogue.EA3116CD4407B5D57F1131BF8D7BB319_4731F06: He did save my life so... time beggars can't be time choosers.
Dialogue.03575B264C3E25A53E11A1B415A47B10_FB122F8: He did what he thought needed to be done.
Dialogue.EBFE907848585D5CB2A77288E876AAFD_FB122F8: He did. And that triggered the Dennis Redundancy Program.
Dialogue.029F5F1A44A8F771247A9F91D47D8C18_97A9259: He does have a pretty baller cable package.
Dialogue.18004A3A4C8C1BCE525E859F904C3D1F_06FC410: He does not see SEE-Bot, so that response means he's working.
Dialogue.8ADDD1D148C7069393FD14A8DFFD5C9A_CC240C1: He doesn't know dinosaurs went extinct?
Dialogue.57C5E0BD4422DCC8DDD9D4A82AD8A198_06FC410: He doesn't mean you, Dire. You're not a fleabag.
Dialogue.533BA5064B7BFF6DA803CCBE9C10F99F_B222EAD: He doesn't want to move on to the next world.
Dialogue.2EB0AC424ACF90FDFBAEE39A3F6AB33F_FB122F8: He doesn't... but I have an idea. There's nothing spookier than a good ol' fashioned campfire story!
Dialogue.D3644ECF401E1BBD80D0859068EE096A_CC240C1: He finds himself on a mission to destroy closets for reasons the bot cannot yet understand.
Dialogue.0DA08CC24182FA3CEB37C5A05615EABC_97A9259: He gathers together a group of his friends... no skills, clueless...
Dialogue.65B5162340C139688291449279AA984E_06FC410: He has a bomb under Homebase, Lars!
Dialogue.84179E514BD3515F8447F8949742AA1D_B68F328: He has an army behind him.
Dialogue.F73EE53E40ED40E6D48D07B30C49B367_06FC410: He is for sure a monster.
Dialogue.2071F4A14863B79A502585BF2E1B2177_97A9259: He is very regal, and the court physician's userpery was beneath the conduct of a true mycopian king.
Dialogue.5D53AA9142AEA494383EF190B0DD0895_D87E161: He is way too hot to be Dennis' son.
Dialogue.F48CB6C14795D9922D38CB9E07826F63_FB122F8: He just strolled right through my windshield.
Dialogue.3DE6D3ED476F9B1747EB63B449A64CB5_06FC410: He knows about ten thousand rock facts, and he is very literal.
Dialogue.FC9CF6ED44E089D4F39FAA878FAC4EDE_CC240C1: He knows he must warn his friends and loved ones...
Dialogue.21164C8444AEE515D93A5998FCE084E9_CC240C1: He knows we're all happier when he leaves.
Dialogue.793A50984D7F5D06A78095BDA85D1C45_94F2B66: He left it on the side of the road in a little town way up in the mountains.
Dialogue.142E5233402497FC8E5F1FA29296B2AF_861A10F: He looked at the sporty kids. No, they'd never let him sit down.
Dialogue.7548386B44D5716BA1EAA4A96DA34493_7D2960E: He looks at me and goes, "Says here you can fight. Can you keep your mouth shut?"
Dialogue.6D243877478FD762440E82ABD3AE436A_97A9259: He loves it so much. And, honestly, he doesn't seem to mind being on fire.
Dialogue.0B9999BD47F144BDD8AFB39E640E39C0_1D2FE88: He loves pushing. Almost as much as pulling.
Dialogue.AC21B9104B34346667494196CA8020AD_06FC410: He may be a while. Keep up the search, Commander!
Dialogue.F2652B8E4F5D9D89625D74A0167B7C63_06FC410: He may have the Vinderman AI somewhere in his brain.
Dialogue.3C582836459B9179E0E7AF8B0DB6189A_06FC410: He means he watched a lot of holiday movies.
Dialogue.259C10864B92F7A3D8DF33A6531EA2CE_861A10F: He might be sick. Can you check on him?
Dialogue.55A384004C4D8E5D13B8889257900F87_EAAE146: He missed my birthday for twenty five consecutive years for geocaching?!
Dialogue.15ECDBCA4E56255A2BD23696B28C9BAF_14FBFB1: He must not see the syllabus!
Dialogue.C0DCB4AA430BB453077153896CD82DC0_14FBFB1: He must take this journey through the darkness... alone.
Dialogue.0C394DDC47B343542A3A6BAF430A93BD_1D2FE88: He pioneered a radical building style based entirely upon confusing rabid racoons.
Dialogue.3D9A84314DE18EAB8410349F4A688F0E_06FC410: He plans to release a swarm of drones...
Dialogue.927177E94F8DB4A34F1730B79E6BEC8D_861A10F: He reached into his machete bag...
Dialogue.DC2AC6F04DD84325EBBA0AA9CF8C0C75_B229E47: He really was very certain you would know what that means.
Dialogue.420687FF491833E8125A37AAE093416B_72190CE: He repaired wagons. Of course he doesn't care.
Dialogue.D6AC2E1349161459D70BF983854C3F1D_06FC410: He roams the plains, grazing on beans the rest of his days.
Dialogue.BFBFF137416996B91F62A699301DF897_06FC410: He said he was having a handsome day, so he sent a lot of pictures.
Dialogue.3140DB46451E90C0E7A6FF8F031A8279_97A9259: He said he's "taking a moment for himself."
Dialogue.30BDE31949C97BC19242588CE338DC07_06FC410: He said salads, Dire. Like... plants?
Dialogue.F6C5750A490618EA5C0961AF787C3C24_06FC410: He said to say thank you.
Dialogue.2637A65745B6BCB156A53981F5C3843E_FB122F8: He saw me walk away from our friendship just to stay up on that stage.
Dialogue.81886DDC4050667BB6238A86786779A0_CC240C1: He says don't worry. Ghost Hunter Dennis--
Dialogue.702DBB5E4E4F5F31DAAB9F8E7B120EE0_CC240C1: He says he's cleansing the hotel grounds of demons.
Dialogue.800CB8334D58E652AC65C986A0D554C9_06FC410: He says the storm came without warning..
Dialogue.7F3F777B4BC7BBE145E24BBEBF6606A6_06FC410: He says this is where it started.
Dialogue.6AF63EBB45BD4FF4F31D018F90BF47F5_06FC410: He says yes he is, love is an illusion, and we all die alone.
Dialogue.00A7C7B942F7689356A1DBA95F253C87_47CFF90: He seems to think he is.
Dialogue.95F7BBD946BEBDE16D7CA2A38FCE98A4_06FC410: He seems to think that's made him wise or somethin'.
Dialogue.400F063D4113413EB676E7BC1FB1FE1A_DA0538A: He sees you when you’re sleeping… Heh heh heh heh heh...
Dialogue.FED8CB47414CC4ABF35F319C20372A9B_DA0538A: He sees you when you’re sleeping… Heh heh heh heh heh...
Dialogue.490F456847BF8A8764DBBE86A9FB7EBB_7D086D9: He should have shown me the evidence. He was a scientist. He knew better.
Dialogue.BB0E4FC141BDB51725E5DA909974888F_181CD3E: He sold terribly, but that's just because I was hitting a little too close to home for "some people," y'know?
Dialogue.6110CAD9402CD7A5FE5AB984D415943F_06FC410: He stopped responding... but I'm sure he has his reasons.
Dialogue.F5AD2CDB42CDB4E8E62D81B70C240912_89ED452: He told me to pull you back. And I... I didn't believe him. I assumed he was just trying to one-up us like usual.
Dialogue.64C0AE8443B9DD968425D2AA14F0E8D6_06FC410: He tortured the journal's writer, then his friends and family, then the shop keep who sold the journal...
Dialogue.5A2E21924E80A03F58A9A59087911B52_97A9259: He wants to eat me? OH MY GOD. Now I get everything everyone's been saying to me.
Dialogue.A302CBBC40A7C1044EA669AAF6E9F579_7D086D9: He was a brilliant man but that doesn't mean everything he did was right.
Dialogue.D5B1596F487453805AF0EBBE066BF3AD_AB3C42C: He was built to keep deep space crews from killing each other.
Dialogue.D729BB944EE47074E5CBF8A5CC2784F6_06FC410: He was disbarred for embezzlement of client funds.
Dialogue.D55DEEE1484146C85060A49501FC35A6_06FC410: He was either trying to spell "Film bed every woof!"
Dialogue.3B089C5D4017B4C1F351E786B84B79DC_06FC410: He was getting on everyone's nerves, so I sent him on a little trip.
Dialogue.453EF0544E4A1821707C0B93296A231F_06FC410: He was not kidding about needing a structured environment.
Dialogue.FE1D1FE74B57E1CB879B2494BB1A8F1D_9801E98: He was talking about Blackboot Ayers...
Dialogue.8C2EFBDD465D2C879456D9984EA61829_AB3C42C: He was the only thing that kept the cast sane.
Dialogue.150188B649979712EAA528B6CF41BBBB_06FC410: He wasn't just smashing headstones... he was collecting letters.
Dialogue.442F89B14DF4D9961BCF0FAB87070C24_97A9259: He won't be able to respond, but he can hear you.
Dialogue.FF17755E4109AE024E9824B9FA16E140_47CFF90: He won't be satisfied unless he's optimized and strategized Homebase until there is nothing left.
Dialogue.F563F4CF45C0AAD56865219C998FDFD5_06FC410: He would never tell anyone about me taking my body for a jaunt.
Dialogue.6ABDC8EE4F645433BC0BB28846BAFFCA_176484F: He'll be able to come back, give us all the intel we need, and head back to his own time...
Dialogue.EB9D6C894084E779FCFC8687EA210764_FB122F8: He'll be alright. Check out this data the Commander's collecting.
Dialogue.5E52950D441807F6749141B01534C6C6_06FC410: He's a drummer. The full experience.
Dialogue.B39B2A5F4AB3BADE3CDA96A51BCA2B82_9D00593: He's a little intense, but there's nothing he won't do in exchange for a first born.
Dialogue.B03EA012425779BF37C85D8C3A6A1406_97A9259: He's a scientist, the world needs him. Me? I'm nothing.
Dialogue.463D74E34AE02DC01124058A0F4F9698_06FC410: He's a tough little robot... he'll be okay. I hope.
Dialogue.86CE7CC844502A46200C87BD4068F8CB_06FC410: He's a tragedy and I'm a monster for failing him as a creator.
Dialogue.1E73E24247B567D4FC7CE2A19222AA63_06FC410: He's around. He's just having a hard time.
Dialogue.C64DDB27471D7FC9705E4AA136550E9A_06FC410: He's back! How did you do it?
Dialogue.F2C78F154B561C205F154B926FD4CC50_724DAF1: He's been absolutely destroying clubs across the country, and today...
Dialogue.7E6BBAE7449450876B562AAEC025BDAA_06FC410: He's been having non stop bad dreams.
Dialogue.41E25EE54491C2B128313EBEDBFA5B80_94F2B66: He's been rushed to Blackwell Memorial... but it doesn't look good. I'm sorry.
Dialogue.B0FDF173439DD6F755F1CD8E2D1338FD_071921D: He's big, and I don't think I like him!
Dialogue.E55A5C4D404E89A915A382A1210A6BC7_DCC9B6A: He's big, he's blue, and he's here to wreck our walls!
Dialogue.A1B0B6A14E621D3E70EC33ADE6DB2B55_87F0BBB: He's developed a healthy fear of me.
Dialogue.982CC15548F42FBBA58D18B7E4E90DA6_06FC410: He's down! Strike Team A, get in position!
Dialogue.D677E2F44A0603C4D15BAE974308FEA7_EC1949E: He's finding his way in the world, and that's no easy task these days. He just needs love.
Dialogue.F93FC9E44E6592C10C69F0BE764DF03A_06FC410: He's found a group of survivors in Gravestone.
Dialogue.F8F157FF4DF391D8246E979B0D5F8867_861A10F: He's getting used to the polo shirt.
Dialogue.2026431D4B116D88E67A889367B2E4F7_CC240C1: He's going for the face! The face! Ah ha ha ha ha!
Dialogue.9B08C7DA428EB8FFB315A3BE8BB8328F_21C1927: He's gonna need a lot of tea after that.
Dialogue.E3A43CC948C5789E624EC98AA527DE0E_97A9259: He's got an alarming holiday-themed weapons stockpile...
Dialogue.C3E232BF48181EBD6248D0953AA35026_6E5AC35: He's gotten right to the smashing!
Dialogue.031483A549B65B4AF0717DA6830ECE35_7712BEE: He's in lurk debt. Give him time.
Dialogue.7C564CE34953D7F45C9A118FEB27553C_CC240C1: He's just environmentalist propaganda used to brainwash kids into planting trees.
Dialogue.219B166E49077FCCB8C35D8B2B397959_EECA944: He's just flinging things everywhere, isn't he?
Dialogue.AC3FDFDB423F53E200E5ED9B8AB2DC78_1D2FE88: He's just this fire smasher I know...
Dialogue.679DDE5E4320C24051803F9110B0B82A_1D2FE88: He's just toying with you. There's more! There's always more.
Dialogue.DABA27B64C2C1FDC109982875E11CA30_EC1949E: He's not a child robot. He's a learning AI.
Dialogue.C14E01B5446F0C3B5ED149B742F16165_EAAE146: He's not a monster. He's my brother.

Dialogue.DCF8FBDE45FB92A3FCFF289CB6DED01B_97A9259: Huh? Oh. (gasp) Oh no! Oh, I've been using it so much!

Dialogue.A8C4325D448483E47AA82C89994D14E9_06FC410: Humanity definitely is not locked in an epic struggle against a ceaseless wave of monsters...
Dialogue.19EF3AA34AB6CF4120EB95A606474DC4_97A9259: Humanity does not have a strong record of learning from past mistakes.
Dialogue.AF133C794BD9D9AA89379086CF2EDD1E_CC240C1: Humanity must now unlock the secret of the age...
Dialogue.D374D84D4157EBFF919582929FCF17C7_06FC410: Hurricane level, name it and leave town, type storm activity.
Dialogue.2596E2B945A4458721DB78B421F280FD_2A04943: Hurry it up out there Ramirez!
Dialogue.5CCD884A45B855CD7AA9418ED9AB6B21_06FC410: Hurry up and take out those husks!
Dialogue.8A5082C54078784164DED8B743A65DE7_97A9259: Hurry up, Willow. We're dyin' out here.
Dialogue.201BDDD34A01864B198C46AD2D6E5BA4_910A467: Husk! I have no immediate feelings on the matter, but I thought you’d like to know.
Dialogue.23FBBE984D14CDCB6CBBF3BB0A132F93_06FC410: Husks and storm creatures corrupt any hardware they touch. Let's keep them away from that balloon.
Dialogue.9BA8620248926BF75479B9BF993D72D7_DCC8D4F: Husks are falling around us, find the flinger!
Dialogue.8C6F544B4B6CFFBF79BEE2B1F3E20CBD_06FC410: Husks can't be clever enough to plan things, can they?
Dialogue.638681114BA84A8FC3AE669851CFBA42_06FC410: Husks incoming! Get ready to fight!
Dialogue.EC2531124DDBA601D17480B62DAB1B96_72190CE: Husks starboard... uh, p- port side? J- just look out!
Dialogue.56B8EB43438953070CC47FBB3514F52B_A96EA86: I - I'm being dead serious right now. Do you believe me?
Dialogue.FA13D68F46D690913E9B4A8CEFC20511_97A9259: I AM NO CHICKEN, FOOLISH HUMAN! I am a wolf!
Dialogue.EAF82E7E436E2790A0AD4E94716502A0_B25AF7B: I AM SEA-ING… LAND. LAND HO.
Dialogue.75FEDCCA4CD179B4EBF0088059EBE2E3_FDAEB92: I DO NOT SEE A THUMB.
Dialogue.5A316F4A4C6BD7D41630E69C265695A3_FDAEB92: I HAVE SEEN YOUR PIGS, YOUR COWS, AND YOUR GLOWING HORSES.
Dialogue.61EAA0C34C7AC1C66336468E0FBBC14A_FDAEB92: I HAVE SEEN YOUR ROMANCES. I HAVE SEEN YOUR HOMES. I HAVE SEEN YOUR BUSINESSES.
Dialogue.3ED39AAE4B393BA405ACA8AE414DD12E_B222EAD: I KNOW where the line is.
Dialogue.93FB217948E6592C67693C95AC474A0C_D4BB04C: I MEAN FIFTY PERCENT CHANCE OF SHOWERS IN THE LATE AFTERNOON.
Dialogue.26D0AFC6455F630CD6DB7490189CD312_FDAEB92: I MUST SEE IT SAFELY HOME.
Dialogue.99184B93458E4AC29E634D9125F0E27A_97A9259: I ONCE FAKED MY OWN DEATH TO GET OUT OF A PARKING TICKET.
Dialogue.3C06F17344EB46BE12505588894D02FC_FDAEB92: I REALLY NEEDED A WIN TODAY.
Dialogue.57F89CC647DA3252F7F240B962CA11C5_FDAEB92: I SEE A BASE UNDER THE SAND!
Dialogue.3CFED2924C2B545D4222DDA14A7E8594_FDAEB92: I SEE A GREAT WISDOM WITHIN ME THAT BELONGS TO THE WORLD.
Dialogue.84675F074C880CAFFB274BBDABFEBFC0_FDAEB92: I SEE A JOURNEY OF FIVE THOUSAND MILES.
Dialogue.DC9B36F943E2BC63AF26FFAA59354CB2_8C46C95: I SEE A ROCKET. A NEW SHIELD.
Dialogue.86FCF1F54F6B136CA0E90CA1A330CCE9_FDAEB92: I SEE ALL THE MYSTERIES OF THE WORLD! WHY? AND OW!
Dialogue.798B15F64421458928261181D8CA8986_B25AF7B: I SEE AN UNWAVERING DEATH GLARE. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.8546697A4A70056F04FBBA9E1892D908_B25AF7B: I SEE DEFLECTION. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.FE2849564E26DFD42062CA922EA1065D_B25AF7B: I SEE DISHONESTY. MINUS FIVE POINTS.
Dialogue.70FF5C1D4B6165CC3442C280F8A4EB9F_B25AF7B: I SEE HOSTILITY. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.7FAE279248B7155ACE928C84570C4906_B25AF7B: I SEE INTIMACY ISSUES. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.BCA2982046D1AEC2D411F3BB09B67C84_FDAEB92: I SEE IT WHEN I CLOSE MY EYE.
Dialogue.87020EAC4873A64150798EBB64DBB8C2_FDAEB92: I SEE MY BLUFF HAS BEEN CALLED.
Dialogue.72A61994451C5116214B5AB204A39BBC_B25AF7B: I SEE SARCASM. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.B8F80ED442D760C5FCA11998F51D42A6_B25AF7B: I SEE UNCERTAINTY. MINUS TWO POINTS.
Dialogue.16DC300448FBA83F8E3340ACF5659895_FDAEB92: I SEE WHERE THIS IS GOING.
Dialogue.3456F88A486FD4D0FD985390C7175155_FDAEB92: I SEE YOU HAVE FORGOTTEN ABOUT LAST WEEK.
Dialogue.F82AA9244EDCB37940D18A9F7C33FDBF_FDAEB92: I THREW MY EYE IN THE GARBAGE.
Dialogue.C2BF284E4C0D60D68614218106CA881F_CC240C1: I TOLD YOU IT WAS REAL AND NO ONE LISTENED.
Dialogue.6661AE2847CA9F092B3E2E974B095C05_97A9259: I absolutely love that we're doing this! But why are we doing this?
Dialogue.8CD8EE9C467BB8A61A3281A67C7AE504_861A10F: I actually found it quite pleasant.
Dialogue.8EBB1D1A4EAA31C4472015B4413F2A74_06FC410: I actually have a history in the theater.
Dialogue.C8CB0BE54B1DCFDBAB2DFAB169A16098_47CFF90: I admire your commitment, but this doesn't need to be a deep cover assignment, Major.
Dialogue.B35FC5F34E1130721339D89A13AB6864_5991012: I agitated the storm by existing between two worlds.
Dialogue.601B774145A8AF05FFD728988F2BA6FE_06FC410: I agree that this is a bad plan, but...I mean, that's not generally a thing that stops us.
Dialogue.AE6BBA7942D56D2FB9E32A9A3DC976A1_06FC410: I agree with the content of what you're saying, but maybe not the tone.
Dialogue.01EDBBDC41B881AE17E6CC9056DBF10D_97A9259: I agree with your energy but do not follow your logic.
Dialogue.5C13EF1E433781F4A7B5998D1AF7B0C2_14FBFB1: I almost pity the mist monsters.
Dialogue.AC06063F4CA2D1459023C0AE07F125D3_97A9259: I already do the opposite of what I think I should do. Except when I don't? Or when I forget. Or when I double opposite on accident.
Dialogue.86EFD2564A427316405B3C8C1CB53F3A_FB122F8: I already have that issue, but good find.
Dialogue.300F229E41E626F1A445A9B580514AC1_06FC410: I already know that's an insult.
Dialogue.884765A7491F5FB1A5D2309D22F3F464_06FC410: I already like it better than the catacombs.
Dialogue.EB8970834B33A60ECD4B8881989C8A89_97A9259: I also am coming, as part of my duty to help the people of Homebase.
Dialogue.1E2765B2445D5762BCC74BAC275B03E9_B25AF7B: I also beep when my battery is running low.
Dialogue.C338209F43DB77B75DD339B596C0A819_06FC410: I also have no idea what you're doing. What are you doing?
Dialogue.4D32614746BABB57BC09D3A17E4E8D5F_9D00593: I also know if they're naughty or nice!
Dialogue.6C0569344365BCEF0F2696837083E2AF_910A467: I also provide the service of diffusing awkward situations. Would you like me to do that now?
Dialogue.D4DEE6AA4306E685D6B65F96CF807186_FB122F8: I always liked talking to fellow travellers.
Dialogue.2288CE4541F6464ACBA2EE9192BA0220_06FC410: I always thought chairs were kind of a "one size sits all" sort of thing.
Dialogue.F08912D149EEB2265D30129E1EE7C9ED_47CFF90: I always thought that was an expression. Apparently, it's a result. And we got it.
Dialogue.8D48E4F3409C9513FB31DE92ECE8F388_FB122F8: I always thought trolls looked like little dolphin ghosts.
Dialogue.F1700324491CF51A74AE9FBBA6B9CBF1_E090F2A: I always thought you two had a will-they, won't-they vibe.
Dialogue.D67FC9244A08467D173BF7A7B2AD7BBD_06FC410: I always wondered why the singer was so upset.
Dialogue.A85A023A428E94677882B584EDF4B3A8_E090F2A: I am ENGROSSED. I am SCANDALIZED by this woeful tale of fast fashion.  But this chunky brine boy is not scared!
Dialogue.A0E14B35419400D910C4E2A8B4E1C292_14FBFB1: I am The Cloaked Star, and I fight alone.
Dialogue.C2326D5545EE747C4DDD828988A7BF7E_AFB40E2: I am a True Love certified master matchmaker and romancematician, yes.
Dialogue.C27472F7415FA4C9AE53F3B8428E0FAE_EB81C5B: I am a leaf in the wind...
Dialogue.CD3E99A046526647013533987E1F3DE2_97A9259: I am about to dive head first into the very thing that scares me the most.
Dialogue.8A75050E45FD49BE4305DD9B9F190E80_47CFF90: I am afraid I have no idea.
Dialogue.6D56642B4BD2B467BCF85092FF20CE9D_FB122F8: I am afraid that is in fact a keyboard solo.
Dialogue.F2C5E4444A0EF3D299F0B1A8B409E210_DCC9B6A: I am at one with my fate.
Dialogue.0E4617AD4E57197471A8ACBB13FC64C6_B222EAD: I am begging you not to call it that.
Dialogue.99DB8A4A407BB5B3BC79BA8EB2880821_D87E161: I am begging you to set that bar higher.
Dialogue.7FDB04544820C1FD0D4F91B960E3C63A_D1275FF: I am calling to you from the vastness of space and/or the future.
Dialogue.772D9493457900255C24DFB86A8996E8_06FC410: I am checking right now. There is no need for more talking.
Dialogue.F85C695F485F0CE8C8819F948ACE1E47_94F2B66: I am clearly shredded for a man my age.
Dialogue.17B476414CA563AE07637286443045B4_1FCF39D: I am closer to death than I’d rather be.
Dialogue.3AA68B1A4116324A530234AC4CFF345C_C2C5A2E: I am dead serious. Do not.
Dialogue.626732EC49037253F7C61A97C3DFC7FE_E090F2A: I am doing perfectly fine for a man with chunky brine syndrome, thank you very much.
Dialogue.196D64FE4E97E9A18A7258B3678BBD40_97A9259: I am feeling a lot of emotions right now, Ray!
Dialogue.22454CDA45B189593BDF3BA362CF1555_06FC410: I am further sorry to announce that we are now... enemies.
Dialogue.3A40949C40DF9F789782F7BF4446C09F_06FC410: I am getting the sense, though, that you two may not be the most experienced pirates.
Dialogue.DF1548904112BE917B3BAE9697A08BCC_DCC8D4F: I am grateful for your help.
Dialogue.F8262E784765B030D5B298B6733A8F59_B229E47: I am happy to announce I've got enough power to complete my calculations… now.
Dialogue.8E23BE884C9648439AAA06B6CFA26D1D_E090F2A: I am in pursuit of the ultimate fear, and only the Door to Darkness can give it to me!
Dialogue.3BF1471D416BC1879B5031872353F659_06FC410: I am instituting a new Homebase holiday... Ninja Eve.
Dialogue.5B340D914D9432C4CEFC5DAC89BF84A7_CC9154B: I am more loot now than llama.
Dialogue.3D3C5113480DFC64D493AB8A487CB77C_1FCF39D: I am more tired than I have felt in a long time.
Dialogue.ACA9BB264764DC4BEC95A2910E1687FE_1FCF39D: I am more tired than I have felt in a long time.
Dialogue.FDB6B7304D3B012DC2B7AAA91ACB5F82_23FCD32: I am nearly out of bullets!
Dialogue.A5A788254C736423FCC746AA6BF335E3_47CFF90: I am not defending battle sleeping. That crosses the line.
Dialogue.662BDC554909496E6B9A85B616D6DDE1_FB122F8: I am not drinking it, Dennis.
Dialogue.D69CCC1B4AF4EE7DA72BDE8C8EABAF3D_861A10F: I am not in love with the husks!
Dialogue.B8805E154CE61F87733D089491BEF7B9_FB122F8: I am not looking forward to this.
Dialogue.2CAC4DCE461CDB4C8EE67F970101B6C8_910A467: I am not programmed to take sides.
Dialogue.35CEE5BB49ED6EEFF32DF69A2FDC9E22_1FCF39D: I am not to be trifled with.
Dialogue.604E533A4D151B28796C4BA957D70BD7_97A9259: I am now asking your otherworldly permission to read your ghost diary.
Dialogue.FFCCFE3C47B89CFC2F83479827B3AA62_FB122F8: I am officially nominating Knox for advanced hero training.
Dialogue.234B742C462FD2324A4D8FACAD058E5E_E090F2A: I am on my last clip.
Dialogue.06D87255456E747C776CAE9EE18619B8_84C369E: I am profoundly moved by your dancing.
Dialogue.0B7FA4E340F7AD7507D38DBB6FEDF671_910A467: I am programmed to see all sides.
Dialogue.2B22DD1344E7D8B5C6B1CDAAD113B605_47CFF90: I am ready to take charge of Homebase HR and training.
Dialogue.0A1F41E04FD6D5EC168A9499478DDE3E_724DAF1: I am so good at this!
Dialogue.B24EB34E4BEC6BF9F6159798EFE5B7E3_06FC410: I am so happy to hear you say that, Penny, you can do better. So. Much. Better.
Dialogue.F1E19D5043AA1595C26E08B8CFED4B9D_06FC410: I am so serious. Can we not?
Dialogue.F18872F2468E22CC0E3C0D826321F1C5_06FC410: I am so sorry about that. But the good thing is, you're alive.
Dialogue.3C36A6DC43BB4579ECA3F79434419AD3_84C369E: I am so sorry, Pen, I- I had no idea we were lifelong rivals.
Dialogue.4360E94F4509715E941A1AB00024E2DD_06FC410: I am so sorry. I would never send you out unprepared.
Dialogue.4BC111E84C7A17FB928CE784A593FA26_910A467: I am sorry for letting the trolls take the equipment, although all my circuits know that was clearly what was logical.
Dialogue.1024D2C64C6A6AF4DDBA36A3EC1AE505_06FC410: I am sorry, I can't do that.
Dialogue.21CF376B4709B3561F35B0A8161C2019_910A467: I am spotting things that want to hurt us. Thoughts?
Dialogue.79FA0CF64E2D4CFFE71896A87B0B7430_06FC410: I am still VERY aware that's an insult!
Dialogue.06AA6B734DED17B4C0DBF8AE1E5B2981_7D2960E: I am the brains and arms of the law... apparently.
Dialogue.1E9919BF469CAFC4800B0A9F567DD6F6_21EB734: I am the hero you need. I can uniquely benefit homebase because I can burst into flames.
Dialogue.44CEA4F848DD4D615F624BBB8641FACC_B25AF7B: I am the last of my kind!
Dialogue.4B06B21B4221DDD1C25D1C9F6EFDA075_F2F813A: I am the terror of five of the seven seas!
Dialogue.A66B99AD424DF9D1AA5029AEF6DC59F2_176484F: I am tired of these guys!
Dialogue.F7509C9342C89AD19BDF628EDD7B3016_A96EA86: I am tired of these guys!
Dialogue.D3E1306143D68FC020841F87C9908B2A_97A9259: I am too nervous to stand up for myself.
Dialogue.7EC629F9407278C02D20FBA528CF2458_47CFF90: I am too tired to care about your or anybody else's soul. Just do the thing.
Dialogue.35E22F674829BEDDA546DEB78BE8353C_7F95CEB: I am totally not amped for this.
Dialogue.6C82F7B341ED3986F82DB78566E88A07_1B59CEF: I am very good at killing husks.
Dialogue.5DA76AD14B353DD83E91AEBDC4E4E555_B222EAD: I am very happy. Thank you very much for the husk hunt.
Dialogue.ED4C047247B99EC700D161B4C2FFB194_06FC410: I am... some amount of impressed?
Dialogue.4E797CB24BD4E41DCD88B1915AFEDD95_47CFF90: I apologize for subjecting everyone to something so racy!
Dialogue.17FDBEB7496E18D2E862298B71E40F47_B222EAD: I appreciate Ray trying to help me feel less lonely, really.
Dialogue.5E51A1E043897A9D7E016393CFAAC017_06FC410: I appreciate the ride and all, but keep it business.
Dialogue.2C1825144AB847FE8A04AB8D9CDF306D_97A9259: I asked him if it was okay to go through his files and he called me a "dragon," which I think is good?
Dialogue.1ACD94564CE0B0488C7EAB91FD82DB51_06FC410: I assumed there wasn't a way through this. But I was wrong.
Dialogue.32C0DB564F5353C032BFEC8FED68D8E9_06FC410: I assumed this data would be easier to read.
Dialogue.8AE4ED89417C7AC7E2EDB7BA9463CED3_97A9259: I assure you the entire kingdom, truly chosen, not the false monarchy off of exit 7b through 7c, stands behind you.
Dialogue.257638A642E0CB37DB63AFBB943A5B51_47CFF90: I assure you, we only stock genuine Slurp and Slap products.
Dialogue.C3C528C544133F33F4CBA4B4FA15CE25_47CFF90: I attend to the management and morale of the people of Homebase.
Dialogue.9F171EE0464BF5B63D5C7D867A05087A_FB122F8: I back up my data everywhere I can. Search any server racks.
Dialogue.34923B474C811D726BB9DAA08B24EB82_97A9259: I became a sailor. I gave myself fully to the ocean.
Dialogue.831F80504AF64A76892EFDBC098B11A8_B25AF7B: I beep whenever the Night Army wakes from its terrible slumber.
Dialogue.6E6358174189003BBEB22C878882F6EF_861A10F: I believe I found one who has the potential to be everything I dreamed of.
Dialogue.0820DE274570F27F04D9E7862A659E09_910A467: I believe Lars pointed out, quite correctly, your budget problem. Namely, you don't have one.
Dialogue.71F34F9E4F7927D03FE6709E55FF0CAA_89ED452: I believe that every man, woman, and child has the right to blow up themselves and others if they so choose.
Dialogue.00DC56FA48A3B009432AFEAEFE5D8B97_97A9259: I bet he got a lot of angry fan letters.
Dialogue.8320EE8A49023764E73B789B991BACD9_7712BEE: I bet he never bothered to return the hook.
Dialogue.34CA213A44565F70E427A3A7AC18207B_181CD3E: I bet he's still in my childhood bedroom. Assuming the husks haven't stormed the place.
Dialogue.CF8DBDCE4A129E62D4634092371D5DE7_FB122F8: I bet he's trying to get a lay of the land.
Dialogue.6B9523164017DF88C229EA8C65826AD3_FB122F8: I bet it sounds more like ... (Rumble Sounds)
Dialogue.E9634D374A5FC5CB7FADF8B57FE0FA08_06FC410: I bet she was ruffling feathers and they wanted her out of the way!
Dialogue.8048B1AD4124684C484F868E3F9231E1_CC240C1: I bet she'd see you and think, "Well, at least he's not a smasher."
Dialogue.222E10A44412C1E252E51DBB57B16677_97A9259: I bet they have really good food at a werewolf party.
Dialogue.51C6C5E4436749E0DCEBD1878D223672_72190CE: I bet you haven't even won a karate tournament. I have. Two, actually. Kaboom.
Dialogue.60A7B72B405F788D83B388AAA0C45D09_EECA944: I bet you look danger right in the face, then run the other way.
Dialogue.7E1704C94CF10E77C4F9A68BC09A23DA_724DAF1: I bet you thought I wouldn't make it.
Dialogue.66583B1A420C380307BD528BD9BDD72C_06FC410: I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you, Commander!
Dialogue.E5894E4645E2C7DE37234C8FBDD68687_7F95CEB: I bet you're wondering how I got here.
Dialogue.467C28DD43FF62FCD11772A160209499_21523A0: I brought gold! Not like those other kings.
Dialogue.5ECA5FB44B316949591D4BBC8AB7ECA4_861A10F: I build a fort, he knocks it down. I rebuild it, he... knocks it down.
Dialogue.6D1E165945B16D4E8028AA95FB079A42_FB122F8: I built a wind tunnel using a stack of box fans and a really high bicycle ramp.
Dialogue.2E6404A840B2B5E2D77C8C87289DB353_06FC410: I call it a storm trap.
Dialogue.DE635D2842170F7F709F64AC1A0BD25D_97A9259: I can also say with confidence that check-out is at eleven.
Dialogue.162576B94C44F8576AB2308A5F967F88_84C369E: I can always find new stuff.
Dialogue.5A1B1F42441AE6C3B6F1FE81AC95D697_FB122F8: I can be two things, little robot.
Dialogue.2B42AA0F4387A25E441BB183F8A3543D_9D00593: I can crack nuts and swing hammers.
Dialogue.8EEE04F946FBBBD3F9AC69BA2EE25485_CC240C1: I can do that! Let me do that, please? Please?
Dialogue.6A73EFD449606CD61D4BAE948B6A48BC_E090F2A: I can feel my mind-soul leaving my brain-body!
Dialogue.EE32DEF64FE5D4DF0DFD33A9DBCBF72E_06FC410: I can fix that. Enter edit mode. Select the square in the middle, and the square below it to create a door.
Dialogue.A8AC95AF4B89DB2F5B4082B37E73BE56_06FC410: I can guess who wrote this article.
Dialogue.B0372D49497129463288E781C4F36E51_06FC410: I can handle a little magnetic-- What's that in your hand?
Dialogue.E1B786A445D7144F238E14923BB990EC_9D00593: I can haunt you if you want. I already see you when you're sleeping, y'know...
Dialogue.B9948B2F4E52FD608385B9A251205212_14FBFB1: I can hear everything you're saying.
Dialogue.5AF6113048AD70A9AFC28C96B27E92F4_FB122F8: I can just shut up if you'd like.
Dialogue.3062754742ADFC25ADBA42A021F38762_97A9259: I can just sneak you back in.
Dialogue.9053EFBC41B785E874B2C3AF77A45C68_B25AF7B: I can lend you my treasure expertise until I'm back on my feet.
Dialogue.60FF534F409AD985A7BDF3B222D9FE04_06FC410: I can make out a few lines...
Dialogue.287305C34F5DE5AF4AE6A3A5A65902F7_06FC410: I can only hope some kind soul will deliver you this, my final goodbye.
Dialogue.8AA46FC240C6F75A14D481960C8A8E97_06FC410: I can own being not great.
Dialogue.89ABDD6E45AF71FB91D4109AC5AE9CF0_06FC410: I can power through. Hit me again!
Dialogue.BD2340DB42B977B6F9897A84822DE29D_FB122F8: I can see some of the holes in the timelines. On the scale of stable to time-mush, we're looking.. squishy.
Dialogue.452808BA4D11427642E6BF8E8429F6F1_910A467: I can see their side of it. I mean, we found the equipment as well, so they have as much claim to it as we do.
Dialogue.FB4DB9504A9E20A890B03081D7750180_B68F328: I can see your hand, Lars.
Dialogue.3C139B0A4C001250CFA617A54C2694CD_910A467: I can still be the best Chief Conflict Resolution Officer in the fleet, but now... I want to have opinions of my own, too.
Dialogue.01A2E89F4E5305E0D811DE9CF670004A_CC240C1: I can still feel the cold tendrils of eternity wrapped around my wrist, pulling ever onward towards the grave!
Dialogue.23C9383F4F649F5424E04F97A9AE958C_94F2B66: I can take care of myself.
Dialogue.AAB4C5AD4CA57FB92F7CA785D268C40B_06FC410: I can tell from the tiny strips of holes on the sides.
Dialogue.0147F786493F6720581EB1A8E87746ED_FB122F8: I can use this to develop a matrix array to compare to the new formation velocities.
Dialogue.7A263CBB41D4D2E2374375B19784FEFB_9F725B6: I can't believe I did that!
Dialogue.278DE34340365C4016CE45A1B4F80F5A_06FC410: I can't believe I fell for the ol' cursed grave trick again!
Dialogue.73A48CBF46124D1FD15C8DBE08E42C3E_FB122F8: I can't believe I made it!
Dialogue.097FA59A44187683A87CA59E8B27CE7C_06FC410: I can't believe how many survivors there are.
Dialogue.755455F84AC4FE1C743066B755DBBB5F_06FC410: I can't believe it! That was nearly everyone!
Dialogue.4C8A99614BBD2332EAE29BBFCF857D6A_B60EE0E: I can't believe it! You're the best.
Dialogue.8DAD3B69424C086591BE569BEB8758E7_D87E161: I can't believe she just admits it.
Dialogue.1D2D35E14BF2F3337C09E48A79189A30_97A9259: I can't believe we have Batquake royalty at Homebase!
Dialogue.D4742E12477ADB1223938A9AF4B6CB1D_765440C: I can't believe we're doing this! (sigh)
Dialogue.B951FFF3431F8549E4D9D5A7222D90AF_0ADEFA4: I can't believe you found BluGlo!
Dialogue.C13B30844D852A02D0B1EC8F88930D02_9D00593: I can't breathe well, but I can reload.
Dialogue.600018844F73426240E8269C1B0CEF83_9D00593: I can't dance em outta here, need some bullets.
Dialogue.CC4AF81D47E2FCD12496029671AD2880_14FBFB1: I can't decide what silence Homebase deserves.
Dialogue.B2A85F3B48DD4F2C7F4E54BD985CD459_3D2D55D: I can't do it alone! I need reinforcements, Commander!
Dialogue.A57D85FB4868498186D4CC8F6A85AA02_CC240C1: I can't do this! Oven life is all I know! Put me back in!
Dialogue.9F930FAD4A579D510C06A1910C0B9329_7D2960E: I can't even figure out why someone would want to be a hero.
Dialogue.2CC72BA04045FE4E7A025F94EE16D59A_06FC410: I can't even work up a mild crush. I haven't even been weird around a barista in like six months!
Dialogue.D06B8DC1406AC626B9F781BC42CE9ABF_B222EAD: I can't exactly die twice, but thanks.
Dialogue.BF7D08694D4AFEA1AECB869E04224732_181CD3E: I can't figure out what went wrong for me.
Dialogue.9453699F486AE447363875896C1AAE69_21EB734: I can't fly, and I don't have heat vision...
Dialogue.8D2C7B7049B7E99513E9D9BC1717F39D_CC240C1: I can't get through the child safety lock on the reactor core...
Dialogue.63DEAE30405415D2B7AFA189E413A2BF_FB122F8: I can't go into the storm without those husks mobbing the van.
Dialogue.0F4583804A48443E14BCA98F2F1BDB53_06FC410: I can't help but assume it's a dire warning of things to come.
Dialogue.E5E930BA4D714A9D502705BC8360A613_861A10F: I can't help but feel bad for the poor animals.
Dialogue.D9DE05294F729275C8F4E1B1E185BE8B_97A9259: I can't help it. I am totally tasty.
Dialogue.168C1596444E68B4478E30BEDE12D81A_861A10F: I can't help that I love Rarnold, but he's no good for me.
Dialogue.A00382C3403A433D41256FAF3CCE1C58_97A9259: I can't just be a good dad. I have to be the best.
Dialogue.92863D5C4ED6E07269251C807535E6F7_EAAE146: I can't leave when there's treasure out there.
Dialogue.3A2535964950E83419E5E9A4E9CCD35F_06FC410: I can't lie to Cap'n Clark! Husks ran off with our headshots!
Dialogue.B4BDC5034264B2245CD8AC9ED6956CFF_910A467: I can't look to myself for the answer. I am built to guide decision-making, not make decisions.
Dialogue.C84EDA4B43E74A93C9A988B0A8F81F59_FB122F8: I can't make that choice for you -
Dialogue.398E7E35468855FCD616AEA8F9304558_DCC9B6A: I can't meditate my way out of this.
Dialogue.23041B9D449C21F3A514179D28130C5F_06FC410: I can't not! Because if I don't, you die!
Dialogue.8FD947124F34535D2AA3F1B45806D41C_06FC410: I can't promise that's the last grave we're going to vandalize...
Dialogue.7B34688A4581087B68C2058784B03D9B_06FC410: I can't quite tell where the storm is coming from yet.
Dialogue.D65371DA4057342E49798195DABF69AB_06FC410: I can't really think of a way to spin this.
Dialogue.E9AA859F4A9BDD82BB744A99E5E4E4FD_9801E98: I can't relate to that, but I understand.
Dialogue.73465DAA4B71B999AFE593AA9EF5EDFB_47CFF90: I can't remember the last time I felt so alive...
Dialogue.2E6515B34BF2E12EC8C84BB6D3C17682_7D086D9: I can't risk the storm discovering our plan. You have the data. You know where we stand.
Dialogue.A657DCE545730AEC5B976BA2CAFE1F3B_47CFF90: I can't see through all this smoke! SEE-BOT!
Dialogue.E5C784A84BF73858309F25AD4B3D65AC_47CFF90: I can't take another night of not sleeping!
Dialogue.5A285C6E4CF6A1AA4FCA95970FCA6C44_FB122F8: I can't take it any more, little robot!
Dialogue.DC24123340D01CAD86C70D99D622BD57_47CFF90: I can't tell whether it’s some sort of latent fraternal instincts, or my revulsion at such heinous inefficiency...
Dialogue.64C4678D4804A8EF0A331E8D111F4CE1_1D2FE88: I can't think of a worse place to encounter a teleportation trap. Tough luck.
Dialogue.AD11AD2B44A35373EC384A8051511B6F_97A9259: I can't wait to see what happens at the end! Or maybe I already heard the end. I can't even tell, it's that good!
Dialogue.66E211F04CF72E97AF73BD83998670F6_861A10F: I can't wait to share my favorite song with you all!
Dialogue.DEB6CC574766D8593842CD9B4E6C8F59_4731F06: I can't... It's all messed up and... foggy.
Dialogue.431700A44B9A9ED8C74488A670B87F84_910A467: I can… see a light. What a strange new experience to catalogue.
Dialogue.BF8F891345A27DC1D9DC6EAA0ED5011B_06FC410: I checked and we are roommates, although Lok is seven and that is... weird.
Dialogue.AB742F83416CE41C919AA88110CD34D5_06FC410: I choose to do this the easy way.
Dialogue.536D54E8497E3BC61A8CA1B15AAD0DD6_B229E47: I chose you to run this base.
Dialogue.B8936A8A4FCB694A43D79FBA045C1567_FB122F8: I completely forgot about it the next day.
Dialogue.C156383D48A04BFC1F71F3BC8EB196D4_06FC410: I compromised the security of one of our survivors... and he's on the run.
Dialogue.ECDB94504897A71EAF276FA1E2029916_910A467: I confess that I could use some help.
Dialogue.4D0241504A74C1F319C4CA940684420F_910A467: I considered all sides of Azalea's conflict with me, and it appears the most efficient solution is... an apology.
Dialogue.4DC7DFDC4D9688ACF7EBF8AFCF4606BC_89ED452: I could build this out of something as simple as old vacuum cleaners if you could find the parts.
Dialogue.7813807F4DA0AC1F18B8A8AA99B4A6B5_B222EAD: I could confidently say you have way too much.
Dialogue.45B68FAF4B3FD5AD06627C851BC3DF69_9D00593: I could even be in yours!
Dialogue.72BA35F14D49658DEAB05D945818F32F_47CFF90: I could figure it out... but not for free.
Dialogue.D60F112549B10F5EAABEA3992BECEEF7_97A9259: I could get in another well...
Dialogue.110C9FE0411C98FAC837F7A4C7A7F9A1_87F0BBB: I could get used to anarchy.
Dialogue.C48E4D844F528D6C50207E8D11B182B4_181CD3E: I could have done a bit more self-editing.
Dialogue.8C409F034CD1388F26EB20A47B0AB7A8_87F0BBB: I could kill a husk with that.
Dialogue.6B00EF8E426D6F16981B54B8590FBF35_97A9259: I could make my own video channel and then everyone can see my movie!
Dialogue.A3EE54FF47998A41F85653A677B64A55_97A9259: I could really go for some... not dying.
Dialogue.C9AF706E43993455DBD0188D5D3EC53A_89ED452: I could really use another set of eyes on these latest guns. Things are... weird.
Dialogue.A44350FF44308C00F8E8FCA6B2577B99_97A9259: I could really use... a burger.
Dialogue.6DC10A9644DA01FC075EB88FF3DEE975_06FC410: I could see it coming across that way, what with the anxious scarecrows standing in for humanity...
Dialogue.0C32A18447026C004EEEC5AD50BD0875_DB7CBEB: I could see that. It's like a metaphor for your dreams... or man's striving for what's possible.
Dialogue.411A6EF04C65E29A65BFB1997A43875A_9D00593: I could spread my merry message across all of Stoneplankentwine!
Dialogue.1C1FAF8D459FFE92D16994A0A5A479F5_AB3C42C: I could teach you how to act like one.
Dialogue.952AEECB48606B95EC58179FBD616E64_21523A0: I could use a long winter's nap.
Dialogue.7C4E3902484305837CD8388EF0676CB3_861A10F: I could use a slash nap myself.
Dialogue.14C63B764040FD17ADDA57B2AB5F5B05_37EFC25: I could use some bullets, little children!
Dialogue.FBEF604F4881D99587CE8E930D3653FC_37EFC25: I could use some bullets, little children!
Dialogue.ECEF0E5745C1E3A95112E590904CECFC_14FBFB1: I could visit my vengeance to the heart of the storm, kill a thousand husks before I'm swallowed alive...
Dialogue.D0BB7D9E4AAAAA8E7852269F6BE3EFBE_7D086D9: I couldn't agree more. What’re you thinking?
Dialogue.4EC80641488E48BE9B6F5FAF21EB0323_97A9259: I couldn't be a vampire. They seem so picky.
Dialogue.0A58560346D27902843E79830F1B9170_1D2FE88: I couldn't believe it. My best friend in the whole world had become a ghost.
Dialogue.DA76DB2744DDD4ECFF09D3AF5DFAED9B_724DAF1: I couldn't have done it without my boy, Dennis.
Dialogue.1A2642464A4C908ABE641BA94D1D8E4C_A2D6E0B: I couldn't let you get away.
Dialogue.3F0D3C8F41C3C87CE83F2C80065A8B86_06FC410: I couldn't make out the rest but he sounded very serious.
Dialogue.57E4F64344AF67150C013CBC881A5B5F_06FC410: I couldn't watch. But that sounded intense!
Dialogue.EDC448A3491E554703B628A3C166DFBE_C2C5A2E: I decide who I help and when and how. Not you.
Dialogue.F77425C24FFDB47EE63AF98122D17D59_1D2FE88: I decided to go alone, leaving my friends behind.
Dialogue.80FBE5CE4B47F1D8B484EF9B5CAF8EA9_06FC410: I decided to have a dance-off with a smasher... who did not decide to have a dance-off with me.
Dialogue.579DE3624A533FBC12EF86BE6CA066B7_FB122F8: I destroyed the band? Oh I'm so sorry I ruined everyone's life!
Dialogue.11BB271B40ED0FA0EDE44F84CAB3BB9D_DCC9B6A: I did it! Did you see?
Dialogue.7C7C2A7C40D1E6C032F4F8AD5AF3D9EB_2DD597A: I did live by the sword, amirite?
Dialogue.EA3909F84E1CFE5A6400C3A0FF3A46F5_97A9259: I did not set out to host a love advice radio show. But things happened, and et cetera!
Dialogue.FA6313604C9487487658BA99DEFA9C88_06FC410: I did some napkin math and the current cage to human ratio in Hexsylvania is 1.05 to one.
Dialogue.062DA28D4018E3890BB2C0BD506CF298_06FC410: I did some snooping through Lars' things.
Dialogue.02AC47D24EAEAF0BB24F60B5B7C316D5_72190CE: I did that thing where you strap on a whole bunch of guns so you can just shoot 'em and throw 'em away when you're done.
Dialogue.7BFE4E15461C328F927248A82D29F8FC_181CD3E: I did the best I could, and you know... the results aren't that bad.
Dialogue.464B67114F76F3B7B2281A89C133A2BB_1D2FE88: I did warn you. No one listens to disembodied voices these days.
Dialogue.D8265B914F95402A7A800089C6AD5981_FB122F8: I did. It's called the ground.
Dialogue.791EA841468AF41436818A8675BAD839_06FC410: I did. No further questions please.
Dialogue.BA54B263424C1A68DFDEB58C367E2190_06FC410: I didn't and I am a... citizen observer of the Steel Wool fanclub.
Dialogue.24922A394D679C9FDBBE8B8EAF0FCEBB_47CFF90: I didn't click through the entire slideshow, but the thesis was solid.
Dialogue.4C663CF94ACD037181E96AABEB386F33_C0E27E7: I didn't die. I was just playin'.
Dialogue.BF4881264B2180CDE9CD2DA714FC8067_94F2B66: I didn't expect you to beat me here.
Dialogue.8AD70AD944DD3E81D01A2699F592B1F6_06FC410: I didn't go down with the ship.
Dialogue.4FBFC6CB46EFECA33882F59543B5F378_1D2FE88: I didn't know Vlad was in town.
Dialogue.3EE838D04DC2C0460218AD80C4B1ABE0_7D2960E: I didn't know he was a judge, but it turns out he was keenly aware of that fact.
Dialogue.46F945DE44CAE0B8FDBCB6B775848078_47CFF90: I didn't know his application was rejected!
Dialogue.6E1CCD954383AD1EC68866BD7DC0CC41_06FC410: I didn't know you have a motto.
Dialogue.15A2A9DD47113EABBA5FDCBE59F83DFC_7D2960E: I didn't know you were so soft.
Dialogue.B2D2129B4F9E80AF024BD693037615C0_47CFF90: I didn't know. Maybe this isn't the job for--
Dialogue.7D2E03DF43EC473B5FCEF481F7DB2835_A2D6E0B: I didn't look for trouble but here we are.
Dialogue.EAA5CAA2467A612A0EFCD18A5606ECF2_06FC410: I didn't make the rule. Movies made the rule.
Dialogue.4AB5F64E4108A79B625092980376423B_B25AF7B: I didn't really have a choice once I got in the box.
Dialogue.BC498CC944D5B58160C0F0A073F04000_97A9259: I didn't really need the antidote after all.
Dialogue.E6EC50114D9A4A7C3091B1BE9B5A0F9E_CC240C1: I didn't see even one goose...
Dialogue.91B447874E9E093177454793321D07C4_94F2B66: I didn't stop to think that it's been fifteen years since my last exfil...
Dialogue.B317073A4F8875AAC6BC36A1497A1432_06FC410: I didn't think I could like Steel Wool any more than I already did.
Dialogue.B2680FB94C686AC0B6223CAB5D3E9C09_06FC410: I didn't think anything was gonna cheer me up today, I really did not. But there's you with the photo finish.
Dialogue.82C5105D4905033BE32E4996F1A75174_97A9259: I didn't think this would depress me as much as it does...
Dialogue.D6C4806A4C56C5488B5A2EAACF443EA4_B222EAD: I didn't want to have to do this, but...
Dialogue.089F84444993C20317A73FBB8CF8B59B_E090F2A: I didn't want to say, but... yeah.
Dialogue.E6C173D34607485D5F121E97610FF186_14FBFB1: I died like I lived.. ruggedly handsome.
Dialogue.407A7B3A4C9D05CB66149283A9157E9E_E090F2A: I disagree, but I accept your terms. Scare me once, shame on me. And I go home.
