Dialogue.F679025642FAE63DE5F9AD953FD0ED6F_47CFF90: I dislike being the center of attention.
Dialogue.466E40BC49AD3001D307AD9C464FFC54_06FC410: I do feel a little bad about this.
Dialogue.7216BA3C401BBD6826F1F28F74BE43EA_94F2B66: I do have that going for me.
Dialogue.6D882DC940E4F6485F5390B60944E449_47CFF90: I do like the sound of King Riggs.
Dialogue.0D0F8A414B47AE36F5CA4197BD46E2BE_06FC410: I do love a good statue toppling.
Dialogue.6007B77D497EE1A49933718371E7BDF6_97A9259: I do need to change topics. Sorry about your... fundamental worldview issue.
Dialogue.C0143D6D47DE79EC68B44D86D33116ED_94F2B66: I do not believe in curses... except for a case like this. Sorry, soldier.
Dialogue.120A5D2C47BA10211214F4AAAC8BCA40_06FC410: I do not have a solution.
Dialogue.E4230A4F41D823299AB1A6A1E024BBE1_B25AF7B: I do not need to be fixed. My primal scream therapy module is still functional.
Dialogue.A12C8AA546A6606E043406AD8C503F7B_94F2B66: I do not understand half these dials and monitors, but it seems like you’ve got some strange stuff coming your way.
Dialogue.C00BDCB44B68D22A9E74F5A9F7B8A420_8DEFB9E: I do not understand the command "shut up."
Dialogue.10CBD60D4811E6C71B150F8791C03301_9801E98: I do not understand what's going on with these rocks...
Dialogue.B2A7DF44470A51C74DEB068D00F6832A_7D086D9: I do not understand why this isn't working.
Dialogue.30CBDB07418769C0566FCBB85B1D8568_97A9259: I do put the durr in durable.
Dialogue.58C616EE4A51B034A02ABC93807F68D4_FB122F8: I do understand the concept of the beach.
Dialogue.039C239A4B4AFD9FA597B2A8073849C1_47CFF90: I do worry that once I turn, you all may not be safe.
Dialogue.4F40D46646B4DD6E54BC89BCBE63E9E5_06FC410: I do! And to make sure that never happens to you again, I built a weather station.
Dialogue.E99572D2455E5509A7A39084DC76E0A1_47CFF90: I do. Which is why I know you're not going to give up.
Dialogue.A91D393D451D25A15D88ED80359972BA_06FC410: I don't care for your inflection.
Dialogue.E581F74B4097CD0825E747B9E54B55A8_7D086D9: I don't care what you do.
Dialogue.0D51F60341D4814D50374891CB1C6D36_06FC410: I don't care! Because it's time for me to stop giving up and start living up!
Dialogue.0E45157540873E3F5683A1B777B0425E_EC1949E: I don't do the past. I like the now.
Dialogue.2460AD9744C490C697AA3CB342A3CCF8_9D00593: I don't even feel like singing.
Dialogue.E9DF84A84B31A022058DA3B3B0BEDDF5_EED9CD8: I don't even know how to thank you.
Dialogue.146526C44C4B5F7B71E852AF27A6056A_47CFF90: I don't even know if there are still any rails to go off of anymore.
Dialogue.B55A50CB4B98E238C878D99CA507E967_FB122F8: I don't even know what to say.
Dialogue.68504E944978AA5DEFB07FA6F2B354CC_06FC410: I don't even think I'm the only one dealing with this.
Dialogue.9BA17A894D03C8FF3959AC92CF1CB5F9_47CFF90: I don't even want to read the Table of Contents!
Dialogue.D2A3C1DB4870EB4D64AB9CB1E9BABCC8_06FC410: I don't ever understand anything. But it's nice to know I'm coming across as confident.
Dialogue.3D0891CE4E065535DAF13C8169089A45_181CD3E: I don't exactly see "Insecure Depression Man" flying off the shelves.
Dialogue.2D78169647CABD108128ECA3A2CE65BE_B229E47: I don't feel compelled to listen to you when you're wrong.
Dialogue.3705E2CD463DF95B6E03AE9F8ED7BB32_B222EAD: I don't fit in anywhere. That's the problem.
Dialogue.707ED31B4828F79A5F4C40B6AC95CBAA_14FBFB1: I don't get a lot of mail, and I got excited.
Dialogue.26AB8BD040EE3F7BA0E10CB75190DC97_181CD3E: I don't get a lot of praise, so I always grab on tight whenever any comes my way.
Dialogue.15AC745D4EDDE8B1B1B60B9CCF45A45E_47CFF90: I don't get invited to many formal occasions anymore. Thought I'd go all out.
Dialogue.B8B889F94ED9A6A39421A48D5F30CF7D_EAAE146: I don't hate this plan. Yet.
Dialogue.2C8A4D5A42B5374310BEFCAC9C848984_7D086D9: I don't hate you. I honestly never even think of you.
Dialogue.0AB42E88454F84AA9536A3889CF952A6_181CD3E: I don't have a great toy line, a bad toy line... just a whole bunch of nothing.
Dialogue.4503B7304939D6B5B6C7BA8B5D3ABE43_C9708CA: I don't have long... please. Find me...
Dialogue.FAA4FCA644016C26CF08D4ACE218EC63_97A9259: I don't know about you guys...
Dialogue.DA8351784DB97B4F29E7B2BD3EF1F170_C9708CA: I don't know about you... but I have had a very bad week.
Dialogue.720C0DA24A87937A1A0978B1A922322C_D87E161: I don't know and that's a huge relationship red flag.
Dialogue.883935D34F314C226BDDABA6EDDC0C95_97A9259: I don't know any of that! All Dennis Jr. is getting from me is an encyclopedic knowledge of movie monsters.
Dialogue.D844DD7446B5E2A7E61D97954D1CB9EB_94F2B66: I don't know but I've been shown.
Dialogue.CF12A066449D394C673547A4AD0E496C_84C369E: I don't know but I've been shown.
Dialogue.742941664CAFCE696ACED1874673AB93_06FC410: I don't know for sure, but it seems like there are lawyers out there in the storm.
Dialogue.AB0DADFD47A629A95AFF6197D6D7F481_C9708CA: I don't know how much time I have left...
Dialogue.1AACCE2D45A0805F18C1A48EB8321D81_06FC410: I don't know how much time we have, but we need everything Dennis Jr. can give us.
Dialogue.D03429BE47C40D943AFCACAB37BA2B5C_CC240C1: I don't know how to stop!
Dialogue.914F2FDC4F6BB226CBF5D787B96404D9_06FC410: I don't know how, but the storm seems to know what we're up to.
Dialogue.AB4FD86B4EA389AA45096599419DCB2C_97A9259: I don't know if I am.
Dialogue.D3A00D954F3A683C74CAD0BDE98CEF2C_861A10F: I don't know if I can ever really overlook your past.
Dialogue.01F999054C2A274F17F06C95FF5B2AC5_97A9259: I don't know if I can.
Dialogue.1D3A5BB4492D32C954CFC081B76F8D85_97A9259: I don't know if I can.
Dialogue.75C0AFD34425D9729659F2A5A63BCA63_06FC410: I don't know if I can. I probably can't. I definitely can't.
Dialogue.737570F44B1CB6DE9A9644AA0AE5167A_06FC410: I don't know if I understand what I'm looking at here.
Dialogue.4269C6B943E4C81AD307F1B54AD43CAE_94F2B66: I don't know if I want to discuss that just now.
Dialogue.7057300B4064A15DC3A6489301923130_06FC410: I don't know if I'm awake or asleep (manic laughter). Merry Christmas!
Dialogue.208A0EBB43380198CC20A79CAECD2371_FB122F8: I don't know if everyone's gonna like that.
Dialogue.A4187E6F44ED2D29F12664AB77E35588_06FC410: I don't know if she would have wanted you to keep fighting...
Dialogue.883219A4446319D98BCF71AB59E4E164_94F2B66: I don't know if that makes you the most dedicated recruit I've ever had, or the stupidest.
Dialogue.0E1CEF064A3A7243DF8E549A2342EB78_97A9259: I don't know if that's a good idea.
Dialogue.FFC746FA4A12347C60F1DF89A81AF10D_FB122F8: I don't know if that's gonna catch on.
Dialogue.207185D64D076FBB00192D9A645B427D_06FC410: I don't know if the world is ready for pure, unfiltered Dennis.
Dialogue.F498743A4BE3E1FA9D78C79EB677D469_FB122F8: I don't know if they will.
Dialogue.F684146A438B7F1851A0F1A5A42D7AC1_06FC410: I don't know if this story has an ending at all, Dennis.
Dialogue.64C3C688483769FBBC338FAE26BD58C2_910A467: I don't know if this will help your search, but normally it's found just below my head.
Dialogue.DA0ED38740A5430D60C22FB55FF6810F_FB122F8: I don't know if we should be meddling with time...
Dialogue.761453FE4C110BE970C412BC68A051B9_7D2960E: I don't know if you're aware of this, but... someone sunk a grappling hook into the side of your van.
Dialogue.5208DC4C4FF36E8A32FDEDB8547AF009_06FC410: I don't know if your life just got better or worse, but Homebase is that way.
Dialogue.BDF481834004E38154397C8EDD106067_B222EAD: I don't know what I am.
Dialogue.62ADFCA9449A04621AF5AF82546DCC27_06FC410: I don't know what Zero Point shards are...
Dialogue.066A7FA2465F03FF376DE7850439F113_06FC410: I don't know what bothers me worse: your phrasing, or the idea that you... might be right.
Dialogue.31520D5641AF5DE98027FDAA86F853FC_97A9259: I don't know what else to do for her.
Dialogue.1C0AE77248BAB771882057ACF742AE05_FB122F8: I don't know what that is!
Dialogue.367776384739DE0D9016AE84DA51F6C8_7D2960E: I don't know what that is.
Dialogue.E53561B045DA9551A7710582EAD79AA8_97A9259: I don't know what that means.
Dialogue.A765D8A9437068EFD1EB0AAE8AC572FA_77D814F: I don't know what that means.
Dialogue.816CE0474D098435A9BDA9A51BFDBDD6_06FC410: I don't know what to do. I thought this would be the solution. Obviously not.
Dialogue.1657AFF04592DC30C844B8B47B73EAB0_B222EAD: I don't know what to say!
Dialogue.1A926C0E4B7B32B189FB48B9C192E061_97A9259: I don't know what to say.
Dialogue.D1D29E66494CB56A0BA1079B796B9BA9_FB122F8: I don't know what to think...
Dialogue.75833D2644F8A39D04A6B7823090C52D_97A9259: I don't know what you're talking about.
Dialogue.CA059E0B4E686ED59D65CD9B807C71E2_7D2960E: I don't know what you're talking about.
Dialogue.F435731A494D10B6A3D4E69DE6B04A9B_77D814F: I don't know what you're used to, but out here we take care of each other.
Dialogue.5EC8154848D8A1931E3226AC541D284D_06FC410: I don't know what's going on.
Dialogue.0BEE5B1F404DE4E98D0C84B8F14C9BC4_06FC410: I don't know when he's going, Dennis, but there's probably still time for awkward hugs.
Dialogue.D1C5A1C846EF7C6F65669382A0CA3E82_7D086D9: I don't know when you go so into torture, but this containment design is beyond inhumane!
Dialogue.60687549418F978CEA697689982E53F6_4731F06: I don't know who Summer is, but she's not my mom.
Dialogue.F50B99434BC90F06645678BE2B8C3433_724DAF1: I don't know why either, buddy.
Dialogue.C325D5B742136F9C18D01690C76B1EDB_06FC410: I don't know why everyone doesn't make a movie. This is pretty easy.
Dialogue.593BB4974080E0E0EDAB0788F2A6F740_1D2FE88: I don't know why he does this.
Dialogue.05000952442990F352368689609AF928_06FC410: I don't know why she's being such a jerk.
Dialogue.2FB7B39F42D5A7A05DF8528003DACC8F_06FC410: I don't know why the SEE-bots are so nervous about this mission.
Dialogue.FB97DCDC413877B6500E4D9540CD2D49_97A9259: I don't know why, but I find that upsetting.
Dialogue.FB63481A4D68FC1F84247BB2C9E3D898_06FC410: I don't know why, but sometimes I wonder what it would sound like if I tied Kevin's arms to trains going in opposite directions.
Dialogue.CB5AD0F6449910E04E9F5FBBA38B1A6C_97A9259: I don't know why. You just make me feel bad.
Dialogue.955FEDC446AEBFFDF147D7998CAF3D1E_EECA944: I don't know you well enough for this.
Dialogue.E07E4A36445C44DFDA1162B6A134FC78_21523A0: I don't know your size, so I had to guess.
Dialogue.D06F3A2541B4F189C4423A89412F2C4E_CC240C1: I don't know! But don't let him get you, please!
Dialogue.780E180D4A1676A16DC414BCC8D3EC6F_D87E161: I don't know! Maybe you could... read my love horoscope?
Dialogue.0A1DE4D84A37763C8539E8B7DCA0E0CD_FB122F8: I don't know, Little Robot. I think we just have to wait for the kidnappers to call back.
Dialogue.BFD87A28464A9927D9185F8F948461EE_7D2960E: I don't know, Ted. I don't look so good in high collars, what with my traps being so absolutely cut and all.
Dialogue.45B400154F3AABC03485A6901B3B44DC_06FC410: I don't know, but apparently Kevin does.
Dialogue.ED56994848FD5CBD004331BCE9E05DCA_D87E161: I don't know, but... I think this is your moment.
Dialogue.CB470CEF4A573396F574D5B6F7846C7E_47CFF90: I don't know, uh... coconuts maybe?
Dialogue.B829A6C749F4A86B7D5930BCE1E4D9C0_06FC410: I don't know. But you'll be happy to hear we're readying a stagecoach fleet.
Dialogue.0FC64889421E92598B6B35A6E2752A3F_06FC410: I don't know. Haunted is just such a weird place to start from.
Dialogue.278A69B74A02218E1CF4898B36F6E206_DB7CBEB: I don't know... Actually, I'm starting to wonder...
Dialogue.7DE8172B4F2037B7456480B3B4503FB5_84C369E: I don't know... I feel really awful. All the time!
Dialogue.E0F9AE0244DDB13F5C1590A2BBFDEC1C_97A9259: I don't like sweet, Ray! I'm a salty kind of guy.
Dialogue.5A07F9F2432329266F5213A1BE0F2C16_071921D: I don't like the looks of that flinger.
Dialogue.FCA25911459803254BFE49BC1EAEEA84_47CFF90: I don't like the sound of this.
Dialogue.A3700C85459D526CA116DFA2D91F5290_06FC410: I don't like this thing's attitude.
Dialogue.ACE8DBC24A7C0AF1DF62C7AFE0ECFB36_97A9259: I don't make the rules, Dire. The book says you're supposed to be on a leash.
Dialogue.0335DD154A55184F8BB695937989AC59_47CFF90: I don't mean to be critical of your process, Ray... but perhaps you could move on to Robotics Manual Volume Two.
Dialogue.CFC631E941BC6CEF5830A4B9BCE4D468_47CFF90: I don't mean to keep you in suspense, Lars. But I can't find Fennix anywhere.
Dialogue.D6CB24C54558B77207A8A4AB38A0EEAA_47CFF90: I don't mind it. I know they're going to a good home.
Dialogue.F3283D73464D41282099B69A6EF3A145_9D00593: I don't need giant eyeholes to see you're scared.
Dialogue.623E883D4196710A976E2D9266719904_FB122F8: I don't need sleep. I need star maps. As many as you can find.
Dialogue.5EB63A99488514B5EE8DFCB6083DBA9E_97A9259: I don't need to learn what that means.
Dialogue.E7E142894FB23857727D05BA197F874E_47CFF90: I don't need to tell you that this is... very bad.
Dialogue.230051024FFB48A7153F9BB10971B1B3_97A9259: I don't need your pity, Ray.
Dialogue.145B93EF46B5052DE3AF68866EF096E4_47CFF90: I don't normally go for meta analysis, but... that seems like a sound theory to me.
Dialogue.95083BFB458835838D60CA9972151EAF_8106785: I don't put my listeners in danger.
Dialogue.348BF5D949CB40FE7E2C5589E88F8473_89ED452: I don't really think that's how it works.
Dialogue.F04CA6B9421E5BED11583E945AAFF8E4_7D086D9: I don't remember exactly where his place is...
Dialogue.D45836264C93BE58009D33AB64A36059_47CFF90: I don't see Major Oswald, do you?
Dialogue.F781F49547D828CA56CCF1AB1FA3B17E_176484F: I don't see you marking anything on a map.
Dialogue.4FEB7B33487B1CE28607F0B1B69654B3_FB122F8: I don't think Carter was really a ghost, y'know.
Dialogue.BC584BA24713C199CEE570A71BDFF5E7_FB122F8: I don't think I can make you that promise.
Dialogue.DBB8B0CD4D852C6CF506788604B80489_97A9259: I don't think I deserve to be here.
Dialogue.4E45FB19452D3235CFEDE9AC05A4EA12_94F2B66: I don't think I do. He gave up. You know how I feel about quitters.
Dialogue.A5A510C8404226810CF44C928D2BDC6E_06FC410: I don't think I want to do that.
Dialogue.DF57D68D4E5900C3D51D4F96D0578D5F_47CFF90: I don't think I've ever said this before, but... Dennis has a point.
Dialogue.2A1A874A45A93E4EFFF7DFBFDC301877_4731F06: I don't think altering all these timelines with information we shouldn't have is going to cause any problems.
Dialogue.D9746AEA4B9EACEC4052C99E4AED1F37_06FC410: I don't think anyone else is coming.
Dialogue.2E14FCDE4D71BE4325549CA5B98FE05C_06FC410: I don't think anyone will notice the confetti.
Dialogue.4A4627BD4EE50C58FE3574A6A0D59AF1_06FC410: I don't think he heard me.
Dialogue.6674C89649E97D4808152FA82D584DEE_861A10F: I don't think he was aware of the etiquette of the situation.
Dialogue.3D99420145CFCEE421D88789704BC456_06FC410: I don't think his house is on any map.
Dialogue.4E00AD42423118A0E89011A399BD451B_A96EA86: I don't think it comes in peace.
Dialogue.DA8EB4D64F7731F89C2BB08B823F6771_06FC410: I don't think one present's gonna cut it man.
Dialogue.80060FAE42FB1343A2A48DA40C3BE991_94F2B66: I don't think she'd be too excited to see me.
Dialogue.CB2F1A1042635F8BD2ACE29329A2412E_181CD3E: I don't think that will ever happen again for me.
Dialogue.DE539B41440DEC21174B81885779E744_B222EAD: I don't think the husk hunt is working.
Dialogue.1A6931A14A2F76B690B19589A76552F2_FB122F8: I don't think this is gonna work, Little Robot.
Dialogue.88A021EF4103757AA6664588DB8E9DF9_06FC410: I don't think throwing another robot at the problem will fix anything.
Dialogue.32A10A9D4BE43C339B8562BD8C1D4918_D87E161: I don't think we have much time before your guy comes back.
Dialogue.83ED7FB04B3818F45F9691B26EA1ABC7_FB122F8: I don't think we need to reinvent the wheel here.
Dialogue.CE811BF34CAD7992899B20BC86B5A74D_9801E98: I don't think we'll be driving limos just yet.
Dialogue.BE675D4148E59393175AB4BF1E3A0CB9_9D00593: I don't think you understand. This is not nearly enough cheer for a respectable Holiday Kingdom.
Dialogue.F0C284504F06D7E8A53EDBA92EC848F2_181CD3E: I don't think you want that.
Dialogue.2DCCA86647F6A748A66BD197C802862D_06FC410: I don't think... oh, yep, there it is. Ooh, that is a gut punch.
Dialogue.60B9032C43BC85B0F822279EFE8A2753_CC240C1: I don't understand any of it!
Dialogue.EFFF57174EFF36D5095CC49FB60C7C08_06FC410: I don't understand that at all.
Dialogue.4CF344E7402433D0A60B4288539051EF_06FC410: I don't understand that at all.
Dialogue.C08E731D45C1DD9582E0C0967362F6D2_06FC410: I don't understand this stupid game we're playing.
Dialogue.0372B3E44FB7C0234E8D50912004E705_06FC410: I don't wanna. It's... people are gonna expect it.
Dialogue.39108DD4461014EDC35F7CABFBB68265_7D086D9: I don't want a SEE-bot. I want Two Two Eight.
Dialogue.1ABEA259459842BDFAA13782768B0790_CC240C1: I don't want anything from you.
Dialogue.3E4924D04BC3A8E663EFEC9F90ECA376_06FC410: I don't want him to be gone.
Dialogue.7F6E1AF54A794789E8FC6E95F089F7FC_B25AF7B: I don't want this sentimental garbage.
Dialogue.61478E7D4111CBFB3A65419F87B35018_06FC410: I don't want to alarm you, but things are looking very very very bad.
Dialogue.7BA334E64371FBE5FE3ACCA724CB1057_CC240C1: I don't want to be all alone in an oven for a couple of days!
Dialogue.D086F7054AF259AF69149E885D395BEC_4731F06: I don't want to be here anymore.
Dialogue.882B7424410AEC43DFA641AB2F839819_4731F06: I don't want to be here.
Dialogue.D254740740F7DD35324413A160F9E74F_CC240C1: I don't want to be mean, but Ray did leave me with a couple of house rules.
Dialogue.5373ADAF4193AA50D918A2ABA543223C_47CFF90: I don't want to leave Homebase unattended.
Dialogue.0712FB5F4D3AAEB0470FEB865A6C9BAF_B222EAD: I don't want to spend eternity with them.
Dialogue.8E3AB7CC496C99BD5030D794A86C4FEF_97A9259: I don't want to talk right now, okay?
Dialogue.505683C24A648E65D862A3ADE672755F_A96EA86: I don't want you or anyone else coming near me.
Dialogue.D4C6B4414D631B8976309EB527CBC627_CC240C1: I don't want you to go!
Dialogue.4A4EEE7048A5CA1703B18F90EAEBA206_97A9259: I don't, but every journalist I've ever met seems to like that about me, so when it ain't broke... Dennis don't fix!
Dialogue.D35B003B4DB8B02F3F27B4AFF44800EB_72190CE: I don't-- Why would you slap a parrot?!
Dialogue.36ACC1B94980973C0363EABD3BBE3DD8_06FC410: I don't. Is it more than ten thousand years?
Dialogue.0D72D1424000D66F3646108BF643A712_37EFC25: I don’t like the look of you, troll.
Dialogue.BE073C4349BEA8508AE026924C983964_94F2B66: I don’t want to put pressure on you... but you’re the last one standing, soldier.
Dialogue.0464854F40C109DC9C521DA5F5620AF1_9F725B6: I dropped out of school, broke it off with my ex, told my parents to get lost...
Dialogue.25640FE941362D596187179A679CDA67_FB122F8: I dunno man. Trying to fight mass nihilistic despair? Sounds way too hard.
Dialogue.B4875C784907F05768E96CA0B51396C0_B222EAD: I dunno. I'm not really a love type of ghost.
Dialogue.37EC837843CC09B26B65D284F433F91A_724DAF1: I dunno. Something good to look at?
Dialogue.0975783B4FCCD35808E0ACBCAF2241E5_DCC8D4F: I escaped the darkness... this time.
Dialogue.3F66D5644CBC2F512162D1930F1E9E99_06FC410: I even had him read Anthony's autobiography of Abraham Lincoln.
Dialogue.1793E10D4D3D571DB7CE2C8E0C8113C5_06FC410: I expect to gain some sort of tolerance to being away from Homebase, but until then we should spend some time figuring out what this new body can do.
Dialogue.6197F48E4D94B1BBEBB86AA41AFC3856_47CFF90: I explained it all in the memo. Remember? The one you totally read?
Dialogue.5D957A8C4C944E181CE814B20C4A3DFF_06FC410: I fear that I will never again hold you in my arms, and never again see your kind eyes.
Dialogue.97DC80D14A7F2C7DAF362CA07BCC78F5_861A10F: I feel a bit odd, Ray.
Dialogue.66E1D3FB4988FA62648CCBB8824E63D8_910A467: I feel a little guilty not dying like that husk wanted me to.
Dialogue.6B82D246479746F85BAC8AA01206E899_D1275FF: I feel as if I was fresh out of the box!
Dialogue.8B9CBDA348563BC4CD2202AB5E47D898_FB122F8: I feel as if I've unleashed a great evil upon this world.
Dialogue.05B40EF149A28F623AF22184D173CA32_06FC410: I feel kind of bad rummaging through Lars' stuff.
Dialogue.26060B3C4D88A712E168C783B1AFD92E_FB122F8: I feel like I should double bag it.
Dialogue.073D8E334535F8608EEC979B1D55F319_06FC410: I feel like I'd remember saying something like that.
Dialogue.C3B2383A4493C106DE885F9255A76159_06FC410: I feel like I'm learning a lot about Lars.
Dialogue.7CBF3B024C17FF731FDE8FBA214E9545_06FC410: I feel like we had so much more to talk about.
Dialogue.060501B149ABE535E9CF2392AFED4779_06FC410: I feel more like myself already.
Dialogue.53B8A0EB45317D72B594459F26B32B4A_47CFF90: I feel my ambition rising. I feel like... raising venture capital.
Dialogue.70ED5DA2449E93D62849C298035C714F_861A10F: I feel my forts getting stronger already!
Dialogue.0D3DA6CF42CBF746AAAC25BFBA61138D_FB122F8: I feel really bad about screwing up your moment.
Dialogue.2B44B92947FDCCF5B1C5D2BF6253D8EE_94F2B66: I feel safer already. How about you?
Dialogue.FF7BDC024D6D4FBAD72B37AB4AFD549B_06FC410: I feel so guilty. I'm just such a screw-up.
Dialogue.C9D38954404E4C864FF4D8A9608B2FED_1FCF39D: I feel weak. I hate it.
Dialogue.85A3090F489AD65BBE3EAF95EC94C286_F6B1D98: I feel... something? Maybe it's a pulling?
Dialogue.7C546DB844A41229A5061085FAE36ED8_CC240C1: I fell in a puddle, sir!
Dialogue.59A988E149FB8DDBE11CDB8D73F47712_89ED452: I figure I must've picked it up somewhere in Hexsylvania.
Dialogue.B15384A5491825C8EE772DAB410DF7C1_071921D: I figure that did me up right.
Dialogue.91BD21C0489019496A669588E134C8E2_861A10F: I figured if nothing else it would keep her occupied a bit. Take her mind off it.
Dialogue.9E9184264BB44356272A24A5B06388E3_94F2B66: I figured since I outrank you it'd be my unit.
Dialogue.9A8989A8418219EDD0B5E5957D58BC21_06FC410: I figured we'd never hear from you again.
Dialogue.9A4C604746832C7BB950F8ABD73C79DF_06FC410: I figured you'd never approve of the risky procedure, but as they say,
Dialogue.44F2A71C487CB0853B71EFA284329629_97A9259: I finally finished reading all the parenting books and I'm ready for... um, what was it...?
Dialogue.9876C2F24595F47BE5EB26975A4DCDC9_06FC410: I finished the Soldering manual and only started three tiny fires.
Dialogue.1D09EF734D3E921F80B778B8FF4C9798_06FC410: I floated the concept of the mega-bed back at Homebase.
Dialogue.C2A7935A468DFE5A518A8B81320AD136_06FC410: I forgot what we're supposed to be doing so I'm just gonna generally use weapons.
Dialogue.032700CA479353602977F4BABCC37A61_06FC410: I found a copy of Soldering: Diodes for Days and I think I'm really getting somewhere.
Dialogue.8DE15839480F2688AE7CD6A37ED0A1C2_06FC410: I found a record of him and his gang, but... they're all dead.
Dialogue.984DDDFF490FB69932138D8327CFC5F9_94F2B66: I found another problem with your plan.
Dialogue.516F91F34026C001A1E417AC26706B39_06FC410: I found the ideal locations to deploy a sensor array.
Dialogue.0BDED9DC47F3CE3F155370AEE3495343_06FC410: I found the landing site! The location of the landing site has been added to your map.
Dialogue.FC2785834157A43F4EFBD893C4FB5261_14FBFB1: I found your little tracking device. So I guess this is goodbye.
Dialogue.C94CE74A4DB64EBC9CF47CBE42DA8FEF_724DAF1: I gave Dennis a hard dose of the truth.
Dialogue.08B00F7340F6F00EBE1D9C8297660C56_94F2B66: I gave the boy a firm handshake...
Dialogue.64330D8C42A884968C34159EE49A57F1_CC240C1: I get so tired of feeling left out and never fitting in. Of people treating me like I don't understand anything that's happening.
Dialogue.E9261E0341E091B1482E92A7C6A29808_06FC410: I get that you're so mad at me, but I still don't understand what you want with a broken SEE-bot.
Dialogue.039D69214E41714443D9A3AB1A29BC8C_EAAE146: I get that you're working on your pirate rep and all but...
Dialogue.82DE894B4259030EED8146AC857C3839_910A467: I get the feeling that the next owner of this ammo will be its last.
Dialogue.4F713A3D47EE5A30691134AA8C4108EB_87F0BBB: I get the sense we'd better find this monster before it finds us.
Dialogue.617FD0FF45DFD2BA6802299A7D954758_0ADEFA4: I go all the way back and all the way forward.
Dialogue.B857C00E42AD25FBCB2EDC858E8BC061_D87E161: I got a few on deck if you want 'em.
Dialogue.77433196409F4A03CA327D831373C0D4_06FC410: I got a soft spot for dirtbags and the algorithm knows...
Dialogue.68E69E6E4CE2DC9186F22DA641525022_CC240C1: I got an apartment in the Canny Valley storm shield. Gonna go hang up my shingle.
Dialogue.CF6A433F48E3C6014B28DFBF3F350831_7D2960E: I got another one for you, Ted.
Dialogue.8972480442A77F33D088A585AC6BCBF4_06FC410: I got eyes on a taker!
Dialogue.DE2C21FB4097111D147D098374F1802E_EED9CD8: I got like four pounds I'm looking to unload.
Dialogue.D12680E5461DF9FECD852E81C8F91B59_07E024E: I got nothin' better goin' on.
Dialogue.414D4C5D42B7C02BA9E1739B1B58C4A3_0A979DB: I got shot. In the arm. Remember?
Dialogue.0A8C881F499220BA8E2894BB164C0FD6_071921D: I got some bullets to answer that flinger.
Dialogue.7FA084104EE343C550F54C9CA604F0A0_B222EAD: I got the sense it was like more of a job, but they are really into it right now.
Dialogue.4C83D9524ECCD18278356AA03E1DAF73_181CD3E: I got worried that the tough talkin' tea partier I designed wasn't enough.
Dialogue.88DA106746433FCF84010D9790D7678D_47CFF90: I got wrapped up in the moment, but that does not change the fact that he has to go.
Dialogue.5FE1462B40A328A95772FF8962A646D0_94F2B66: I got you that oil you wanted.
Dialogue.9CE6E9B84D424EE98A1B94AB14793634_1D2FE88: I got you that trap you wanted.
Dialogue.D46689584532CE7932A87BAB2E0326A9_2DD597A: I got you the good stuff.
Dialogue.9BFD40FE4D43B86F40E7A890A8A5F15F_97A9259: I got your letter so... let me know if that changes.
Dialogue.0FD1C3E441CAE2CC5C43D58D2AFEAC76_A96EA86: I gotta ask, and I am sorry, but I really have to ask -
Dialogue.A9C1FF734078CB29B9F3A4896680EC72_21C1927: I gotta ask, why's that so important to ya?
Dialogue.87833483462FC31CD024D0A2747DAC51_579B086: I gotta catch... catch my breath.
Dialogue.1388BA2443BC6CB694F26A91B0DA4813_06FC410: I gotta disagree with you here.
Dialogue.0DC7AE96439F6F9557BDAA99C6826BAC_97A9259: I gotta ditch this pocket cheese!
Dialogue.EE36FCE74935AA221A3DEF9ED83DC090_2DD597A: I gotta get me one of those.
Dialogue.2A853A9F4F0146BD7407CABD9C0F1067_97A9259: I gotta run, but enjoy those headshots! Hah! Hah...
Dialogue.5ED80C974F4FA02940A97589F21B6167_FB122F8: I gotta say... wasn't expecting you to be the one to have my back.
Dialogue.00FE499D4C588AE66E96BD81DF63A8B5_7D2960E: I gotta tell this guy to move.
Dialogue.4129C6264E7418E34B1F8BAC6DF79369_1D2FE88: I grant you a do over.
Dialogue.093A5F01490F3D6D3EFD5EBFD810D030_1D2FE88: I grew up wishing I could be the set... and also devouring interlopers!
Dialogue.D5661E704A6B5BCAD82CF28BBBADA10C_B222EAD: I guess I can bump you up on the list.
Dialogue.F800FF16432774C032B8319637DEC835_72190CE: I guess I can't fake my way out of this one...
Dialogue.AE54C8AB43F330F28A72C89D8EAD8EED_4731F06: I guess I expected more from you...
Dialogue.74E7A2AC4630F693B1BA60921F2EBB1D_97A9259: I guess I have that now.
Dialogue.45B9D7F74F9F876462FEE488BFE1F514_861A10F: I guess I should tell you all... I had a nightmare, too.
Dialogue.E3FA20774955BE152E0434A66576B3B7_7D086D9: I guess I still don't understand what you were trying to show me.
Dialogue.188051424F6A50C61F2E6B832850ABF2_06FC410: I guess I won't be heartbroken if these cannons get destroyed...
Dialogue.50EAAB244B7E990C58C05591315AB13A_77D814F: I guess I'll go stretch my legs...
Dialogue.50D3F36A478E6B240EF13F9851D1BD19_B222EAD: I guess I'll see what she thinks.
Dialogue.33641A964698FBEE9AE546BCA51B19D8_FB122F8: I guess I'll see ya in my nightmares.
Dialogue.CDD93C9C4AD7D36FE16EAEA4F71E20BE_A96EA86: I guess I'm a glutton for punishment.
Dialogue.1743A869444A8568F00D6E834D66A649_B222EAD: I guess I'm doing this again.
Dialogue.2E0D8A684425B02BEB20ABB586BED6C3_B222EAD: I guess I'm feeling a little bit better after all.
Dialogue.9B271BF144B903601EE9AE8756467B7A_FB122F8: I guess I'm just not easily fazed by relationship drama. It takes a lot to make me angry.
Dialogue.D0A5867B4C76A5A0279A96877F790D3D_AFB40E2: I guess I'm no longer needed here.
Dialogue.BD4833CE4452AB2D8F5270B5CF9BC11E_47CFF90: I guess I'm starting to understand Ray a little more. Things go off the rails and you just... react.
Dialogue.88EB907D48DA2ABB7D582996349175E7_47CFF90: I guess I'm the only one who finds that surprising.
Dialogue.61AC60D14F5B70149EBB9AA7DB17B0F5_06FC410: I guess he was a bigger deal to me than I was to him.
Dialogue.197769BB40B4299221F7C9A6A325B57D_FB122F8: I guess he's not having spooky visions.
Dialogue.623527EA4FC5CA6BE6D8CE937DB3BE3E_97A9259: I guess if you can do it, I can do it.
Dialogue.EDA2D38548BD760DD99CCA97B051B997_CC240C1: I guess it beats sitting around in my room all day.
Dialogue.A71796354774E5B83978A7B164A24D82_06FC410: I guess it can't reach you up there! I need a clear head to get me a view of something happening down here.
Dialogue.4317C38541102AB3CF46FDACD2A1674B_47CFF90: I guess it means that you're in charge from here on out.
Dialogue.B64FE7A8411712103A322195EAA3A870_06FC410: I guess it's just nice to think about something other than the end of the world, you know?
Dialogue.FF8B6E2542F63FF0E7EAFBA004D7A9FA_97A9259: I guess it's lights out for you.
Dialogue.DE74C9D74FEE48347B634FADF64EBC68_5991012: I guess it's time to come clean about why us wolves were attacking you, so... (ahem)
Dialogue.A432F76D4F86E314D88B36A9DFA10170_7D2960E: I guess now I'm afraid of letting anyone else in.
Dialogue.2FC6A8A541BA51E9EC49C0AF0D09742A_7D2960E: I guess staying here at Homebase...
Dialogue.35222B2848472338DD28C89F72F5BC9A_06FC410: I guess that makes you the king of the monsters, Commander.
Dialogue.8823437E4F3D314AF1CD2095F57699AF_176484F: I guess that means he got the suit.
Dialogue.5EC563664F811D6AF9A8A2AA4F6011CE_06FC410: I guess that settles it. It's time to... whatever-the-opposite-of-celebrating-is this... Terrible Christmas.
Dialogue.B343AED44747B086556AA0A0185EFEED_06FC410: I guess that's Dr. Vinderman's old research partner.
Dialogue.289BED8444B9F6CD690FA1A51D8635E3_06FC410: I guess that's one way to store an axe.
Dialogue.A79858F04BD2A7D4EB0254BE1FD41E16_181CD3E: I guess the first toy I ever made.
Dialogue.F934FBB14FE3C5223100E78DBD29716F_CC240C1: I guess the husk hunt didn't help.
Dialogue.624A761840E4685283B6169D7163F7FE_724DAF1: I guess there's no world where I'm not a complete screw-up.
Dialogue.248C364D45E0A098EFFF3E871648AD3E_97A9259: I guess they do make cookbooks for ghosts... just not for you.
Dialogue.975405554432324D56540B9B206D0404_DCC9B6A: I guess this is my ninth life...
Dialogue.E0FC9E6F43A0D5B5C146048D669CCDBF_B222EAD: I guess this place is haunted, now.
Dialogue.675518F6454BE803E0E04EA425A411B5_06FC410: I guess we could bury a big ammo cache and put a sign on it that says, "Hey, future! Look here for ammo!"
Dialogue.FF238D6D46E5656BB4C794BF4613E0B2_06FC410: I guess we don't need it. I was able to make EMERGEN-SEE-Bot into a microwave again.
Dialogue.EB4ECA9D498B058B7B8C18B01C4526AC_97A9259: I guess we have no choice but to pack our bags and go.
Dialogue.864D8E224B39251E13FC28A15E7FF16A_861A10F: I guess we know who Arrlene fancies now!
Dialogue.8E8958D34C40370C74416E87B886B88B_21C1927: I guess we should go... uh, destroy all of the Slurp we can find?
Dialogue.7FBABDF84B8B6BB51ECD3FB7E2709C5C_06FC410: I guess we'd better listen to the man.
Dialogue.85AB31C34E1C423C53400BA3B383DCFD_06FC410: I guess we're having a bad Christmas!
Dialogue.1FCECC694F8429C6199CC28393C58E14_861A10F: I guess we're having an afterparty.
Dialogue.611DC163434520413EC3628E6EC36F50_CC240C1: I guess we're pretty lucky that meteor came!
Dialogue.9D86701345E0EB462C6594AC4BAD66EE_06FC410: I guess werewolves don't really do plants.
Dialogue.824BC525464EA9B28700B087A39EC4B8_C2C5A2E: I guess you earned an answer, huh?
Dialogue.98ED977B408676FF8EC2FD90FB36F1FE_7D2960E: I guess you got yourself some hotshot lawyer.
Dialogue.F76150B5447CD9851FF64B8377BA6F1B_97A9259: I guess you'll have to figure that out yourself.
Dialogue.1DAB43324F4E7BFE60DDD1865E10C0E1_47CFF90: I guess you're the one to lead us into this final battle!
Dialogue.7F16550A40847D46971D5EA61936AFE7_06FC410: I guess, but what if I was actually looking for old socks?
Dialogue.66CC35504E9A48C7C7CE07AC977BF519_EAAE146: I guess. But I was sort of expecting it to feel more... special? Like I would just know, y’know?
Dialogue.0638496C4003D5964FE1F39CAF05825D_F6B1D98: I guess. Just... starting to feel like there's something you're not telling me.
Dialogue.B477506D4D2025BCBD7F3A8233CE67DB_F6B1D98: I guess. Wish I could figure it out.
Dialogue.127A28BE43CA237F0BAE51AFA172E64C_9F725B6: I guess... I think about how I'm feeling.
Dialogue.37E1DBA24EA46FD253847A9E7F8A5CDE_72190CE: I had a perfectly good scam going.
Dialogue.001511774134AD7E41916EA30374B24D_B222EAD: I had a purpose at the hotel. And even though I'm not there anymore...
Dialogue.859C1CA641CB9B2BE4CAC2AC750A88D7_06FC410: I had hoped we could learn to live in peace with the bees, because honey is great.
Dialogue.3327AACD4F21A4DCC282309A46FB9F23_724DAF1: I had some great plans for this secret track, but like I said... I'll getcha next time.
Dialogue.DC2FBF4E4E621040452C6BAD01CCAED8_06FC410: I had this terrible dream where I was trying to help people and everyone just... ignored me!
Dialogue.6858C25041C3645861669A89A4E62A25_21C1927: I had to burn my tea leaves and cast my table cloths into the sea.
Dialogue.E788FD2448BC0B82234D52BA33EECB26_CC240C1: I had to evac a hero. Only two left fighting!
Dialogue.4C7962604A5146D02607D79942D7CFB9_06FC410: I had to listen to Vinyl Dave explain why jazz is the only honest music to get that record.
Dialogue.5C742A054661E5227C4943907FB10D66_89ED452: I had to make a choice. I put the shield up to protect everyone in the fort.
Dialogue.0B0DA30C474B000FCD36C4ACDACEC03A_47CFF90: I had trouble sleeping last night, so I thought I'd read up on the hotel.
Dialogue.2AF81BB547E96EA7C1D4E9909DF7DF03_06FC410: I happen to have a solution!
Dialogue.898C1C7E42374D8568DB66A4FF8D22ED_97A9259: I hate seeing him go, but I love watching him leave.
Dialogue.BBC00B3A48316901C2D5E9BE82B56A46_FB122F8: I hate to ask but... why does this matter so much to you? It's just stuff. We can always get more.
Dialogue.F811CD6D461098E8E812F0ACFBF7CB8E_47CFF90: I hate to ask this but... you're still alive... right?
Dialogue.0AFD922D47047B22AABD8FB294D33748_72190CE: I hate to ask, but can you give me and Keels a minute to talk over our plans?
Dialogue.B41CD7174D96A5F4737747919643EDFF_06FC410: I hate to ask, but can you send your data?
Dialogue.BCE4B1BE42B57F585658498949967414_21EB734: I hate to be a bother, but I come callin' with a dire warning!
Dialogue.1F013197463BF4B44BAEF9842B14CD8C_89ED452: I hate to break it to you, but Plankerton is a deathtrap.
Dialogue.7C640F374C5ACC97F03242B8D3273423_06FC410: I hate to break it to you, we're not giving up just because it's a deathtrap.
Dialogue.3CF04E654A755F779F2C75B89BEBF9EF_06FC410: I hate to interrupt when you're in the bone zone, but we've got evil lurking all over the place.
Dialogue.915E9E0E44BFB82292BC12B36FCC6718_97A9259: I hate to say it, but I'm starting to think that vampires are jerks.
Dialogue.01DF6BD54D012B9030426E9FFCCA7FB6_861A10F: I hate we insulted the husks, but we're better off without them at the wedding.
Dialogue.27871BB142014F0EE0C80CB8D3237CCC_176484F: I hate when we get one of the billion-year-old time-crazed Neds.
Dialogue.ED1802C743F3712CAA0FE99FE3F4DBE3_14FBFB1: I have "Why Have All the Birds Stopped Chirping? Oh, God. That Seems Bad, Right?"
Dialogue.CF425E594965FEECD495D185BD6458BA_06FC410: I have a bad feeling that he's tracking down a very real nightmare creature.
Dialogue.5F94095247C05957C30C148156A62A33_C0AFF0C: I have a complicated inner life.
Dialogue.1C964BAB44934442D733249BF8ACD8C0_06FC410: I have a feeling we'd better find out soon.
Dialogue.6ADAA7754B511BA94A1F3E91B8F9BF0F_14FBFB1: I have a library of silence.
Dialogue.C71BC9BD4445D1AF421630BB06518CD8_06FC410: I have a meeting reminder to come bring you a suit?
Dialogue.B2C052F3428C3215F3888EB5C1B6ADB1_47CFF90: I have a plan in motion to address the issue, but first... we need to get our radar network back online.
Dialogue.FC41EB2A43F84DA8AAF839A085EB9D6C_06FC410: I have a proposition for the two of you.
Dialogue.7E9A498B47D906EA28AD17ADF0592F84_FB122F8: I have a scientific mind, man. I- If you don't tell me, I'll be up all night trying to figure it out.
Dialogue.194D9E5045C7098081DD1AA369161E52_D87E161: I have a story for you, Brainstorm.
Dialogue.E40295DD40614DAE1DC09B806CF85486_06FC410: I have already told you both multiple times.
Dialogue.6720D10142F18E45C8CCFD9DB86004D9_FB122F8: I have better things to do...
Dialogue.77E015BC4EC85CA9162D7F9FF64078A8_06FC410: I have discovered Vlad's true weakness! The sun!
Dialogue.E7C1B42A4DAF1C6B980B69967B9EA059_06FC410: I have discovered more monster weaknesses. Here goes.
Dialogue.D5AA2539468B0815E6C6CE932691B4F0_9D00593: I have discovered the perfect summer Christmas song.
Dialogue.1F025C4A410BDCC0B29CC8BF87C3DEE3_97A9259: I have done all I can for you my son.
Dialogue.7D1321614C5E052AF73575AD36CC6816_B25AF7B: I have eaten of the storm's corruption, and now I am The Lord Of Darkness!
Dialogue.C8A4ADE248801B04DA00B09021119060_D87E161: I have everything I need to go on a fox hunt.
Dialogue.0FEE58264087C2752B5EE2BB3B27656B_47CFF90: I have gone another night without getting sleep. Tell me you're making progress.
Dialogue.2812CE09425ADAEBCD2511B651BAEB43_06FC410: I have good news and bad news, Carlos from the past.
Dialogue.813A5FDE4432742DB45E048D5B0426C7_910A467: I have gotten in the way of a lot of attacks today. Hoo boy.
Dialogue.DCA991774AFE8553CAE8D6893BA0DD57_AB3C42C: I have his personality backed up on a drive.
Dialogue.04AD53514AEA9B5AB355C6AC7A4AAD09_06FC410: I have hover boosters, so I don't know if I can do trust falls without scorching someone.
Dialogue.13C8E26549CBDCA87BB906A3907C8AD0_861A10F: I have just the song this summer needs!
Dialogue.14C6BEA84D07294A1FAB36B844B43CFE_9F725B6: I have just the song this summer needs!
Dialogue.928C4A6D42D2D74F45A772BD85032716_14FBFB1: I have just the song this summer needs!
Dialogue.669345B1473418AB5408DCA9D7E7ADEF_861A10F: I have my great-great grandmum's recipe, but first we need to get the ingredients.
Dialogue.21FDB0E2478245265C254D911DCAC789_47CFF90: I have never admired a personnel management technique more. That was inspired.
Dialogue.0BFCEB5C46EA3DB599DF5FAEBB3611A7_97A9259: I have no choice but to attempt contact with the spirits themselves.
Dialogue.DBCBF06B4D4BE66234286AB09FA94014_D87E161: I have no clue what you're talking about, Riggs.
Dialogue.A77E96D641640A2FC719C59104EF0C7D_EB81C5B: I have no funny bone, it is true.
Dialogue.156743434B26D6DAFFC5629D71A97612_06FC410: I have no idea how to fix that.
Dialogue.42CD6B8947CB69407F3B26A044B8A083_7D2960E: I have no idea what I'm supposed to be doing.
Dialogue.FE05C00449CBBAECF39D24AA56DE1765_97A9259: I have no idea what that was, but it sure sounded like L-O-V-E.
Dialogue.CEA9B0E84F7EBC6777F862946D8D176B_D87E161: I have no idea what you're talking about.
Dialogue.5D8B375942057E4B748EB1A12E7567CD_06FC410: I have no idea why Carlos and Desiree would be working together.
Dialogue.22B0BFE64C4132999DC31EB791D78D37_D1275FF: I have no quarrel with you, good toys. But the deed must be done!
Dialogue.7E82800643A22777293A08AA87712CFA_B229E47: I have one simple request for you, Commander.
Dialogue.CA6BDA0442A9CE4D48D0C89861EDBF9F_C9708CA: I have reason to believe that the people who built these bases are still alive.
Dialogue.7FEF029D44D7FBDC0BD23D91E6F82536_FB122F8: I have reason to believe the storm has created a new branch of physics...
Dialogue.CD58CC0C4639339A79877CAAB3C773AC_97A9259: I have recorded my encounter with a real, no longer live, ghost.
Dialogue.35F8479C4FC7381DCC27EF9738A60005_97A9259: I have resting Dennis face. Maybe you're reacting to that?
Dialogue.0C5AB5ED4BD9409A01D6BB9025F72259_06FC410: I have returned to my perch above the fray.
Dialogue.497502F3424864841BD4918631D3571C_CC5E92B: I have so many more weapons to shoot...
Dialogue.5712968643673317603C5EA906B25940_1D2FE88: I have so much more in store for you...
Dialogue.D7D258B444B25D7591AC41988AE1BFCA_EAAE146: I have so much pillaging left in me.
Dialogue.ACE08A6A4E6B1DDB2A11B896691D1F16_06FC410: I have someone I want you to meet.
Dialogue.16F491B2436C19D505C15BB1AF876B04_CC240C1: I have taken the shards to the lab...
Dialogue.A4BB895D49896BD91761789B7F33E698_06FC410: I have to admit, I'm less impressed with fire than I was before we arrived here.
Dialogue.AC233DAA410BE4B8714292A8DF018026_724DAF1: I have to agree with Dennis, here.
Dialogue.46A66F894BEC451138D1EDA627591709_06FC410: I have to go for a minute.
Dialogue.3BCDA45246E7E7587A849398C11F254C_97A9259: I have to make the time we have perfect.
Dialogue.381261B84879FEC4CCBE47BC5C3F296A_87F0BBB: I have to say, Ray... I'm pretty impressed.
Dialogue.0F8A99054D8CA3709FE0B7A65E6E6BFB_97A9259: I have to upload my order to the Taste Wizard Prime unit. It's the only way.
Dialogue.E7C6659C4E3B37D90558E58A0E7BBCD4_06FC410: I have tried everything at my disposal to track down SEE-Bot.
Dialogue.C786C5D24F1C3BF4B163589181E1BFC9_06FC410: I have, in my hands, the ultimate building upgrade. And the best builder gets to try it out first.
Dialogue.6B5FDC784723D9F377545D9B79385374_FB122F8: I have, like, three memoirs that are full of so many crazy stories, even I don't know what's real and what's fabricated anymore.
Dialogue.E054F2CD4A04CE3821F0319E2694DF26_14FBFB1: I haven't been in such pain since my childhood in- (hand over mouth) I HAVE TO LEAVE.
Dialogue.A84163134C307E7D16CAFCB9B1B0BFE9_97A9259: I haven't gotten a compliment in three weeks!
Dialogue.392A08B8420973FA140117819189E6CE_FB122F8: I haven't ordered the turtleneck yet, but... I have added a few to my cart.
Dialogue.5712C0B144D2C5D87E3DB291A34987C2_06FC410: I haven't rolled out any kind of battle plan.
Dialogue.971AE1AA49F79D94E40B789B96EC2E08_06FC410: I haven't slept in three days!
Dialogue.D6D9A4424952C690A5B319819EE020EA_FB122F8: I haven't written the song yet, but... (sigh) Jess bummed me out when it comes to matters of the heart...
Dialogue.DABB1D7D4525D567D55A168F49DF7512_051E656: I hear someone calling me name earlier?
Dialogue.C3F1228945A6303677F2FA90942D5818_97A9259: I hear something about lighting fires?
Dialogue.3E01723E490E9ED84A74B9A50B30C309_EAAE146: I hear the clatter of husks!
Dialogue.7027CDD141691F35C5CDEABBE677E0EE_FB122F8: I hear you all are in need of a storm analyst.
Dialogue.EEF46C824D6DD1123F8E52BF556E7BED_87F0BBB: I hear you guys are ripping love a new one, and I am here for it.
Dialogue.DB863AF94CEBC7FE4B418BB448F08817_06FC410: I hear you're onto a surefire way to make this a terrible Christmas. Lay it on me.
Dialogue.DBE76358465B2601F6305C9AB6C47EC8_861A10F: I hear you're ready for the biggest scares of your lives.
Dialogue.39B7E17847738C2ABDC386BF9E4D7653_FB122F8: I hear your little buddy's lost his soul.
Dialogue.1B2DDE234B069A577554B898DCF26739_861A10F: I heard "Rarnold"? Heh, maybe? Yeah, let's go with that.
Dialogue.48FC869744684A3A16C26394BEB6B601_06FC410: I heard Desiree uses landlines to avoid the storm listening in...
Dialogue.D5A312EF46BD1860D963BFA7CCA1B916_FB122F8: I heard if you tune into the right radio station in this area, you can hear strange sounds.
Dialogue.C2B5777C4CAF9DA5C724F5901E8A460C_7D2960E: I heard it... on the wind...
Dialogue.827582214578FE7DBE5B65AA21C86FD5_21523A0: I heard there would be cocoa.
Dialogue.8D4229674D04BCD95B62CDAD5CF5E51A_94F2B66: I heard we've got a new breed of monster on our hands.
Dialogue.D50C05BF442F9E3EC50EC388F1446BF1_06FC410: I heard you and him fighting.
Dialogue.8FCDCF6849750D56F073E8A05FB86BBC_CC240C1: I heard you might be spending Christmas alone this year.
Dialogue.4A59525D4BB9C9C66D3503BB331378AA_06FC410: I heard you on Dennis the Love King.
Dialogue.452B061E4FB483E799741EBF3D50587C_7D086D9: I heard you say "Here we go."
Dialogue.ADAA710D4A81BB63C017C8B3290130EF_C2C5A2E: I heard you talking to Madcap.
Dialogue.907ECE954ADBC38D043807A0A2CB69D6_21EB734: I heard you was in the market for a bit of closure.
Dialogue.C7ABD8A94B1C9F06325D948CA319F857_47CFF90: I heard. There's very little left to burn so you stay on task and I'll keep the home fires not burning.
Dialogue.38010C5445BD1D604452DCBA8FCE175C_47CFF90: I hereby appoint you Head of Homebase Paranormal Investigations.
Dialogue.60C3EAAE446CC0C54148139748452DD3_06FC410: I honestly can't even tell what's changed.
Dialogue.BB225FA34596FFD246F9F498FF290C13_7D086D9: I honestly thought you'd like it.
Dialogue.ED212C3F4209F0131D83FB841035A3D4_B222EAD: I hope I didn't scare you, Lok. I entered your dream to let you know I'm here.
Dialogue.AD50F4964F4ACE14659AAA81854D0AAB_21523A0: I hope I'm not full of coal!
Dialogue.21E199E341412E55E6CE5DBE14FA1709_CC240C1: I hope Toyztopia is a toy utopia... but it might be a toy dystopia.
Dialogue.F4E233424A281BB0EB10948D484D03A1_21C1927: I hope it's Cuddly Bear bullets.
Dialogue.3630F2B742F27C2C0448D9994D7D0E18_97A9259: I hope someone else has a plan.
Dialogue.04F1246045EE3780CB369FA46B15038C_A96EA86: I hope that wherever she is, she can find her way back home.
Dialogue.91B64DF64D8B2037AAB38DAFEB094203_47CFF90: I hope there is a bridge, because we won't have a boat.
Dialogue.63E2D9D34B710002622C4C88ED8811AC_FB122F8: I hope they check the radiator! We don't need another overheat situation.
Dialogue.81E8497A4E13E7BA0530189EDC01E907_7D086D9: I hope this gives you a fighting chance.
Dialogue.AA0612404599BCD7ACAC1382A045A6EC_724DAF1: I hope this is a self-esteem building tactic.
Dialogue.90583BA9462A4D1CFA4E2CB372D0AB0B_1FCF39D: I hope we can build a snowman.
Dialogue.032EB49D4381D8B2B13DBCA412FD83A0_06FC410: I hope we can find one with the little car attached, Lok can be my sidekick! I'll get him a bandana.
Dialogue.E08C2DE94E600383B9F61CA5063977F6_06FC410: I hope we didn't all go soft.
Dialogue.E1ACEDAB45E077DD7B39D488CB9D3459_97A9259: I hope when you get home, you have a good future waiting for you.
Dialogue.4DB4536B445EC92E8DE1C69CB04257F1_47CFF90: I hope you can understand that we have to think of everyone...
Dialogue.5E526D21413A643C5E1A0089FD76F4C2_21523A0: I hope you get something good!
Dialogue.2F2E67654EA89F0B9D948392A5CEC4DD_21523A0: I hope you like it! I looked everywhere!
Dialogue.ED0219DF4DDF395313EBEE883A8DD999_861A10F: I hope you like my song, and I hope you find us on the beach!
Dialogue.2FD903AA479F23D98A44268886174FE8_724DAF1: I hope you like what you see.
Dialogue.F16FBE9E44C5722D7FA9C3B945897B4F_06FC410: I hope you're all feeling merry and bright, because we're about to get husked up.
Dialogue.E615972A40B3A57B340826B3007D76B2_B222EAD: I hope you're all getting settled in for a long winter's nap!
Dialogue.BC86F13746DDDBFFE4B58FBCB88B7928_06FC410: I hope you're in the mood for lasers and vengeance! It's time to fight the storm.
Dialogue.543BECBF47EDA86C09A1929CE228AA95_72190CE: I hope you're not! This should be very easy.
Dialogue.4C5325C0443AA8A273BEC8A1D00458D3_06FC410: I hope you're ready for unwelcome guests!
Dialogue.A983CDA04D338620B699FFA384A6C082_47CFF90: I hope you're taking notes, Commander.
Dialogue.426BD64A422C17FB803C5EBB4944CB4A_10E97D2: I hope you've enjoyed your little tour of my facilities, because it ends HERE!
Dialogue.2B3BE76F44E1BA1387099380AA2BCB8D_FB122F8: I hope your buddy steered clear of this place...
Dialogue.7A2083174DAB73E9A3C7C8981BE2C778_EAAE146: I hoped my fate was to be crushed by gold doubloons...
Dialogue.C93F27A049A59E2169CA0EBC9A6731CF_97A9259: I immersed myself in the high seas life.
Dialogue.4A05C3F94BE84E642A382FB2B3A0714F_181CD3E: I just didn't get it. And then I panicked. And then I gave up.
Dialogue.F43F40874590C21C4BA53DB8D66A10B5_7D086D9: I just don't see another option.
Dialogue.A482190D452FECA0C79BAFB3924A7998_EAAE146: I just expected to look around and be like, “Wow, that’s where Jack fought the cannibals!”
Dialogue.D7DC256A4C4097EF68BAF59AF30F2A52_B222EAD: I just got sick and didn't get better.
Dialogue.F6EF0CD34619C98EB080168A7F9BF760_06FC410: I just grabbed an old butter tub.
Dialogue.EA4D501541069533C08B3495F3824510_06FC410: I just had a bad day.
Dialogue.5887CF18493FD9F020F3B1BBC37E3AF5_1D2FE88: I just had an interesting discussion with my supervisor...
Dialogue.8F71FA694E8D5082F9CD4887805B902B_47CFF90: I just have to start moving.
Dialogue.7D50DD3C45E82ABBE39B408E1F57918C_47CFF90: I just hope you haven't picked up any of her, uh... bad habits.
Dialogue.55A550C9455610CC49292C87302D3822_0A979DB: I just killed a monster. No, I am not soft, now.
Dialogue.8281427744F28BB07B934FA3DD07B192_861A10F: I just learned a few new husk-fighting moves is all.
Dialogue.6B69BCFE4CEF58F5E6AC27B093A275C4_06FC410: I just mean... I don't know the last time I've seen Homebase come together like this.
Dialogue.CE69DD3E4B24AC9F04ADB3A094D38423_861A10F: I just meant... would you like a teddy bear?
Dialogue.3640E19A4B4CEBFC13E65D9FC597A111_0ADEFA4: I just need 2 BluGlo to power the device.
Dialogue.3542C3A24B8CB23D3CBEE0884955B4D3_06FC410: I just need a minute without SEE-bot.
Dialogue.627F158F48D018D376323BA6AD33D004_97A9259: I just need to be alone, I think.
Dialogue.B26F7C864704B363B41AB6BD173D24EF_97A9259: I just need to craft the most perfect grilling machine known to man.
Dialogue.B087844E44BFB1437D524AA17BF25E9C_06FC410: I just need to know they're safe.
Dialogue.8570CAD040F2428E2B40C483CC688E9A_FB122F8: I just need to let you know that I will crash this van.
Dialogue.A00A2281493939EFC86CAD9AE25E1CB0_84C369E: I just need to… yeah… okay... okay...
Dialogue.12D6A0D749F481C436AE0481074F3B5A_861A10F: I just needed a few more supplies. This spark plug was first on my list!
Dialogue.B16373184A292F0C183326BAB946A62F_FB122F8: I just observed two storm cells!
Dialogue.6B8B10864551BF755865238CFD2D1D80_97A9259: I just realized I should ask you for advice, Ray.
Dialogue.0990BAFF4E2C5313E71824AF514F9048_06FC410: I just sort of assumed that a monster as terrible as the Storm King would be like... the main bad guy.
Dialogue.E18D35AA4F20DF902064888952BAA6F8_97A9259: I just spent what felt like an entire lifetime drowning in the darkest saddest corners of my mind.
Dialogue.2B9ABEFD4D28E6D286209ABFA92F5BBE_9F725B6: I just summoned the confidence of a seven foot tall Christmas maniac and got started.
Dialogue.BC720CE647134FFC8DBEC8BB7D215E74_CC240C1: I just thought that was how you normally dressed.
Dialogue.2AD1BC674659CCA8F8E72896CB4062E4_97A9259: I just want everyone to know that this could not be going better for me.
Dialogue.C652E9E945ABF9D37B371AA28B919B47_21C1927: I just want to be treated like everyone else. And I want my friends to be treated like everyone else.
Dialogue.724894BC402F7FB3D068148E40CA172B_06FC410: I just want to make a show that makes people believe even for a second that we have a future.
Dialogue.0E387E0C4770B4080F6A009E5BF11157_97A9259: I just want to say that it's really important to me that we're not, like... awful.
Dialogue.1DF9B3F64CB5042C504DBB86653A1CC4_C2C5A2E: I just want you all to know that asking for help of any kind is a sign of weakness.
Dialogue.342634124FA527DA3ECC538C55C62BC1_94F2B66: I just want you all to know...
Dialogue.F7A99EBA4766B1A786A4B795E912465F_B222EAD: I just want you to know I'm not proud of what's about to happen.
Dialogue.EA7177BA4ADDD69C5C736F8A08B4910D_97A9259: I just wanted to thank you for Batquake.
Dialogue.F42D7AF54AE7C0260EC879A9F976C959_47CFF90: I just wanted to thank you for your help with all this.
Dialogue.23E87F784EA93524696BE8BA69AA223E_47CFF90: I just wanted you to know, I'm standing by to help.
Dialogue.7677E5EE4A13CCF85BBD2FB82E9C37B5_06FC410: I just won't ever sleep again. That's a solid plan.
Dialogue.F0BAE42D4E1F0B1AB0D81AB0AD7A4E81_9D00593: I just... I just love the holidays so much.
Dialogue.D34A01384156BABA1D392DB59AC65068_FB122F8: I just... really like cause and effect. Ya know?
Dialogue.F27C61B844FEEAD86B0CBC8379642E81_97A9259: I keep finding evidence of other ghosts...
Dialogue.38F60ADC408E1C0561B48A85DD3C320F_1D2FE88: I keep forgetting to mention the traps. We have traps now.
Dialogue.A8461E8F490E67EEFFB43CB9990939CF_06FC410: I keep forgetting you were in a real band.
Dialogue.F5005D1D49DDB298F457648CB57B1DD0_7D2960E: I kinda already got my thing.
Dialogue.A6696D8B463A785C6E28C395D0AF0BC1_06FC410: I kinda got wrapped up in your theory, but that is not what's happening.
Dialogue.26C566464FCF96B6CC2CEF92774E0F2C_06FC410: I kinda want to check your math on this... but I also really do not at all.
Dialogue.B0292860465F1F17E4287A960FF46ACE_06FC410: I knew I'd been here before!
Dialogue.7D0C31D64ADAD0AB40A1F6B7708BDD87_D87E161: I knew he was a flight risk, so I locked the outside door.
Dialogue.0641440F4F390986115DAF97E0630462_D87E161: I knew it was a grift, but it was a chaotic grift, and that was compelling.
Dialogue.F76D3A1D4A4A5D8EB307F4A70725D02A_97A9259: I knew it was trouble from the day we switched it on at the Durrburger HQ.
Dialogue.D9EF1DC34143A90BB63B6EBF80B46E11_06FC410: I knew it! Lars, could we use this chart to launch someone into Hexsylvania?
Dialogue.1A2A08B24FF6795273CD7598BD052264_06FC410: I knew it! You're angling for a second Christmas!
Dialogue.C841298945EF589C83CF38B2A4FEDB0D_97A9259: I knew that burger would change the world!
Dialogue.CBAD0B1A407528EB742EF0947292196E_9D00593: I knew you wouldn't invite me to your Homebase parties.
Dialogue.2B24D76D43D8539BF39C38A7A0A7A67A_97A9259: I know I'm dumb, okay? That's just how it is.
Dialogue.766ED0644F65E19D2CB2048D246ECB4C_06FC410: I know I've seen rocket parts around here, and we're a space movie.
Dialogue.3E05C4A9426B22EB81313EA34A732DDE_06FC410: I know Lok has been working hard on becoming a lawyer, but I just don't think this is the job for him.
Dialogue.10E33CDF43188BF5524FE897A0CD213D_21C1927: I know about the Morpho Gear Gang, Ted.
Dialogue.EDBA7A6A411E5D199EDC689D3AE8B514_14FBFB1: I know an enemy spy when I see one...
Dialogue.B6B42083482E53310645D3BA11A92FE3_97A9259: I know beggars can't be exec producers, but does the world really need another sequel?
Dialogue.770C580046817B4462A18D94133EF5CD_06FC410: I know emotions are high, and Cuddly Bears are locked and loaded.
Dialogue.CB45619342F218F27ECE4AACDD2A5E05_7D2960E: I know fear, and this ain't it.
Dialogue.2F3137854D8494161612E29FA786DB9A_E090F2A: I know for a fact, for a fact... that if a nosferatu licks you, you get to vamp out for a full thirty minutes!
Dialogue.767EF20644D339647818509D09FA9D58_06FC410: I know he's a little rough around the edges.
Dialogue.541F5F644046C0C6DC6F5B9CC6778435_CC240C1: I know how to cause a leak in the reactor so I can make radioactive beehives!
Dialogue.D6E5515748A674EBCDC1C8A7D2996B7E_06FC410: I know how to decrypt what he's saying.
Dialogue.96CE6ED84D0201BA703CD7BD29DA810A_97A9259: I know how to defeat The Nothing.
Dialogue.FA7339E84851DD086143F3BF07A25BE1_B222EAD: I know how to turn you into the world's most notorious pirate.
Dialogue.9BDCBF1A4AD6D9FFC64ECC91BCC3F9E8_06FC410: I know it can be a little messy...
Dialogue.812ACA3A4955D0192BB8ECABB5A9CB20_14FBFB1: I know it said not to open it until you died, but...
Dialogue.ABE0FCB4436F6F4CAFB51189C5A3A4FC_C9708CA: I know it seems tempting… but I have got good news -
Dialogue.22DEFA2B44CD94EB570B769B87D46934_C9708CA: I know it sounds like some crazy conspiracy... but I have proof.
Dialogue.DBB1A54549B2C1BB9EA066BE21E06753_97A9259: I know it was my idea to talk to the vampires...
Dialogue.338ECF1A4365D659B9752F8AAD4CBC66_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.3FF4F6BC4AAA4E44461804A6F6525759_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.5A6B4CE44A4089A5DC40BF9226C3E487_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.9474D6784C3596F37D1C418323D415F8_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.BCDD337D47EFCEBC10F2CFAD4BB09AC4_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.C07E42CC4F60B044194CFEBF82A47CA9_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.E39F06CC4C74CE391326C78899D4AECB_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.EBCE7E5043F58F2CCF06D78DCB15FF4F_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.F4BE324F45F9F126AAB925986204D553_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.F8DE84E34586B8AF2684DA8E20704528_0ADEFA4: I know it's a lot to ask.
Dialogue.D85C66F24E153C0003C1B9842CD85991_97A9259: I know it's just a stupid lantern, and the husks would have gotten it eventually...
Dialogue.1194F9B94FD13A93E05BE599A5218C43_06FC410: I know it's not likely, but if we can piece together the note quickly, we might get the upper hand...
Dialogue.C696D71C4AB6717E9D06CEB93B25D47A_06FC410: I know it's the last place I would check.
Dialogue.6F4E703F4431BB8DC3F1CD8443B722A5_06FC410: I know it's the old west but did no one use paperclips?!
Dialogue.C34BF6A54ACE9DF50911EAA9EA1D6470_06FC410: I know making friends can be hard.
Dialogue.8876E2D54E07E0185EDBFA80AC25DC13_EAAE146: I know my brother's a complete idiot...
Dialogue.5E69DC6E4CDFCDB50D982F98728E8A11_D1275FF: I know that I don’t know, and for me that’s enough.
Dialogue.CD109FBD44D86F74CD63DE9840B75D0F_FB122F8: I know that dead behind the eyes look anywhere.
Dialogue.510F9B5B494B299C728F3392269114CA_06FC410: I know that sounds bad, but I have a backup plan. According to my annual "Getting to Know You" Homebase survey...
Dialogue.63A1D5194D5F20AE75DD49AE31316C48_97A9259: I know the dude from Batquake!
Dialogue.64DCB32649B2B8634B86A49041F81B58_06FC410: I know this isn't much... and it certainly isn't enough.
Dialogue.F568D4A44ABFF0326A639ABB97505D3B_06FC410: I know we haven't found your friends yet...
Dialogue.B4E7454C451A377DCDDA8DB8BE6FF921_D87E161: I know we needed that stuff, but... that explosion was pretty cool.
Dialogue.7B9833FA40A7F214B24C81916E242758_06FC410: I know we saw Dr. Vinderman's message...
Dialogue.B49B08D74C857232245A37BC8EB76D99_06FC410: I know we'll find a lawyer soon. Just keep looking.
Dialogue.7E1E14C842C5324B86C15AAB3C55B49D_06FC410: I know we're all worried, but I'm sure Crackshot is fine.
Dialogue.BD51A589446E6E68093FDE80AEE27059_97A9259: I know we're getting cans, but I packed Dennis Jr. a lunchbox for the trip.
Dialogue.71A7E3714BE9CCD16CD4E7AABBAA0399_94F2B66: I know we've let you down.
Dialogue.BDFC29954E9B7611E9A9A48CEA38EEF6_7D2960E: I know what I need to know, you go through life with perfectly normal thumbs.
Dialogue.6D0383294829F83AAE96B0A9EF5A47B1_97A9259: I know what I've got to do, but that's gonna be more of a solo adventure - oh boy - oh it's happening -
Dialogue.5BF40E44461E419CE5249192B1ED625A_C2C5A2E: I know what you're going to ask and the answer is no.
Dialogue.0A8AD52246F132C8227F258E0214920F_7D086D9: I know what you're planning to do.
Dialogue.2AFE9C074D781D2B1C0EFB8153142CAF_06FC410: I know why you hate me, Desiree.
Dialogue.88AF20434CB99E5D69FE7FA0B8DA0C0C_06FC410: I know you can't see me, but what I'm miming should be obvious.
Dialogue.8E367C3B4D1A35D4DF3FAEA201C06E8E_910A467: I know you had many options. Thanks for choosing me!
Dialogue.C57EC13A4BA32344F919859AEA50A289_06FC410: I know you like the color blue...
Dialogue.6E882C23461D2364885EA9B893E4B6E1_181CD3E: I know you said you wanted a terrible Christmas, and I really tried, but then, the ideas...
Dialogue.3D82CDBC465BBF1F04B2A0961D36DD54_861A10F: I know you shut this whole thing down, but maybe we could do another run?
Dialogue.A553C4A74C445E93DCAB18AD0E442929_9801E98: I know you two always seemed to think so, but I am not the band therapist.
Dialogue.8F4E4F5D40EDD62F420DA682C573DAFE_94F2B66: I know you want to expand our reach, but we're stretched thin as it is.
Dialogue.6F3A19644E1751579331A1B1CC417B5F_06FC410: I know you want to go home... but you wouldn't last six minutes out there alone.
Dialogue.34E8478F42826FCA895294A50337C804_AB3C42C: I know you will. And the response is, "Aye aye, Captain."
Dialogue.E2DA18F14888B3C9D4DE80BDBB933458_06FC410: I know you'll make it work, Clip, and it'll be great.
Dialogue.74D523584D87DD54475050A62C437770_97A9259: I know you're afraid of screwing up.
Dialogue.8A98487442619CE1346F998F5644E9CB_47CFF90: I know you're anxious about finding treasure, Ray, but trust the process.
Dialogue.FDA863CA4B710DFE9EF0FCB5484F6350_7D2960E: I know you're getting the Christmas Misfits back together, Ray.
Dialogue.CD53927C488E2333E5C6BA87D459B688_77D814F: I know you're joking, but... that would have done it for me.
Dialogue.F6719FBC4EC77CF242F6FB964CA71F24_87F0BBB: I know you're lying to me.
Dialogue.43CD26F0495BDFE8A1A4138E08C4EEB9_47CFF90: I know you're making a joke, but I've seen first hand what that man has done to the Homebase chicken population...
Dialogue.3032222043D149D4B768CDACF6F1D926_06FC410: I know you're not happy with who you are...
Dialogue.BE8FCAF643B883C1F1CAB5B0BF3FC946_06FC410: I know you're not in love with Kevin because Kevin is unlovable.
Dialogue.C07C242B4560A8FAAEAAAD8B149C7C52_06FC410: I know you're not. You just did nothing.
Dialogue.D14995CC4C5D3B373ABCED8680207516_06FC410: I know you're stuck in time, Ned, but don't be cryptic.
Dialogue.E3F134634592C4CF3690BDBC6A80BDFB_7D086D9: I know your optimism circuit is blown, but you gotta stop bumming the rest of us out, okay?
Dialogue.9F2D6FDB40128343424A88B87D4AA63E_72190CE: I know! I just keep thinking, what if dad could see me now?
Dialogue.3A3A781B4E3BBD627D5CA58094133C7A_06FC410: I know! I've read all of your papers!
Dialogue.5A4F4D6342714DF6713D40B07C46FC42_06FC410: I know! Maybe some romcoms will kickstart my heart!
Dialogue.0287D50846217153B80757BD0F8A59A5_06FC410: I know! We'll make some holiday trees to welcome our new ghost friend, Willow!
Dialogue.67982F824D5DDA31C06003B072BF6C32_06FC410: I know, but it's okay it didn't work out. You guys were under a spell.
Dialogue.22A8327942DEDA001ECABFA49FFF87FB_06FC410: I know, right? It's really weird.
Dialogue.12A6ADBE4A2799E14DD7A29D1314D515_06FC410: I know. And I'm rejecting it.
Dialogue.9535FE7A4F3539691E7D7188E45D84AC_06FC410: I know. I mean... I guess maybe I don't.
Dialogue.16F929EC4F9499505F8EA49512D325EA_06FC410: I know. I want to help him too...
Dialogue.F642D3AA4F680CF00149A0ADC40E89EF_06FC410: I know. I'm looking for a solution.
Dialogue.3C0E5F6A481B0D73E41274A53D4158BD_14FBFB1: I know. It's hard to choose.
Dialogue.B9527B0145EA518C32E7DFB2B6DFD7B5_B222EAD: I know. Not my first time being a well buddy.
Dialogue.AD764C484E988E667FB1F4A9718B2BB6_47CFF90: I know. The generators are failing, but don't worry. I have a plan.
Dialogue.D90813CD4CA9A54BC653878576B2658D_861A10F: I learned a lot from our slasher friends.
Dialogue.1F4689C247D1AB364B52859FF4E2D6A8_06FC410: I learned that you can cry in your sleep.
Dialogue.0A1EA5194AB8F0848976A8BF65C281A0_84C369E: I like dancing, even without love. What about just dancing with your friends?
Dialogue.D437A5414FB3FD6F227A32920D0131B6_CC240C1: I like him. He's got a great attitude.
Dialogue.4C390C2A4FBAFB4E0DA577B9EE8E2B80_FB122F8: I like redundancy. The more the merrier. I want a backup of a backup!
Dialogue.6460369E41B142F6282C859CC15F472F_D87E161: I like that he's so open about who he is. And his many, many flaws.
Dialogue.465AFDC147E082DF6DE913AF1D73A524_9801E98: I like that one. It's called "Brain Feels".
Dialogue.7D21642D45743070C971DCA5E844CC23_14FBFB1: I like the sound of that.
Dialogue.34B755CF40573E6A51A5A8949E05FE72_861A10F: I like to think I got him ready for her. And without me, she wouldn't exist.
Dialogue.6B86E9FD40FB23FC8D094CB671B1058B_FB122F8: I like to think that the storm doesn't know what it's dealing with. Us.
Dialogue.383557B04DF85359A1E28A87571C66A7_5CE5FC8: I live among you, follow your rules, teaching you whatever tricks your rube minds can retain.
Dialogue.4520DBB241A00E9989A2FA8D370D82DE_DA0538A: I live to see the reindeer games again.
Dialogue.25E39FAA41871CA7A7BA19ADBC7EBC40_06FC410: I looked into sending us all into space and, let's face it, that path ends in 'splosions and tears.
Dialogue.A941FFA3487D817F31F5B48DEAB5A0FB_06FC410: I looked into the homebase blueprints, and oh wow.
Dialogue.6B3CB8394F2D264DCA95069B15941ABC_06FC410: I looked it up. Jefe is a card game with no rules and also somehow a lot of rules.
Dialogue.4F94F713454A40871C638095E3FA99A5_861A10F: I lost count. Got distracted by those magnificent floppy head puddles.
Dialogue.D3F010D145FF058E7291DBA88A1DAD21_06FC410: I love a new Storm Shield!
Dialogue.471A9A1F4E279D6F5293638CE02A4F4E_7F95CEB: I love bangin' tunes, but not this!
Dialogue.097862824104E4B6C5C21FB83334E5FD_CC240C1: I love being out of the oven! I can do anything! Anything I want! I can go anywhere!
Dialogue.A0728B9E48F5482D076CEAA2E35AF9A7_AFB40E2: I love building but I'm not in love with building.
Dialogue.2614CE8045CBDD07ABC4D69ABA1D3FB5_7D9D435: I love helping the good guys.
Dialogue.3BDF66B84EAC2478FF1E349F2BD8AC0A_0A979DB: I love it when you save turtles.
Dialogue.CEA6B181434136B0EFD769814DFC5088_97A9259: I love my buddy Ray. And if you hear my voice, I probably love you too.
Dialogue.48D3C62F45C4E7EE9C2B06B9060C01A1_06FC410: I love nicknames too. Like Ready Ray, or Ray-dar, or like Sweet Lady Ray.
Dialogue.FA6BD9834B1D3AAB8A701AB70988783D_765440C: I love the classic design of a good old-fashioned lightning trap. (chuckle)
Dialogue.1577E18345C85CD4089AECB69F60B856_72190CE: I love watching everyone I ever meet process the horror of my missing face in real time.
Dialogue.644FF9A04133A21E0A255484B6AD30BE_06FC410: I love when dudes communicate by making weird eye contact and playing very important indie rock songs at me.
Dialogue.DA376A524340D95AAB324BBB7E7EE100_1D2FE88: I love when life hands me an easy victory.
Dialogue.1A740EDD40BDAF996EB4CE82F598F141_97A9259: I love you, Ray. But this is the tenth time I've heard this story.
Dialogue.2E6E639243335A056A9EA6BDFDF40FA0_FB122F8: I love your true fan spirit, Little Robot, but this is bad.
Dialogue.2D060C00425E9A535FA341AA57C14A4A_97A9259: I made a sign for the honeymoon wagon, Penny!
Dialogue.3094818E477352B4B9FA63AC04674500_06FC410: I made it myself for your welcome home slash almost welcome home party!
Dialogue.DB213CC147B923164F34DD9A3ECCEFF0_9801E98: I made the mistake of looking away and then... You know. He wandered off.
Dialogue.985606E342BC5340994BCEA64DF25E48_06FC410: I made this armor for Spitfire. What's it doing here? In a hazmat barrel.
Dialogue.111D23BA4D309331ED44C4A746F2B4CA_97A9259: I make burgers. I love movies.
Dialogue.8A591C2344023B4151F51383F1680BA1_181CD3E: I make the toys, my whole life is fun and games, so... this should go well!
Dialogue.43B8669244188DF4F0DC49B073FD9DEC_72190CE: I make this look easy because it is. So, so easy and not hard.
Dialogue.4DE1119F429AFB64C863479697DB395B_06FC410: I managed to track down a copy of the Tourist's guide to Hexsylvania.
Dialogue.2D03ACE64ADC1E3B003FD7A8BEB8511A_06FC410: I marked the location of the set on your map.
Dialogue.9A88699640273BEDC11E2BBCB367CC82_06FC410: I marked where to place the cameras on your map.
Dialogue.80DEAC5243831D50F3C6CCB3C8828563_97A9259: I may be a loser, but at least I didn't--
Dialogue.CFB700BB42CD3DD6995392A9CDDD63E8_47CFF90: I may be just an intern today, but keep your eye on me. I'm gunning for the Director position.
Dialogue.BA22CE944D13C8517561899AF13A14E4_910A467: I may have 'sploded that husk, but I still respect its opinions!
Dialogue.03CA9CB346A2B5C817BD29847597A064_06FC410: I may have been bragging about how you're one of the original founders...
Dialogue.2C17316047914B2FA68579B486C587DE_06FC410: I may have installed some ransomware on the Homebase network which will delete all of our files... very soon.
Dialogue.1E57C0D24EB38271B84F15B8E9BD2609_7D086D9: I may have made the wrong decision, but I stand by it.
Dialogue.29BB488344D113A36B5CD0B45665F914_47CFF90: I may have oversold the appeal of peg legs. I won't do it again.
Dialogue.67BF987A43F1FC8894DBABA4CBAE550C_9D00593: I may not live to crack another nut...
Dialogue.4FCBE2FC4C6E24506450EE8E397CDB22_FB122F8: I mean I guess that makes sense.
Dialogue.1C0141394181C01461C8A2A59946859B_97A9259: I mean I was... but then I just-- I suddenly lost focus.
Dialogue.31009C2844354430D1D911BCFE2605DE_97A9259: I mean in a spooky way. And then the box disappeared.
Dialogue.16661CF645F65336E208FA8AA3D932AA_06FC410: I mean it. People will panic.
Dialogue.553534734F64A77314752F80CEC53B61_47CFF90: I mean like “Look out! It’s the Dread Pirate ...Blakebeard.” “Only one pirate could be behind this reign of terror: ...Blakebeard?”
Dialogue.62F7E29D4BFD02499AC0A2BA728B0911_06FC410: I mean literally... because I... have a plan.
Dialogue.A94C6BB24B4549DC55319B97D517774D_47CFF90: I mean she does but, uh... we have a strategy in place for this sort of thing.
Dialogue.783DD56040A059FDEC48199B0DC1213F_5991012: I mean, "Garbage Stream" could be a total mistranslation.
Dialogue.F32255024D963526AC289EAE7A2A7253_B222EAD: I mean, BluGlo bomb... on- onium.
Dialogue.3018DA1347CE059C8A9B03938EB6B6BC_06FC410: I mean, I am aware and conscious of what I'm doing. Thank you very much.
Dialogue.D900E81343031A006E32A79EE13BC553_97A9259: I mean, I broke time last week.
Dialogue.460F6FDC42578143CC455C95C3E76EB5_5991012: I mean, I couldn't. I'm a wolf-- Could I?
Dialogue.20841CB4474BBFDB196FD98FC743E43D_D87E161: I mean, I really, really hope so...
Dialogue.43D5F84A4177121E1827C097E36DBEA9_5991012: I mean, I would suggest going on maybe like a little press tour...
Dialogue.AEC9DA774D33E9BEB82A8AB7B5A75A89_97A9259: I mean, I'm no psychologist, but is it possible he bonked his brain?
Dialogue.A5F43D174CF9E9C035E11697F3828580_97A9259: I mean, I'm not not getting the appeal.
Dialogue.0C70D3AB46C8C73DABB195AC450EF0F1_06FC410: I mean, clearly they're not from the future and on a mission to stop Dennis Jr from leading the resistance...
Dialogue.49D48C51453EB57CD92F85BAD7B7989A_06FC410: I mean, do not take pride in this.
Dialogue.1A9D592A4E3BAEE1C9B71A98719503D6_B222EAD: I mean, dying is one of the critical steps.
Dialogue.918D1CDE4EEE7CCB96293A9D361314FD_97A9259: I mean, general direction's not bad.
Dialogue.4F80F6554BEA03D7EE22A794F15B9DED_97A9259: I mean, if Darwin were here, he would be very upset. Because this is not what survival of the fittest looks like.
Dialogue.A43145D44686BBF7332B72B1F683DD30_06FC410: I mean, if some were big and others were small, how do you choose who sleeps where?
Dialogue.5B94A22348053DD64635138020461912_06FC410: I mean, if you really think you have a secret to tell, go ahead buddy...
Dialogue.BD15886348A189044E2D338C545ECF10_5991012: I mean, it's against the natural order, according to all of their... meat paintings.
Dialogue.A2AAAD0C4FA169FD18B0ECAC1DD61366_9D00593: I mean, jingle bells, dude. Jingle. Bells.
Dialogue.D785510E4EE1B037362366A06D156DEE_FB122F8: I mean, look at that projection! Does that make a lick of sense to you?
Dialogue.25520C7A4CD8F9D36E1D5392A3F23439_06FC410: I mean, look at these animals. They're not fighting each other. They're not eating each other. They're not...
Dialogue.0577401E4EE46CC65D3553BDF2BD08C5_97A9259: I mean, love's a nightmare, no doubt. But, you know, you can't knock it 'til you've tried.
Dialogue.502DCBCE436EA8EF6A6BD89C4DD60CD3_F6B1D98: I mean, not right away. What you did is still super messed up.
Dialogue.125FB00C4AD1EA0F3602BB9BBD0DC5B1_97A9259: I mean, obviously that's the goal but... no promises.
Dialogue.0AE1E67C47A09B9139CE61932EAD734F_06FC410: I mean, specifically in this instance.
Dialogue.12AAAF96472335FEF63D5E805722F8F6_EAAE146: I mean, sure that's probably just a fairy tale, but maybe it's not?
Dialogue.2516D7124612670B5A5D1A94E15FBBEE_06FC410: I mean, sure there's a new chapter of the guidebook about Vlad's return to Hexsylvania.
Dialogue.72302EC34FF8A0E0621F0EB9F129B998_F6B1D98: I mean, that's cool I guess. Still sucks I died, though.
Dialogue.2563186C492FFA879D98FBBA33A63666_06FC410: I mean, that's the creepiest possible way I could think of to say it, but sure I guess that's--
Dialogue.0EC15DBE4F50FCD182AC239918225136_B222EAD: I mean, the whole "sheets are a ghost" thing went out with gaslamps and chimney sweeps.
Dialogue.157DBE9349D3F85E2AC421A9AF822906_861A10F: I mean, there should not be raptors running around, royal or otherwise.
Dialogue.D07860E74CA049F3F1635A9D69C847C8_06FC410: I mean, they were going somewhere, no one ends up on Route 99 accidentally.
Dialogue.F011C27E426FCC5F6C2C40B66CED7747_72190CE: I mean, this is so good it makes me regret stealing so much stuff from Homebase.
Dialogue.12952FA6458B3A7E948FD39935063721_77D814F: I mean, three survivor rescues? This fast? Something's not right here.
Dialogue.29B4CF054190E2D5171633BF025C79FF_724DAF1: I mean, truth be told, it was me. But not on purpose, alright? We were just talking.
Dialogue.978E350541A6D0C365CCD39733963B5D_06FC410: I mean, we all knew I was going to tag him before releasing him to the wild.
Dialogue.BD7869EB4C29117AE6EA179DD6A1ED6F_5991012: I mean, when it comes to chickens, the coop warmer is on, but there's nobody in the roost.
Dialogue.4FC53F084B0DEFCE8D382DB790B1B333_06FC410: I mean, who am I to talk about decor, but I can't imagine buying one of those husks paintings...
Dialogue.7DFA551A4C82BB924CA5BD8297524F6A_06FC410: I mean, why haven't we thought of it before?
Dialogue.41C9101F4345E504E37E299439294E80_5991012: I mean, yeah, but like...if you had to pick?
Dialogue.0DCE62FC44A4D82E35025CA6E8FFBF12_724DAF1: I mean, you know, It's still early access. But, uh... you know, point made.
Dialogue.7F33434C4B5E020305A209A4B0F96591_5CE5FC8: I mean-- Sure I was! Ha! Jokes among friends, who doesn't love 'em?
Dialogue.EF9175A24A52F8212C0CE3A136075A0A_9D00593: I mean. Let's check it out. (dark chuckle)
Dialogue.518C88F341874EBFCBE32F97DBCE92DD_97A9259: I mean. We're the good guys.
Dialogue.36843EEB4E87FB2BE7A9D9908D9E5D34_06FC410: I mean. Yes. What seems to be the problem.
Dialogue.D28882494F7F6BA5747B52ADDEDFBA88_06FC410: I mean... I don't know. The endless parade of horrors kinda threw off my barometer.
Dialogue.0A9A05A34CEE159BB0ABF790E7D956EB_06FC410: I mean... I even... I- I bought Lok a voice pack.
Dialogue.AD140ACB46F07002F9C767897C95AA09_06FC410: I mean... I'd love to see you try.
Dialogue.F1AB59474063265A71073DA5A48BE15D_06FC410: I mean... I'm beginning to think they might crack the top five.
Dialogue.40758B324BAD2BCFFFCFFC8444E99B16_06FC410: I mean... I'm not not cool with that.
Dialogue.08CD60754AD6749E0EF8F289B4CE8268_06FC410: I mean... If I didn't know better, I'd say this was the work of Dr. Vinderman.
Dialogue.549633384056191692D0D1B721ABD742_47CFF90: I mean... if you agree to stop attacking us, roar angrily.
Dialogue.AD3407E84A327009B88ED2B2BC345EF2_181CD3E: I mean... if you were better I probably wouldn't have gotten fired...
Dialogue.7862ED6348AB8C20A6902B9A818C15B9_A96EA86: I mean... it's great an all... but you know I can't come back.
Dialogue.2E7BAA434AD29F4B46BF59B83E05B4BF_47CFF90: I mean... why are you collecting freezer parts?
Dialogue.F8F3DCCD4C864DC3387B5B8697FD7219_7D086D9: I mean... worry about it, but don't do anything about it.
Dialogue.F2336A8D408A3D9CDF7258BF445736B8_97A9259: I mean... yeah, it's hard to believe that my son from the future is here to save the world...
Dialogue.A2045EC24D3D2D7A16DD1AA0CD51A135_97A9259: I mean... yeah. But this is the logical result of sending everyone to a slasher camp.
Dialogue.108053E44274C4D161CFD780CFA92A6A_06FC410: I mean...you know, dinosaurs that forgot how to be fun or compelling, heh...
Dialogue.74050EC3477229F00608EDBDD6F8F24F_861A10F: I meant fascinating, which is what I said!
Dialogue.4F814C3C4DF1C08996F1A78855483850_724DAF1: I meant that in a self-pitying way.
Dialogue.E0A2C3E644E46774979FFFA5469FAAD6_861A10F: I meant you should do that stuff. Not like, you know, with me.
Dialogue.6100242F49CA0479931A929EF9A888C3_06FC410: I met Cap'n Clark. The real Cap'n Clark. She is here and I met her. Get me episodes!
Dialogue.B6D073C6434B29241A1DE9B8AF08F66F_97A9259: I met a really cute doctor.
Dialogue.00BFBDF54EB4EA40FCA6A8BF835E8E51_14FBFB1: I might not. But, you know, I'm a little shy.
Dialogue.F49BDC9444EF03CBC4382C9CF8F3EF3F_97A9259: I miss my mom so much, but we can't end up in the same afterlife.
Dialogue.59EE20C049146E0766C1C79ECE51143A_FB122F8: I miss the days when we were only worried about monsters.
Dialogue.812C7E89477C4276CB26AB8E55EA9722_97A9259: I miss when he just reminded us to sign our timecards...
Dialogue.B75222E54A168A79C5068B8ED6AB2E60_DCC8D4F: I must breathe. I know, I know, but it's true.
Dialogue.69681AE949F7D3FF827199BA44ECEE82_47CFF90: I must insist that you've collected enough ornaments.
Dialogue.7886177D44A4D95386E5D297445564A1_C0E27E7: I need a doctor... or failing that, a sandwich.
Dialogue.DD05850C4AD4F713A584CA8BEA3FE329_071921D: I need a hand over this way.
Dialogue.5C62684C41A5CCBB4505F2B952828473_1FCF39D: I need a moment before I can continue my work.
Dialogue.760D5F794290A5B23AE037A3E9A884BC_97A9259: I need clocks. As many as you can find.
Dialogue.A94F11604EC0F1793DBB159310DAE22F_97A9259: I need more samples, and where you are there's a lot of them.
Dialogue.036EB300479185B7EE11EBB57B62E020_9D00593: I need music. To the radio station!
Dialogue.EB03CA81430027527663F5A685EBAA2B_E090F2A: I need my chunks to FEEL something today.
Dialogue.08ACA8714E63E024B97A2C8F16908EB8_97A9259: I need my head! Without it, the whole Dennis organization falls apart.
Dialogue.AC9366994E2F8B9BE05BBB9CD48AFFE4_97A9259: I need teddy bears and stuffed Quackleses!
Dialogue.9516A3124019E7A78589559ADDC5A5EF_06FC410: I need the Gallant to fly once more.
Dialogue.D69A52CF49B4733C4DB9DB9310E5DB24_97A9259: I need to do something... something that I know matters!
Dialogue.149D36DB486C2EC1E94B1982AB7EBC79_06FC410: I need to find a way to listen to this.
Dialogue.4A78144D4FB7B3BE1475EAA8E0842F1F_AB3C42C: I need to get back into character... Do you mind if Cap'n Clark takes point?
Dialogue.59A9633A48433D87513BFBB1E5AB6281_94F2B66: I need to get my men and women fired up.
Dialogue.A138F02C41CFB94F459DCE97832DE45D_FB122F8: I need to juice up multiple sensory sectors, plus give the pattern recognition pipeline a kick in the pants.
Dialogue.DF7B9010459FE024257729A326751EFA_7D2960E: I need to know for my mental health... Are you busting my chops right now?
Dialogue.6AACE678443E809D1DE138A991461701_47CFF90: I need to know what he's up to.
Dialogue.CC771AA840FFB74C25738A9D3155A3F8_94F2B66: I need to make them want to prove themselves.
Dialogue.29C71E594B72D13DCC2FB5B9997C63D6_071921D: I need to rest my boots.
Dialogue.21B78DFE458F6E698BB09DA1B8442638_72190CE: I need to spell out "Blakebeard's back, you'd better watch out."
Dialogue.A80F35824196E1CE9B6BC48A724A92AD_FB122F8: I need to think about this.
Dialogue.1A7A23154F5D6AAC314D3AAA0158F346_06FC410: I need you to be a bit more specific.
Dialogue.B835671D4703AB2890AC2697A242DFD0_06FC410: I need you to clear a path for the med team.
Dialogue.9EFD57B54EB5BD5CF6DD1BB56AE0AE57_06FC410: I need you to do a fly over. I'm sending coordinates now.
Dialogue.9B8760AC45FF4EE3743D95A2AEB361A8_94F2B66: I need you to show them what lies ahead in Plank Harbor.
Dialogue.235FFAD94DF671D6EB5BB9B2923D855E_FB122F8: I need your help. Can you hook me up with a better antenna?
Dialogue.89476E7F4961EEA54754769158658969_06FC410: I needed to make sure you hadn't become some weird monster.
Dialogue.0D785A3D4FE6C9034A35DDBD5691DA7F_EB81C5B: I never asked to be born.
Dialogue.3F193CD945AD39F69EF4B38BF49BDE1B_97A9259: I never figured you for a nugg-kill.
Dialogue.D8C4FFC54EDC340EBF6E14A01EB76B3C_97A9259: I never knew a werewolf could have social anxiety.
Dialogue.78D35A184D53F31A5B93D697495B7195_14FBFB1: I never take a wrong turn.
Dialogue.68BF277E474690D12E093CB585F69161_910A467: I never thought I'd say this, but I think we may have to... agree to disagree? Oh, dear.
