Dialogue.D1B0C29C473A5ECF3D13DA8D86F4046C_EED9CD8: I never thought I'd see my family again.
Dialogue.26DF641145F54324419A8B8103894289_9D00593: I never went to bomb school.
Dialogue.87807D6745609677C139688E6C645E01_B222EAD: I offered you a ghost army, and what did you do?
Dialogue.E2E57015434C0AC7470BB792C73510E7_7D086D9: I only drove over there once.
Dialogue.91623FD4455AE38EE1A835B57AA22DEE_765440C: I only have one more clip!
Dialogue.981874334C26627C3AE205B17ED8FC6C_B229E47: I only have the knowledge and memories that Dr. Vinderman gave me. If the original couldn't do it… what’s an AI copy like me supposed to do?
Dialogue.C87E627F48C74C3E4A7DC9AC4D988252_B222EAD: I only made the shower head pour blood once. Okay, twice.
Dialogue.284A8A3E43167F9C01B0CFAB4E87FDBB_14FBFB1: I owe you an apology. And a thank you. So I made you something.
Dialogue.7DCDE56C4FE4178E8859639C147DEE95_FB122F8: I owe you one Little Robot.
Dialogue.D98181284C1F50DFE4A2ECB9D02691B7_CC240C1: I paint a tree pink and it's pink because I say so...
Dialogue.B1CA7C7C478D8E075C331EA9E138639A_06FC410: I paired you two for a reason.
Dialogue.B7D4750C45E71C9E97C048BE095304FF_025DC3B: I pause for laughter, and then we go to the first slide.
Dialogue.4E3456E74221598FCAF48FA812239451_06FC410: I picked up some of the work she left behind...
Dialogue.A92294E04F51C5F1AF9C1E927C1CFD35_21C1927: I pour a mean cup of tea, and I am always ready to share a sympathetic ear or a friendly smile.
Dialogue.538EF2C1421BFAC891832CBE2EAAED79_97A9259: I prefer to be surprised by my mimes, honestly.
Dialogue.5E0411D34D08C2B6265A22881813BF0C_861A10F: I prefer to call it "spirit building."
Dialogue.BEB83C4E4FC791718F3CA2966E463D78_47CFF90: I prefer “whatchamacallems.” But, yes, your point still stands. Eagle Eye? Send the next coordinates our way.
Dialogue.C3D2DC5B4B5A588110D6E0BFBD689EE1_1D2FE88: I presume the valet has informed you of your recent status upgrade.
Dialogue.D56CB0D84519B274A63712B702021892_A96EA86: I probably don't need to tell you that the hero community is not happy about those fliers.
Dialogue.D7F97ED44753E0DE55946AAC7E3B359B_765440C: I probably should have mentioned it earlier.
Dialogue.C14B8FE045455178CDA27CBB2BE5C123_06FC410: I probably shouldn't give anyone ideas.
Dialogue.531BAC9247EAC0329463F3BB80313552_06FC410: I promise I wasn't trying to bum you out with this mission.
Dialogue.D4E9B0454BDACB12D970C293AEE351B1_06FC410: I promise you, this isn't the end.
Dialogue.33666A854CAA68DB63C44AB2E76281DF_C9708CA: I promised you some good news, and I intend to deliver before the generators die.
Dialogue.49BF9B9F4C1344C2867B198534A7B455_47CFF90: I put together a slideshow about the Collective Cheeriness Quotient and how it could be improved.
Dialogue.BE16AAB84D8540421D254D87075820EA_06FC410: I ran some simulations and Carlos's chances of surviving in that region of the storm are depressingly low.
Dialogue.40789BE145E37DEBA9FC1FA346E56EBB_861A10F: I read that cover to cover so many times as a child.
Dialogue.2E7E5CB0407A106F978E29BF3833CA23_7D086D9: I read the letter you wrote me.
Dialogue.15BC9D5D4378A53749DD74B6FF53531B_9801E98: I read through the research the... other Syd completed and it is miles beyond me.
Dialogue.8842EFD94109CCF82FD16F976D5434E0_CC240C1: I realized I might have been holding the diagram... upside-down.
Dialogue.4DB415AD4A94926CB07E00BAC0FBF50E_06FC410: I really am working on a better plan.
Dialogue.B8379AA5458C3E5D622EFF92E4CA28BF_B222EAD: I really appreciate you trying to cheer me up, but it's just a little... old fashioned.
Dialogue.158DF53A4C6E18E0069E13A963B710FA_0ADEFA4: I really can't leave without it.
Dialogue.24F9CBDB45056B975933E094A0847460_0ADEFA4: I really can't leave without it.
Dialogue.9564F716437CC48F94DD7EB3CA1BD841_0ADEFA4: I really can't leave without it.
Dialogue.5BAD52154311ED097FDADD99E7BC67D4_0ADEFA4: I really couldn't leave without it.
Dialogue.D57D2ABC40F35F2AB6B3CB8AFC27AC09_47CFF90: I really don't need this information. But, thank you.
Dialogue.5E63A85A42F0CFD38BCF3CA4121EC3C6_7C9093D: I really hope this goes better than the last siege.
Dialogue.2E454FED4490096B138F7A90B3BED1BD_06FC410: I really mean it this time!
Dialogue.3AF4FF334A112B10E64B9883C9523B1D_7D086D9: I really need to get back to work.
Dialogue.094602C042C8610AFB679E9C51105B92_97A9259: I really need you to declare a winner here, Ray.
Dialogue.F629FC21411ACB8E5FC3B7BA5F8F1E9B_47CFF90: I really thought that would work, but everything we do is making him stronger.
Dialogue.78696A6D4EB1B2848C78E59140E06090_06FC410: I really thought you'd be happier... about all the blood money...
Dialogue.A14BB5A64307A6412F32B69EFEC2B7E9_861A10F: I really tried not to. But, yeah... guilty.
Dialogue.D0AE1EAA46F73F1494EFB8AD9EC782D5_21EB734: I reckon that right there is the truest of heroes.
Dialogue.25A1763F4481A2914B6F77849F4CBC2B_14FBFB1: I refuse to fall in love! Do you understand me?
Dialogue.A77D4DF3408192B2ABD537BF8BF70B04_EAAE146: I regret burying everything we stole!
Dialogue.E7B980594991D238ECE1318809E1EB39_1D2FE88: I regret to inform you we'll be draining your life during your time with us.
Dialogue.9F38A4EA41EE0EC74E65A4AC4DE81BD4_F6B1D98: I remember being really mad when I died. At him, maybe? Ah, it's still coming to me.
Dialogue.D9AF0A604C4AA947A4581E96D4B3FE95_D87E161: I remember paddling across the lake to hang out with the other counselors at our rival camp.
Dialogue.61A1B07148A150428C38DABF2DE6C528_94F2B66: I remember telling you to do laps.
Dialogue.046211394F6F83A460BCD6B9DAC85444_B25AF7B: I repaired wagons for everyone in town.
Dialogue.1327D58E4BA24150CDA90CB0AB8AEEA5_47CFF90: I respect the fact that you want to take a stand here but, uh... please don't.
Dialogue.CD0B0C8D41927A7724AE3FB9F55380CF_06FC410: I reversed his circuitry, and let him unattended in the mist...
Dialogue.8628B361481ADEFFAF979BAA14FB4708_06FC410: I reviewed the footage of my performance in the field and it was... not great.
Dialogue.4152CCFB4E2D75F2FDCC7ABC8E111BCE_06FC410: I rigged listening devices on... what were probably telephone poles.
Dialogue.E7CD048F4E52832D133CF1A657A8A717_A96EA86: I rounded up all the searchlights I could find.
Dialogue.69A281CD4354EB055432FF8019F2687A_1D2FE88: I rushed to a cursed statue.
Dialogue.012097F043F251E85F80A8A76606534A_CC240C1: I said I'd cover for you.
Dialogue.7F3A91AD4EB952C05217B8873EE89778_FB122F8: I said no. Any chance to be stubborn and wrong, you know? So. That's that I guess.
Dialogue.4BF1940F45297D5B872C8880671DAF68_EB81C5B: I said pick me, not pickaxe me.
Dialogue.1FD6181B4E2499A20AFE4CB8ED4B828A_FB122F8: I said the exact same thing!
Dialogue.3D8921814ED0DE746AFEBAADBA2FFB26_DA0538A: I said to hold the line, pa-rum-pa-pum-pum!
Dialogue.8D274800441E0077AC6A57B1566B63F1_DA0538A: I said to hold the line, pa-rum-pa-pum-pum!
Dialogue.76DCB8EA4EF2C7C1B018D0ADA8849883_47CFF90: I said, "Be honest." But for reasons I cannot fathom, you chose to be terrifying.
Dialogue.07575A48432495221C652786E30306B5_06FC410: I said, "We should stop talking, then," but it occurs to me that you're on that, so... Okay.
Dialogue.AAB3206F466866FD52023BBB5F898B7A_9801E98: I said, are you ready to rock?!
Dialogue.0506197747E030195717A2963ADBC130_06FC410: I said, listen up broads and wiseacres, any action in this town - it comes through me and me alone.
Dialogue.5DDB2CA64F5BDB34B5E58E98125F5860_97A9259: I saved a life! What do you have to say about that?
Dialogue.6AAACBF04DF96DEF217A6EA7A30E00D6_06FC410: I saved everybody I possibly could, but I didn't die. So... that's that.
Dialogue.68D5ABA6479B01620DDCAB9AA2AEBA1D_14FBFB1: I saw a chicken wearing a cloak...and it changed me.
Dialogue.5348419C4528E4470B6940B0D3DCB39A_0A979DB: I saw her across the battlefield and thought, "Man, she's the worst!"
Dialogue.F4BF425D42F2C0EAA7FBEFA43A761675_C2C5A2E: I saw one cluster completely out of the storm. That doesn't happen.
Dialogue.3ABC2404480DD8551A3762999FFB5A97_97A9259: I saw something that was worse than every nightmare I've ever had combined...
Dialogue.B693A61C41717D45740206BF6E29A19C_FB122F8: I saw that light show you put on back there, by the way. Righteous pyro.
Dialogue.4230F8E649D67AEE487544A83B468C81_8106785: I say "No more!" This... is war. Take up your muskets, patriots.
Dialogue.0640243D45894AD5C33FBB85C5213E36_97A9259: I say go for it! Keep the calls coming. Dennis the Love King is on the line.
Dialogue.A643B13B453E66FC831E1E8A87547099_37EFC25: I say we focus on that flinger.
Dialogue.5CDFA80F43E95F3EFD2F6684EB55AAF4_8AED70B: I say- do you question the contents of my carapace?
Dialogue.AB3F833E4C2AC001503013ADB2262388_37EFC25: I see a husk! I hate it!
Dialogue.1B10140E414C0A3290F5FF9615591852_06FC410: I see a lot of angry glaring from the cast and crew...
Dialogue.AE40FFE340B5CB3D421598850F88EF0F_4731F06: I see dad outside. He's fighting the husks.
Dialogue.F7BD66D34AA8D3A57543B2AB03CACE0F_97A9259: I see it. I recognize it. I know this jar.
Dialogue.7FE9BE3F41FD992FC930DAB65A8381C9_47CFF90: I see nothing wrong with borrowing a few pirate maps, and passing the work off as our own.
Dialogue.32503454421398F1AD6ECA934F2F8037_47CFF90: I see survivors with no one there to protect them from the storm!
Dialogue.442556A445A9E6DE0756A191881CE42C_4731F06: I see that you're trying... and I guess I respect it?
Dialogue.6FA7F8F24420462356B71BBCBA570DA8_47CFF90: I see the end of the world, Dennis.
Dialogue.A041B70C46CC1A161A8DE9A09DA83752_97A9259: I see we're playing hardball. I can play hardball, too.
Dialogue.BF6FC67F41876BCAD0165DB986E07587_37EFC25: I see you when you’re sleeping too, you know.
Dialogue.0825247F4EE66018880ECF9BB9766510_7D086D9: I see you're as blunt as your creator.
Dialogue.66C3B75847CEE8CB19C062AE85EAF8A9_071921D: I see you, creeper. Make your move.
Dialogue.7682486A408AAFEEEA2FF68345015FE9_FB122F8: I see your four of hearts...
Dialogue.D7E12FA647AC3A47729737B1113F43E0_910A467: I seem to just be a head.
Dialogue.835DF0D5443A455DC22552A2B43CC4F8_071921D: I seen a taker or two in my time!
Dialogue.36093E9145CE9F27ACEC1F8C0D1ABAB4_14FBFB1: I sense I have found a new nemesis in this scary chicken.
Dialogue.CBBD9B4342483957E7B070AFC7DC6F47_CC9154B: I sense a disturbance in the fort.
Dialogue.DAA46111432B2004BDD382834E37A1F6_06FC410: I sense this will not end well.
Dialogue.5B55034E43A2D5455392529A8652C6C0_06FC410: I sent Pop to find the missing expedition and... he's still gone.
Dialogue.AD41C80C4AA4CB37AC324FA071B3E045_06FC410: I sent an expedition to locate the... whatever it was Dennis saw.
Dialogue.D3F76B0C4683000089B91194E684B8B6_4731F06: I seriously have a lot of super deadly weapons.
Dialogue.4D2F122940A7D57F5F7E138796D469E0_97A9259: I seriously have a problem. And please don't tell me I don't because it's really serious.
Dialogue.8E63A5D54AC3B3815A992C8AB9452CDE_B222EAD: I set up the poisoned pirate punch stands an hour ago, so all we have to do is wait.
Dialogue.7AC913724E33F8C3691107BDA1540684_9F725B6: I should be in the backseat of a speeding convertible.
Dialogue.2104F7EC4E839FBAEB41649E7F72B0AE_7D2960E: I should be out there doing something important, not stuck here with you!
Dialogue.29C0B8FB47261C172DCB20BFB9D4192B_B222EAD: I should be so lucky to make it to foul demon. Technically, I'm still just a second degree unclean spirit.
Dialogue.D0C6944C4AD4C9470F5F80BD7E2CAA7E_DA0538A: I should bring some back for the elves!
Dialogue.67A9D88D432B1702448614B35CAC50C2_4731F06: I should not be allowed to have this.
Dialogue.F4FD5DCA4A7DF480A80710B90EAE95FA_910A467: I simply find the most efficient solution to the case at hand, no matter the size.
Dialogue.7F374F7D4ADCA96E63F0A2B08CE6CFEA_1D2FE88: I sincerely wish we did not leave them lying about!
Dialogue.F7A589014252197F1849E5BEE8092CBC_9F725B6: I sit down and I start.
Dialogue.C7D9801345EEF13C358238ADF3034A3F_06FC410: I snagged us a guidebook back in Plankerton.
Dialogue.F291BDC04C82E8EDB367D29F2FCE42D0_0745BDE: I spent a year in the hole. I ain't goin' back!
Dialogue.DB0E8E6C483CFBE308731ABA1D0488EB_94F2B66: I spent four years in Plankshank infiltrating the Harbor Cartel.
Dialogue.F0E5443A4DF62DB13FB1FE98F0A55A2F_C2C5A2E: I spent nine long years on the inside just dreaming of Slurp. I'm gettin' one. Now. A real one.
Dialogue.EC3E1712421A91E299E5AD8F0B363114_97A9259: I spoke truth to power, and I got a write up and two Durr-merits.
Dialogue.CF4FDF7B4F4485BAA9B21F9380A37011_06FC410: I stand corrected, I guess...You guys know we live in a nightmare, right?
Dialogue.592BF34D425A8B96AB0B049E6FA322C9_EC1949E: I stared into the void and said, "Not this time!"
Dialogue.CF21815E46B299B32B042D827759E684_B222EAD: I stayed behind to warn people about the hotel. But... if I don't have to do that anymore...
Dialogue.0F2D9E5D440076AD956E049B6C312E35_9D00593: I stayed up all night making that note!
Dialogue.4A0161B34195F2AF88DC95BF0F704BDE_FB122F8: I stepped out for some fresh air.
Dialogue.0AC7B4D2436CBDCD93EC79AED822852C_94F2B66: I still don't know if I'm even the man who took that job all those years ago...
Dialogue.DF633D1D4467DF7E0F0CFEAD8B358025_72190CE: I still don't know what the big afterlife is like.
Dialogue.E85D5C2945FF6664B7A1ECA5B12684D7_CC240C1: I still feel bad that we broke one of the main rules of Homebase.
Dialogue.F8EDF664421468EBD7F5FB931984624D_B229E47: I still have no idea who you are. Can we get back to work, please?
Dialogue.E696C80141E49B88C3BF28AE1CF42DC9_EECA944: I still have so much more to see...
Dialogue.001F1055422EE21CB3D8849F5EEC8D46_FB122F8: I still sorta wish I was a pirate.
Dialogue.59182F984A48FCD22BCC91BFD9F0E13C_06FC410: I still want to hear what he has to say.
Dialogue.8414207C4AF64C98423EA3836B9DCBA1_CC240C1: I stopped drinking juice. It makes me catch fire.
Dialogue.DEBE3969453A0A85FF0CA3BCB444A203_FB122F8: I studied unique storm formations, my buddy Carlos was a star stalker,
Dialogue.A335722C4357618AEFDA4DA4627E3249_97A9259: I suddenly feel like this is a very bad idea... like I'm messing with forces I don't understand.
Dialogue.1D2A2CA7450336AF8AF6CD8F008DAD54_1D2FE88: I suggest succumbing to the heat now rather than facing him.
Dialogue.F6751562418E01C11609ABB9BCEB4F4D_7D2960E: I suggest we proceed with trial by combat.
Dialogue.3D58A2C64470E32004BDFEAE9258D402_910A467: I suggest you join me in space before the broad release.
Dialogue.1BAC2C4D4FB8567098828E86F0CC4A1F_94F2B66: I suggest you kiss your loved ones goodbye and make your peace with your creator.
Dialogue.917CF69A4081A7CB55D6A1BC83E3AEC6_B25EA52: I suggest you stock up on healing supplies before you need them yourself.
Dialogue.6D0D9B5244418CAFC46E9697082E23C9_94F2B66: I suppose I have still got a lot to teach you.
Dialogue.DF2FCB4D4EEFA6944484B68BA69C8FC1_06FC410: I suppose I'll be seein' you again this evening.
Dialogue.C507F5C54F977A65963254A51FAA16D3_94F2B66: I suppose he did. And I suppose there was.
Dialogue.D6D90FAD4F0C031BFE002080CD450038_94F2B66: I suppose he spent his life fighting so it just made sense.
Dialogue.B734F1B04DCC56789D4EABA8FDDD9B96_47CFF90: I suppose now is as good a time as any to mend fences with the Outlander community.
Dialogue.7C3B02F54B55524E46B1AF80F50F74F6_47CFF90: I suppose there's no coming back from that. That brings us to Mayhem.
Dialogue.9B9FDF4849D69B3FC5D3A689B85FA83F_47CFF90: I suppose we'll just have to wait and see.
Dialogue.66AFDF034A88387CFC14C8AD50D66E99_910A467: I suppose you must need that more than I do...
Dialogue.DA2B3A8D498265E3D363F6B8CE8235EE_47CFF90: I suppose, uh... Let’s keep looking for parts.
Dialogue.99ED02FF45A92FE9D90F8AAC9F6AF1E9_23FCD32: I survived the dungeons! This is not where I die.
Dialogue.6084E28740A4CAB3E3AB31AA966152B4_87F0BBB: I take care of myself. What of it?
Dialogue.89F52A954B735AA6FC8EDB9CEBB1A715_7D086D9: I take it you got my gift?
Dialogue.4D65B29B4E015FC350185A8C0C1311E8_8106785: I tell you you don't have to be afraid. I tell you you can walk outside and enjoy the sunshine...
Dialogue.88A0899F49416110E4B4F3A6408DD8AF_06FC410: I think Clip finally coming clean with her secret and letting go of the shame is helping get rid of the curse!
Dialogue.926E6F6B453496952764929D092AFFFA_06FC410: I think Dr. Vinderman would have liked that...
Dialogue.1AB9C1FA447A2FCBD84662991156C817_06FC410: I think I can build a lie detector, I'll just need medical equipment parts. Let's get started.
Dialogue.BFD1E15B42CC179B9C1122A83C2EE97A_2A04943: I think I can hold it.
Dialogue.AE160E2D477D30D80EBD83BA72F80148_37EFC25: I think I could use… a long winter’s nap.
Dialogue.52A403394C2C14396163CAB99E30029D_071921D: I think I found a me new partner for this dance.
Dialogue.25A1AA5B4DB20662153FF5971A5AF346_97A9259: I think I found part of the note!
Dialogue.BFF11E03438CE0EE7B505B9F336667B4_06FC410: I think I have a solution.
Dialogue.1DCFEC5144B6BF326885D8B713AEDFAA_B222EAD: I think I have an idea...
Dialogue.98E278E8400C7383649ADFA75CC8A9C6_97A9259: I think I have impostor syndrome.
Dialogue.58D6C2DE498FE91D5DD903A5BA2A7C81_CC240C1: I think I have something to say.
Dialogue.FDE704D4413F3FDAE7233B9B4F7CA29B_06FC410: I think I have to say goodbye.
Dialogue.FE14779944AD2372AB1315AA54290EC4_B222EAD: I think I have writer's block.
Dialogue.803DB9A54EDF2B0937E7FBA327A65E92_06FC410: I think I know a way to expand the storm shield. It's a little dangerous, but we can handle it.
Dialogue.E37CF7B543DD25DA32A478988762DDD0_06FC410: I think I know a way we can help Spitfire.
Dialogue.B2C1B1254B140C4A421F22AA710B750E_06FC410: I think I know how we can neutralize those rifts...
Dialogue.720864E648A25F9232B93ABF85ED432B_D87E161: I think I know that one.
Dialogue.55304ABA43361A6EB3E809A18EF4A714_97A9259: I think I know what is and isn't a Dennis burger.
Dialogue.E01CBA044C0A858B46110C93C64BCA9F_06FC410: I think I know what we can do.
Dialogue.D6B99D314C4B80FDF33620B6EA725D5B_FB122F8: I think I know what's been causing these little hiccups.
Dialogue.244F6CB64C90FF1763C5D2A5135D354A_071921D: I think I may need to see a doc.
Dialogue.C979C6874F733FF5EDCAC9A7BB0B0321_47CFF90: I think I might be in the position to offer you some help.
Dialogue.F4279BEA47E9C95E03255F9FA4F245F6_FB122F8: I think I need to know.
Dialogue.D779683043B8E4342BD7A0B0C62D8C68_861A10F: I think I psyched myself out.
Dialogue.8803B0A743D269770CFB8EBC828551DD_06FC410: I think I really upset Lars.
Dialogue.E7970B2D4DF9519F542ED38F778DE986_47CFF90: I think I recall rebooking once.
Dialogue.6E6A9D9D449CEC1F0C62B4B0FD3AF54D_06FC410: I think I see why you want to help the slashers.
Dialogue.516B8F614F5988732E0ECE87D6653E7A_97A9259: I think I took a vacation with this jar...
Dialogue.AAF527C349A0322640278383F7B5868F_06FC410: I think I understand less about what's happening now than I did this morning.
Dialogue.803AF9704BDEB274857737BAB46F9660_A96EA86: I think I'm gonna need some help getting home.
Dialogue.304866384C0281A7F5BBBF8B6FBFF696_06FC410: I think I'm gonna review the satellite footage. Something's not right here.
Dialogue.7C0B1FC140B35AAB9A68D4A39E90D9C3_97A9259: I think I'm in over my head here!
Dialogue.B1EBA4214198C1D35AD80DB0F6EC597C_06FC410: I think I'm starting to see why the storm would settle down here...
Dialogue.F9090A88446084ED2C29B19538F72C5E_06FC410: I think I... care about this jar?
Dialogue.AE4C123E4AD88432912718AA8E4B0F2F_181CD3E: I think Jilly could use something new to wear.
Dialogue.8DA3232A4A5B4BBC401304945248A676_97A9259: I think Jilly needs some help inspiring the team.
Dialogue.5091A4314F4E79AD3665A18434821611_861A10F: I think Rarnold and I are settling into a nice groove.
Dialogue.2614B1E645610692B1778B90BDC1A88B_9F725B6: I think Ray sent me here to tell you you'll find your way.
Dialogue.7A311C7F45376C4E8AB8B29C27017C2F_06FC410: I think even a good person can step into a puddle of evil, but you wipe off your boots and you keep moving.
Dialogue.940D3C1C43B6A67BC06063B26F038E0F_06FC410: I think everyone's under a little stress.
Dialogue.83D172BA4C4617D79EEF13A5088EB898_72190CE: I think he's been through enough.
Dialogue.560625E74BE5519E8077D5BEE3BEF511_47CFF90: I think he's fine up there in his van.
Dialogue.F4EB208848BC24E8E5867AAFA2D40036_06FC410: I think it did. Okay, you've got this, Commander.  Defend your defenses.
Dialogue.D6B14443411CCBAC243C259252207B5F_EAAE146: I think it must skip a generation, because I'm doing great.
Dialogue.4D2965F4458C9E75455441B98466C3B0_47CFF90: I think it's a bad idea, but I trust your judgement.
Dialogue.5C9D27834E8E2261EFF9A48C37E9F491_06FC410: I think it's a van, Lars.
Dialogue.FAFC5F204AFA42E03BFC788639F2471B_FB122F8: I think it's destabilizing the storm.
Dialogue.931B58D74E195815F118AC825E902432_06FC410: I think it's from him. I need the rest of the file.
Dialogue.800B7F7C45B14771B27957BDB2A60DBD_D87E161: I think it's in hiding right now.
Dialogue.ABEB7C09401CEEFF432EE8AFA8E2CF14_FB122F8: I think it's petty cash from an old blood bank.
Dialogue.955F97D14DDBDCE1F20CCBA0FE467594_9801E98: I think it's safe to say if there were any people down there, they probably were driven off...
Dialogue.1DA6ED204C9F9854C609E7AC7648BFDB_B222EAD: I think it's safe to say you'll be finding explosive presents for years to come.
Dialogue.54858FC54F3C4C042E2BA0941E99992B_06FC410: I think it's some sort of letter.
Dialogue.BF3983BA406C7570902C0FBD30C5D379_97A9259: I think it's the Slu- (gag) I think its the Slu- (gag) I can't even say it. It's the drink. It's infected.
Dialogue.AC3B70FB416D1156803666B20F7F35A8_94F2B66: I think maybe a car is involved.
Dialogue.8C6ADFA94A5865E605BD26B0B9E6D0C9_1D2FE88: I think maybe he just can't resist making a big entrance?
Dialogue.5C2127664309AC8D2DB5ABA3CD4D99FA_97A9259: I think maybe it's been an overwhelming day for them?
Dialogue.5BA5FE3847E27333E7E2B0BD9655F083_06FC410: I think now you may understand why.
Dialogue.783807B34501987E5D304596CEB07171_06FC410: I think practicing the dark arts is only one of many ways a good cop can go bad.
Dialogue.F359171C4E154119FA3EF8827DF3D68F_72190CE: I think she really wants to use those peg legs we picked up.
Dialogue.BC43ED194225108D5B542D93D5B6B673_AB3C42C: I think she'd see you protecting your crew long after others would have given up.
Dialogue.B43EA04D4AAAD00620C83DA79AEE4621_FB122F8: I think she'll tell us what she wants. Until then, we wait and see.
Dialogue.96454903483B24080D4930B56AB90D86_7D2960E: I think so. I think I'm really starting to become--
Dialogue.959269E74C6241DA33CEC7835D1DB643_06FC410: I think some tea and conversation will do you both good.
Dialogue.9C69B93549835D35FF1F64B2BE60F87A_910A467: I think that husk wants to chew on me. Which, I mean, is understandable.
Dialogue.9A47FE11405281B84F8FAAB25EDD1AC0_06FC410: I think that makes me the greatest warrior who ever lived!
Dialogue.C023FB2A49DB943D79A2AA9D6FDA2C82_071921D: I think that one bit me!
Dialogue.0A37FD4846858288347296AA4E8FFDF2_94F2B66: I think that one died of secondhand embarrassment.
Dialogue.DB4456A044EC0F97F17DB688FAF2F591_1FCF39D: I think that one skips leg day.
Dialogue.E8C59E3D4FB4E2F80C75F095F351B168_37EFC25: I think that one’s going to be too big for my sack.
Dialogue.81D767F443B6DC47E150959C3348EE22_97A9259: I think that will also make it mad?
Dialogue.B0DDC0F54E699FDC7FD79BAFFA6A78B7_06FC410: I think that's a dog training manual.
Dialogue.4FF0D09C43B3B3355BB7BF983CF2E435_47CFF90: I think that's just a smudge on the lens.
Dialogue.7CF115454C9EBFF66E960BBDD97BEA64_94F2B66: I think that's the last of the rings. So, that's the end I guess.
Dialogue.73429BF9409C0B50672BACA9F3707DC3_06FC410: I think that's the last one.
Dialogue.9A3FCAA84E554F9FDE9AC08CBCB179D1_06FC410: I think that's the last one.
Dialogue.D542422D4A21C5D38A83D9908431A74E_06FC410: I think the Storm King is targeting human brain waves,
Dialogue.A4073DDD4F8FBF879F4ADFB6DF347709_06FC410: I think the dealbreaker may have been the pay structure.
Dialogue.1FFD037448866FF7E59E60A3495DB268_FB122F8: I think the disturbance at the end of Canny Valley is weakening our reality...
Dialogue.8B3D64104ED8F2692ED11F907E3BACF0_06FC410: I think the fliers are working! We have reports Lok is nearby!
Dialogue.F9CDAA90407EF4D063E8C0A9C380C420_06FC410: I think the people around me are giving up.
Dialogue.FDE3592644B529C91C26F5B47EDBFC58_97A9259: I think the problem is we're not using lawyer bait.
Dialogue.50E3AF734F4A0DFA6F0613922BBE7A84_9801E98: I think the shortest explanation is... I'm a science based dirt psychic.
Dialogue.3871FE0B414FBE450BB2FBB72CCFEA86_06FC410: I think the survivors are going to need a little encouragement to come out of hiding.
Dialogue.CF91954E44083EEB7A180BB68E367457_06FC410: I think there was an accident!
Dialogue.02A485CB442CD5D32BDCC1A71FD3D9D1_CC240C1: I think there's BluGlo inside that big one.
Dialogue.6B5DBD4B4728892004B415BB8FD92844_FB122F8: I think there's an extra scoop of evil in this zone...
Dialogue.217170BA426F7C259C77329B26B9CA62_861A10F: I think they're really making progress with us.
Dialogue.616F11D84E00A0A5B53A478FA9F940CA_C2C5A2E: I think this is either Glurp or Caffeine Free Diet Half Clap.
Dialogue.37A8AAE84263063D2C5A0A953E3EA436_C9708CA: I think this is it. I don't know if you can hear what's going on outside… but it's not good.
Dialogue.4A4826C84BBD533C54694A827AA027F6_06FC410: I think this is the last note, seems like the trail's gone cold.
Dialogue.A9A58BEC41EE467F7625C489F507CD4D_D87E161: I think this particular dread is less "creeping" and more "imminently dangerous."
Dialogue.353214D94B39E974271FD0A7759DD0BC_B68F328: I think those albums might be the real deal.
Dialogue.C8E37E5E4432C25D8483BEB51724C9F6_FB122F8: I think those days are over.
Dialogue.A0643C264696D71089F75BACEFE04B93_765440C: I think those electrical coils are attuned to Hyde and the Doc's physiology.
Dialogue.E828518C4633638FC64F299811705E1E_06FC410: I think we all learned a valuable lesson today.  Don't do the thing I did.
Dialogue.E920F41D483EBC8DEAE827AB9DE19264_06FC410: I think we better take action.
Dialogue.523E1C034D3794472F417EB6190F3975_06FC410: I think we have to worry about Lok.
Dialogue.BEC9F1C443FF2CF1C05E7E959F3588D5_97A9259: I think we just found what we're looking for.
Dialogue.FCA374914F0E17BA913904A0B7AED680_3D2D55D: I think we need to investigate the area…
Dialogue.7B02D5554C8711CCF66B38B7D0098D44_765440C: I think we should collect as much BluGlo as we can. It could be useful later.
Dialogue.0929966E4729B73F280240A625E1C6AA_06FC410: I think we'd better do what SEE-bot says.
Dialogue.E26FB3634F21E36E8BE1ACB92CBB48EC_06FC410: I think we're heading into a dangerous time.
Dialogue.C8FEABB24B45CA417A0B259181FE0DDF_06FC410: I think we're ready to take things to the next level.
Dialogue.68E189E1492A620AA45916B0564CB897_06FC410: I think we're really making progress with the slashers.
Dialogue.26B01EAD476365C78A04C69F46DD1493_06FC410: I think we're running out of time.
Dialogue.BCCF0B334060836EEF3EB78CD0C51707_06FC410: I think we've got a major rescue mission in our future...
Dialogue.05CFF30442BADF94C44F3CB1C8F01933_FB122F8: I think we've had enough painful silences to last a lifetime.
Dialogue.3F79268949464A21FE3736B4F6A8604B_06FC410: I think we've nailed the creative. The high level we're going with is "Wow! I'm inside!"
Dialogue.65B4258B4861EB54AA1AF6B7169ADFA6_06FC410: I think you can help me change that.
Dialogue.B8C8105B497F43A3819908B108CCB0B8_06FC410: I think you get the gist... let's move on.
Dialogue.71EDC2F94C01F88CEBB31A8518BC83BF_47CFF90: I think you know what needs to happen.
Dialogue.D5224D614D9547B3226CDD9A9DAC02AA_7D086D9: I think you should join me.
Dialogue.E775634F4FC0BFB55ACC738360D1D53D_910A467: I think you'd like me to say, "Yes." So, for sure, yes.
Dialogue.4CDCE4CB4BD43A34C6CD39B782534A2E_181CD3E: I think you're all overreacting here. You're not that bad.
Dialogue.D1A434C847F292584C19D694BACC957B_DB7CBEB: I think you're lying, but I'mma go with it because I want a pizza party.
Dialogue.BC3444824D4875A48066F2A78419192E_D87E161: I think you're not ready for me yet.
Dialogue.E11F48FA49C892204A4C58A99B9E6768_861A10F: I think you've had more than enough time for talking.
Dialogue.7E59D48649D24EDB29A0B28A663A8688_5991012: I think you've successfully held off retribution!
Dialogue.997048BC4F0FF60DDCC044A1974A6F49_7D2960E: I think, due to the nature of my work...
Dialogue.F8A66F4C42CA51BB1D81F08916198D91_06FC410: I think... he's pitching a show.
Dialogue.B7B7455F4D664B1BC5119EAE8DA8DAB1_06FC410: I thought I could jump much higher than I can jump.
Dialogue.E184452A44CEF9681D8AA28AD0D07D7D_B222EAD: I thought I didn't want any company over here...
Dialogue.532686E543A5AB03675D1EB208D57249_14FBFB1: I thought I needed to see her face, but what I actually needed were her words.
Dialogue.BC3A5B194F9845F193D36497CB359CFD_21523A0: I thought I would skate by this one.
Dialogue.16F0217A4540DAF2A6AE68BE44990AD1_06FC410: I thought I'd get into the spirit of the competition, so I came up with a prize.
Dialogue.61B89DFD455C30B70ECF8185EBED114F_97A9259: I thought about bringing it up with Rarrnold, but he might bite my head off, for real.
Dialogue.04582DF94D62EEEE0F1EA089837631B4_861A10F: I thought about what you said, Ray.
Dialogue.84A894E443282BA9FCD617A8983B554E_06FC410: I thought he was doing a bit.
Dialogue.89073E9B4E2BB472BFEF9993DE1D54D2_47CFF90: I thought he was going to help with this.
Dialogue.32B900704EAD498B4679B2B2EA7E9B0E_EC1949E: I thought it was a husk! It's usually husks!
Dialogue.683AC7EC45EB52F40BC1EFAF82A62DEC_724DAF1: I thought it was fine, but Anthony hated it.
Dialogue.A14D231E485B7417461D58ABB614EF2B_1D2FE88: I thought it would be funny to add some lava to the situation.
Dialogue.31F2689E4B5D824C6203D18FC671BB9F_FB122F8: I thought it would take longer for money to make me totally tech bro bonkers, but... nah
Dialogue.30BFEB2A456D6D235ED5339EECCEB649_06FC410: I thought rocket pilot was the perfect role for him in our movie.
Dialogue.84E241A84D7654E0C13A7CA6779614C1_5991012: I thought so... But I don't know, you know? I don't know... Maybe!
Dialogue.17DCD1B4439FB20C2C6EFA9A919AF12F_FB122F8: I thought that might be the case.
Dialogue.86C6FC1741E23E4FE70760ADC12B372F_861A10F: I thought that was the one!
Dialogue.9E0AD732415ECEAB13138D80AF157ADD_B222EAD: I thought the point of all this was to undo everything that made last Christmas so special.
Dialogue.0268590F4F971E11848801A521025DF5_F6B1D98: I thought these people were all your friends. You really keep secrets from them?
Dialogue.1F1FF7644971F97B724E5C976425842F_06FC410: I thought they were being really, really insensitive...
Dialogue.8BF386CC488446C1C0CE6FA06668C902_06FC410: I thought they were rebellious scoundrels with devil-may-care attitudes and swashbuckling panache...
Dialogue.31ACDD4543E4E76AF049D9A203E6DB71_071921D: I thought they'd punched my ticket.
Dialogue.0EF421784F3506EAEEF8B2897DF733FB_06FC410: I thought this plan was gonna be my magnum opus, my Morpho Gear Gang.
Dialogue.F768FCA749B31778D2D2F085400431F9_06FC410: I thought this was going to be one of the silly ones.
Dialogue.05AB701C4AAB788F1317989C9188D73E_B222EAD: I thought this was supposed to be a terrible Christmas.
Dialogue.CD1FBEC2403555E10FDD2D8F096A0823_97A9259: I thought we all agreed we'd stop using the h-word if no one actually had loose slices of the h-word in their pockets.
Dialogue.3A76CA32475CCD85BE641D8AF6EFB8A8_14FBFB1: I thought we were done with this game.
Dialogue.81588CF74F91C8AC5A76AEB69BF046DD_F6B1D98: I thought you already told all your secrets.
Dialogue.DEB8666240742B2CAEB999B68666AFD2_5CE5FC8: I thought you didn't need survey results?
Dialogue.2F8244DF46F32613C172D7B029260771_FB122F8: I thought you gave up on me.
Dialogue.A03F87C94249E6833171D3888772833C_06FC410: I thought you might enjoy smashin' em up a bit.
Dialogue.D01E41E747C28989BB54569570C3520B_47CFF90: I thought you might like this one.
Dialogue.DD7E80E44F9E1A08A2FF86BBC72E8128_B222EAD: I thought you might want to know, so I didn't count.
Dialogue.B10A59284FD33DB10B57058E27DA725B_06FC410: I thought you wanted me to read your horoscope.
Dialogue.FA69DA3246D6B8F9577D27A85EF62B06_94F2B66: I thought you were a scientist.
Dialogue.C93DCF4544B06FA5966B5EB456E945D9_06FC410: I thought you were doing a bit. So, what's your whole angle?
Dialogue.821CD5EA4CD2AB127370B18433160F66_06FC410: I thought you were my best friend.
Dialogue.15D5D4314CBFFD5EE594BF844DB261C1_06FC410: I thought you were my friend, Dennis!
Dialogue.1C0A5B9B4B002244F7D191BD7DC9CDE2_FB122F8: I thought you were sending Pop.
Dialogue.AA200657423EF8905514EEBCF777630F_47CFF90: I thought you would, Keelhaul. These are your Club-Steppers. Perfect for a night on the town, and guaranteed to hold up while dancing.
Dialogue.A80C3A4C44F2721B9C7C2699F944A950_06FC410: I thought you'd be happier about seeing your sister.
Dialogue.9F2BF3DB4F4EBD0BBAFBAAAB906CD7EE_7D086D9: I thought you'd be happier about the action figure.
Dialogue.245F9EA74DE06BE6480775AAC489CF4C_910A467: I thought, "If they want to make a movie of their own, who am I to put a damper on their creativity?"
Dialogue.0F7D67FA481BBB46D4D2D09730F3D494_7D2960E: I thought, "What better decoration than a fish that may-or-may-not be real?"
Dialogue.66F211C44F73307320138F9A1292B2DC_87F0BBB: I thought... that would make you mad.
Dialogue.3AE682184F0CFD9A467AD6BF73CC2B2E_06FC410: I thrive under pressure and without it I turn into a weird, upsetting puddle. Like a deep sea fish.
Dialogue.692A7A2C4C5A0E48EEE68BA06D9AFC93_97A9259: I told my manager Craig, predictive burger technology isn't a recipe for a good burger, it's a recipe for disaster.
Dialogue.36CB89ED4449B4F2167A59AF58EF3362_21EB734: I told that little robit, if you shoot off cannon, you best be ready for the buckets of mail.
Dialogue.AD91DB0B4EBDA67CC7795DB1C9D87E6F_21C1927: I told you I was a big deal in the beverage world. I got you covered.
Dialogue.ED3DD4D4488780C877F91882D9B6511D_47CFF90: I told you not to give him your name.
Dialogue.73F7AECB42BF3B766E286786458501F8_724DAF1: I told you this was a bad idea!
Dialogue.4E72D3B3429EC2F7B8C62EB764669FA0_7D086D9: I told you to delete the files!
Dialogue.66F73A0F4BB6AC4F68ABA28A0F78E4A0_CC240C1: I told you! I told you it was real!
Dialogue.5960E4E94015E5D330B81AA034206450_B222EAD: I told you, I can't watch this.
Dialogue.970EC92A4C8F192AD768B6A16E0AFC49_89ED452: I told you, there's no "secret ghost!"
Dialogue.20BCC09E46FD6B0A0E7A53B34C136A8B_E090F2A: I told you. I have chunky brine syndrome.
Dialogue.2FAF3A7040CD927CCBCF2C828788C523_B229E47: I told you... I don't know.
Dialogue.8AEEC4AE4ED7A407A89F7E87C9F21E5F_C0E27E7: I took care of that strong force for you. Yeah, don't mention it.
Dialogue.165350D04D9BEDFAA0F1B78BB8868D68_06FC410: I took my stand against that infernal outlaw,
Dialogue.A92D69E847D14928C3E9A5AB298C7393_B222EAD: I took some time for myself, haunted a few new places, and made a farmer think his goat could talk.
Dialogue.4459A3824EBCEEEE36FA5FA44C3104E6_06FC410: I tried everything I could, but he just wasn't improving.
Dialogue.589DB0A143834255C23A618DCC838552_CC240C1: I tried not to say that. I tried so hard. But I had to, Ray. I had to. Why?
Dialogue.BFF072B74B05FDC2CDF983B43BD9AE07_06FC410: I tried talking to Raven and it was very confusing.
Dialogue.4D9B7B17490231CB4D0A729AC590F806_7D086D9: I tried to find another solution. This isn't a guilt thing.
Dialogue.6CBAA7AB47140E0E518DA28159B0998E_97A9259: I tried to lie around in bed all day, but I think I have Restless Dennis Syndrome.
Dialogue.5CBFF2EB43178504260A37A94CDF0EE7_94F2B66: I tried to light a fire under the boy. Told him he doesn't have what it takes.
Dialogue.886C07BE403AB115FCACADB4AE0CD05D_06FC410: I tried to make a list of activities like you asked.
Dialogue.D4FC2CA8454A870722308A8FA09491D6_97A9259: I tried to run, but then I knew I had to turn around, come back, and be an adult.
Dialogue.990F8B3542F0602945E672B2B8CE49C8_06FC410: I tried, but if I called and you weren't there, then my dream wouldn't be a dream anymore!
Dialogue.B235FC7C4C068F2B9D98D7AF2FA5385B_47CFF90: I trust you've had enough time to determine a course of action?
Dialogue.CC78984140D14626D17A7CAA689C1333_97A9259: I trust your judgement on this.
Dialogue.93621FAA428F587520E6C9A1709BD1F9_06FC410: I uh... forgot to tell the hover fleet about the storm and husks and they did not enjoy the surprise.
Dialogue.0C034C804F0D0001EF05C7924E1E0DFD_06FC410: I understand Lars wants us to stop looking for his friend.
Dialogue.09D8F3D44F05DE91D941F496A67A8EF4_910A467: I understand if you want to attack me.
Dialogue.3D3A7784449766301E9542832E274247_9D00593: I understand it may be difficult to extend any measure of faith my way, especially considering the dozens of unexploded munitions I've lost track of at Homebase...
Dialogue.BD589E3548862A029F8CFCBD5784DDCD_06FC410: I understand plot structure. Thank you, Dennis.
Dialogue.67C0A9794E5DC7443E34E2A5779DA34B_47CFF90: I understand that we have mismanaged our reality so badly that the other realities are worried...
Dialogue.7E841D4F4AF1A817055DCEA7B8B5C949_B25EA52: I understand that you're letting your health station supply run dangerously low.
Dialogue.9A6993F742E01B6BC1A710B949EAEC5B_47CFF90: I understand you're sending your people to Plank Harbor.
Dialogue.52E44B874F1A2501B48843BC34E0992E_9D00593: I understand your reservations, but I assure you my intentions are purely tinseltastical.
Dialogue.D2A1A7B146411328092ACFA751C85E9D_B229E47: I updated the plans. I think you'll approve.
Dialogue.442946494112E53FDDB1CCA7D91566E5_FB122F8: I used the souped up van's sensors to investigate the formation in the sky.
Dialogue.B14CF2004A53516673D768A2013E394A_7D2960E: I used to be afraid of something happening to the people I love.
Dialogue.B706F9514B124857994C2CB18EDC6388_9D00593: I used to make these as a kid.
Dialogue.0479F75140289CE5432E3F85F85228F3_06FC410: I violated every health and safety practice I have ever put into place.
Dialogue.E35874064AF28AE708C844BAA0B807FD_5991012: I wanna see what a "zigzag stitch" is!
Dialogue.1DE3C75D47B36A977D1E91837ECB1C33_FB122F8: I want each of you to grab some vinyl of your favorite band. We'll roll out when the the time is up!
Dialogue.70FCB3DE45A702DC8354A8974E445CDC_94F2B66: I want everyone to look to your left.
Dialogue.411C5E584D8C5E711F775AB93CDABA76_C2C5A2E: I want genuine Slurp. That's what's first.
Dialogue.F9C96886456713FC60585CA48158A1C3_CC240C1: I want to be haunted by existential dread like you guys!
Dialogue.D12564C540755C1443EDAF99A140DCCA_14FBFB1: I want to be the man who rids the world of love once and for all.
Dialogue.B673BB294FBC8316C51C328503D49D57_9801E98: I want to hear the top three rock facts you've got.
Dialogue.426DBD294C3D9254AB56719DD4107ED9_EAAE146: I want to hold on to those memories.
Dialogue.CFDF9FEB4EA3EF5496E30C89ED8953B3_9801E98: I want to know every rock fact you've got.
Dialogue.8220AC204F846952E46C3A990588716E_CC240C1: I want to know why the major is fighting husks.
Dialogue.A100043D49A337A45542CE9AA6EE93D8_181CD3E: I want to tell you about Jilly Teacup.
Dialogue.893F86384184FF3892CB89AB1000C595_9D00593: I want you and your kin to hang stockings filled with coal throughout Homebase.
Dialogue.FDE7F26948603A24C5A02DAA6D9191DA_7D086D9: I want you to delete the Project Tailor plans from the network.
Dialogue.D74B6FFF40D8C8ED48B20D8A8CC6D672_77D814F: I want you to know that every sunrise I've seen, every sunset...
Dialogue.5EB0CE864DDB66B37C49E2AD9BF87279_B222EAD: I want you to meet my friend.
Dialogue.647C85FC4903DB0BF26757B77F0FDB5C_CC240C1: I wanted a secret so badly because I just wanted to be treated like an equal.
Dialogue.49A5E97540F6C2EB63D629A470F9873E_181CD3E: I wanted the world to fall in love with you guys.
Dialogue.38AE0B4E46693E178A0F2CA71C1BF80A_06FC410: I wanted this plan to work with all of my heart.
Dialogue.D224601D42BF31AF0EE5D99A0533374C_9D00593: I wanted to do the note, but...
Dialogue.313EB4CF486F4B1E4A5144B9A153AC6F_06FC410: I wanted to find a present that says "your boyfriend is sorry...
Dialogue.EE09000444FFE28271D675BBAA9430F1_06FC410: I wanted to let them know you how much you care.
Dialogue.E4360D3E40855AB2A0E279823977C94F_9D00593: I wanted to make you squirm a little.
Dialogue.9C9D77534D12A70DD7C962838EE315C6_89ED452: I wanted to pretend I had never been a husk-smashing adventurer. That I never had a best friend. That I never pulled the switch that resulted in her dying.
Dialogue.1ED0149D4714FF2E0398A2AEEACB7916_D1275FF: I wanted you to know, we support you.
Dialogue.36BF7155444C5CD59A721EA246FDD9E8_14FBFB1: I warned you not to follow me.
Dialogue.2665811B43168E597807F6ADA8CD4C2E_06FC410: I was able to analyze the missing pieces, I know which letters he took.
Dialogue.E629B8C046B9382832865C8A6DB6E80D_14FBFB1: I was about to administer my unique blend of vigilante justice...
Dialogue.FF7E2E3B452EBB21896D0AA48719617E_72190CE: I was actually referring more to the efficiency and excellent use of momentum but, uh... yeah! “Splattery” is good, too.
Dialogue.F1056B3747C44EA9F16A70A8CF70C6E9_B229E47: I was afraid that would happen. Can you get a satellite feed turned on so I can see what I've missed?
Dialogue.5F9C62D442C8E1F4D33042A36BB113D3_06FC410: I was afraid this would happen.
Dialogue.C8DCD3254039E0B5473EEDBFF5CD1360_D87E161: I was at the computer, watching videos of skateboarders absolutely biffing it.
Dialogue.2F9165B4461F1DF53FDE36915D8B5A30_97A9259: I was binge-watching that one channel that's all about the hotel's unique accommodations and services...
Dialogue.C62BBBE1480367051598E995817EE67B_FB122F8: I was closing in on a storm cell... and next thing I know, this wispy ghost lookin' dude is IN MY VAN.
Dialogue.EA5AAC154D1DA099344E1B9B86FAE51B_D1275FF: I was designed for more than this... I think...
Dialogue.DCCD3EE842822E37D5D45E86A75B7EB4_97A9259: I was eating a box of Archduke Apples and they dissolved in my mouth!
Dialogue.EBEA0F5243AAED91527181B7A3DCAD77_94F2B66: I was escorting a group of survivors...
Dialogue.C7C4F4724CAF82088368028624E6A7D7_47CFF90: I was expecting a more exhaustive analysis than that.
Dialogue.AD27E9D8456A5D819480D89CFF3FB2E9_06FC410: I was faking it pretty well.
Dialogue.74CFF45B4E4CAA327F368FB9820EC4A4_5CE5FC8: I was floored, humbled, inspired, impressed. The list goes on, but who has the time?
Dialogue.8CF00C874F7148986F4E3B90F0C4040D_9D00593: I was forged in the cozy crucible of mall Christmas. Santa Town made me who I am.
Dialogue.A702CEB04106D90A2DCB6C8AB81F117B_94F2B66: I was given five minutes to draw up a plan of attack.
Dialogue.A2BB2CA3480462941EDC91BB39B057F9_FB122F8: I was going to ask you why survivors are running away from your heroes...
Dialogue.074BEAA14AEC9C2AE655849F0153F513_06FC410: I was going to check out the radar, but it's upstairs.
Dialogue.82E0A7B54056E764E4AC75AB041BF57A_97A9259: I was gonna ask for a trade, but... never mind.
Dialogue.90FF81EE481B0CD49D499BA62F94F5D9_06FC410: I was gonna say, "Not completely depressed by the world's horrors," but... yeah. I guess.
Dialogue.173457E84597C31307F1B18AE670CCEA_5CE5FC8: I was gonna walk you through the deck and break down the demos, but actually...
Dialogue.05A7EA92496825156E389BA72F87CED1_181CD3E: I was hiding from not being good enough any more.
Dialogue.3A3F3BB04CF9D0A19F0BBBAFCCEB295D_06FC410: I was hoping Pheobe's columns would encourage you to... open up your world.
Dialogue.D418444F4562E7635030139A2DB522C8_06FC410: I was hoping it was just an evil phase.
Dialogue.77BEEC384A0AD4E1F87B49A9407A7723_A96EA86: I was hoping this day would never come...
Dialogue.4B7E96A94B4E4A0306E06690BFBB6794_7D086D9: I was hoping to have my feet a little more firmly on the ground before I brought everyone on board...
Dialogue.013041EE4694FE58DC4A2A889CB42BDC_7D2960E: I was hoping you'd tell me.
Dialogue.07CB3E4B456A219868B32CB8D8C37878_9D00593: I was just a dumb kid with a heart full of nog... I wasn't prepared for the darkness.
Dialogue.3985D1184527E57F373A6A977D1D5336_06FC410: I was just going to say that.
Dialogue.E1EF52E7444C98437DEEA0AAE52573DD_97A9259: I was just making a dumb joke... I am not prepared for this conversation.
Dialogue.560399614FC3C639F36B07A3A8A1C859_94F2B66: I was just saying that to get you all fired up to prove me wrong.
Dialogue.190EA50A46DF93CAF2B8DF965259D62D_14FBFB1: I was just wondering... Have you tried sticking to the ominous cover of shadow?
Dialogue.76C3C9464D1FF36D5B4CCE9F6FB8FC34_47CFF90: I was just... preparing the lunch menu.
Dialogue.7CCCF1E74012F14DDB6294AC09068733_89ED452: I was just... so happy to hear your voice again... and I- I didn't want to tarnish that second chance.
Dialogue.5D0B32EA4DC30E74F9C75DA378C57479_06FC410: I was kind of his assistant slash consigliere slash sounding board...
Dialogue.7FAECE5948E2E656548813B05D145371_06FC410: I was kinda worried you two wouldn't get along.
Dialogue.A964C8A6437ADCC6D77F538D12F4C320_FB122F8: I was like, "Don't think about Homebase, don't think about Homebase."
Dialogue.66DDD03F4575806A487670B322A2EBCB_9D00593: I was like, (laughing nervously) "Who are you, where is Santa?"
Dialogue.E2AA915C42C5286D54E02096E99E2F71_06FC410: I was looking at the recipe and you should have had two drops!
Dialogue.16466A7E45FA5F8147A96FB62667E96D_97A9259: I was missing crucial information at the time.
Dialogue.1C370B494B73BC111776DC924BD446C4_1D2FE88: I was nobody's fool. I knew you could only use a cursed statue once.
Dialogue.928072764246E5F59BDA83A748B9EB4D_E090F2A: I was not aware you were masters of the horrific arts.
Dialogue.63DC778C4EBAC52E4B4F729ABD41F247_06FC410: I was not impeached and anyone who says so is a liar.
Dialogue.CF39F3D447A112869D24F0B5CADCA4F5_CC240C1: I was not supposed to say that.
Dialogue.D162022D44C17EB7C95735B3B36D366A_1D2FE88: I was not wrong. Hah, enjoy!
Dialogue.0063D1874BCD10C62AC622A6BF4360D8_FB122F8: I was observing the action from my van...
Dialogue.2EC8A4CD495ED22FBF5FFDAAD212F4F0_94F2B66: I was prepared for a battle to the death.
Dialogue.E0E972014BF09FF3B4570595765C6D75_84C369E: I was raised to value honesty.
Dialogue.F89CC95E4FEEB86698AA6D8D8AE1495D_97A9259: I was so preoccupied with whether I could become a heartless burger baron... I didn't stop to think if I should.
Dialogue.87B84D6D45C943B1198F1CA164F3851B_1D2FE88: I was so worried you were going to escape.
Dialogue.533C83E54BAE4528A1DA0F92BC708574_06FC410: I was such a nerd back then.
Dialogue.CB31877D49870E01384B9F8BAB81786C_A96EA86: I was ten once. Trust me, I've got super hero names for days.
Dialogue.8A12022D4B4552C74A8F9A80B6B9B9A4_72190CE: I was the world's worst pirate!
Dialogue.C1CE89C34413595D8826FA873873EFB2_97A9259: I was thinking once your kingdom is complete, maybe it's time for me to retire as your loyal subject?
Dialogue.A95D2B014BBFF2A203CC82A1D9285E74_06FC410: I was thinking you could throw one of your legendary Dennis film festivals.
Dialogue.8E42006142DE36F6C8C0219911DB2174_CC240C1: I was told there would be a story.
Dialogue.63C8DA95452E173045AA24A9009758C4_D87E161: I was trying to build an empire driven by commerce, and friendship, and obviously greed.
Dialogue.FFE636E049C8939A0F5DEDB8646BEC2F_FB122F8: I was wrong to try to stop you, little robot.
Dialogue.37812ACC480F20897EEB72AA347DD7C6_97A9259: I was wrong, and I'm sorry.
Dialogue.DD919C4C4A274A5B4BA861ACDA6183DB_06FC410: I wasn't crazy about that engagement line anyway. Let's try again.
Dialogue.460680344F2AAF9D959E749ECE6213B8_B222EAD: I wasn't tormented by some ghost.
Dialogue.FFFF7B7447189CB8A45E2A8BC868CCDF_FB122F8: I wasn't whining, I was trying to cheat.
Dialogue.76F894E64CEACF14825C72A175B8C71E_06FC410: I watched all of the movies from the Dennis and Summer time travel film festival.
Dialogue.0BF672C14FB1F9DE259A46A863497D76_06FC410: I went overboard on trying to get him to be the perfect Anthony replacement.
Dialogue.46465C1646C713B4A04C52AF13F0362F_724DAF1: I went through a personality shattering retreat.
Dialogue.71C2827547F96F3A4872FEB7DD566294_47CFF90: I will be entirely too wracked with guilt to answer.
Dialogue.6B3962C547F317422C9ABAB1626E303D_AB3C42C: I will be leading the headshot recovery initiative.
Dialogue.A625201D465AE13D432804B6FEB9B13D_87F0BBB: I will be so upset if you kill me.
Dialogue.F45346F947A1082382EB6AB3AB89F309_72190CE: I will bury you like treasure, and then I'm gonna forget where I buried you.
Dialogue.EB0CE2BA4FA199AD41598F9A5C69BE2E_21C1927: I will channel my inner turmoil into rage at my enemies!
Dialogue.2B9FB65648EADB2C0A2FA4AD35A004DC_97A9259: I will conquer the world with my alertness!
Dialogue.59066206404ABA518FD024BD3594936D_47CFF90: I will do some digging on this situation. Until then... be careful.
Dialogue.F118D0314B70A0386CEA8799EBB5F35F_7C9093D: I will face down this large one!
Dialogue.CE9977B546FCB7581D4DBBB0639F8EEC_06FC410: I will focus on our noble goal to save the world. Even though we will definitely fail.
Dialogue.0B4A0C764ADBE1F4D9D08EA7AE2681FD_06FC410: I will haunt your family for generations!
Dialogue.A2FAEB804B46F862F4FF6082CE1B25B4_10E97D2: I will hear all the screams you are capable of making!
Dialogue.80DB03754A9F8FCF13FB29AB58ABDE76_DCC8D4F: I will hold on as long as I can.
Dialogue.3293C4A44155E5EAFF9B58B07250B7A4_7D2960E: I will litigate you into the next century!
Dialogue.E385992E4B33D9A52CC851BC0086EEAB_DCC9B6A: I will live to shred again.
Dialogue.7C9E96D14D464D59445B1293B0E0849E_06FC410: I will make a note of that.
Dialogue.0A6BB13744B4B65774A2829158FF9B06_7D086D9: I will prepare a supply mission to give Carlos a fighting chance.
Dialogue.90765F8D41CB378EA2765B826D5440FD_E090F2A: I will pretend to appreciate it.
Dialogue.12EBE51D4014270E8AFAA386341CD94E_37EFC25: I will take that, thank you.
Dialogue.5481B8D448FBE6296EAFCE9636BBF48D_14FBFB1: I will try to move on and keep the fight alive.
Dialogue.7031851043F11C29FA836E99C9FF2829_B60EE0E: I will use these bullets well, commander.
Dialogue.2C132FFE4721286232F690ABF91F4CA2_87F0BBB: I will. We're risking human lives to find a... thing.
Dialogue.16B585434AA3E431F0207CB6CF821F96_FB122F8: I wish I could take credit for it...
Dialogue.4B91BC764834B894F087E5AC7C0CBBB8_CC240C1: I wish I had a secret ghost haunting ME.
Dialogue.0567034F48302ACA6937569136769195_06FC410: I wish I had gotten more time with Des.
Dialogue.11837303492B2CDC320A7F9B38C01384_F7FABF5: I wish I had some marshmellows...
Dialogue.9928B0514C7883D7258356BEB698914F_06FC410: I wish I knew what was in you!
Dialogue.3562F8AF47697E267E9D5EA10D4C4E8A_EECA944: I wish I never fell in love with you.
Dialogue.10EBCEDA41FFA7365487E0B68A6C040E_06FC410: I wish we didn't have to leave...
Dialogue.5DA85E30431FF610014CC2A87E01A349_CC240C1: I wish you didn't have to leave!
Dialogue.F9D1F3DC42AC33A5A40B6E81FCC3E8C9_AB3C42C: I wish you would have stopped the trolls, ED-EE.
Dialogue.03B16D0146FE1C1571BB11A2DD4D671B_181CD3E: I wish. These are the best ideas I've ever had.
Dialogue.8EC5184544DC7929173F49ABEE63EF89_765440C: I won't be able to do it justice. You'll need to see for yourself.
Dialogue.E3BA0BEF406CCEA2055C77908E48A648_861A10F: I won't be wearing this outfit again, that's for sure.
Dialogue.B591958040E8C33F15916197354AD69C_7D086D9: I won't have to. The magnetic field will.
Dialogue.FC14C16F40D7372E1D6554B88D480BAA_84C369E: I won't let you down, Commander.
Dialogue.2E7D0D374190333257363794140A295D_06FC410: I won't lose my friend to a relationship with a husk.
Dialogue.C9C0262F4D1381D60AFA6E9233540FAC_06FC410: I won't tell if you won't tell.
Dialogue.9F0DAEFA43CEDE3C85ACEC86BB3C26EE_21C1927: I won't. I'm glad you're back.
Dialogue.FE9FA9C143E8E0CDF2F28F874A5CE8E6_06FC410: I wonder if Homebase would like a puppet show instead.
Dialogue.35C2D3BD436F8C0DC243538ADA608451_06FC410: I wonder if she ever got the message...
Dialogue.99F56F7E4EE26A6B8E4291903BE7AD14_06FC410: I wonder what he's studying. Storm effects on Husks?
Dialogue.7EEEA5D843257DB01BA13EBCCEE09194_06FC410: I wonder what kind of scientific research the Hexsylvanians were up to...
Dialogue.5E62223B4851F2CBAEAC4C86F7ECFAFF_06FC410: I wonder what's been going on with him.
Dialogue.53082F9B4D4E9A5080F5D29F73054527_EECA944: I wonder what's on the other side but... I don't wanna know.
Dialogue.A63AB173407CE971C84EFE857927978B_861A10F: I wonder who the lucky fella is who caught her bloodshot eye.
Dialogue.822B57F442960EB8BFC108AC194A3FEC_06FC410: I wonder who threw the first rotten tomato?
Dialogue.5F195CBB4A33A17B324F71952ACE1E6C_06FC410: I wonder why it stopped here?
Dialogue.B2CBC5C44CD57A93644889B9DBE6DFE4_87F0BBB: I wore a romper and went on a dinner date.
Dialogue.7CDCD525480E1AB1315BE9A36AB86396_06FC410: I worked on Dr. Vinderman's Homebase Storm Defense Project.
Dialogue.3EDCBE2648D3BA32461F8D850D98B063_97A9259: I would basically settle for anyone who knows how to wear a power suit.
Dialogue.384EBD0A44AACD90F4CD4ABBA23486F9_7D086D9: I would be happy to hear you were reviewing his trip itinerary.
Dialogue.5782DB6B4206AC8D1C91619042CD7A53_1D2FE88: I would be remiss in my duties as your dungeon if I did not slowly drain your life.
Dialogue.53156AA2492435D3767F71A1A62E0569_97A9259: I would be... less sure of that.
Dialogue.BB7E7C8640881094A79044AE80D30BE9_FB122F8: I would bet whatever you find down there is responsible for the collapsed bridge! Be careful!
Dialogue.30F7BDD6410FA3E8C8CC6FBBC33E0A4E_910A467: I would gloat, but I literally lack the programming!
Dialogue.C913F06B4E9D1F4959689284116BB3EE_B222EAD: I would guard a bunch of gold birds too if it gave all of this some sort of point.
Dialogue.ECB2B24848517599F52FEDB2BC0C0961_06FC410: I would love to say yes...
Dialogue.298A21A34ACF14CE50ACA7A0226C0BF1_5991012: I would love to see a book someday.
Dialogue.B8C63DC5488D21B0CDC6F2BAA40F8233_861A10F: I would love to spend just one day without some sort of husk battle.
Dialogue.864A85F44022ACEA058F1D9C1A174700_06FC410: I would love to, but I kinda have a lot of irons in the fire.
Dialogue.D13B9BB54118F79C7FFCB8A91C78B946_E090F2A: I would make a good boss.
Dialogue.90582835469E3B337E262A9808D69E7F_0ADEFA4: I would never do such a thing! It's too dangerous.
Dialogue.51AEA16F4719884E96F26FB2A0AB20C0_FB122F8: I would never have left Homebase.
Dialogue.64A889B54C3DB993216A5FB019557F1D_06FC410: I would never hoist your mast.
Dialogue.34DBAF5F44981B502A8F75A97E71D11E_94F2B66: I would never put the lives of survivors in danger for a pity mission.
Dialogue.C902D366452A1654E0EBFBA6D8D0C81D_06FC410: I would prefer it if they were crying out for trees.
Dialogue.51560AE3470E134587EECC8F424161ED_47CFF90: I would rather have candy than concerns, but you insist upon calling a troop of monsters right to us.
Dialogue.D7A908CF441DEDF05CD1BA94CE26F1F3_9D00593: I would say thanks for the heads up, but I'm busy keeping my head on.
Dialogue.BC1A70CC4DF531CCE1BC7EBFFB0E2060_94F2B66: I would stay away from that twister if I were you, soldier. Nasty business.
Dialogue.F56D3570427AE53AAA5D97A6F6EE45F1_9D00593: I wouldn't be the man I am today if I let signs tell me what to not drink.
Dialogue.835E386F411D44FD25F7FEA6F08A4492_181CD3E: I wouldn't be too sure. We just got the first reboot prototype back.
Dialogue.76691D86451048976225F29CF04C62E6_9801E98: I wouldn't exactly say we've come up with a good plan.
Dialogue.3FA8183A447733DA44F728BC451EDF42_FB122F8: I wouldn't have told you if I didn't think you could help.
Dialogue.62E7924D494EEDBE6BCCD389FA2D9057_47CFF90: I wouldn't have wanted to go anyway.
Dialogue.6BD87F6B4991D0DD6933E1A05B933C3C_EAAE146: I wouldn't let you peel potatoes on my ship.
Dialogue.FDE25FAE443A7848281D2A96E1AB9686_9D00593: I wouldn't put socks under that tree.
Dialogue.5E25C59440047560112517B8D21E7A17_FB122F8: I wouldn't read those if I were you.
Dialogue.001521744E44F7996A0AE6A68E515491_06FC410: I wouldn't want to be a werewolf.
Dialogue.3229C0044591ACD927BF01ADAD6FDB4F_06FC410: I write you this letter with a shaking hand and a broken heart.
Dialogue.F757AAF8400A9441946DC4AAA3F46638_94F2B66: I wrote it if you want to see what it says.
Dialogue.7ABC442F470E4CB8F1E3659198ABB0E4_DB7CBEB: I yield back the balance of my time.
Dialogue.6C026FFF42BF0049F10A529466B723D0_FDAEB92: I'LL ALLOW IT, BUT YOU'RE WALKING A LINE HERE.
Dialogue.20CECBE84F81DA6415AAF08A4BCE2DBC_FDAEB92: I'M SORRY? DID I ASK FOR HACKY AND OFF TEMPO?
Dialogue.E11B16B24FB4C9D174F45686F0D8BDE5_2DD597A: I'd advise you to stop if you value your thumbs.
Dialogue.E4AA81104015217B64306687F1D511D2_1D2FE88: I'd attack those trolls if I were you.
Dialogue.D31618E840D5F72234E0768B1FC64D5A_47CFF90: I'd be less proud of that if I were you.
Dialogue.951D40EC4C617E8DBF6725BC4CABD951_94F2B66: I'd hoped to wage a winning war against the forces of evil...
Dialogue.13A1793646D96BDDC1A39F9DA322C8AF_910A467: I'd like to arrange a debate where both sides are represented.
Dialogue.8F7A360540E30D9B560B07A118AFEE99_CC240C1: I'd like to be excused please.
Dialogue.449971A6421604C70C33B58554A87EAF_FB122F8: I'd like to keep my inseam private, please.
Dialogue.6BCF76E347266421E7081E891EC30E93_47CFF90: I'd like to remind the heroes of Homebase, I would have spent what little time left we have preparing for the pirate invasion.
Dialogue.E70A92004FA5E7A5398B26BB44497FC0_AB3C42C: I'd love to give you an inspiring speech, but the writers quit.
Dialogue.A2221D734E9B90572F9A49B7B588E8B4_06FC410: I'd love to help you out... but, Dr. Blackwell is super intimidating.
Dialogue.750BB3E2451B6AA423DAE589D7C6EE8F_C0E27E7: I'd love to shoot you, but I'm out of bullets.
Dialogue.A16A6AFF4689E3BB5FA5BAB5D4F1DBBF_6E5AC35: I'd love to shoot you, but I'm out of bullets.
Dialogue.53AF1C714B0713796056C6A512B24D4B_FB122F8: I'd love to, but I signed this cinema manifesto in my twenties and if I go back on my word they will come for me.
Dialogue.CD3D1F974B95DC0C7C3A83BD266C406A_06FC410: I'd never give your job to anyone else, Riggs. Or should I say, Director Riggs.
Dialogue.4687DB114BD21BA6730118BE27076BAE_C0E27E7: I'd rather not die, thank you.
Dialogue.BA0F6BC54B93F44CF9520BB3F19DB92C_97A9259: I'd say they're more like cocktail onions.
Dialogue.89BB752F489A9C6502C117A6127E53C8_FB122F8: I'd say this is what Desiree's team was working on...
Dialogue.6D9285BB463CC419FA6C84BC146855A4_EECA944: I'd study them if they weren't attacking me.
Dialogue.330B715B4E93D47B7BB9F7853B1DC155_FB122F8: I'd um. I'd like to be left alone for a minute.
Dialogue.81EAC16141158764AFA77094FE53D6B0_06FC410: I'll add it to the list, but not at the top. Or the middle.
Dialogue.CE566E2A4C66BFF2155911BD2BB81EA3_47CFF90: I'll admit I didn't think you'd actually do the job.
Dialogue.13BA47C64CE96A5E903282B5E0279C40_97A9259: I'll always remember how much you suck.
Dialogue.44DF3B0C4966530298BCD697CD1E1D14_89ED452: I'll assemble the workshop, and once you hit Plankerton I should be ready to roll.
Dialogue.6462DF1442395D96B6AC19919B6057E2_5CE5FC8: I'll be here. Unless you're worried about... me...
Dialogue.1A45DA9048DE9972482B3F87C986FD73_F6B1D98: I'll be honest with you. I don't really know. I feel like there's a reason, but every time I focus on it everything gets... fuzzy.
Dialogue.C55A5478442F7FCD834CC4BB70785E6F_97A9259: I'll be honest, dancing never leads to love when I'm involved.
Dialogue.8AE6D289449DBE4DA615A094E36EF132_97A9259: I'll be honest, though. I'm not looking forward to it.
Dialogue.CF3573E54C14D596014ADBBC6E337075_06FC410: I'll be honest. Wasn't expecting many of your kind to be here.
Dialogue.DABBDFF442F959768A9BA79122D14AE1_9F725B6: I'll be nice since this is obviously your first day here.
Dialogue.50C671A74C3FDF4FDC02078E6E7470A2_47CFF90: I'll be ordering by the case, so, you may want to adjust your lifestyle accordingly.
Dialogue.932ACF3441E83416E0639F8A3A805A94_7D086D9: I'll be out of your hair soon enough.
Dialogue.3070CEA24B6E300CA6A58BB8CCBB3702_06FC410: I'll be the one to face Crackshot.
Dialogue.F719AF2547440903C028BB98708999CB_FB122F8: I'll be your lifeguard. Keep you and your friends under blue, husk-free skies.
Dialogue.EA725A044A0F0B9DE67C4F8B5B33B083_06FC410: I'll clear it with Captain Clark first to make sure it won't be weird for her.
Dialogue.68272B3344D7351B782F1598C94D898F_97A9259: I'll cut right to it. Us boars are usually pretty good at finding stuff.
Dialogue.70B875A2470C226065D9229B844557DD_D87E161: I'll deliver the chills while you deliver my overstock.
Dialogue.765F359B479B603FC20BA7BB2F10C25F_EAAE146: I'll do the same to whoever gets in my way!
Dialogue.0D061815466D4AA34D2A60BEDF079933_861A10F: I'll explain when we find her.
Dialogue.C32F44074EAAB8B95297168221CA75EA_06FC410: I'll figure it out. You keep collecting those star charts.
Dialogue.E5745A9542486CA29A0F59A09B4FA1AA_47CFF90: I'll find combat ready candidates. You go search the area for oil.
Dialogue.D39178DD4D42F5A741A326BF2CC827BC_7D2960E: I'll find someone who needs my skills and get back to work.
Dialogue.ABAD71B3400D78AF2DF5AD93195A08EC_06FC410: I'll get back to you on that. Right now, I have some studying to do.
Dialogue.583B35D84FDB3972B4B72280F965DDDF_FB122F8: I'll get started on the head.
Dialogue.AFD268394065B590FE2C418BD8F93C94_06FC410: I'll get started on the rocket.
Dialogue.F92459754D03764AFBD506816558BDDF_06FC410: I'll get these to Homebase, you keep searching the zone.
Dialogue.DE8F9DAD46E8245D536615A88FFAE816_FB122F8: I'll get those clouds warmed up...
Dialogue.D03795DC406732198DDB9FA11AF48444_B25EA52: I'll get to work on the supplies, thanks!
Dialogue.B1DBD578462C46E74F92DDA82FD40C00_06FC410: I'll give the storm this... destruction is really satisfying.
Dialogue.8B2F88754DB3CD99F631A6BBA0CD90D9_97A9259: I'll give you some privacy. If there's anything you want to say to him, you should say it now.
Dialogue.347DE5D346ED60A9A6123CAD8EB3F8BF_CC240C1: I'll go turn myself off now.
Dialogue.23A77DE44948EF40A37071828D60F16E_06FC410: I'll handle the samples, you search for Pop.
Dialogue.ADE1D1AB4CCE5E844A5B11B50AB21AA4_06FC410: I'll just be alone with my thoughts and feelings.
Dialogue.B7E1AF4D45823272BF730FA25CB8DDAB_06FC410: I'll keep an eye out from here.
Dialogue.307E47FC4592FB46B32A949026FBBC99_06FC410: I'll keep reading, you look for more circuits.
Dialogue.0A78EAAE4803B36FE4CDCC9EA81EA4CD_97A9259: I'll keep that in mind for the next time I end up in a well.
Dialogue.3E95973B46E9239333E6F8B143DEA826_EED9CD8: I'll know it when I see it.
Dialogue.CDE90CF942218E285CFCC0B75CE7734E_89ED452: I'll let him out. Hi, Lok.
Dialogue.521BDB734155C711059192A8A9FF9DFD_06FC410: I'll let them know you're disappointed.
Dialogue.71A2987A4BD6A7D3117662B90C3586C4_B25AF7B: I'll let you in on a valuable treasure hunter secret.
Dialogue.5E50905C4EF486FB15DAF4891F5D6D89_06FC410: I'll mark the location on your map.
Dialogue.B45FA42149D2FF46A19798B0F2ABE78B_861A10F: I'll miss these kinds of trees and plants. We just don't have this back home.
Dialogue.865D11704241CCFD3EAD2ABA0B99DE3C_06FC410: I'll need more consoles. Keep looking.
Dialogue.5AC3F69744D89DB717E2DD9A958F6EDE_97A9259: I'll never get to drop a game changing mixtape, or watch the sunrise over Mt. Copper.
Dialogue.B228C6C3426C94EF9DB589ABCC45A8B1_9D00593: I'll never get used to coming to in the desert with no idea who I am or why I'm mad!
Dialogue.7A9B3766446AC4826E4A479F9FCFE8EB_B25AF7B: I'll never know what it's like to have a friend, or fall in love...
Dialogue.35654ED84A3CF0FE9D05FE9032A1EC57_97A9259: I'll pass that along as well.
Dialogue.714B7C384EBE8B79437D698EED888AA4_06FC410: I'll read up on this so-called Vlad Resurrection.
Dialogue.82E1038049DE0E98909197AB1CBC1BF0_CC240C1: I'll redeploy the team during this break in the storm.
Dialogue.AB5E055B4D9D3F5CEA7CBA86AE85784E_7D086D9: I'll save you the question. I did, technically, abandon Dr. Vinderman.
Dialogue.9038333049FB9E3ED28136A58C708B3C_7D2960E: I'll smash up some cars, patch you up good as new.
Dialogue.7C163BF649E79F7D33FF1AB917542E6C_06FC410: I'll sort things out with Lars.
Dialogue.7E1BEA3443C19902C2A084B078408EDD_21C1927: I'll start packing my things right away. Two possums should be enough, right?
Dialogue.B4E807F34577A9A7D5CAE38919AB6633_06FC410: I'll straight up tell you that husks have breached the walls of our backup Homebase.
Dialogue.7FA8515F48313509F5266799DE1081DF_8106785: I'll take an outhouse over Homebase any day of the week.
Dialogue.F484C48743FC138C99824E889905DA01_D87E161: I'll take ghosts over... the world just... breaking.
Dialogue.18568ABA436D5DF97D73EBB5D5605F03_AF0DA39: I'll take my chances with the... th- the quote-unquote "storm."
Dialogue.FBFD9503462FF1F896FA6B89D891CD11_CC240C1: I'll take that new TV and then I don't want anything from you.
Dialogue.FC41F81446A7E584E3B35E8C6F5EB389_97A9259: I'll take the job on one condition.
Dialogue.560E9534453F33A466D10AB20FFCB261_B25AF7B: I'll tell ya the tale of the wolf of the sea / Brutal and bloody, and ruthless was he / The most competent pirate on the whole seven seas / Right up until the end, oy!
Dialogue.E2E569B54BC6CFE81A8C2CAA88566D8C_9D00593: I'll tell you when we're done!
Dialogue.3648029B41F2D42712F974A0930F16A6_94F2B66: I'll tell you when you have a problem.
Dialogue.8402455D4E2B45ADFD271783CBA3106D_21C1927: I'll try, but I got buzzy bees curiosiating my jam jars!
Dialogue.563A5C7947C65B111F2A75B2DB9BDEBF_06FC410: I'll, uh... file this away for future meddling.
Dialogue.BDCC68DC499702AF199E179407E90049_06FC410: I'll... tell you when you're older.
Dialogue.19F3C0574FE42FAC083E7C88743C46D0_97A9259: I'm Dennis, and this is Delicious Journey.
Dialogue.555189EF491FDB724743EEA93E3ABC85_5991012: I'm Gia! I'm the Wolf ambassador to humankind!
Dialogue.57AD85AB4E8035A508BB8C9F37C1D7F8_06FC410: I'm Homebase's leader AND a pocket calculator.
Dialogue.FEA5AA9E4DC5915D2B1EEE8F373B3DA1_06FC410: I'm Roy. Ray. What are names, right? Pssht... just a... meaningless social construct.
Dialogue.6592E233433CB08D5F3EE1B62C90FEBD_06FC410: I'm a Bad Ray. I enjoy non-cooperation.
Dialogue.E8045E3D421AF6A92A202BA4699A7BBF_5CE5FC8: I'm a carnivore. Please avoid describing your team in any way that could be interpreted as delicious.
Dialogue.097DA898405DE089188ED39A10AA2CD1_97A9259: I'm a creative spirit at heart that can't be tamed by bureaucracy.
Dialogue.BDF269094892E0D848A9EF92586851FC_06FC410: I'm a failure! Just like Ted!
Dialogue.5FC5044C4964FF51979B879BC9DD7FF1_2DD597A: I'm a good pick, you can't go wrong a classic.
Dialogue.0A400BB044566DBBD947BD8ADCE17DF2_CC5E92B: I'm a little woozy over here.
Dialogue.C85A3B594B548159359C1DAA20DEF479_7D2960E: I'm a man of my word...
Dialogue.D10BD1D740F226E5BDA6E29AB033ABC3_7D086D9: I'm a minute away from activating the bomb.
Dialogue.1F6F3AA24D36917DEAD1ADA29B8E4712_EAAE146: I'm a sailor, not a runner.
Dialogue.0E92FB19483D44AA175C71B5B153EABC_FB122F8: I'm a storm chaser and he's an astrophysicist so it wasn't as cheesy as it sounds.
Dialogue.1A6EA3C1454A95C57D665980C3D02796_861A10F: I'm actually having a delightful day.
Dialogue.C21534A9491D5E3937801D9A3EC19061_CC9154B: I'm afraid I can't let you do that.
Dialogue.9640AFA048581376422AAFAF91B929CE_1D2FE88: I'm afraid he'll make that quite difficult.
Dialogue.0386ED31450D5CD3656568B8493E79C8_47CFF90: I'm afraid if I don't do my part now, I'll miss my chance entirely.
Dialogue.34F1C802449C31D204B8038843FA9825_06FC410: I'm afraid if you go to the party, you're going to become Head Werewolf or something.
Dialogue.E83F69AF4D2982FB094192AAE5625972_47CFF90: I'm afraid it's not up for discussion, you signed a contract.
Dialogue.97A6C0AB4298051762A504B25F73822A_97A9259: I'm afraid of doing this alone, and I want your help.
Dialogue.69415AC84FBC88DB8F437FB979A75A71_9D00593: I'm afraid that's a di-no thank you! Authenticity matters.
Dialogue.D2E956CB46BEBD1705E79089541B42A6_47CFF90: I'm afraid we've been taken in by a trickster.
Dialogue.05A08CB047A5C5585BDE96BAED876FEA_FB122F8: I'm all guns and no ammo over here!
Dialogue.C5D1B2354A8486EDC3ABE29BF1D322FF_06FC410: I'm already watching a group of plucky heroes form lifelong bonds while saving the world so...
Dialogue.4D9CC5464EFB396E4FFA3B9B16C08CAB_06FC410: I'm always up to something. That's my raison d'etre. I assume. I'm not looking that up.
Dialogue.860056014EF550127301BF9D5F7BF29D_72190CE: I'm an amazing pirate but not immortal. Got it?
Dialogue.AE23343E4878C4D975C62AAB1FFF9752_861A10F: I'm an engineer AND a scientist.
Dialogue.83A598E04AA26E01F15C81A66CCDD2A5_4731F06: I'm armed to the teeth... and ready to floss.
Dialogue.B6F0D04C441AB7BD2D6DF3BFBA7BF721_06FC410: I'm asking the same question myself, buddy.
Dialogue.45FE83674C8BE71B47832CA2BBCABCE0_97A9259: I'm at the bottom of a well.
Dialogue.99623C8A4D40731757D22D9B2D782EEB_EAAE146: I'm back, and I hold grudges.
Dialogue.4A951E0347C87D2F2295E9BAFBC0D9D0_97A9259: I'm banned from calling team meetings for two years.
Dialogue.4803213F4EFBFD279DC5F08A2F7F0BD2_06FC410: I'm beginning to think Hexsylvania's economy was entirely cage-based.
Dialogue.DCADCC234275A6CA527A3D883CE498EF_06FC410: I'm beginning to think that Plankerton is far more dangerous than expected.
Dialogue.0F4CFFFA47FFBFC7263A4F86ED0088E0_CC240C1: I'm being brave. I'm not even hiding under the blanket yet!
Dialogue.B502884240A530076476EEBABE567912_94F2B66: I'm beyond rusty, and without my hand, I'm not gonna be the soldier I once was.
Dialogue.9D6A37C54402D163A6C9B7B07F561BB9_FB122F8: I'm breaking protocol and calling a meeting.
Dialogue.4FB1BF7A4EA0FBE73590EA9605A973C0_FB122F8: I'm calling this one In The Zone!
Dialogue.70325EAB4F8CA76F514940B0E6BBFC58_84C369E: I'm confused. Why is this happening?!
Dialogue.EEC6BCAD4AED526FE37B748923893BBE_FB122F8: I'm considering starting an infrasonic survey of the region beyond the borders of our map.
Dialogue.15C32CA34A3F34FF0B0EC793C1079CF5_C2C5A2E: I'm done gassing you up, Teacup. Take your chance or get out of the way.
Dialogue.0AB6827B42EEA72A1491858FD422297C_7D2960E: I'm done! I don't need this and I don't need you!
Dialogue.616FBA26456AF2A0989B81AAE0915FFC_06FC410: I'm doubly impressed! And double troubled.
Dialogue.015913124757A76EA09CC0BBE6765245_DB7CBEB: I'm down… but I'm not out.
Dialogue.13980F19425C2779F0DDBB9F5E25FC88_CC240C1: I'm dropping in the full team during the break in the storm!
Dialogue.C13B48F54294502F931DD5908DF30028_CC240C1: I'm dropping you back in. Get out there and stay warm!
Dialogue.CC43FF02440BAB6FD2442D9C5A2EBA1D_14FBFB1: I'm dyeing a bin full of t-shirts right now.
Dialogue.05A0B7BE468C686CF9C272A1662B39C4_94F2B66: I'm excited to get back out in the field...
Dialogue.ACD797A348102AAC7E3CB8A35AC72664_97A9259: I'm feelin' lucky. Play that tape!
Dialogue.550472E549192FE9E9E2CC996365E20C_89ED452: I'm feeling really blah lately, and that's just not like me.
Dialogue.7428BB234790E8F1CA2F179390189267_21C1927: I'm fine. It's fine! He'll be no match for my next great idea--
Dialogue.1E63224D48DAC1CF7165BFA130E7EC39_FB122F8: I'm flyin high in my science van! I should be a happy as clams, little robot.
Dialogue.6C85A3BA422FFAB0F7FCED8CE68E5AF6_FB122F8: I'm flying over sand, Little Robot.
Dialogue.B9DF9C22480472631502AE96424655DA_06FC410: I'm frankly shocked we had so many to begin with.
Dialogue.E5C2B79A4C7F4026520080968160BDB2_06FC410: I'm frightened with notes of insulted. Very nice, Keelhaul.
Dialogue.DBCCDE5945C11AF25F8F32BFD38E6759_1D2FE88: I'm full of bubbling molten rock because I must feast upon interlopers.
Dialogue.681A43684CE4014766AF589E3436B6AE_7D9D435: I'm full of surprises!  And candy!
Dialogue.15CF5920481C25971DA77488FB4EEF30_06FC410: I'm getting a lock on the signal.
Dialogue.85FB19CC4478DDDB39A022ADCC204F8E_97A9259: I'm getting a lot of M energy. Those are no doubt Ms.
Dialogue.31AF94F44A767B5F525E88A25BF126AE_CC240C1: I'm getting some BluGlo readings off that Krampus over there.
Dialogue.DE98E4D4485370E001D63EB0C25E2CFF_06FC410: I'm getting weird readings in your location... do you notice anything strange?
Dialogue.FC5A6C714088B9106A34F59B552FADAD_861A10F: I'm getting... so much building practice.
Dialogue.3FD2E2F04FFACCC23270B59B15CB168A_06FC410: I'm giving you the night off?
Dialogue.E89A06784D06A50BB956D3A071E20E01_06FC410: I'm glad everyone is having so much fun with this.
Dialogue.77F3C8344EB4B23F922118AEEA02502A_06FC410: I'm glad she actually did find some good out there.
Dialogue.4AE2147342E683B828E70DA5FFD94EAF_9F725B6: I'm glad that makes you happy.
Dialogue.43FBEC71467499EF5381DEA1B1A2A998_FB122F8: I'm glad this thing has airbags.
Dialogue.026A573949B64B89493E8E86ED8E4ADB_06FC410: I'm glad we could help, Syd!
Dialogue.8737C3894969029506D9549C503FD8CE_06FC410: I'm glad we could spend some time together.
Dialogue.14BF2A23494030AFC65FE99295E1974C_AF0DA39: I'm glad you had so much fun, but I have been cowering in a basement for a year.
Dialogue.B9C4F04140DBA90F9021F88E89C81E96_861A10F: I'm glad you want to be a part of my project, though.
Dialogue.288F177240FF2DBBB0BA1D864D3A7F90_06FC410: I'm going right past him and locking up for the night...
Dialogue.EAE3490A4A7B7E657DD83BBBA5551749_724DAF1: I'm going to blow it as usual and everyone's going to laugh at me.
Dialogue.22A864A842354E73779BC6A6781417C0_06FC410: I'm going to embrace this new challenge head on!
Dialogue.68F3FD71456779415C852094AE774853_06FC410: I'm going to get you through this, but could you please send us your data first?
Dialogue.160F829346FC6A69FE364F9DE2F0AED2_06FC410: I'm going to give you the chance to sort this all out yourselves.
Dialogue.63F873E949F8C4ADCB65D2B6B49702AD_06FC410: I'm going to grab life by the husks and savor every weird, confusing, awkward moment!
Dialogue.52185241487A928423478AB17A68C18E_7D2960E: I'm going to hit you now.
Dialogue.2691C713422C6125CABB22AADFAF108B_B222EAD: I'm going to ignore that because I like you, but now I need some time to think.
Dialogue.3567F8904332FAE4592FD3A39A9A6189_97A9259: I'm going to look that up, and if it's not nice I'm putting you on the nugget enemies list.
Dialogue.6DBAD6C3448BB78D4EA4AEBD5674AA39_FB122F8: I'm going to offer a counterpoint.
Dialogue.A7B3342846BA93BFDA21A6990FC8CD4F_06FC410: I'm going to outlive my friends by nine thousand, nine hundred years?!
Dialogue.3307B4D04EA75995E49333AB1A2154E8_47CFF90: I'm going to put some tape in the wagon... just in case.
Dialogue.F3D253B943A02392CB994D9456534248_861A10F: I'm going to reinforce my cabin.
Dialogue.754446EB4AB2753296E92A867DABBB7D_06FC410: I'm going to see if I can put him in a bag or something.
Dialogue.3F131D114A0F412D9379828727FA2F8F_1B59CEF: I'm going to shoot husks. It's gonna be good.
Dialogue.07DE08D14BE66C6186754DAA00D04078_FB122F8: I'm gonna ask you something that might make you want to beat me senseless.
Dialogue.1F7B278647C789E1D99FC59774EEDAA3_5CE5FC8: I'm gonna ask you this because you are the rubiest of the rubes here...
Dialogue.3146A61A41B421494DC1C89F8072D446_071921D: I'm gonna assume he was armed and move on.
Dialogue.4FC2D6D147D713DA1793E88A2548768C_97A9259: I'm gonna be a dad so obviously.
Dialogue.FA01403E434B8033CF32A3938FF8A001_06FC410: I'm gonna be straight with you. I forgot roads maps existed.
Dialogue.53FF3C0649081E996AAC73B9710C3979_84C369E: I'm gonna go... sit in the dark for a while.
Dialogue.D453BE8A44658293A9D14E8D0C64A78D_06FC410: I'm gonna have to give you all the credit for that...
Dialogue.EBD99D5A4038D471212027BD3DE30673_06FC410: I'm gonna just get right to it.
Dialogue.7967E2E7435578DE2B16FEB3363B83C2_97A9259: I'm gonna look up "envoy" real quick and...
Dialogue.37F47DEF47178CE68DEC04A94BF791FD_97A9259: I'm gonna make a combo meal outta these husks.
Dialogue.FBA4E7CF44B8D97374C610AAD7478679_06FC410: I'm gonna need to, uh... commandeer that Steel Wool box set. Official Homebase business.
Dialogue.190555A84F8F5AE6E17B4F812A2F58FF_06FC410: I'm gonna need you to defrag, alright?
Dialogue.5A995C074EB7880135111A81542FEB76_06FC410: I'm gonna slowly become not bald anymore and then invent... renewable... solar... squirrels? And build them schools?
Dialogue.F39FCCAA44C7972A58E7ABB5C185D267_FB122F8: I'm gonna step outside for a moment.
Dialogue.00EC0E5D48FE6FFCCD540CA6DD45AD14_C2C5A2E: I'm gonna stop you right there. (slurp) This is off brand Slurp.
Dialogue.0218AF3E4D03DFB597F030934F1B66ED_FB122F8: I'm gonna try and get these portals stabilized and closed while you take care of the next one.
Dialogue.5C2C6B384D892512F4F8FF9E3413C890_FB122F8: I'm gonna upgrade the rumblepack sensor module.
Dialogue.D8A590B94272B73E54D52E967D032408_06FC410: I'm guessing that while we're getting these bikes, someone else is off finding helmets.
Dialogue.72C09D2F4CBE8E34069835AE5F12B782_06FC410: I'm guessing you found the hate potion?
Dialogue.2D8800914A555DE0FCF171BB38D313EF_06FC410: I'm happy you found a new groove, but I am selfishly sadder that we're all going to die.
Dialogue.979044EF447ACB96A4EC84A3C5CAB1FE_5CE5FC8: I'm here because others have judged you. And found you to be, uh... tsk, oh, what's the word...
Dialogue.762AE7E941D4F1579F81939930723F67_5991012: I'm here for the snack tribute. I mean, the rest of the pack - they're here for revenge (chuckle). But more on that,  um, later.
Dialogue.07DCE1BA40D388F012972CBC25A6A78E_724DAF1: I'm here with one of his biggest fans,
Dialogue.FEBB7E0D4B035F7E86B2D59AF3FFB733_4731F06: I'm honestly feeling pretty unloved right now.
Dialogue.D21DA9784E11E91569745090941A0AD9_06FC410: I'm hoping for some classic Steel Wool, but those skinny ties say, "Temper your expectations."
Dialogue.E18AA88A44244D1CD392B992A4255284_FB122F8: I'm hovering over the legendary Dr. Vinderman's palatial estate.
Dialogue.8F71F64944AD29ACF4D02D88722D9E0E_9D00593: I'm in so many family's homes and they don't even know it.
Dialogue.79C911DD4C7D09CA10B3648732063D41_97A9259: I'm in the middle of a well!
Dialogue.6A4EA40C4396E6C763677FBAC4D91B84_181CD3E: I'm in the zone, Ray. I- I'm sorry, but I just felt so inspired- DRIVEN to do this reboot.
Dialogue.8989DACD44895BF10B2DBC83D56EAD70_A96EA86: I'm in this the whole way.
Dialogue.E5034C3E4375760A7A544195EF17F36B_176484F: I'm in this the whole way.
Dialogue.8658294349852D3E6E09B1A82D4C1B04_87F0BBB: I'm in. I'm sold. Let's go.
Dialogue.288A372F4C1CF0F0758998A59CFD4D1D_97A9259: I'm just a man who cannot afford a new phone.
Dialogue.31F6C81F4ABB1B469590E8802DFDFF5A_47CFF90: I'm just a normal director, maintaining operations of Homebase and trying to keep everyone on track.
Dialogue.6D2C930646431C9445DB648EAA87BD23_D1275FF: I'm just curious if I'm a spaceman or a robot.
Dialogue.C7EC9CD2483901889C419BBD3EC03EA3_EAAE146: I'm just excited, Blake. Can't you feel it in your veins? We're getting close!
Dialogue.0C26C639480AB93327C105B8798796B9_FB122F8: I'm just floating here! Its- it's not good.
Dialogue.F6E2F3574B0D451357F81A84F3884527_06FC410: I'm just going to gently disassemble it so I don't forget everything I've ever known.
Dialogue.90465CE94960B1B25F5D87AFE400F41E_E090F2A: I'm just going to lie down right here.
Dialogue.EAEC70C14F656445986FEA81C12FDADA_97A9259: I'm just gonna be an extra. Because that's what I am. Extra.
Dialogue.B7A0E1724AFD4C7729B18ABC8DE52798_B222EAD: I'm just gonna go crawl into a mirror and wait for someone to say my name three times...
Dialogue.65C477364424F09212C94984CA115B9E_97A9259: I'm just gonna throw this blanket over you for a moment, and whatever happens, happens.
Dialogue.0EE489534B046A76646F4A86CB71F32F_97A9259: I'm just not ready to be a dad.
Dialogue.5F15EE9F48FCF0C3E98584B2F7F4B02E_97A9259: I'm just under a lot of pressure, okay?
Dialogue.ADE103A1480BEA25AD4F38B1E742EA46_97A9259: I'm just worried I won't be there for Dennis Jr.
Dialogue.4752114347964721C5F043A424DF6EB6_97A9259: I'm kidding. I know where you were going with that.
Dialogue.EFFFF48D421B1406A031869B2A1353C1_06FC410: I'm learning so much about ghosts.
Dialogue.B072BA55480CE9318D4AB781C4B19F33_97A9259: I'm listening to the entire script and I still have no idea what's going on.
Dialogue.4CD2270D40284ACE7C508D978573DA16_071921D: I'm lookin' at you, and all I'm seein' is yellow.
