Dialogue.C2D1F24B457FA66C97C4A893DC211CAC_FB122F8: I'm looking at actual confirmation that the world reacts to the way you fight and gather resources!
Dialogue.E30079D1438D9CC05AFAC2AE4FC9B671_97A9259: I'm looking at you and I see... ninja.
Dialogue.05C9C15D4C2D1E513E77F387183213B8_FB122F8: I'm looking for cassettes. You will be rewarded... semi-handsomely.
Dialogue.F79D36424D285392AF0E85A77861D90F_9F725B6: I'm looking for some friends to write songs with!
Dialogue.ACE4FE7D4E517CE4D4E1E7B26C7D55AC_06FC410: I'm looking for the suit, still. I promise.
Dialogue.494B039C4ACA8618E1487999256F47FA_724DAF1: I'm looking to go to series real quick...
Dialogue.BAAFA3C149A4F7E02DDDBE995159527C_06FC410: I'm lying through my teeth, there is nothing I want more than to give up.
Dialogue.C655775E486D7E68A2A01DBB7048F601_06FC410: I'm mad I'm not on the cover of this album.
Dialogue.6D3A31724F0FC39E0D4B1E802978483F_861A10F: I'm more a hammer and nails girl, not needles and thread. Why take the chance?
Dialogue.110A207449D2DB58317DE7BE3728C2BB_06FC410: I'm more curious about why Desiree wants to create and stabilize a rift.
Dialogue.745210604810E93CCB1B94A167496696_861A10F: I'm more of a hands-on kind of girl.
Dialogue.AABE5D5249D4233EB16DB08554BA7F35_94F2B66: I'm nervous every time I go in the field.
Dialogue.82E30C694E8CB98559EA91A9C05C18E5_B60EE0E: I'm no good hand to hand, got any melee weapons?
Dialogue.6E7EB2F741071C89FAD8F79879E3B83B_861A10F: I'm not a nugg-kill, Dennis. I just think that maybe we're being a bit cavalier.
Dialogue.DDC639B84D0E8C48F865ED9F43335CB8_72190CE: I'm not about to spend... infinity years being known as the worst pirate who ever lived.
Dialogue.BA54782B4D32551B0C84DBA1BD6501EF_14FBFB1: I'm not alone. All my enemies are here.
Dialogue.DF81CC7C4D4CA7D95C8F6C9F4E4911A6_06FC410: I'm not an expert in this sort of thing, but not much can be solved with juice and cruelty.
Dialogue.8E5B68EF4B5F892F5FF60EBCAFFF9D15_B25AF7B: I'm not anatomically correct? Why not?
Dialogue.E11570554537521C4B15778EB7A9933F_9F725B6: I'm not at the beach psyching myself up to finally take a surfing lesson from that hot surf shop owner.
Dialogue.AED8B9D14B21C3A247612B9D1C8D1AFB_06FC410: I'm not burdened by the keeping-Homebase-good whatever stuff.
Dialogue.5BB3982C40FE3577DEDD24B80AD90CAA_97A9259: I'm not crazy about what's happening here.
Dialogue.293935DD469FE2F9AC93F8B0A1455242_47CFF90: I'm not dealing with that until we take care of Dennis' impostor.
Dialogue.186BD83444018295EC9DFE9B1FB6FFEE_7D086D9: I'm not demanding we send someone over.
Dialogue.A25E7D6743323DB4DE679BAE9A051424_724DAF1: I'm not even sure if I know what this is.
Dialogue.88933EFF481D14F40CE87B9787CE65DF_06FC410: I'm not evil I'm just not great!
Dialogue.5B203C8546B2E46BD869899E4A2E5DAE_06FC410: I'm not evil, you know. I just did the calculations. Going it alone seemed smart.
Dialogue.30A1F66747C3C74522482E80F9AEF64D_1D2FE88: I'm not full of bubbling molten rocks for my health, you know.
Dialogue.5A94CEBB4870C9B90EA6468737F1DCC8_94F2B66: I'm not giving up. I'm accepting the fact that he's giving up.
Dialogue.B4E008AD42FF990BAE250BB0D86174D5_579B086: I'm not goin' out like this.
Dialogue.DED267A842E9D25288BAB6A93A7F2600_4731F06: I'm not goin' out like this.
Dialogue.B9C6F19B4061A59A9691DC83772748A5_97A9259: I'm not going to hate you.
Dialogue.1B588371410006A2CFC63C859EAD4060_06FC410: I'm not going to like it!
Dialogue.3CE665E54A70D32F159533AB72985199_F6B1D98: I'm not gonna sugarcoat it, Cassie. Being dead sucks. Being a ghost in a gun sucks even more.
Dialogue.241F8E4D4BBB3DA65A0B6D9CEDDD8342_A2D6E0B: I'm not good cop or bad cop, I'm best cop.
Dialogue.5723742D4CAFB1A9A7C3969FE81FDD87_9F725B6: I'm not good yet, but I will be. You should join me if you want!
Dialogue.B52C88B94BC8D2BB8A7534964969DE40_D87E161: I'm not great at that. At all. So.
Dialogue.C262F53B414081D698CD148203D64D8A_06FC410: I'm not happy about going right into the heart of darkness, but this Ayers guy needs to be taken down a peg.
Dialogue.3A286AF844FB3172999228915F82E546_1D2FE88: I'm not happy about the progress you're making...
Dialogue.D286CA8C474BBEB33FD892B11BBDDB0E_EAAE146: I'm not here for honor, I'm here for the booty. Arrr!
Dialogue.8335EA72478BDB8EA5A2299558A3CB74_89ED452: I'm not letting anything hold me back anymore. You hear that? You dumb curse? I'm done letting being scared, or ashamed, hold me back anymore.
Dialogue.BFDFB40B4C12DDD326E0F18098902E61_B222EAD: I'm not letting you off the hook.
Dialogue.8B3E2835494B86F998773585039613BA_06FC410: I'm not looking for hate here. I'm hoping we land up somewhere around mild tolerance.
Dialogue.7FF99B7E483288CE47AF5D9F6460F061_47CFF90: I'm not one to judge a book by its title...
Dialogue.784C5168494966DC015B6CBDB3BFD931_A96EA86: I'm not putting homebase at risk.
Dialogue.8B247D8D44907FF83AAF9EB31B4C1EE2_AB3C42C: I'm not saying this is bad, but... it is not my show.
Dialogue.6DD6628940790A6C8D8A7CAA88F181AA_06FC410: I'm not saying we can do better...
Dialogue.5E9608D244182B49D4125BA861DD8012_06FC410: I'm not siding with the slashers...
Dialogue.29D383184C0FB65EDC6D6898D9EFF24E_FB122F8: I'm not singin'. It's more like angry yelling.
Dialogue.98B8B0A446A393C8122D96878EFE3302_06FC410: I'm not some art house visionary.
Dialogue.429D3A864760DC135B187180A6D0FDC0_4731F06: I'm not supposed to die yet.
Dialogue.C1AC557A4CCE3BBDFA2B528A18D1191A_47CFF90: I'm not sure I understand why you're so worried about your pirating legacy.
Dialogue.4B8B366C4267D8E11423E08CA1E498AA_06FC410: I'm not sure how I feel about this.
Dialogue.14E07CFA49C36C9664DF40932E5EFF7F_861A10F: I'm not sure if they teach this at wolf school but the storm is kinda eroding reality's ability to make sense...
Dialogue.53D2D338418267A98DE26E8AC7965C38_06FC410: I'm not sure if this is helping... but I am enjoying it.
Dialogue.C8FA17744FBBD9B08365EBBB8FDCCEEF_06FC410: I'm not sure we want there to be a Part Two.
Dialogue.E82B1B2046DD7A4885A5C0B5B4F4E22C_FB122F8: I'm not sure what my favorite things are, maybe science flasks and experiments?
Dialogue.458A8F954A330BE075C54980E1051A19_06FC410: I'm not sure what type of evil we're dealing with here.
Dialogue.9C281AAE4052CFA5949AEDA40B5F8C0C_D1275FF: I'm not sure what we're doing, but I am optimistic about it.
Dialogue.BEC6E304475B305C172988A03945AF4D_94F2B66: I'm not talking about husks or smashers.
Dialogue.A18D05564F0C4AD6546136807C38C159_C9708CA: I'm not the only one saying this! There are reports coming in all the way from Stonewood of experimental Vindertech gear - Storm Shields. Homebases!
Dialogue.656DC74E4BDEEC239DF2138DC8CF4063_8106785: I'm not, thanks to my tin foil hat.
Dialogue.28AD5FEE43EB0B52D990449CA746DA45_EAAE146: I'm noticing that when you hit the monster guys... they... die?
Dialogue.378CC776403899AB3FB541A6787CF3EA_9D00593: I'm on it, boss. Trees! Ornaments! Homebase will kneel to the crushing spirit of Christmas! Hahahahaha!
Dialogue.885872174F1837B9E293FD88527314D5_B68F328: I'm on my bike. Gotta go convince Syd to give the new album a listen.
Dialogue.F86B733A4AB632AA5A4BDEB30C47BDEE_47CFF90: I'm only going where the spirits guide me!
Dialogue.09B4FB3C4434FBE36C0A35A5A40AD543_97A9259: I'm past golden brown and well on my way to extra crispy.
Dialogue.B69713154BFD277FA5A23190556A430B_06FC410: I'm picking up a lot of crowd noise... but yeah.
Dialogue.6DB61E9440D6E9BD840ABA8922847269_06FC410: I'm picking up a strong presence. Keep looking.
Dialogue.15D8F31F4D704AE142205ABD29178EDE_06FC410: I'm picking up evidence of a major husk termination event nearby.
Dialogue.79982C044ECD30B5B18C4AB7741B7440_06FC410: I'm picking up high levels of storm corruption centered in the catacombs.
Dialogue.1280EADC478054A97BEC1095F0F60BD3_06FC410: I'm picking up some moderately evil readings.
Dialogue.54E305C44D358D92C876678CF4080492_FB122F8: I'm picking up some weird signals coming from the old military base.
Dialogue.93AAC9DC4E4E27021A8AF2AF38BB03E4_FB122F8: I'm picking up what you're laying down.
Dialogue.41CBD1164C95941ED7CD738423C78A64_B222EAD: I'm picturing your gravestone. It's lovely.
Dialogue.FC5BA893466D4A335EABA99DE478359E_FB122F8: I'm pretty sure that should be what we're focusing on.
Dialogue.76F6C7B845061A3580454D9CE2B3D206_97A9259: I'm pretty sure they mainly just don't want to get eaten.
Dialogue.9333121A4225C4D8264CD48161F44F1F_910A467: I'm programmed to resolve conflicts and see all sides of an issue.
Dialogue.E3313C644F286681386C93BF5E9FC879_CC240C1: I'm pulling you out for now. I'll drop you back as soon as I can.
Dialogue.7F0CDB814387C813BE208F83C5AD030D_06FC410: I'm putting the hype train back in Hype Station.
Dialogue.67416F754691E77C40EAC9822A22896E_7D2960E: I'm reacting to you telling me your man Lars lives in the sky!
Dialogue.969467B64C2D3C3FC9F5599BDDE05C94_CC240C1: I'm real sorry you never got a chance to follow your dreams, mama.
Dialogue.2CFDD2B344CDFF3D7648EDA836A44F71_9801E98: I'm really excited to relive the epic days of Steel Wool
Dialogue.4513D5AB43D1A1D4E3904BB6E90FED61_97A9259: I'm really glad everyone's got a take
Dialogue.A28C73C8470389CC7CA1D1BEC5B51A07_181CD3E: I'm really honored that you'd think of me.
Dialogue.1F7753104C556189002AEC819D0426DB_06FC410: I'm really not happy with where this discussion ended!
Dialogue.375A9D654178752A58FA91BE55930F1B_06FC410: I'm really starting to dislike this Blackboot Ayers creep.
Dialogue.7F9CA26641A98C3553E657817EABE8EF_06FC410: I'm really starting to take this personally.
Dialogue.A6FA820A45E8ACAFD2C5088594AD6CFD_FB122F8: I'm rebuilding my music library. I'll pay a bounty for any cassette you find.
Dialogue.BF15E58A4B398CB1D489188FAAD6F1E5_724DAF1: I'm repped by The Dynamic Blast Agency.
Dialogue.D43B884F4DE4A8E6EAEE5CBF4A4D070F_06FC410: I'm rooting for cacti, but expecting something worse.
Dialogue.65526B7744B1A409FEFA62BC71DE571A_97A9259: I'm saying this as a man who knows the exact date and time of his own death...
Dialogue.311E204A427E4E4EB13A6284ADD78ED3_97A9259: I'm secretly happy we haven't found a dentist yet,
Dialogue.54F3F04B4A48F75D6555BB881423E2E2_FB122F8: I'm seein' a smasher. He looks... smash-y.
Dialogue.6070778241360561BB18A89F5219C3E6_06FC410: I'm seeing signs of the people of Homebase starting to come around!
Dialogue.6203C255467E6CD0174B3CB5453263B2_06FC410: I'm seeing some strange electrical patterns across the map.
Dialogue.D651994A42A1DE2E97D99CB645EF9FE7_06FC410: I'm sending a MED-Bot just in case.
Dialogue.B8DC8BFD4E5CB71470B9FC9D1E43F3DD_06FC410: I'm sending you back up above the clouds. Go take a cold shower or something.
Dialogue.A4B3DCBD4F1900414B6C60AD4C0D9C7E_724DAF1: I'm serious! You have got a heart that is, like, bursting with desire to make things better.
Dialogue.9B867BEF499C492DB70F809FC54CA679_97A9259: I'm setting up a movie marathon. I put the movie on, and on the screen I see...
Dialogue.FC317D0345BCF0BDD5E6B78290F3CCEB_B222EAD: I'm so powerless, floating around, not connecting with anyone or having any real impact.
Dialogue.AE158B5143AF3C65DE5AD3891C2FF7E9_06FC410: I'm so proud of you Commander. Taming the mighty Stonewood, venturing forth bravely into the unknown...
Dialogue.D4DE638648EEFB7CCED620918B36C44E_F6B1D98: I'm so proud of you, Cassie. Keep being awesome.
Dialogue.82F4C12C44679A56C2C7C09F7D633F02_06FC410: I'm so sorry. That's not what I meant.
Dialogue.45550C4344AEF82DC46D6F9C742D85BC_06FC410: I'm so, so, sorry. We were on our way... but then we found Hexsylvania.
Dialogue.1485EC6349419632F78AA184D4C5B477_21C1927: I'm sore worried about my maker, Ted Travers. Is he here?
Dialogue.B383586448E9FFB4F827EC8D89F6D2C8_06FC410: I'm sorry Commander, but he can't be gone.
Dialogue.357E2EE1415771C44D7D39904047C453_06FC410: I'm sorry I hid the truth from you.
Dialogue.E2331E8648B4B394DDFDDAA3659B9889_724DAF1: I'm sorry I let everyone down.
Dialogue.E20129DD4C1B5B11B8742C9170817006_FB122F8: I'm sorry I made life hard for you and everyone else.
Dialogue.1886CA9B49476217280946BFE654AA7A_06FC410: I'm sorry I never got the chance to meet her.
Dialogue.F6CEF8E94D3E0689DABE02973C7829C4_7D086D9: I'm sorry for you... and I'm sorry for me.
Dialogue.BA064F1C4EDAB500E122BDBE82B854E1_EAAE146: I'm sorry to dump this on your doorstep, but I don't know where else to go.
Dialogue.4CEA5D0E40AA1D05C727AD9A273B655F_47CFF90: I'm sorry to have brought my terrible curse upon you.
Dialogue.482066524D7D72933CD17B95D01DF8D1_72190CE: I'm sorry we ransacked Homebase, buried your treasures, and stole all of your copper wiring.
Dialogue.E75615A948A6C3B1C9FA89AB831CBD55_06FC410: I'm sorry you died, but that doesn't give you the right to become a monster.
Dialogue.2A8EFBE448C04D33EFDDE3837B0705F8_47CFF90: I'm sorry you feel that way.
Dialogue.1F1F016640977969C9241582BABB2CA9_181CD3E: I'm sorry you're not better. Truly.
Dialogue.526960F4483B9F6C5C28A98A3FA5BF3A_181CD3E: I'm sorry you're not happy with my work.
Dialogue.CBB5CDBA4F8FB396ABC579A513F9F4EC_06FC410: I'm sorry, Commander. I can't do this.
Dialogue.51A4C3F443C9BA38DA48F5ADDEBF60CC_06FC410: I'm sorry, Commander. You don't need to worry about my problems.
Dialogue.81B5A6A04E60313A1F5F50AA61E85ADD_06FC410: I'm sorry, I didn't know we're friends.
Dialogue.A0A650FC41DAD93F4FB7AF8C01FA1712_8DEFB9E: I'm sorry, I didn't understand your question.
Dialogue.F0764F8148965C227351D3AC3D7FB5B9_8DEFB9E: I'm sorry, I didn't understand your question.
Dialogue.57CBFA194D6B15EAFC1301A2B22A5310_06FC410: I'm sorry, I'm still trying to understand how Homebase could hate the greatest show ever made.
Dialogue.D25C18F44E6AE1561FA4198AB13991D9_06FC410: I'm sorry, I... I don't think we're going to find the cure.
Dialogue.F224522F44DF876E64E83C9D8BF2E61D_7D086D9: I'm sorry, I... I really don't.
Dialogue.9E01824E49128277BF096983C415A400_9F725B6: I'm sorry, Lars. Did you name the truck Claudia?
Dialogue.B02A1A8A469A8A24BCB1A6929DD4AF5E_06FC410: I'm sorry, Lars. It's just... it's just true, man.
Dialogue.93EE385B48C3D93BF76F199E15CD120A_06FC410: I'm sorry, but just to be clear... have I been kidnapped?
Dialogue.C976AE7844659CACA1E26AB75021FF07_84C369E: I'm sorry, rhythm. I never should have denied you.
Dialogue.2B9912AE446D8D6057AF9896BDF73D3F_8DEFB9E: I'm sorry, the transmission to Desiree has been blocked.
Dialogue.A76BA2A14927B89FCDCADD95B43CA5FF_8DEFB9E: I'm sorry, the transmission to Desiree has been blocked.
Dialogue.13D33353449D529D482A02BE3B75E450_87F0BBB: I'm sorry. I- I got too focused on one thing and I missed the big picture.
Dialogue.2A60BDBF4F2931DB525D30886F571CB7_9F725B6: I'm sorry. It's just not the first time I've heard that.
Dialogue.344E3481446B31A8B2407CACB383FD20_1D2FE88: I'm sorry. This doesn't feel right...
Dialogue.4E5D0072400FF078CD335099A0ACD944_7D086D9: I'm sorry... that I have to be the one to do it.
Dialogue.C0EE878B48EAD322C5EC54A0506C91D5_84C369E: I'm sort of infatuated with this girl, right? But we also hate each other.
Dialogue.BD6ABCC1412564D8734142B1D8C4EFFA_9801E98: I'm starting to see why Carlos won't talk to you.
Dialogue.68646A834F09C4151C564ABF3D0D226C_AB3C42C: I'm starting to understand how the budget got out of hand so quickly.
Dialogue.E0B23FD2459B65C9BBCED5A84B9B63D4_06FC410: I'm still getting a faint ping from his locator hat.
Dialogue.82B2936749F7F06B0F123BB0D3FE83C8_C2C5A2E: I'm still just in it for the Slurp.
Dialogue.FF75476C4CA8136A87B099BB90971CC1_861A10F: I'm still not ruling out Husk-Bombs. (gasp) Or Bomb-Husks!
Dialogue.781BC9B641971E54895B5980D5788719_861A10F: I'm still not sure about this plan...
Dialogue.57A680344656CEC2F747228F803A407B_97A9259: I'm still not sure when dawn happens. My watch doesn't have that kind of information... it just has numbers.
Dialogue.5BD079BC4DCA5B2B993E6A8C9152565E_06FC410: I'm still not that worried. Are you behind the... very graphic husk attacks?
Dialogue.4881B6ED4335AB91EB811B9096587EA1_06FC410: I'm still really, really sorry about that, Lok.
Dialogue.0D8C377A45EDB73D06EBC0AA77A9AF26_72190CE: I'm still waiting for the catch... but that was really nice.
Dialogue.C28C56D54663E8E71F9A6896BD943E77_06FC410: I'm still working on finding the final Project Tailor design.
Dialogue.D3D32CF74D988D5C744BBC99F44675A5_06FC410: I'm such a lazy jerk. I'm sorry, Pop.
Dialogue.C65CB70741FEFB11E11F8792DAB750DE_97A9259: I'm supposed to be firm but fair, but also his friend and relatable, but also successful and a role model?
Dialogue.B51C816941AD92A1223203902CF19A2C_910A467: I'm supposed to have two legs, but maybe legs three and four know something I don't.
Dialogue.0C6423A04039FE9B1B11A5BAF91CF684_47CFF90: I'm sure I have one around here somepla- Oh! Here we go.
Dialogue.70DD987645323AE3E30DEFB09F648AD5_06FC410: I'm sure I'll screw this up, but if you get this message, I want you to know...
Dialogue.ECEA4B9F4D42B446C0CAF1AE93DE4C6D_06FC410: I'm sure his timeline is great now. The sun is shining, the birds are chirping...
Dialogue.0623C7BB46B90D3FFB20829F88515471_97A9259: I'm sure it doesn't feel like one when you're rollin' around with stacks of Ls.
Dialogue.2BB8A8EE4863644E69252EB4041F237E_06FC410: I'm sure she's under a lot of stress. Once we find SEE-bot, then you'll get to meet the real Desiree.
Dialogue.EB94A21A437762661476C79DBA804F4D_D87E161: I'm sure that sounded more heroic in your head.
Dialogue.9EA512C748DAB2953A487B98BAFF806C_FB122F8: I'm sure the survivors will be very flattered to hear that.
Dialogue.98230F1C4E7C9F1DB5E4F9BAA152DCF4_FB122F8: I'm sure they have their reasons.
Dialogue.D486B42A445AB766BD06BDA884C063D7_1D2FE88: I'm sure you didn't break that on accident... The living sure like to smash things.
Dialogue.9709836A4AE2E3D7D65D78B9CB8EC5D6_1D2FE88: I'm sure you'll be the first.
Dialogue.866F1B854A64AE5341977BB3E37508BC_EC1949E: I'm sure you're doing your best.
Dialogue.BF0C9753435396EA4DAD0CAEC599661F_06FC410: I'm sure you've got it covered.
Dialogue.3153DF6942536622DDF76EAB7BD36732_89ED452: I'm surprised YOU don't have more secrets you'd be freaked out about people knowing.
Dialogue.E5C03140496781DF04EE0980D5E2C981_7D086D9: I'm surprised you're so impressed. You use teleportation drones all the time.
Dialogue.976FF26D49A4781C8C2281B6AE78909A_06FC410: I'm talkin' meteors, planetary rings, disgraced former planets.
Dialogue.F83582794F45DE4ABF343192D99C8AB0_94F2B66: I'm talking about the Storm King.
Dialogue.45E433B4402A0EC94D88C2A4382F1B8E_B222EAD: I'm terrified of what's down there...
Dialogue.1EF1B51A405003D176EE968365BE36F2_97A9259: I'm the guy who tells Dennis he sucks.
Dialogue.ED1ACA814B993F53C234A9B553FF47AB_06FC410: I'm the one who buys him voice packs. So, yeah. It's just... he says so many words.
Dialogue.D7A2EEFF4EB74874EC0F429CD85D0DDA_06FC410: I'm the one who changed my name, okay.
Dialogue.BF2D639F464568F70B649BAF87DD0BCF_06FC410: I'm the one who steered us into this amoral arts and crafts nightmare.
Dialogue.B1FD5B294BA96A44416D52B9EA7F5FEF_21C1927: I'm the worst thing you ever made!
Dialogue.DAC064084510D74C962380AEF57762D0_4731F06: I'm there. I'm even younger this time.
Dialogue.08BA0DA24925363680666590BC85CDFA_FB122F8: I'm thinking either Observable Psuedovector Declination with Transient Relative States...
Dialogue.E90EE1884941994C217148B6771EFEDD_7D086D9: I'm thinking it will be left of the track... but it might be right of the track?
Dialogue.718CDD3D492EBA5C1817B6A86AFE39A2_06FC410: I'm thinking this is a Reality Hiccups thing.
Dialogue.9492A8AB43452FADDE287F8BBD9DB1E2_06FC410: I'm thinking to avoid any.. you know, weirdness, we just push all the beds together.
Dialogue.CB9C9C3144A8CF049FBD2EAA59262986_06FC410: I'm thinking we smash some cages just in case.
Dialogue.DBA5BDC7434CB0DBC371A0926AB2F45D_861A10F: I'm tired of rebuilding things he knocks down. It's like he doesn't even care about the mess.
Dialogue.CE0815AD462811068525839FBE47FFA2_B222EAD: I'm too sad to argue. What's up, Lok?
Dialogue.CDE1807B43F8A6A1A1082FB37EAEA396_DB7CBEB: I'm too young and too beautiful!
Dialogue.E16F746E4858569E4F204E9ADBCC71E4_CC240C1: I'm tracking a supply drop nearby, Commander!
Dialogue.E136ACDE4B3EEFE0300F149B44D59B10_FB122F8: I'm tracking multiple low flying craft heading south west.
Dialogue.311E453E4FA3C83F9B09D19E2E986CE3_B60EE0E: I'm trapped and under attack! This is so unfair!
Dialogue.2BBC72364095D283D8CEC0803269FFC4_FB122F8: I'm trying not to take it personally.
Dialogue.21BBF1104F747737DA0815AAF2E72B66_06FC410: I'm trying to figure it out, but my memory is so... fuzzy.
Dialogue.687EDB3349FDFBADEB4DBD949BF60615_9801E98: I'm trying to use the fossil record to learn about the future.
Dialogue.70EE802C4347CC60DB8EA688194A62EE_47CFF90: I'm uncomfortable with that idea for a variety of reasons.
Dialogue.3B8B24CF443927004225679F66CF44F6_FB122F8: I'm under a little bit of stress here, Syd.
Dialogue.9BAD33FB43937AA8DBF3039BCC04FEB1_06FC410: I'm under this blanket. And I'm staying under this blanket forever.
Dialogue.275133A546781C63E8F9608F701D41FF_97A9259: I'm uploading the Dennis Combo to the Taste Wizard mainframe.
Dialogue.5A66D58840E45F182B1FB897255EE206_CC240C1: I'm very glad to hear it.
Dialogue.F2AA06BA4FD6DBA2CD023FAB66CEA543_7F95CEB: I'm what you'd call a "well-tuned tickler."
Dialogue.3E047DEB40A673567F97659C87446530_9D00593: I'm wherever Christmas is found, Lars.
Dialogue.8853410D49250E74B4F1A59B13E386D2_9801E98: I'm working on Carlos' bike and it appears to be disappearing.
Dialogue.242CE0F5425A10A5439CD1BC2CCE4244_9D00593: I'm working on my own holiday song. Want to hear it?
Dialogue.62B705724903F17443F577BC6CCEA911_06FC410: I'm working through the second act. It- it drags.
Dialogue.42D4C0D24F45B896A662EE9A25C403F5_06FC410: I'm worried this is a Reality Hiccups thing.
Dialogue.2AC8A8C344CFB83DE98A5E8BBA59A89E_06FC410: I'm worried we'll be facing down a storm-fueled Vlad monster.
Dialogue.E858D2924235031671807AB61DFC9579_06FC410: I'm, uh, b- building a bot to help me sort some things out.
Dialogue.75439C904A244B6A3F138FBD80AF2CA4_06FC410: I'm... feeling pretty lousy at even the thought of giving it.
Dialogue.BC4069E348898CBCE7B5A1A54FE41D71_FB122F8: I'm... gonna read up on our brand.
Dialogue.4CB61D0F4030C0D97E3ABEA7C41D0BAB_C9708CA: I'm... talking into a robot. It feels weird. But if you are hearing this -
Dialogue.7DE6C64D48432468C9BE2BAED1BC5ECE_06FC410: I've added another location to your map.
Dialogue.5AD36B00427C2EE2B3B5238E544995DA_06FC410: I've added some tracks to your inventory.
Dialogue.31B6A8D842543E663FB921A05347B4AE_89ED452: I've already put together a prototype of the Danger Ranger!
Dialogue.CFC9A9D040A2069AA5649F9345232ADC_47CFF90: I've already taken the liberty of scheduling checkups for you both back at Homebase because this conversation has been... alarming.
Dialogue.D59607B245F093A896B722AA3A0E3127_B222EAD: I've also come up with a plan to ruin everyone's Christmas.
Dialogue.28A169874AC6CA6BAD081DAFFC65E142_06FC410: I've always dreamed of going on a road trip.
Dialogue.A2232272423B27CDC216659B8B17AA0B_06FC410: I've always wanted to leave it all behind and head out on the open road.
Dialogue.E56B48654BAC274CB4CE77857F720D14_06FC410: I've always wanted to say that, and it was exactly as great as I imagined.
Dialogue.75D816F7493714EBA9FF38B12D135138_06FC410: I've always wanted to see Thunder Route 99...
Dialogue.4C07D562488034512A78C7856E0E8577_06FC410: I've been awful. Put me in front of a judge.
Dialogue.77FC4F4242F00054B72702B0AA764AF6_89ED452: I've been carrying that everywhere, trying not to think about it, and then when you came back...
Dialogue.2AFAEEBB40798C2FDDBC498CAD29874C_97A9259: I've been crying in public a lot, and that's been great for my self-esteem.
Dialogue.A91AFA4843A65036CEA2EBB76E7063B1_861A10F: I've been doing some diagrams of ways to integrate these supports into our forts in the field.
Dialogue.23814D2C47EF44396213258211D146AA_14FBFB1: I've been here the entire time.
Dialogue.86AFC2D844B3319E32A101828553605F_B222EAD: I've been here the whole time. I'm Lok's "imaginary friend."
Dialogue.C0AC93D94ABB979A8CCCF798E30FCFD9_181CD3E: I've been hiding from you for years.
Dialogue.E16549024AB45156FF841CAABCF69B52_3D2D55D: I've been holding down the fort. But nowhere is safe for long.
Dialogue.5EEEF30343227C5F06FA5385E02ACD22_97A9259: I've been inspired by all the great science you are doing!
Dialogue.F73C92124E01110B655A1C96096F0558_C9708CA: I've been intercepting radio transmissions for the last few days... and I believe these are the real deal.
Dialogue.D0CCDF444B8341D7A1736588A501A69B_72190CE: I've been lying to you about the whole pirate king plan.
Dialogue.6B5D5FD1423F81EA3ABDC49FB1926C97_97A9259: I've been meaning to ask about that. I mean, like... that's for sure Knox, but now he's a villain?
Dialogue.7F0153F643CEF5FF8C8D5A98464A29C8_97A9259: I've been meaning to ask, what exactly caused you to go to prison?
Dialogue.24AD75A74420C558579EAB9E2FBB7DBD_97A9259: I've been preoccupied with my own problems and that's really, really selfish.
Dialogue.F4ADC55F41B52AF037FA29B69B80D873_EC1949E: I've been reading... and I got my head around the science.
Dialogue.B53AA25A42A0E7E658737E9A8544EF8B_7D086D9: I've been running an analysis of these rolls.
Dialogue.64AFE34F4F58E4BC3420E7B643727AC9_06FC410: I've been running some updated simulations of our siege on Plank Harbor.
Dialogue.3E879A194C5740556CDA7FB377B3A8BD_06FC410: I've been scouring Canny Valley for everything I can find on Ayers,
Dialogue.918DFAD241A0937E8F7A95A53E964A1F_21C1927: I've been sitting on the shelf too long..
Dialogue.B699E10D43C7E0826EA936BBA44FC5D1_861A10F: I've been thinking, Ray, and I think I need to go back home and see my family.
Dialogue.307F500A44783470DFB0359645CAEE54_06FC410: I've been told that we've got a special full moon coming up.
Dialogue.2043676B42D1649B67CE4AB5BF533610_06FC410: I've been trying to get everyone to agree on a gameplan to handle them.
Dialogue.7D961BE845E84F820FBD87916D3DA17B_1D2FE88: I've been... defeated? That's even possible? No!
Dialogue.F5308F11498B653AECF5D0A26F84A279_1D2FE88: I've been... defeated? That's even possible? No!
Dialogue.4A2C33D74CA3C9E1F9273AB235C025C5_1D2FE88: I've been... defeated? That's possible? Noooooooo!
Dialogue.72557B3344BC707BCAC4BFA74E0B6700_EC1949E: I've come to terms with getting dragged by the sweetest baby robot alive.
Dialogue.AF19F3BF43862C92A538DBA22B7600E7_724DAF1: I've come to the desert in search of legendary gunslinger, Blackboot Ayers.
Dialogue.BA6375EF4F5BEB46AA3E668C53C950D6_861A10F: I've decided that you're gonna be my summer project.
Dialogue.8C5ED7924605DDB44EE79BA44EEECB6D_EECA944: I've done so much... Is this how it ends?
Dialogue.38ACFA9F498B9061BC3ED9BBC1BC2BD3_06FC410: I've downloaded the schematic. Let's test it out.
Dialogue.6F8F385B41BB2C95C46E91AC0DCF81C3_B222EAD: I've driven greater minds to insanity.
Dialogue.8F599B71405E7D9BEB669587F877DC54_97A9259: I've dropped my phone in four separate toilets and one fountain. So, trust me, I know what I'm doing.
Dialogue.5DD30E79459F19F9A59FB58C56D2907F_CC240C1: I've felt sadness. I've felt pain. I've been connected to an Old God who showed me the Infinite Abyss.
Dialogue.C67072C34D6A5D703A4DECA39D1F2A00_AB3C42C: I've fought fake aliens, I can fight real monsters too.
Dialogue.7942C37644551F57AA7600AD07523AB6_06FC410: I've found a solution to our problem.
Dialogue.377738994050940BBBDDC7A8B7218BB7_06FC410: I've found the launchpad and marked it on your map.
Dialogue.0159BD654492E3A26401A39DAF57A684_B222EAD: I've given it some thought and I totally believe you, and I'm ready to help.
Dialogue.A0BD381F445F6735118D7F8B422FA3A3_97A9259: I've given it some thought, and someone does need to take a stand.
Dialogue.626AC61B4434EEB8B91C3AB57508AA6D_9D00593: I've given some thought about what you said, Ray.
Dialogue.48A1D676479A1B044A427EA2E23681FF_72190CE: I've gone through all of dad's research. He's real.
Dialogue.94B683A14980385FC55B8BA7A0105DB6_06FC410: I've got MED-bots standing by. If he's hurt, we'll take care of him.
Dialogue.8169EED946007992BC59558E6B51E290_47CFF90: I've got Pop and Kevin on high alert, but let's get this done ASAP.
Dialogue.4181391B4A7A03F07FF78082DB4ED4B1_06FC410: I've got a fix on Pop's location.
Dialogue.A98CA24F4A6AC52A14C3B1B720C3AD2B_06FC410: I've got a good feeling about this hover fleet!
Dialogue.2BD029E647EBEE50C5AB01A4B65E6EBF_06FC410: I've got a plan. You need to trust me here.
Dialogue.33A216DC44DC1B2952534E8B111BBA67_FB122F8: I've got a rough landing ahead.
Dialogue.9CF070494698364817046CB10B8F4B39_861A10F: I've got a summer song of my own. Can you help me get it on the air?
Dialogue.BC9A24C24ABEEED4223A0593D1966608_FB122F8: I've got a van full of good tidings! Let's fly!
Dialogue.C304227A4DB3FB6DACCBF1B62FEBC7CF_97A9259: I've got a whole new thing to worry about at night now.
Dialogue.C44A5AF34E17D319C8EB388868BDEC58_7F95CEB: I've got all the bells and whistles.
Dialogue.F13535D245220965C39A759328444739_181CD3E: I've got brains, you've only got.. skill, and weapons, and... a striking jawline... and... (sigh)
Dialogue.70FA1B36460DF0DD1660E0AB284F50E8_06FC410: I've got eyes on Lars. Let's let him sleep.
Dialogue.021EC3B34DEEF8414C95CDAEE8B70998_FB122F8: I've got eyes on some husks!
Dialogue.17692E3C496208F88F2CDC8FB860062B_181CD3E: I've got it together, really, it's all under control and we will win... I can feel it.
Dialogue.6FB25828496217D80F82B0A2725345BF_97A9259: I've got it! We put you on a leash and we can go for walkies to help you run out your were-energy.
Dialogue.2C51C7CE404CA7D59E69079F94F50595_06FC410: I've got like six more pages of this. Keep taking out those statues.
Dialogue.CB81583F44FBA7238A837F82D64C8126_EAAE146: I've got more fight in me now.
Dialogue.F535DBC545330715F550C38691CDD4DF_A2D6E0B: I've got the goods and the guns, what do you have?
Dialogue.94EDAA494CB620F5032E71BCEC9A111F_FB122F8: I've got the perfect launch site in mind!
Dialogue.C624348442EC217C8BC080A95F45C274_06FC410: I've got way too much dirt on him that I could dish out.
Dialogue.4E1CB72C4CC385E69545B39A8BF42277_B222EAD: I've got you booked for a pretty simple stress dream. Are you SURE you want this?
Dialogue.EA190549486C9D47ED05C592F70F9B7C_CC240C1: I've got you!  I'll drop you back in when there's a break!
Dialogue.31C9653B4B1154EAF5B03BB161FA0162_06FC410: I've had dinner with this jar.
Dialogue.D3424E4B4B355A165CA9FDA18EC455E0_724DAF1: I've had that my whole life, man!
Dialogue.29FE4C594C8DB9422E42D3840BB1921F_7D086D9: I've had the same thought myself.
Dialogue.B4296CE54C1EF91B6025C49E88756621_06FC410: I've heard people say that, but never in that tone of voice.
Dialogue.182E30434786830DF4EAD1BB2A74C1D2_06FC410: I've located the launch site and added it to your map.
Dialogue.727B60624CE48C6D21CF2BBDB6D94455_06FC410: I've located the launch site and added it to your map.
Dialogue.2C3A6A1C4356FC82F6B847A5E1BBBAF5_06FC410: I've made some Missing Posters. Everyone split up and spread the word!
Dialogue.66F00EE6450D6A46C15547B33910E772_06FC410: I've marked a place to hide the cannons on your map.
Dialogue.96BE478444671F2E0E1594ADC9D8E2CF_06FC410: I've marked an evil location on your map.
Dialogue.FFC20DD84F98BB40E8579B89440E8534_06FC410: I've marked his last known location on the mini map.
Dialogue.0C3E44294FA3B4D528E029A173A71349_06FC410: I've marked some locations on your map.
Dialogue.82222EE649F918A8784648BBCAE67919_06FC410: I've marked the last known location of the shelter on your map.
Dialogue.1A3278B64AC6CCB0F605D294DCCB6124_06FC410: I've marked the location of the fort on your map. Let's go protect those survivors!
Dialogue.BEC7153F40239647BE9815892A357A50_06FC410: I've marked the location of the shelter on your map
Dialogue.EBB2D9824FA119CDB038ABAE19E32A0C_06FC410: I've marked the location of the shelter on your map!
Dialogue.F35AC6B540571F93F047DAA546E1F5EB_06FC410: I've marked the location of the towers on your map.
Dialogue.9821968E4C3D706DC49FFFB4F2A3F2AF_A96EA86: I've marked the location on your map.
Dialogue.AE60722E4371806A6A582F8394856537_06FC410: I've marked the next evil location on your map.
Dialogue.CCE06999414BCE94759FD591E2885121_FB122F8: I've marked where the 'scopes need to go.
Dialogue.45B424054D7BAE008075559DEF1F8F9E_06FC410: I've met werewolves, vampires, um... a merman, I think?
Dialogue.6C081DE74B402597137CC1B4941595DB_EC1949E: I've never been a failure in my life and I'm not starting today.
Dialogue.DA1583E7475AF4692B29E5B61C32CA71_47CFF90: I've never been one for carrots.
Dialogue.50133CA3422E68D549AC908D80E57FAB_861A10F: I've never lurked a day in my life and look at me now.
Dialogue.8E1EBE7941CE3920F7EFF4B96A1879B7_97A9259: I've never seen Ray that angry.
Dialogue.AAD8444043F67441C1A84087C6CD2DAF_9D00593: I've never seen a doctor and I'm not starting today.
Dialogue.3EA30EAF4104C75EB841D78E5B4CCD49_06FC410: I've never seen a map to Hexsylvania, but that doesn't mean one doesn't exist.
Dialogue.8579792F471274582969198FB3DCADAF_21523A0: I've never seen an elf with one of those.
Dialogue.FDCCF69C41F1D1462505E3BF5776FCC4_9F725B6: I've never written a song of my own.
Dialogue.8BB69C6041FF3C7A7A7770A5B15A1939_06FC410: I've noticed a high degree of storm corruption in... some graves.
Dialogue.629C15D546163C45788D6EB2FF5D16EF_06FC410: I've only been here for like twenty minutes.
Dialogue.0A2703284AEFC27D229CF0A4D638F0BF_21C1927: I've only been tracking you for six months.
Dialogue.14EF80354B365E2948C78EB99993AD47_B229E47: I've placed telescopes throughout the zone.
Dialogue.049795A64968030001681BA6C727C42D_9F725B6: I've played in front of maybe twenty people. Maybe.
Dialogue.813356C44866C26E317BC296A6AEF6ED_06FC410: I've prepared the van propulsion device. Deploy when you're ready, Commander.
Dialogue.83E745A94F34C6D01A9CE89E069AE539_14FBFB1: I've read all of her columns. Many times.
Dialogue.C7DC493942D1C1CC0F5C79B34E4E1D8A_06FC410: I've read every road trip book, seen every movie, listened to every wistful song...
Dialogue.8772BE9A45B8E41B1671D798E1274668_DCC8D4F: I've read the future, you have no chance.
Dialogue.250C2B41456CE05F990D5699E60F42EE_06FC410: I've recorded his movements, let's see what he's... been...
Dialogue.543C0EEC420697EFB77A93B56616D87D_21C1927: I've seen baby dolls with more fight in them.
Dialogue.E742C04B4110B0198FF9ED85D5F3EB91_3D2D55D: I've seen something like that before... Way back before all of this started...
Dialogue.DED2C6EC4DA03C4B0DFAA290E69CB6C1_06FC410: I've started a new life where no one will ever find me.
Dialogue.7F5AC1784F9A4C0C9F1E82B1C7DD37B8_0A979DB: I've traded love for truth, and I can truly see for the first time.
Dialogue.3215E7F54638346E0D8DE9BAD1C5DD2E_06FC410: I've tripped about fifty times. Is that a lot? I think that's a lot.
Dialogue.12C74B6A4F509591757E6790A99E4849_97A9259: I've watched every episode of Ghost Boss.
Dialogue.5D73FF4440C5B6C6DE49CA9866A052C5_14FBFB1: I, on the other hand, think wolf names are depraved. But in a good way.
Dialogue.1EC0BFC24D7AA3D97E12CFAABD069607_06FC410: I, uh, did a little more research, and the manual was talking about shared goals, not... shared nightmares.
Dialogue.3E8BF4D3458960E64CAE63815DDB341B_97A9259: I, uh, ha- have done some thinking...
Dialogue.E920C3ED46479177F6D1CBACBFD63C8E_06FC410: I, uh... could have done better. But I didn't.
Dialogue.CB90FDAF4B9F56E33F48C39EF21ABDA4_94F2B66: I, uh... had to do some guessing on yours.
Dialogue.7CF886C84EAFBEDAE5DB249CFB67744C_84C369E: I- I could- I could use a hand, I guess.
Dialogue.60C4C2344C55CB98EEA197851277132E_FB122F8: I- I don't care. I mean, I care about doing a good job, of course, but I don't care what other people think of me.
Dialogue.3CA578E84B3FF1D75181278A05AEE260_21C1927: I- I don't feel so good.
Dialogue.498B28D7401CDED7AE3A9A8ACA9F8669_F6B1D98: I- I don't know he seemed pretty nice to me.
Dialogue.25ACB3A94241D860799D2392255EAA41_72190CE: I- I mean, yes, but, you know what? I think I've got it from here, Willow.
Dialogue.B02389B14011CF479A8B77B194A46A78_181CD3E: I- I promise you... I am valuable, and you should save me!
Dialogue.77373A4740B493DEF343B8A8D2F97899_06FC410: I- I saw your box copy said you can never turn down a good tea party.
Dialogue.F62D014E4C7C6FD2AA0A788B628EFA61_06FC410: I- I understand Penny, but we're a family here, too. You can't leave!
Dialogue.D581B26D4B08BAD1AF48409BC2D9C650_9D00593: I- I was also confused when I said yes.
Dialogue.095809624286E50EF57C248589E5C768_06FC410: I- If you're on my team, you're dry docked and you know why.
Dialogue.59AAC07F469205C70D2F8AB682E62A28_FB122F8: I-In a science way. Not like... you know... in a van way.
Dialogue.3B57E0AE4FB77742F59D3B8FD083C3CB_724DAF1: I... I gotta get outta here...
Dialogue.812224064C7A60BE3CAE83AD7C04A0B1_B222EAD: I... I need to be alone.
Dialogue.421CD0E84F620C40C74EFDA83AE00A6B_47CFF90: I... I suppose you're right. I've been on the defense so long, I've lost sight of our real mission here.
Dialogue.59B48C964CE3CF1098B9A9A4C73112CA_CC240C1: I... don't know. I'm sorry. It's my first day...
Dialogue.521571C54784BF546F43ED91C2A7C5E2_9801E98: I... don't understand what you're saying at all.
Dialogue.775B693649A9FD078D79128D87F52320_EC1949E: I... don't want to... complain, but... help!
Dialogue.AA606473414A7E9B26C6D48F3D7264AA_06FC410: I... guess so? Anyway, the creepy name isn't the concerning part.
Dialogue.06F3184E443A7B0356C6C18AC7AE447F_89ED452: I... he... I mean, kind of?
Dialogue.1C59856348D443360F91589BBF33C77F_B25AF7B: IF IT PLEASES THE COURT, I WOULD LIKE TO BURST INTO FLAMES.
Dialogue.9C0C19C44AC34E69F743BFB6FEE8CDBD_97A9259: If "peckish" means hungry then, yes I do.
Dialogue.01E90F8E4406350DC31BC0A6CA879F64_FB122F8: If Carlos is out there, he needs our help.
Dialogue.B02EFCB542DA0600EEB2F5A2FF7CEF99_D87E161: If Dennis was just 100% doof, he wouldn't have made it this far.
Dialogue.0795B52B49EEDA9EB46C5DBADA0F553E_06FC410: If Dr. Vinderman is restarting the Homebase Defense Project, we need to be ready!
Dialogue.2F1F1E184FCD7892CD99F386B67E3029_8106785: If Homebase's lies have you hungry for the truth and thirsty for enlightenment, Dennis Burger is there for you.
Dialogue.9B43DC25420CCBA6F5D16DA0FB9CD2D8_9801E98: If I analyze the structures down there we could learn something.
Dialogue.8D7CD8544C38C9ABB7A51AA318211F32_7D2960E: If I ask you a question, are you gonna do that "figure it out yourself" thing or are we past that?
Dialogue.B400EA39457A8061A32C4BAAEE027375_FB122F8: If I could take it back, I would.
Dialogue.1594974749D8178D5877CE8A734B7FBD_06FC410: If I dance like an idiot? Hey man, at least I'm dancing.
Dialogue.606402404EF9F7C3925C2DA9CE31AB34_7D2960E: If I didn't know any better, I'd say you lied to me back there.
Dialogue.9D1741234763EB9F6826A8809131ABCC_06FC410: If I didn't know better, I'd say this was Director Riggs.
Dialogue.1B3C2CA24F901DEA2F022CA43B4F193B_D87E161: If I didn't want to be here, I wouldn't be here.
Dialogue.303CF896425CD8C9C4DAB4B8B03A07A4_97A9259: If I do, will you promise not to eat my soul?
Dialogue.CC59A5024D2461E51C7957BADB8F4A91_AB3C42C: If I don't get photographed in this dress, I have to pay for it.
Dialogue.A05D38AC4842B65CEA79DE81A1BDF838_06FC410: If I embarrass myself, who cares?
Dialogue.7D7337644BFAE2A7D002E0AD034E4EF6_FB122F8: If I figure it out, you'll be the first to know.
Dialogue.C50BC49C416EC3B52ACF45B968F77DF7_97A9259: If I focus on winning, suddenly I'm very scared that we won't.
Dialogue.37975C2F407F033885B98F9849ED6DDE_9801E98: If I forget a few I can usually *Singing* Fake it!
Dialogue.89A3FECE4F555E289E1A7194CA4BD90D_176484F: If I give you a medkit, will you go away?
Dialogue.8C867BA94B4FC3C3CA4A82A205580A9E_B60EE0E: If I had a pistol, I'd back you up.
Dialogue.231ED776432FEBA3F7D142A69F48DA66_B60EE0E: If I had a sniper rifle, I'd be a hero!
Dialogue.AD163CE4438A76D2F88BF8A63E94B840_97A9259: If I had known his backstory, I would not have said the mom thing.
Dialogue.FA8B99594A7676769D0DEABFFA1CDE35_06FC410: If I had to guess I'd say he's near a truck stop.
Dialogue.1C6A89F447B4CF8525B4E8BA34BC3F96_47CFF90: If I had to guess, I'd say it feeds off your insecurities...
Dialogue.A96898C8499BAC8CC9989ABEE36C1F8C_06FC410: If I knew Homebase didn't want me around and had nowhere else to go...
Dialogue.5C3D1D3C4C6D35DDFF433E8E94DAF0E5_9D00593: If I may, I believe I have a solution to our problem.
Dialogue.24971C14446275F8BF23D8A82F2EF02D_23FCD32: If I must live... I must live.
Dialogue.E9C2D87C4AE8A42150918595016983E3_97A9259: If I say I am, will you stay?
Dialogue.2B9966854DA80736AE0F77A324003D80_14FBFB1: If I show it to you it just becomes a lair.
Dialogue.13493AB949A520E85A49A2855DFBF0AA_14FBFB1: If I survive, I'll let you know.
Dialogue.3D517DF54A0DB69107EA09A3B76709B6_4731F06: If I tell you, do you promise not to screw it up? Because if you do, I stop existing.
Dialogue.C4F6FC5A4817B9CE10D66088BA856313_CC240C1: If I tell you, you won't believe me!
Dialogue.3C34D9C842FA0F9F31CA8A94197F4512_72190CE: If I told you I was gonna stay around and look after you, you would have gone nuts on me.
Dialogue.0FF173F445B9B2D1DCC2F891DF2031E0_B222EAD: If I wasn't already a ghost, I'd be afraid of becoming one.
Dialogue.EE75B3814CDDB116CE265EAAC421928A_06FC410: If I were Vlad... this is the type of rumor I would start about myself.
Dialogue.FD9AAB0A48C03AC14F1D9AA570E5C4E6_72190CE: If I'd known it was gonna be this easy to destroy you people, I would have slept in.
Dialogue.1A84CD27447C75D789F2AFAE574987C8_97A9259: If I'm attacked by a vampire, I hope it's one like him.
Dialogue.3792DEBA4FD9CF67BC60A28E3D560E95_06FC410: If I'm being completly honest, I want to make everything hover.
Dialogue.1F8E5A044980842FD020FDAB86F8E817_B222EAD: If I'm gone, there's no one to scare people away.

Dialogue.8059FC624A654F601916D19992EB36CC_06FC410: Is that the place with all the elemental husks?
Dialogue.335F21BD4BBB06C41AA312865EEFDADA_CC240C1: Is that the thing where you eat junk food and stay in bed?
Dialogue.4CDDDB3E4D94E596800693B68288862F_97A9259: Is that what books sound like? I mean, it's been a while.
Dialogue.0B750F7A4CD7C9D2795DE7A8D15F9A16_181CD3E: Is that what you would like?
Dialogue.CCBE2421444CC7C1D110DEBAA67CD5E0_06FC410: Is that why the wolves were attacking Homebase? You thought we were "The Worst, Actually?"
Dialogue.213D591249C86F3D940E65A0FB29EFDD_97A9259: Is that your fanfic? Ah! Hand to Zeus, Ray, I did not fic snitch! I deleted it!
Dialogue.7C76A3CF46CA3643A09C2392F30BBE73_47CFF90: Is that... crucially important to you?
Dialogue.84D4F2694E758645ED4CA8B18E4F28EB_87F0BBB: Is that... cube thing sending us a message?
Dialogue.2756A706407D03651859E1848204CE9F_FB122F8: Is that... is "dry" a complaint we're getting?
Dialogue.000C2BC14D894082A05F05B621D67878_14FBFB1: Is the silence following a failed wedding proposal.
Dialogue.DFEDCBDA43AE207208508583A872CECA_861A10F: Is there a complex social order based on pack hierarchy?
Dialogue.DA373EF1429D09DED2E0FDBAD2DF581A_06FC410: Is there a spider on me? Get it off! I can feel it crawling on my arm! Ahhh!
Dialogue.3DAA5E8E4CD2F2C30A13738657F1352C_910A467: Is there anything I should know about as I come online?
Dialogue.0B2C2A924EE4546AC6C490AD0166CBEC_06FC410: Is there anything else we should consider before we retire to chambers?
Dialogue.C54706C140F6565215B00FAFBC401146_06FC410: Is there anything we can do?
Dialogue.8488FDC745CF64A0D263FFB3A5E9EF65_06FC410: Is there more to that list, or...?
Dialogue.DAADF5C74C89CC54B8D7379D0B926059_7D2960E: Is this Lars a bird? Or a little fluffy cloud?
Dialogue.FB5696D7462DB5F78DB4FFA1E265E8F8_97A9259: Is this a Reality Hiccups thing?
Dialogue.25B236D94793152862AC108B1797BF7A_3D2D55D: Is this a missile or some sort of rocket?
Dialogue.64C078EB463C35F9A7480183F2325EB3_B222EAD: Is this a reverse psychology thing?
Dialogue.9DB2C3AD43A82CEA30D156A6BDDA3747_06FC410: Is this because of the Major's...
Dialogue.A545453246DC7F1700EDA8A07308444B_FB122F8: Is this because you're bitter your solo album tanked.
Dialogue.66EF973E4FADEE69E6A52F97012649B6_5CE5FC8: Is this for real? You're really considering letting me join Homebase?
Dialogue.2493C819498172FC6943E4990D806F77_97A9259: Is this how it's gonna be, ghost bros?
Dialogue.22A413054E153E7B99C4A18808A82E6C_B222EAD: Is this really how you want to spend your last day?
Dialogue.0E0E02BE44191F05A55566A4901B46E4_47CFF90: Is this something I should be worried about?
Dialogue.BC9914D14DD0ED2C8D5CACB6A5693988_72190CE: Is this the end of Blakebeard?
Dialogue.15BCB42C43372177DEC9EA90737948E0_06FC410: Is this what you sent to everyone?
Dialogue.F23928B5469A2B21BBE703AD4D853184_97A9259: Is this where I get in line for some caffeine?
Dialogue.FBF9DA194CC88BB74BD2259A88955ADD_FB122F8: Is this where we should be spending our focus right now?
Dialogue.FBCF2E954D9B85C090379793D31FA2EA_06FC410: Is to be the one standing on the bridge.
Dialogue.5BF5B54B4FA27C028A0047A87228AB70_181CD3E: Is your back the only reason you're helping me?
Dialogue.D2E87E464D1ED87A305878AC6C0C8B14_EAAE146: Isn't being a pirate supposed to be more about, like, I dunno... a piratey state of mind or something?
Dialogue.7EA9FF5D4B0FB9E839FDD9B8D8925E33_861A10F: Isn't saving humanity your whole deal?
Dialogue.ADCCB7D44BD707937BB5989FBDCEB94C_06FC410: Isn't that great news? Survivors will be filling our shelters in no time!
Dialogue.D16C353A4CAF1AD66833E9AE5508CF25_94F2B66: Isn't the storm the most marvelous thing you've ever seen?
Dialogue.7648B99F40B7C5C671D4F6863CE717D0_21523A0: It IS the most wonderful time of the year.
Dialogue.9E0680AB469B7F95B1A4679225128B58_94F2B66: It appears many members of this base are under the impression that Santa Claus is real.
Dialogue.C5BF51DC48B84CE1F32FCB959A053296_AB3C42C: It appears the situation is well in hand.
Dialogue.2A21CF804105FDC94B57A6B2E049B5AC_FB122F8: It broke from the squall line, and it's been hauling fluffy cloud butt ever since.
Dialogue.DD6994E141C18DFC70647EA8C58FCE34_06FC410: It came to light that earlier translations of the Cavern Glyphs were in fact, a hoax.
Dialogue.98820010483422209F184FBFC7B90F30_CC240C1: It came up to me, and it was probably as tall as a fort! Maybe two forts!
Dialogue.2C43E2F34EF7457D4CD57FB69744818C_06FC410: It could be. If you try.
Dialogue.6B85C0C74CD143576226C984A807C992_06FC410: It could just be contamination! Or... maybe the storm is leaching into the soil...
Dialogue.139375CD466C36D4CE7DD8AE4E7DFA40_47CFF90: It cuts off there. If any more come in, I'll send them your way.
Dialogue.BF7CD9834BFE9B30F191CC8B407E78A9_4731F06: It didn't matter if they lived, just so long as we die.
Dialogue.EB09EBCC4075B25A6A16278B71546B1D_47CFF90: It does capture the feeling of a ship at sea.
Dialogue.9D2DB5D34CC6437997AADB83CFAA9FDA_D87E161: It does not, but it's getting dark and we need to get some fires going.
Dialogue.08E333784B5E1A27CD4835A3743AA66B_06FC410: It doesn't involve trains, right? I'm really not feeling trains right now.
Dialogue.23F1E3AC4E8E8DA222BB2EA151A02AA3_47CFF90: It doesn't look like the mob can swim, so destroying that last boat should deter them.
Dialogue.68202E11408FE37928E0CA8DCA9B3CD6_06FC410: It doesn't look like there's a lot out here for Syd to be surveying.
Dialogue.3EDC5CAD4C97DDE2617BC49A115696D4_06FC410: It doesn't mean it's Dr. Vinderman...
Dialogue.78FCE29C46AC6FE8D5FB41A32D526221_CC240C1: It flew through the air like it didn't even have legs!
Dialogue.F9F116FD42F26AA1200A949FA5379117_9801E98: It goes "The sight of your vision makes me blind, I ride the cyclone of your love"
Dialogue.0FE460DE4A46F7E89F7AF592FB97F755_AFB40E2: It goes against everything I stand for.
Dialogue.3C19513F4C3C05EC6BDD898880B2DD86_47CFF90: It got me, Ray. It got me bad. I'm in love.
Dialogue.3BDDF21E42A33EAFF4EFE5A9DC41B0CD_21C1927: It has become strange, unpredictable, wily, clever, and dangerous.
Dialogue.111252B0440C3C5F05DE7FA0D572C77C_94F2B66: It has come to my attention that I have opened not my V-Mail, but the Global Disaster Simulation. Sorry, soldier.
Dialogue.7BF4A8C54AA902CF829FDF89F588BB57_94F2B66: It has come to my attention that over the last few weeks... I have been insufferable.
Dialogue.A341F2704E1CC4E49E7CD292B358F274_97A9259: It has millions of sauce refactors. Billions of special modifications.
Dialogue.C90F545448942F48CAD50B8FFE6E3E5A_1D2FE88: It is a pity that each statue only works once.
Dialogue.0412AA4D426195C172CC1C8A58A62C2A_FB122F8: It is lowering our threat level, but maybe there's a better way?
Dialogue.466EE71E410C59EA30DB33A75E6C01C6_47CFF90: It is not an N! Stop pulling so hard!
Dialogue.82153A4B46E884C7F5DCE08313E45BB5_06FC410: It is not. The survival of mankind depends on you finding SEE-Bot.
Dialogue.33052EB2406A2DDF25D54680175C7455_94F2B66: It is our duty to keep people safe.
Dialogue.7AD339D04E6E28A862D8D9B9C37E765E_94F2B66: It is pleasing to the eye, and smells like well-worn leather and responsibility.
Dialogue.46F05B2B45EC87ABDB046099393DC540_14FBFB1: It is posted in the shadows.
Dialogue.3E08679848992A7F483D7CA9A7FB4A5A_06FC410: It is so freeing being out here!
Dialogue.FFD63D4140A93E772C829A8050527D0D_D87E161: It is so unattractive that I'll never ever be able to see past it.
Dialogue.FBD30806425A0102C93064BBFEED4653_1FCF39D: It is the time… of construction.
Dialogue.2B82C71C418E2DD4BCF039A48B522F2F_97A9259: It is time for me to put away childish things, and become a man.
Dialogue.5E71BD8641C1D3571ED24B9099B5F7CF_9D00593: It is vibrant, brimming with festive energy.
Dialogue.C5B4AD9747CD3D9736236B96B3A2468F_B229E47: It is written on the wall.
Dialogue.BFBE7EF1438A7C4E1126DABFB8FAB0BF_06FC410: It is you. It's all of you. This is what constant low-grade disappointment and frustration does to a person!
Dialogue.19004F9D4E4352427106FAB35A3B6041_94F2B66: It is your duty as a citizen of Homebase to tell them they will not.
Dialogue.5CA9379C4F1373D6FDBB8D801D17F833_06FC410: It is? Oh, I just retroactively lost a lot of self esteem.
Dialogue.A0CDD3EB4657886BD18031A83BEECBAF_47CFF90: It isn't “cute,” Blake. It is a nautical harbinger of impending doom.
Dialogue.2A52ABF14716525C978D6A84F01B1733_06FC410: It just feels like we all deserved a terrible Christmas.
Dialogue.E88BB391445BA355DFEAD8849E47A6BC_0ADEFA4: It just needs power. Luckily it runs on BluGlo.
Dialogue.3DEBCD8342898984409BD886F9662CC2_06FC410: It just says "sticky" for four more pages.
Dialogue.A8809E644383FA760E50E49A05C28F02_06FC410: It looks like a research balloon,
Dialogue.540E01A14C6A1CDCFB9FB2A6B057EF66_FB122F8: It looks like the husks are going somewhere.
Dialogue.FB5917824F94367236CD3A85566B898E_06FC410: It looks like the trail of scratched trees ends here.
Dialogue.ABCCCDFF467B0E068F71F18FEF1619DF_06FC410: It looks like this lab was working on something called an Atmospheric Laser.
Dialogue.2BB4ADA64949B859C3109A8903B7707E_06FC410: It makes me the most me I can possibly be.
Dialogue.2718A5D54A490FD0A2001AA092C59D11_EAAE146: It makes you sound like you're the lead singer of a twenty-five member freegan music collective.
Dialogue.B82BC42042EB27BD637C8DBCC53B02F0_FB122F8: It may be hard to believe, but these surprise beatdowns are interfering with my research!
Dialogue.9D4612D747F176E3DB7E59BC92D056E9_97A9259: It may be relevant to know there may have been some words exchanged between parties.
Dialogue.C86F7C1A4B72EB51EE3FCAB80DB7ED8E_06FC410: It may have been a bad idea.
Dialogue.C46D4E97424EB106F8DD248EF78F57E3_06FC410: It may have influenced some more than others.
Dialogue.5640EEEB4AABCAF2E010999A96B28F66_FB122F8: It means that any Steel Wool member can vote me out of the band. Permanently.
Dialogue.35A0BCDF47DBB0097E2BADAD57D9432F_FB122F8: It means that the sensors can go wider than ever before!
Dialogue.BBCC4BEE44FB7AB54083AA911565DC6D_FB122F8: It might be a bit soon...
Dialogue.4BE8397A46D6AD47A61844B7BD4810C0_06FC410: It might take a few minutes.
Dialogue.8472505D410EE480D88BB0BF22DC2B2F_47CFF90: It most certainly should not be.
Dialogue.9420059A40FFDC5F96F725998F300FB1_06FC410: It must be exciting following the path of your dad's research.
Dialogue.18FAD976474832BF2C79E2B5AD71D4D1_CC240C1: It must be hard being far away from home.
Dialogue.E9F3C64D4CF24A49EF14CA987A03DF84_06FC410: It must be hard knowing the best thing you can do for your friends leads to you... being alone.
Dialogue.BD8182BB44AFD48C5260F8939ECE9758_B229E47: It must be nice to live in a world of moral absolutes and certainties.
Dialogue.682A320C4E4B29E51B2B92AF39B922D5_7D086D9: It must be nice to live without a conscience.
Dialogue.232F6A7144BB78C309ABECBBEF94A753_861A10F: It needs working brakes, safety belts, and to be faster than a mob of angry villagers.
Dialogue.F969EAF64A030533C2963FBBABC6554C_E090F2A: It opens! THE DOORWAY TO DARKNESS!
Dialogue.26706CB54AB73760993D1EA7AD6EF0CE_84C369E: It reminded me of you. I, heh, I kinda had to.
Dialogue.9D115FB74EE70FF9CA1BC4A4A97FE0BD_97A9259: It reminds me of the feeling I had in class when Mrs. Turnbuckle asked us to write about what we wanted to be when we grew up.
Dialogue.FE938869402E7CBE7A62BBB741861B12_97A9259: It said, "Urgent. Please Read. This Is Important." What else was I gonna do?
Dialogue.B91E81AD48A95CE86737D2B39EC91810_06FC410: It says this was a popular destination for pale, servile, and highly dedicated employees.
Dialogue.D4FE6E744931AAB71CCB5FB23FC4A361_06FC410: It seemed rude to bring it up.
Dialogue.3ED6C3A24564D3CD32D001B0AA57D5E2_910A467: It seems as though like you'd like to finish your movie. Perhaps we should reclaim your gear from the trolls.
Dialogue.9F2DABD944E2805D07EB6A80048281C8_861A10F: It seems like making something to beckon dark forces should sound... I don't know, spookier?
Dialogue.9AEC3A84455F470DB902808ED97232BA_06FC410: It seems like only yesterday we were taking our first baby steps into Stonewood...
Dialogue.A9DA7688473805C6D93C7B9105FC17CB_47CFF90: It seems like the test should be thoughtfully examined by a professional.
Dialogue.B70DA768405614B1680AA18EF3182CBA_FB122F8: It seems to me you've spent your whole life doing whatever you're told.
Dialogue.957D6C7B4CAED30AC946E5A3AD42A1A5_06FC410: It should be safe to gather resources and build defenses during the day.
Dialogue.927728724C2A57E3DE415A9C094EA8BC_97A9259: It should have been done last month! Ugh. We are burning through our budget!
Dialogue.6A57D27B4F52E270B173B4A42A36BDB6_97A9259: It sounds like the Director is not looking out for our safety right now.
Dialogue.2C91CDD843981C7686DB8EA101EB4BF4_06FC410: It sounds like you just need some more processing power!
Dialogue.7118D2E44222F5D12C28B0A1C2E34ECB_06FC410: It sounds simple but it almost always works.
Dialogue.672C97964ADA8646E696E694739CEA31_47CFF90: It spells "Debnis" and you know it!
Dialogue.4328A56045C007AD280084B6F3EB356C_06FC410: It starts out all "death to tyrants!"
Dialogue.ED852699420013587CF427AB8259AD94_FB122F8: It turns out that heavy insulation isn't great for things that fly.
Dialogue.4A6A58754F59C97BA3E5D584F5D5089F_9801E98: It usually means the ground is shifting...
Dialogue.AB354EF944C22673D6CE11920D169357_47CFF90: It walks you through everything you need to know to become a hero.
Dialogue.41A2F25F4766218191CD899DCB18FBF2_06FC410: It was a long time ago.
Dialogue.BDCD7F30478A6B02F8D2BFB5C94C2453_8DEFB9E: It was a pleasure to serve you.
Dialogue.557C8D5442F4F64B9862FAB28A4F1DEB_A2D6E0B: It was a smash and grab!
Dialogue.B02650EF432FA1505BA1C5B10C3E02A5_A2D6E0B: It was a smash and grab!
Dialogue.FCD384744CD3809E634FC58A8EDB22A4_CC240C1: It was a time of tragedy. And great sadness.
Dialogue.7E78B4BA439E176EA2F152A338AEB5EA_B222EAD: It was a triangle-shaped business girlbossurtunity.
Dialogue.A46D07FB4B803D1B0AAF0098731D9D96_724DAF1: It was alright. I- I thought it would be like psychological horror. Like cerebral.
Dialogue.6FB2D7CB457D0DA37984AE8E9EF07A41_7D2960E: It was always, "Do what you're told and we'll take care of you."
Dialogue.66B9FC2E4C6D6032102E958CC8C5BBC0_B222EAD: It was built on a battlefield which was previously a witch burial ground.
Dialogue.8FBCDC7F42069D0F2BB62E8E94ED068E_1D2FE88: It was every adventurer's worst fear... piranhas!
Dialogue.2303C8AA44A118A1AB38738DB0A7FBF1_B222EAD: It was funny, so I did not intervene. (mischievous laugh)
Dialogue.20E11B38429DE3D8205FEDAD9D2CB7D3_9D00593: It was getting too much for me anyway. That's why I recruited a friend.
Dialogue.C868AD524133C2883A2C34BFBE4F29BF_72190CE: It was just an excuse to drag things out.
Dialogue.100196D246FD0D2B22A82F92B1B73377_FB122F8: It was kind of a right away thing.
Dialogue.5B9221994286275DACA568935AD2F2F1_3D2D55D: It was like the storm was targeting those survivors.
Dialogue.9B19F7EF44A959578C07818072CFC641_14FBFB1: It was my phone number. Before. The phone number to reach me, Blaine S-- (hand over mouth)
Dialogue.0406E7F74A74779F2A5A9B919BB03421_B222EAD: It was nice having you here with me, but get your people to leave.
Dialogue.730D4065412FF4F25DE3169970C79F7F_7D086D9: It was nice to know you, Ray.
Dialogue.59D257324E7EC6E80AF8578F197062DD_7D086D9: It was not easy to come by.
Dialogue.C685AF1A4AB06D9EFBB01082E400E096_B222EAD: It was only a matter of time until it fell apart.
Dialogue.92616FB14B636907B670DAB00D11EE4F_1D2FE88: It was over and we knew it.
Dialogue.639C8D704F2BBDB149E882847E4360EF_06FC410: It was priceless and perfect because I am special, but it was also bad because I forgot that my brain esta no guapo away from Homebase. (chuckle)
Dialogue.6D30FD2240010EF10F941B9111F71350_EAAE146: It was quick for him, but I hope it also really hurt.
Dialogue.8542AFB045E26633886405963B3F8882_06FC410: It was really bad advice. I'd forget it.
Dialogue.71EA561747299E68D1E2F192B8881438_861A10F: It was so scary when the storm spoke through me. I don't ever want to lose myself, again.
Dialogue.1F7EF2744E9C17AC5A33B1ABE3CF5E56_97A9259: It was the crunch heard round the world...
Dialogue.EEE952A94AE3806FA446D7B80228E0D6_1D2FE88: It was the dreaded troll trap... and we were its latest victims.
Dialogue.A1BF0B4D4E1B4E1C6E447E908634D9D9_06FC410: It was the presentation deck with like fifty stock photos of white business people mid-jump. That did it.
Dialogue.488B0C1947C00A06335290A37F2CC9FD_7D086D9: It wasn't. It was just Dr. Vinderman showing off. He couldn't help himself.
Dialogue.B6CDBD764D6A4E569DFBC89735E47CBC_97A9259: It will occupy the system for years. If not... forever.
Dialogue.30C823CF498AA648012CCF9D944F6006_06FC410: It will take ten minutes to fully recharge the shelter.
Dialogue.F260101142473B801026D497404CFF9F_37EFC25: It won’t be a good Krampusnacht for you.
Dialogue.BF1DB02E475748D858E0DAA71F7948C0_06FC410: It would appear that the survivor who left that note was onto something.
Dialogue.DF6602954ACE511FBF7C659EB2B8EB5B_47CFF90: It would be a Class 5 HR violation to even hint at the identity of the subject or subjects of my infatuation.
Dialogue.77C9FFC946F0CC16B36604B57C4BDD5E_97A9259: It would be a celebration of the sea. Turbulent. Stormy. Infinite.
Dialogue.CEE9A2044983E4D1060DC1A7DC72B1CF_06FC410: It would be an honor to share my post with you, Cap'n Clark.
Dialogue.58D9C55644FFD7FDB783CB80ADD3770B_910A467: It would be hypocritical of me to encourage Ray but discourage the trolls.
Dialogue.D462D4E54D123107217D7E98F2693737_861A10F: It would be lovely if for once you said, "Penny, I have a compliment for you," or, "Penny, I have some candy."
Dialogue.142A74594D252285F999D18252441102_861A10F: It would be nice to go out for once, instead of staying in and... destroying things... again.
Dialogue.F6D647C34F8CC6637D32368E687A526F_06FC410: It would be real and you would be gone!
Dialogue.A18DA1E74A53ACA6B3BC199880072591_72190CE: It would be such a mistake to let me go.
Dialogue.8C9E0D1548E7D72916EAB5858A507D60_E090F2A: It would be unfair for me to be the only one to enjoy the cold touch of creeping dread!
Dialogue.AF3DF133485DD1920F7F42936AB43811_14FBFB1: It would delight me to eliminate these fuzzballs for you.
Dialogue.8232C3184676B220A367D696D5A63474_861A10F: It would have been nice to have more warning.
Dialogue.97E9853F49A28D7ACC2BFA84B791E1DB_14FBFB1: It'd be fine as long as you don't touch my stuff.
Dialogue.8181ED174D566C98974D59B660AC7677_97A9259: It'd be kinda nice to forget some stuff and start over again.
Dialogue.1EAC0B2A4DBC671468BDA0924A31FE3F_06FC410: It'd be useless and rusty now but there was a lot of it.
Dialogue.845CAD8546416D586136B695370F43EB_FB122F8: It'd just be nice to know the door is locked.
Dialogue.A69DB5D84270E906EA4D5FA893F5DF64_06FC410: It'll be a cool, casual conversation. I- I'll use words.
Dialogue.21A0FE654CE9F29C6C86E384738B2CF0_06FC410: It'll be like a slumber party. A dinosaur-themed slumber party!
Dialogue.24C14787436007C637E4F0AD36F60C27_06FC410: It'll counter the effects from your meteor shrapnel.
Dialogue.13B352F94373F806A53703A11D63A486_94F2B66: It'll do? There's no such thing as "it'll do" in my vocabulary.
Dialogue.A5DBAE89427E189952AEDEBFE88EDE59_7D086D9: It'll let me sleep at night.
Dialogue.E72425D14EC2B73FEF045BA4537CEE9C_97A9259: It'll take some time before the results are ready. So should we, like... bond?
Dialogue.1BCE1AB349AF612C828A789F30EE94FE_14FBFB1: It's Cloaked Star. You know Gia's name and not mine?
Dialogue.F77D813D49DBD56113C23096BE0C1F04_87F0BBB: It's Jess. You don't know me, but I was on my way to rescue you...
Dialogue.9EA615584E2B66AA28E90C8A47F0647B_94F2B66: It's Lok's design, we should honor his intent.
Dialogue.FCD1E30D4A759EBC77000DA6B5042F2E_97A9259: It's Manifesto Week on Vindernet Junior.
Dialogue.30DCFAB046E6F6158D2498B1CB9FE1E8_9F725B6: It's Quinn. One of my favorite parts of the summer is falling in love with a song.
Dialogue.E87FB437469EDD0FF3C950B5B6CFCDBF_B68F328: It's The Nothing. At least that's what I took to calling it when I was... on the other side.
Dialogue.D5D26B164943F77024D7F1B3025C5C61_87F0BBB: It's a book about the history of dinner.
Dialogue.F45462FF4A5371C781AC249DCC631EC6_1D2FE88: It's a classically-inspired fiery hole of nightmares and lava.
Dialogue.5DA7ED0848D96499A29A0083FBD937BD_06FC410: It's a dangerous world out there, Commander.
Dialogue.78AB86B84F9459439C374BB5D1C9DF63_06FC410: It's a fork and a knife.
Dialogue.15B344AD420D4CB702213AB6028EBDA5_EB81C5B: It's a good day to die.
Dialogue.3006BBC24AB2ADD2E3956C9708D99DF0_06FC410: It's a hard habit to break, sorry.
Dialogue.2FC9042C467132DA9807FEABEF03CFFC_94F2B66: It's a lot all at once.
Dialogue.2B03154543748C32B3234D9D419CFEF9_97A9259: It's a lot of pressure for a new relationship. Where do you even start?
Dialogue.72AA2B5246157E4A0592328B743569B2_1B31EE2: It's a lovely day for loot.
Dialogue.35C722B14A15CE3ED556E289CA9F078C_7D086D9: It's a noble plan, but it won't work.
Dialogue.06326CF84E22A7DDF8A964B3538E5414_06FC410: It's a party! Just... be yourself.
Dialogue.56185B91449C34B96448558751AD298B_9D00593: It's a piece of no coal stuck in a stocking of betrayal!
Dialogue.755E69D54B194755F75A6CA953C96C82_FB122F8: It's a place to start at least. Let's grab one more reading for safety.
Dialogue.F3AFA9B4443BD13C4F187AA6FD089F5F_14FBFB1: It's a risk I'll just have to take.
Dialogue.D15657784FB4E846F398FE9CD16ADBA8_14FBFB1: It's a sound that I, Blaine (hand over mouth), know well. (small burp)
Dialogue.C30AA4DA490836E31C31B396E1A0DF2F_FB122F8: It's a state of the art mobile storm analysis lab... and a van.
Dialogue.13FAB77049F1C067739FC381D90D4948_06FC410: It's a tie! That was the plan all along!
Dialogue.5F4E0CD0425673709743CCBB4505E8E9_84C369E: It's a... just- it's just a present.
Dialogue.5C4325FF4215F2FBFF226CBA63646297_14FBFB1: It's all anyone is talking about.
Dialogue.BF32D9224D8F3D07752A47AE3B90B26A_97A9259: It's all, "Where do I put my hands? What do I do with my feet?"
Dialogue.7341FE6B45E0B1AE53EBA1B374B54051_B222EAD: It's almost like the dead don't care about your pirating career.
Dialogue.23A7B04F4224C353314B2580CA083F78_0A979DB: It's alright. Hey, I've been meaning to ask, what's with the "Double Jump?"
Dialogue.B007B07C4C6852DCFAD7BFA6E1150B6E_B222EAD: It's also chemically identical to something called "Doctor Lucius Von Badvilliain's 100% Evil Wet Specimen Embalmer's Slurry."
Dialogue.0AD1C01943F5B4D5346791B384936590_724DAF1: It's also good for people with bad memories. I am in both camps.
Dialogue.872A9E1241F5D034221D51B8C9A38669_77D814F: It's also what happens when you use ammo you find in a bush.
Dialogue.FB9FB0854A20B8F011FF789ABCB2668C_FB122F8: It's always been a special place for me. For all of us in Steel Wool.
Dialogue.EA1C063548E2A3D8DE0D84837233B712_06FC410: It's always the last place you look.
Dialogue.AD3F4697483298D5E8A0BC9EFD560798_87F0BBB: It's amazing the things societies built themselves up around.
Dialogue.CD840A0B410109CBFB33B599C3526384_B222EAD: It's amazing! All of you weirdo meatbags have your own roles to play here.
Dialogue.3AE2610E41CA30DBC627E3B8352ACDA8_21C1927: It's an exercise bike, stuck on the lowest resistance setting...
Dialogue.4AE7F0E54D9C8C883CB10B9097A31038_94F2B66: It's been a while since I've been out there.
Dialogue.9D5D94A1409B812E8AEFBB87D158709C_A96EA86: It's been an honor serving with you.
Dialogue.BEED5FD14476CE2F02C877BAA25F08AC_06FC410: It's been running on a loop since the... accident at the lab.
Dialogue.D58D3C9B49F5C5BEF8712AB316B3E7B0_B222EAD: It's better if you don't know.
Dialogue.413A2F6A48401EDBF76542BB278B1256_37EFC25: It's big, it’s ugly, it’s right over there!
Dialogue.A9F76C56481FD0DD75414EA29ABC7DEF_7F95CEB: It's called a "downbeat," not a "beat down!"
Dialogue.E09FAE8C472A636AD914238DD7171039_94F2B66: It's called humor. Look into it.
Dialogue.9EA76DE142D945D0C9F951B8648B37FA_CC240C1: It's calming and makes me feel powerful and in control.
Dialogue.369470434513B7B0F42FF1BA2F9F9F6D_06FC410: It's coming in for a crash landing!
Dialogue.D72600924BF7001D3E31CBBCCD92F632_06FC410: It's completely possible there's also a two-fort-tall floating... something that says, "Vroo."
Dialogue.D08BE46249E7C1DA8CB1778E176132AC_FB122F8: It's cool, little robot. I get it.
Dialogue.4E18E8CC4BEF585F6B881E986CFC1935_06FC410: It's cool, take your time, we're just waiting for you, ready to go, all systems go, that kind of thing.
Dialogue.6F480A2B406F7E66D352218AC1FFFF01_06FC410: It's cool, we're playing the long game.
Dialogue.180B61BF4F05FBE1BE7AE68DA4A4F4E5_06FC410: It's cool. (yawning) Okay, love you. Love bed more. Love blanket most.
Dialogue.21BA30A243C5CF53E1063A8DFBCEDD3B_97A9259: It's cool. Haven't thought about Christmas at my uncle's place since I was a kid. It's kinda nice.
Dialogue.05488776482DADF56B574A9945B7C9D2_06FC410: It's crammed full of dangerous meteorite shrapnel.
Dialogue.EF3A52EF416C40081152D8B53EFC119F_97A9259: It's critical for flavor and probably emotions.
Dialogue.901C8C8248D4AA0C8E2166A309068469_9D00593: It's critical that we move quickly...
Dialogue.1E8F4821400B047DF1574D876C9A7EEB_5CE5FC8: It's critical the Homebase leadership embraces the new brand.
Dialogue.9DAF389A4DAB8C58C12DF18D1C6FC841_06FC410: It's easy to see how you made it this far.
Dialogue.81351AD24D0F025BEF93908F29A19969_06FC410: It's either that or calling him and please don't make me call him.
Dialogue.4965267F4BFA818A6EE046BFB3D44081_861A10F: It's embarrassing! I was trapped in a room full of puzzles.
Dialogue.8CCEB1F64A728CDA257DFCA828EFD2E1_CC240C1: It's even up there on the sign above the coffee machine! "No making people!"
Dialogue.63B1CD014654E0A22717B791A60E89C5_97A9259: It's fifty percent about how he wants to live in Homebase...
Dialogue.8CA033E44F8000EC6A8CACB53F2D8905_14FBFB1: It's for the Heavy Metal Husks.
Dialogue.5AF786424C553CD604351E8E00D20359_06FC410: It's funny. Even with trying to intentionally make a bad Christmas, I can't help but feel a little...
Dialogue.7D52BBDD4A76B4663C8206AED18706D4_06FC410: It's getting too dangerous out here, Commander.
Dialogue.491240F34B3C72FB06F608AF4F297A41_06FC410: It's going to be a rough launch, so we'll need the perfect launch site.
Dialogue.35755F6C443BDDE17DA2C7BB20DC2CE5_9D00593: It's gonna be a late night. We should get to it.
Dialogue.46236C444D6B0E139F82BEA7FC0C3281_47CFF90: It's gonna be a long night.
Dialogue.8E56BCB548024B3102707C9A35DD7AEC_06FC410: It's gonna be messy. My brain will... still not be great.
Dialogue.ADA10160472B54047A0047B682A8025A_72190CE: It's gonna kill everyone who drinks it.
Dialogue.DD0E55A54AD06EA84B9F7C8878C30319_06FC410: It's gonna look like we've lost.
Dialogue.D835DB9F485F121A0F35E6BEFF825B90_FB122F8: It's good to have you back, brother.
Dialogue.1F953EC1417BFF76A5A4F3959013668F_94F2B66: It's good to see you, Val.
Dialogue.083D249F4196BD190DDD9B84798EA17F_06FC410: It's good to see you, too. Two Two Eight is... SEE-bot. Oh yeah, sorry. He's gone.
Dialogue.A1A6D99945779DB597B7C09CB2AEE0BD_06FC410: It's goodbye for five thousand miles.
Dialogue.226AA6BE4087857ADC56E78CF9D03A72_861A10F: It's got a needle so strong it can attach anything to anything!
Dialogue.D5E3337747667856B7E367AE39100B58_72190CE: It's got a strong base, like me.
Dialogue.1EA4BF6C4FACEA68FEB604B781E23539_97A9259: It's gotta be cheap, Law Bot's basically destroyed our economy.
Dialogue.E0166E37420B7D2550F381BD771E352D_B25AF7B: It's huge! Definitely evil. Crazy teeth.
Dialogue.CE1BCC264A4DBFA2D80A24BDBC0138F0_9D00593: It's insane that someone would stuff ornaments into a box instead of just leaving them up.
Dialogue.4A3E035F485A6CF932B4018CF2F8BF8C_21C1927: It's just I'm sore worried about my maker.
Dialogue.ED79FE764CB3594FC820BC8C8D262270_06FC410: It's just a common alloy that happens to be extremely radioactive.
Dialogue.B8421FC348E18217A0B9F3BEC17FF7C7_FB122F8: It's just a picture of a couple. They look happy.
Dialogue.A33979C34DAF1B8CBA5EE5B2CCA98105_9F725B6: It's just an old song I found. Makes me happy.
Dialogue.16AF8DCD4C2AF55ED65A80A472A79E8F_FB122F8: It's just more As and Ls. La, la.. Th- There's no way this spells anything.
Dialogue.1CED05E14CC4372574F2179194D0197E_06FC410: It's just so flat and affordable and near the beltway.
Dialogue.F2458BE2420D50371845808AAECD56F0_EECA944: It's just that I am so not into you.
Dialogue.4D54E22848126EE35AEF7EAE09B53361_21C1927: It's just that when Cuddly Bear gets the worries, that give me the worries...
Dialogue.AC3D8C424CF684E9F543CFA77B08D34C_D87E161: It's just weird that you're from this year, but you sound so old and lame.
Dialogue.47D62D944197E0CE556B24BC9931639C_94F2B66: It's just what someone wanted, presumably.
Dialogue.965A9DC547DB81A1A546A0B7CC9EA445_7D2960E: It's just... I don't have nothin' else goin' on right now...
Dialogue.E7FB7E7C433B6AF7A81E1FBC5AB526EF_14FBFB1: It's just... I'm there a lot. And I find stuff all the time.
Dialogue.87D701794805139F61B7CB9AF86C842A_06FC410: It's just... it's all so much. All at once.
Dialogue.66C158D240416141F793E98F33090727_06FC410: It's just... the hair should not work. You know? But it does! And he's clearly a big jerk. which I--
Dialogue.F67CC3B947E63DDD6C0C3F8B3507973A_06FC410: It's just... you don't seem to know how to pirate. And you don't talk like pirates.
Dialogue.D9042EB244A31C1FF0A64A9C3D242DC7_97A9259: It's kinda hard to dream big these days.
Dialogue.93CE26B348BDE069DF7CFBA54165759A_47CFF90: It's law school. It's not hard.
Dialogue.53C4C4F0404EAEEE9FB528A9EE12ADBF_06FC410: It's like I knocked over a box of words.
Dialogue.EDE917A540F7D977340B6DBEC24CC120_06FC410: It's like I'm looking at a boat, but unlike every other time I've looked at a boat, I'm not bored.
Dialogue.6926B926481B16741394E39EB1447049_EAAE146: It's like a celebration of the friggin' ocean and you're over here apologizing?
Dialogue.F11C07734C700E602F82B1924C9655F0_97A9259: It's like a dare. You know?
Dialogue.0A19F8824FDD18F22C12D0BC4443D537_1B31EE2: It's like a dream I had!
Dialogue.3381350649843CCA1CD56FA458E3F7F6_97A9259: It's like boundaries make me feel safe or something.
Dialogue.A3BA98A642C48244ECEB409A6C94266C_87F0BBB: It's like herding cats… and then blowing up cats.
Dialogue.45D0D9CE469668C94B3605842688DEC0_89ED452: It's like no one has any self-control whatsoever.
Dialogue.964490D84211D380B58867B3DB4EF84A_06FC410: It's like non-stop disaster. I have too many things going on. You know. Too many balls in the air.
Dialogue.728951D940D32D1C6C558C8F5A8311EF_1D2FE88: It's like the old saying goes...
Dialogue.725A49FE414C8C61D82CEB8CCCC8E603_06FC410: It's like the storm is shaping reality here.
Dialogue.C65933784F60E93876B449AD5BDC4014_C0AFF0C: It's like you really get me.
Dialogue.0E6D87F2410AD0415F1B38B4DC4B4CF1_06FC410: It's like, I've been a backseat passenger on so many journeys of self-discovery...
Dialogue.00CD76264BF28D0BF78592AC861A4A23_D87E161: It's more fun if they're haunted.
Dialogue.46D9B5784EAEE75249D632B525CA1F03_06FC410: It's more important than you think.
Dialogue.0AAD71E64C3DAFEB47AE7DAD7ECE4612_06FC410: It's more like love, respect, space and... yeah, number one is money.
Dialogue.A65D966D4B1FA0A44944CF8480060B9A_FB122F8: It's more of a... lopsided splat.
Dialogue.F92E94C14D677F7FF1E00AB2F50ACBDE_06FC410: It's more of an all-encompassing dread.
Dialogue.312DC6A94B5693AB9F55778B7E161331_97A9259: It's more that classic question of "Do I like her, or do I just like her because our child is prophesied to save the world?"
Dialogue.DA6CE4AB400AB04EEB9D8AA5BF837009_4731F06: It's movie night. We're watching Time Chimp 4 again. Mom hates it.
Dialogue.AC50EE1842795B1EA3BAF58C9EE25250_87F0BBB: It's my turn, so you're watching TV.
Dialogue.661018174B5A7818D10ACD801A3C3E98_77D814F: It's nice to know you're not alone.
Dialogue.C224146E4D30E64049FE1CB570922046_B25EA52: It's nice to see that you care about your team, Commander.
Dialogue.4F3B6C6F4F0B524ECD185E9526B67F8A_EAAE146: It's nice you want to stick around for me...
Dialogue.2E6FF8934F9066FE8CC5EEB05A9CCDA2_06FC410: It's not Steel Wool, but... welcome to our band of survivors.
Dialogue.6DB8DF0143E44C92C26BB3A29162F0C2_E090F2A: It's not a big deal. Just causes some minor coordination issues...
Dialogue.897752A64BB8BA68570C4F936ECCEAB7_7712BEE: It's not a blood ivy, but the graduation to death row conversion rate is above average.
Dialogue.DAA3E46741D08A62BF57EE8D1D56583F_9D00593: It's not a giant bomb. It's a giant Christmas cracker!
Dialogue.B27ECF66452DD4152509C387B40DA2E3_B60EE0E: It's not a job, it's a calling!
Dialogue.D25E0C974B3F157E93A0E89189CFF00C_47CFF90: It's not a prank. Dennis... if you want to join the fight, you're ready.
Dialogue.B25B04FB400E5F57443C128D963C3F43_FB122F8: It's not a real goose, Lok.
Dialogue.8B19EDCD47D120F79511B3809A08443F_89ED452: It's not an exorcism, Dennis. We like Carter.
Dialogue.D0138CD54B3AF991A1006CA560F80DAC_DB7CBEB: It's not been done, I'll give you that.
Dialogue.1E62FB6E42627C6DB860CBB68CEE7404_A96EA86: It's not enough that it's killing me...
Dialogue.86D3BEB44614B5FF090F4DA3234C3169_06FC410: It's not fun if they're already broken.
Dialogue.7B08988340DCFD76654B279727D15C59_06FC410: It's not going to work. Way too much interference.
Dialogue.350FD3174B653152CB8853B797D80C50_89ED452: It's not important. Come on, we have more fires to light.
Dialogue.B4F7D57B41B1706E52C93AB932425DB8_06FC410: It's not just about the playing, it's the personality, the heart, the spirit.
Dialogue.842D2F734BF02E9AF28D0890014C5EFF_06FC410: It's not like anyone is taking a break from saving the world to clean out their car, anyway.
Dialogue.D001AEFB4638806DC46FCEB21D9E85FB_AB3C42C: It's not like the VSS Gallant actually flew through space.
Dialogue.23434ABA4D4A3ED15BD2F5AD8B4D9188_97A9259: It's not like they have another option.
Dialogue.B53F1A0345ADF32A2B7598BA27B17D7D_181CD3E: It's not like you were recalled for being a choking hazard.
Dialogue.67406CB14F629AE4032B59AA25EEF89E_06FC410: It's not matching anything we saw in Stonewood.
Dialogue.1D50310C41EDDC9C1EDF3A89B13BA5E2_FB122F8: It's not perfect, but it'll do.
Dialogue.3952676D46E73C234DF155B7638D962D_06FC410: It's not perfect, but we recreated your mural.
Dialogue.FC8A04FD463CC790BD22299A5304CE10_97A9259: It's not personal. It's just, like... I've never slashed a camp.
Dialogue.BD18004642B07E7D1DBEBAA29288D41E_06FC410: It's not really a team. It's more of a me and the Commander situation.
Dialogue.B762C6BC475944ABF3E8028DBD5135C2_B222EAD: It's not that I don't want to spend time with them...
Dialogue.0A9A9EC04E13B5F4D16C9B8BF2D61CB2_97A9259: It's not that. Homebase hates the show.
Dialogue.61909A8B404BD977DBA751A1007CD858_0A979DB: It's not that. It's... so full and... I feel this strange longing. It's like... something I could only explain in a song!
Dialogue.6E5B1EA24A791C55098F1A9866667962_AB3C42C: It's not the best set I've ever seen...
Dialogue.21B28DBE49F03A7C008718A6739C2564_77D814F: It's not the hand, it's the prosthetic.
Dialogue.53EC8D284603FA82FB77B3B2F36D842A_94F2B66: It's not the most functional, but Lok made it for me and he was very proud.
Dialogue.9C2AB37445D8B06061A1E8B98611B5A2_97A9259: It's not the show. It's what it represents.
Dialogue.16F189A5439D32E72B4E959A284125DC_C2C5A2E: It's not there to be believed. It's there to stop people from asking questions.
Dialogue.D2C1379C4333E3C4173365A9AA14E0C6_06FC410: It's off! What now, Your Highness?!
Dialogue.A182DAB74118EBBFF67CD1916D71D8B2_4731F06: It's okay. You figure it out eventually.
Dialogue.804BF1DB4450BB77567F38BE0A86BFB2_D87E161: It's one of the big secrets of adulthood, Ray... None of us have any idea what we're doing.
Dialogue.7A30A4E04F9CE3878D2B6EA2658ADA17_06FC410: It's one of the song books Syd needs!

Dialogue.B84BD4394061B58980B437A3CEDEA7FA_861A10F: It's over. Too many husks escaped the maze.

Dialogue.5ED21FDB4CE5CAC9A0E6B3A738B865E2_06FC410: It's pineapple juice and fizzy water.
Dialogue.31AE69E74F9CEC520305A39E41081D96_47CFF90: It's possible we've been underestimating his abilities.
Dialogue.DC9CA43E4F5A047F967F96B4BD1CC3A1_910A467: It's radiating life and love... and that's not very fair to the husks, now is it?
Dialogue.BBD7E42C4E9A127BCFADDC8BE23F6975_06FC410: It's really not as spooky as the legends and the guidebook make it seem.
Dialogue.35FFBA6244FAD79229981DB8FFEDC09E_06FC410: It's really, really... awesome.  And cool.
Dialogue.CAC5C7B44A0EC7F2993C848A8DAEED5D_97A9259: It's riddled with riddles and contradictions "Hold the extra sauce" "Unsalt the fries" "triple flip the patties."
Dialogue.46B536684153266D90AFDD82AB122EC9_97A9259: It's rife with beefy inaccuracies, but it's the second best meat-based love story ever filmed.
Dialogue.B94E815F4B805B46063C768947B72413_06FC410: It's says here it was built upon the bones of the vanquished...
Dialogue.80333CD340BF34290DAF779DBD83DCDE_47CFF90: It's scarier than that. He's, uh... I'm...
Dialogue.A99365F24A7B4162E78270911468287D_06FC410: It's signed See you soon. Vlad.
Dialogue.BAE72566482EA345C1A14084DFA35A2E_06FC410: It's slightly better than nothin', I guess.
Dialogue.9FD8BF6A4A36DB642553B2B232325050_06FC410: It's so beautiful I'm not sure if we should take off our shoes.
Dialogue.5FB02B914A25AA096A895EA8ADAA48F8_765440C: It's so hard to find a lair with a pre-installed deluxe lava waterfall.  Unless...
Dialogue.41610F334C85EC0722FA5DAA0F2C532F_C2C5A2E: It's so pathetic what you'll do to make peace.
Dialogue.77258F4A433A0192BE5372977417FD69_CC5E92B: It's so unfair for me to go while the monsters live on...
Dialogue.00F687724E8AC364FB86E2AD74147EC1_9D00593: It's so... long. And so lonely.
Dialogue.E7C20DF04569D07BE2FBE5922306DB70_06FC410: It's sold out, so I'm going to need your help.
Dialogue.9137F838484F1CB2D5112495290DB379_B222EAD: It's still going to be the worst dream you've ever had.
Dialogue.3766E31C4A8A5365105486A22936C424_06FC410: It's still too crowded for the med team, keep at it.
