Dialogue.6CC18A524D7A8E2DD3CF7AB29C6614CE_06FC410: It's ten kinds of deadly, and one kind of "very unstable."
Dialogue.EE279277446AFCE6A6F97DB2EB4279CE_B229E47: It's terrible timing, but I should mention that I won't be around much longer.
Dialogue.7E3A81D04CD83C61AD1C7BB174F942B7_181CD3E: It's terrible. You can say it.
Dialogue.F2A2692A42CBBF12E3CF78854563FDBC_06FC410: It's that time of year again...

Dialogue.3BD79BCB4A657BB9AC1A80864CD272DE_F130B8E: It's the bottom of the ninth!

Dialogue.FC844C41446C8256E35B8A8C8515A7C9_87F0BBB: Listen, Lok. Is it... possible there wasn't a monster?
Dialogue.CAC1B213463902F6B0357AAB9CE3A3A0_861A10F: Listen, Rarrnold. I know things between us have been a little weird since we broke up.
Dialogue.D315547146899ACC9CF4F0B38AAC27EE_FB122F8: Listen, Ray. I know things haven't exactly turned out the way you wanted.
Dialogue.E8ADB3764DAB4D8C828B67BF90D6CB91_72190CE: Listen, let's just both say we won and hopefully nobody asks for details.
Dialogue.2F11BECD4D63C8A4C553EF9F033B234F_89ED452: Listen. I want to help, and weapons is what I can do.
Dialogue.A6EB0A07418AD75DD8CD668B8BA136DD_97A9259: Literally. My grill is a busted piano.
Dialogue.7AEB00904F8C2199E9535C8E7F2BCA17_FB122F8: Little Robot, why am I getting fan mail?
Dialogue.1A4E0D0046C3A3BF8E5B7390679145B1_FB122F8: Little Robot... I think I died.
Dialogue.E7EE696046DAA388F00891BE0F00FC7C_9D00593: Little did I know... Raptors paid way better.
Dialogue.4274194A47F2BF6BB81AF18CDA35C87D_06FC410: Little is known as to why Ayers, formerly a mild mannered horse whisperer, traded in horse talkin' for gun slingin'.
Dialogue.B7C65D4641E0B40F6BAE6DBDA89FEF2C_06FC410: Live from Thunder Valley! Great find!
Dialogue.2AE4D0814572298C96689BA4F544561B_B222EAD: Live through tomorrow and I'll give it some thought.
Dialogue.6FF9C70A4F94BCED083E9BADB4EF1D6E_5CE5FC8: Living among rubes will not reflect well on me or my duplicitous arts, so I propose the following.
Dialogue.D46747BB422CFF289B9AB68777BEF444_F2F813A: Llamabeard the Danglin' Pirate, at your service.
Dialogue.5F6682CE4B121CCAADCEDD8D03D41590_F130B8E: Llamas are the camels of the sky.
Dialogue.65E6840A4683CEF91F7C71B19EA9790E_FB122F8: Lock the door, tear it up, walk away. We're no more... no more. No. More.

Dialogue.E7182DB24E6A3B4F1743899CEBCE273C_97A9259: Lok isn’t just afraid of that monster, he’s afraid of the unknown!
Dialogue.DE79536E45F57B44DE7C8884B2BC5B5C_97A9259: Lok makes a snickerdoodle cookie that is to die for.
Dialogue.AAD3A30B48EC0A1790B6A69B92411BC3_47CFF90: Lok takes the final law school exam tomorrow. Did you even know that?
Dialogue.422AE3BB41811F560723ACA0572A7710_9D00593: Lok taught me a valuable lesson about giving...
Dialogue.E4DA46664264AE8250CF08B63D9D8EE5_94F2B66: Lok was found unresponsive, possibly facedown - but it is hard to tell - in a puddle.

Dialogue.770270BA446F7DB70C8D6EAA5F892E5C_06FC410: Lok's so full of water it's amazing he hasn't completely shorted out.
Dialogue.F35FD067450B571261CFE98AEA09AEA5_06FC410: Lok, are you currently possessed by the Storm King?
Dialogue.F35BA5DA4ED4018EDDAC2E934A1EF5AA_06FC410: Lok, buddy, can I give you a little shake?
Dialogue.39C795BE434F24D2724D058782CD341D_97A9259: Lok, buddy, want to watch me feed this teddy bear to this dinosaur?
Dialogue.3AA57955427565526A685596236ED8BA_06FC410: Lok, buddy. I can't help you unless you tell me what's wrong.
Dialogue.E32BA83F4D29CC7B81C1DAB8B28E78C2_06FC410: Lok, buddy. I'm sorry, but this is not something you can help me with. I need legal representation.
Dialogue.BAFBDE8845B6B42D69F20CB4DA5D6DE7_06FC410: Lok, how bad is the bedrock situation in Canny Valley?
Dialogue.AF031B344B36E8E494E139A450DE67B0_87F0BBB: Lok, is this what you saw?
Dialogue.791C69874E59ED487EFC15869837B484_A96EA86: Lok, my man. What are you doing right now?
Dialogue.78904A024C0DD5130B2F3AA352492443_97A9259: Lok, say goodbye to visions of horror and endless nightmares...
Dialogue.CF00DA8547A0A1E17A6A6F9014951644_06FC410: Lok, there's no such thing as monsters.

Dialogue.1564FF2E4354A8CAA09261B258C8FE63_47CFF90: Lok, why are you dragging me to the bathroom?
Dialogue.C0B67FBF4AF5ACF96ADEAA8044196DBF_B222EAD: Lok, you're the first person I've spoken to, not just haunted, in two years. Of course I like you.
Dialogue.91E8EB5443F71C88E06B458A328F2C25_06FC410: Lok. Again. We do not have cars.
Dialogue.934441C74DBF4E81C0DCCA800A41E311_94F2B66: Lok. Operation "Kind To Be Cruel" is a go.
Dialogue.CD54929E4EC3DBA85E13658C3D407623_06FC410: Lok... I'm so sorry we let you down.
Dialogue.322CF1334704F47CD86385A70FA541F0_06FC410: Lok? Buddy? I had a talk with Dennis...
Dialogue.B1969EBD462F3F35A35B56B2FE3BE107_06FC410: Lok? Buddy? I have some bad news.
Dialogue.CC5A2870466CEDFE5B6454BE3924D3EF_97A9259: Lok’s present is almost complete. I just need a few more key components.
Dialogue.0046E9C148821EA2AF3F1E9AF2CD7B5E_FB122F8: Long as that thing's running, you should be able to explore the surrounding area.
Dialogue.CD791D2B4FBC643D4A58E9A7BD381212_97A9259: Long may his fruiting body rain spores upon the earth.
Dialogue.A73C6756407DED8386CC6C88F3F211D7_97A9259: Long story short, there was a meteor and now there are birds.
Dialogue.95712902463AC0CD14BF41B4E03A74CE_1D2FE88: Long torture session short, the boss ain't happy.
Dialogue.B245BC534FDE2263C281F09A3C52780D_06FC410: Look - sometimes I just get real honest when I'm on the radio.
Dialogue.A4086CAE4902FD1D9FECE0B4364D7ECE_94F2B66: Look alive, risotto! We're gonna find that monster of yours!
Dialogue.E9D1A43746D1EA6C59F9B0913E06B887_1D2FE88: Look around! All that's missing is the narration.
Dialogue.EEE6346E4EB9AD8C9210FD9AB7CB4978_06FC410: Look around, man. If you feel terrible, that's just life's way of telling you that life is happening.
Dialogue.4F4A043948DA3BCE43DB169D81CBBCFA_84C369E: Look at all of those people, just waiting for us to bring them home...
Dialogue.53E4CCE740826ABE53E69981400D9FBA_37EFC25: Look at all the ammo in neat little rows.
Dialogue.E7D004D848A4334D640E06AA1293F624_AB3C42C: Look at all you've done! Sure, you spent the entire budget and built a completely functional prop rocket...
Dialogue.49210CD644F695F3A79E9BA992DF6171_72190CE: Look at me in the eyes. Do I look like a man who honors contracts?
Dialogue.05288CA0419B61C7B3A945B83E4CF4DA_9D00593: Look at me! Why in the world did you think I needed clarity?!
Dialogue.01D573A842C222A34B171A92CFDB78C7_21C1927: Look at me. Who wants to tea party with a murder doll?
Dialogue.07E750AE4696F66152C9B39D2892E057_071921D: Look at that one, just floatin' along!
Dialogue.089E0D7C41A83ADD2B7B03A649E17CFC_FB122F8: Look at that. I knew we'd make a good team.
Dialogue.E86259C2451E1D285874BA9EFA3DDA49_DA0538A: Look at the arm on that one!
Dialogue.E9B6219F4E5EB2D259C58A980AB30109_FB122F8: Look at the author of this file.
Dialogue.ED6986054234BE25EF29549BFD057C2B_7D086D9: Look at the land from the perspective of a billionaire.
Dialogue.ACB31D3C4123257060CA659A873E4CC2_724DAF1: Look at the staff photos. How much corduroy do you see?
Dialogue.DB1FDAF445E1722E25D83E8F90183FD4_9801E98: Look at this! There's a glyph.
Dialogue.2A65EA2545F4C00196C4928F38EF020B_FB122F8: Look at this, you're a natural.
Dialogue.E0A3EB9A4CC13D1E9EAE6EB8EC11B857_EAAE146: Look at ye shiver, ye jellyfish.
Dialogue.8D43BC9C4704F117769BB28A7347435E_06FC410: Look at you getting involved in the community!
Dialogue.74FAE98347396615550E608AD1B5BC73_06FC410: Look at you, master bed finder!
Dialogue.F452BA9348E05FF7E4603BB3AD08CFDE_87F0BBB: Look closer. Someone wrote "Cheater" all over it!
Dialogue.CAC16CE742B0EAAA04F461B29D9CC9BE_06FC410: Look for any lenses or telescope parts.
Dialogue.7C0F3B874F1697BE79118982A708383A_06FC410: Look for any radios you can find.
Dialogue.4C33DC044D7D1F4F4B34EFA2BECE247D_06FC410: Look for anything you can agree on. Anything at all.
Dialogue.FF01ED59483C1B7687C5E4A2D194FB84_06FC410: Look for more beds to add to the mega bed!
Dialogue.823C88874052FF96A391DEA6C771E3C0_06FC410: Look for more. He will be the king of cans!
Dialogue.6D4F8FE74AE46B65E82ED8A711E08493_06FC410: Look for some more troll holes.
Dialogue.AE72E240424618517225D2B9416EF126_06FC410: Look for weak spot indicators next time you're harvesting.
Dialogue.D5FF2FAA4554B355B696479B954C8F08_37EFC25: Look out! Some of those flying ones!
Dialogue.E6614A2B4EE7E11451EE5193503EEC64_94F2B66: Look out! Those creeps spawn more monsters when you destroy ‘em! Nah, I don’t understand the science either.

Dialogue.951325A64F0879EC6FF5ED882CF0D225_06FC410: Look out, Hover Tub under attack!
Dialogue.7D0D17FE4299EB5DF94B598C42504260_06FC410: Look sharp, Commander. Vlad is a known lunatic, suspected vampire, and history's eighth greatest monster!
Dialogue.D20966F94A96E938CC03309E83E0CF46_A96EA86: Look sharp, we don't know what we're gonna find.
Dialogue.1252591C418646B6CBD2BDAAA928B979_E090F2A: Look to the skies and tremble!
Dialogue.95F0449B47E329744E98FC854F7DEA61_910A467: Look! Over there! It's something else!
Dialogue.0C3300F9461EEE685D251E9DB1249460_06FC410: Look, I get what you're trying to do.
Dialogue.76BF9B614FD69CF17C005F8D54BFFCF1_FB122F8: Look, I have no idea what Sarah sees in you and your...skills...
Dialogue.226A7A6C40DD6CFB99CCC59F5A9902B8_06FC410: Look, I know I've asked this nine times, but are you super duper sure you want to stay with... this design?
Dialogue.CCA7A44745D7DDC368765F9C00258E96_06FC410: Look, I know dying in the woods for the greater good is the ultimate dude fantasy...
Dialogue.036738C24A7894951995DAAB32DCE5A2_FB122F8: Look, I screwed up. But I'm working to fix it.
Dialogue.613AD5A047E1CE6768CDD2AA6179B49D_06FC410: Look, I'm not stopping until we find your friend, and I don't care if that makes you mad.
Dialogue.EA3C9E6B4A502773BED33F9C7ADC74D0_EAAE146: Look, I'm not supposed to tell you this, but... prepare to be raided.
Dialogue.9815FD8943700C54A08CFAAE097B1F04_87F0BBB: Look, Lars! Someone was done so dirty they tore up all their memories!
Dialogue.35336E9E42399858CA803DAA18C1345A_CC240C1: Look, Penny! The next item from your list.
Dialogue.9D6983E94BCF87207FB59891E8B0DED0_FB122F8: Look, Steel Wool had our time in the spotlight. We faded. It's over. Can we just leave it alone?
Dialogue.9AE249A14DE53591C5894D840D048362_910A467: Look, a smasher! Maybe it’s friendly.
Dialogue.038A1D48451EC04B0419818C94819D69_7D2960E: Look, dude. I'm not one for games.
Dialogue.20B79A9949FF38F2992E8CA56207B21C_7D2960E: Look, dude. That's two "really"s more than I want to hear from my maker.
Dialogue.ADB8A0B94A898E9E256A6D8ED619CC20_FB122F8: Look, if you don't know how... we'll help you.
Dialogue.5883272C4A2C5B3B92B4B1BAFE32497D_9801E98: Look, man. You can always get time off for good behavior.
Dialogue.4108BDD8493E0A91370B5786FEEBA000_97A9259: Look, they may be zombies now, but at one time... they were PEOPLE.
Dialogue.95CB6E1A45E9CCF42DECC9B9DE6877C3_06FC410: Look, this one has clouds in it.
Dialogue.266A1ACD426F6F28F8616B96EE796AF6_D87E161: Look, we're a group of heroes.
Dialogue.C5FD11C9452EF68164DAFD9C50DDEC2E_7D086D9: Look. I don't expect you to understand... but after I left he programmed you to replace me.
Dialogue.45969EDE47941C8808FD22B77F821271_97A9259: Look. I don't know a lot of things, but I do know food.
Dialogue.2452161B4D674DBF745E3884FD9E5C7B_06FC410: Look. I know everyone is on edge, but can we please approach this animal situation with restraint?
Dialogue.7D9C799145AD8719EDC0E5817CE835F6_1B31EE2: Look. I'm a llama. Not a dragon.
Dialogue.DA41D54246683282C52B0CA44AADAC37_06FC410: Look. Lars is coming for you now -
Dialogue.36BA95AA498F670BAA9A7C9D8DDA768D_FB122F8: Look. Ray clearly saw something in him... and I think I did, too.
Dialogue.BFF4F1884DFA07E6E655EAA6511E3E83_06FC410: Look. We had this really high-minded approach to the end of the world.
Dialogue.FE1E7A344DB3B19457D1AFAD70452B54_06FC410: Look... don't tell anyone else about this...
Dialogue.7873546E4E3E5F67F737D0BB15BBF096_06FC410: Looking at the horde headed our way, we should probably work on our aim.
Dialogue.0E01975E4787D0956E007DBB5801CB6A_FB122F8: Looking at the night sky really makes you realize how small and insignificant you are.
Dialogue.10796DE8455C7FFC65EB8A9F40CA9982_06FC410: Looking your way for some good news, Balloon Two.
Dialogue.D6FF539445ACD8DC83D853868FF737F4_CC240C1: Lookout for a new supply drop!
Dialogue.0E5C290341B7713D9BAFE8A28BA1630B_06FC410: Looks like a drone to me...
Dialogue.87628F254B84A6A7DDD498919A88B096_06FC410: Looks like a pile of presents.
Dialogue.1D8FD29E4728B9A6A433709F4CCCE6E8_06FC410: Looks like he recognized it's you...
Dialogue.B6391EA3437D84144C97588AB394F746_7D086D9: Looks like it, but it doesn't quite make sense.
Dialogue.46EFBD2148DBB53DA95417AB9DA9FE01_1D2FE88: Looks like somebody's got some unfinished business.
Dialogue.DEC7F9064231B78CB99A06BFB2E8CB2B_1D2FE88: Looks like someone's ready for the dungeon.
Dialogue.48CD0ADE4035FEF9064FEE93B8DEE078_06FC410: Looks like the husk's plans have changed.
Dialogue.6CF62D08474E452B6EB9F0871ADDB7D1_06FC410: Looks like the life support modules have all been stolen.
Dialogue.F48268DD4A15C4265833B18FCBDCD0C8_06FC410: Looks like the sentry bot has somewhere to be. Must be nice.
Dialogue.7F631AB640D3263A00F5B2A1D5484F66_FB122F8: Looks like there's a full on Category 5 Love Storm brewing down there!
Dialogue.3C9226B34291811AE003B6B78288C174_06FC410: Looks like they have backed off for now.
Dialogue.8C1366BF41300161AA7892930717BD5B_A96EA86: Looks like they're rolling out the 2018 husk lineup.
Dialogue.7ABE018B416830B3B1D5BAB4156045A4_06FC410: Looks like they've all been looted now.
Dialogue.7EC3B01E4D4C19D7F7FBBA84BA8DFEB4_06FC410: Looks like we could use some traps.
Dialogue.9411D3BB4E7F0A6CDEA8B693A90CC095_06FC410: Looks like we're getting' back in the grave robbin' game!
Dialogue.E072C4AD4AF62ADF1EC790B6B8B5CC12_FB122F8: Looks like we're gonna have a fight on our hands while she cools down.
Dialogue.7F386DF249198BED89563B9B94F54D88_06FC410: Looks like we're in, uh, uncharted territory here.
Dialogue.B0F70D13424514DC82E9E58A46E52BB9_06FC410: Looks like we're ready to defend. If your walls take damage during the fight, you can repair them as long as you have enough of the matching material.
Dialogue.46B040D9497B8F1381FE928A689AEE8D_06FC410: Looks like you made them mad, this next raid is going to be tougher.
Dialogue.AD2789CF4F568B207996C38C7C07DD66_7D2960E: Looks like you're free to go.
Dialogue.A042E1624E2ED13D4D7206A9553DA873_06FC410: Looks like you're going to need a superhero name.
Dialogue.4CB7D7CF4C1CC3095394BDB0FABDF963_DA0538A: Looks like “Santa’s sleigh”-d another one. Heh heh heh.
Dialogue.F7DD7FF447915A3AF25C4CA6A8D7C2E3_DA0538A: Looks like “Santa’s sleigh”-d another one. Ho ho ho ho.
Dialogue.7E7B7E154349F32C94DF3F843F6ECBC9_C0E27E7: Loot Llama, ready for a beat down.
Dialogue.599FFBE9408D1B4F57EAE0A37E6584EF_DB7CBEB: Losing blood. But I still look good.
Dialogue.9EC6A93A446AC577BF08D6B4BC4E0F44_06FC410: Losing control like that... I need to know what I'm doing.
Dialogue.9249B8464B8A299A22AB4996507ACE6A_06FC410: Lost a camera! Our big studio picture is now an indie!
Dialogue.32D6E03C40895270F01172BF66DAD799_CC240C1: Lost in the strange ether that separates the living from the dead.
Dialogue.654217A7431FFF04DF1672B642C2620C_1D2FE88: Lost? Look for the purple flames that burn in unexplored areas.
Dialogue.81C86CE0486A375EF97A6DAACC26713C_1D2FE88: Lost? Look for the purple flames that burn in unexplored areas.
Dialogue.627024D8494728D86CA49D9E3E4810F7_47CFF90: Lots of it. And tell no one.
Dialogue.564821FC470283391B8D92A7A7EED7EB_06FC410: Love has made a mess of our lives!
Dialogue.F8541FEE4BC4AAF0AAF3AE840C540294_97A9259: Love has ravages? Why wasn't I warned!?
Dialogue.36588C7945A49E497982B3B9C2CB1366_0A979DB: Love is an illusion crafted by the media...
Dialogue.C3A5FDFF49C3366DF8016888373DB687_14FBFB1: Love made me the man I am today.
Dialogue.01A6A3B949E9FB90D9AA0CB6C2C9DC42_06FC410: Love makes fools of us all.
Dialogue.AAE5DABA459D36855E83879A44D277BA_06FC410: Love the content. We'll work on the execution.
Dialogue.2C535A6F49C27E6FCC0FC288B289575A_94F2B66: Love the smell of fresh Time Cheat.
Dialogue.3D435D7C4D57038C2A610EBC2E6E37F3_94F2B66: Love will not conquer all! Not on my watch!
Dialogue.FBB0ABE741E910AD7BD5FE888F7CE316_C2C5A2E: Love you, but I'm not doing call and response.
Dialogue.D043A203488FE2B98349D2A9CE246888_94F2B66: Love's a lie and we die alone.
Dialogue.86776F04471C529513E4C7B251288720_97A9259: Love's vision is based on movement.
Dialogue.50124FC1442F3ED6C21F28B9B61B77CB_06FC410: Love... is dangerous. And it really sucks.
Dialogue.3E15480A49B0E706E0BD638579EB93BC_1D2FE88: Lovely to see you. So glad you could join us today.
Dialogue.39BA3860440D29C4B0662FB417977B02_06FC410: Low walls are great for slowing down the enemy, and they don't get in the way of your bullets.
Dialogue.26DDB85A446C74B662571E9A0B914203_06FC410: Luckily all the beds so far have been the same size.

Dialogue.3B1182A94782953B4CF8579E745E9B07_06FC410: Lucky we were able to get all that equipment back, ED-EE.

Dialogue.BA6E5B274FBE7F03F6F25981D2E1959A_EC1949E: Luna's here and ready to fight.
Dialogue.B737701446F2E4CAC6A05C9855165907_8DEFB9E: Lunch is here. Everyone is walking away from the table. I will put lunch on the table. There is lunch. Lunch is sandwiches.
Dialogue.DD846D4148AFB288B4222491B87853F8_B222EAD: MAYBE YOU SHOULD TAKE THE HINT.
Dialogue.2421F08A411443ED78CFF0966255D9E7_06FC410: MISTER UNTETHERED. Humanity is a mess, so we come asking for your help.
Dialogue.5C12CF2D43630F0898DFDB92988F813A_21C1927: Madcap, everyone. He really misses being king, from the top of his cap to the bottom of his fruitin' body.
Dialogue.3204F68343EF46E90ADDEB8E25EB5ACB_47CFF90: Madcap, my team is at your disposal.
Dialogue.F45301FF4CC1CEFF8930C4A202129E00_06FC410: Mailbag! Huh? I'm going through the Homebase mailbag, see? I'm not hiding from my responsibilities.
Dialogue.52A8353D4867C513450A0CA07A29EC0F_47CFF90: Major Oswald in particular may be able to understand your experiences.
Dialogue.EF42A134405AB719D24C3CB2ADD457D3_97A9259: Major Oswald is only training you out of pity. He doesn't believe in you at all.
Dialogue.66FF552D459C8635E2D691A7193F0C92_CC240C1: Major Oswald wanted me to come tell you everything I like about you.
Dialogue.17C11BD940D335A5D6606F9BFEACB167_77D814F: Major Oswald! Come see me at Homebase!
Dialogue.D79AEB1F4272800C2E226BA30E955C91_87F0BBB: Major, their society was more into farming, storytelling... that sort of thing.
Dialogue.4167841C46A6498C080B89AA61585B69_97A9259: Make a choice, or I will choose for you as I chose for the festive wooden imbecile.
Dialogue.894B819E4C82308CF08BB1A320CB1D73_FB122F8: Make a plan, then take another crack at it.
Dialogue.933562164B0A82295597158A179F2913_9D00593: Make it both happen, Lars. Both at once.
Dialogue.8A0559CC487C281FE38C50BE0C928574_9D00593: Make it strong, even without frosting and gumdrops.

Dialogue.43D234CD43F38BA9EDB97B80E52F197D_97A9259: My buddy, Ray, thinks you're gonna be great and that's enough for me.
Dialogue.06C2B8E44F210C4421488391350B3208_D87E161: My chapter is ending, but yours is just beginning.

Dialogue.7C32B4E745124153183F988F03AC38D7_94F2B66: My god, do I love a good paper trail.

Dialogue.CB218CFC4E724C54DF09BDB0D7C280C0_06FC410: My heart is heavy with anguish to think that I may not, in fact, reach our home.

Dialogue.65436DE049CDE50DD62598AF161B6974_14FBFB1: My memories are all I have left. I refuse to let anyone else into my heart.

Dialogue.2F3BAA354EBDBEA75E0315AF85284815_1D2FE88: My monsters have assured me they will not fail, and I believe them.
Dialogue.99F85B404C96C11EFB4B6A8E24D28CEC_E090F2A: My mortal coil is shuffling off as we speak!
Dialogue.92609BC24AFF841F5507A3BE8D6247B3_724DAF1: My name is Anthony, but you probably know me as Lil' Anthony Dynamite.
Dialogue.0A082752454A677145F54BBF78B02A6A_14FBFB1: My name is The Cloaked Star.
Dialogue.A997AAEA4336950FCA5414BF096DBFBF_14FBFB1: My name is The Cloaked Star.
Dialogue.9560CA414A37CA65CC8F12A8AC636C9A_77D814F: My name is Val, and I was there when my friend needed me...
Dialogue.68DA36664D487983F9550788EF21C113_1D2FE88: My name's (unintelligible howl) and I'll be your dungeon today.

Dialogue.790A0A1448AE7D79C1D0E694511565E0_97A9259: My parents knew, but they took the risk anyway!

Dialogue.36BF6E7E467EFF04AE891D95BACDB41F_FB122F8: No. But I'm getting there! I'll do it in my own time.
Dialogue.BE6C755C4162BFF7F217D183BE1F9B35_5CE5FC8: No. But again, love the confidence.
Dialogue.F1F02A4D42AB9263C13255B6DB83A827_B229E47: No. But he programmed me to say that so... puzzle that out.
Dialogue.891354F7410D2E08CD5749987C0F1744_06FC410: No. Dennis! Stay where you are!
Dialogue.01360E5F422F392191A468804931976B_06FC410: No. Dude. Stay in the tower! It's nice up in the tower!
Dialogue.D1175D04466CC6F6D5560780B868884A_B222EAD: No. Everyone puts their hands on the planchette.
Dialogue.91AFA36E42F53206C18157893F651609_CC240C1: No. Everyone would know it was you, and that wouldn't be a secret ghost.
Dialogue.D352287F44D4C9A74DA424802C73E170_14FBFB1: No. I AM a secret. And I offer myself to the curse.
Dialogue.AA90878A43F859CCB757E5B4C89E4516_7D2960E: No. I forgot she's not around anymore thanks to my...
Dialogue.91383995491B971C3ED2C6AD8C424BD7_EECA944: No. I just like food that's not terrible.
Dialogue.780DB68A403EB771A51EB4B15ECF92C6_B222EAD: No. I just went out with that guy once and he wouldn't stop name dropping.
Dialogue.4C4EF85B4BD44D9D9C35B59D53A0C6F5_97A9259: No. I know you! If you made a rule, it's for a very good reason.
Dialogue.70879647487FE38B11D5AAAF87A0FFB2_FB122F8: No. I think she's pretty angry.
Dialogue.87604A8B45C9DD8E09E0408E6C6F6490_06FC410: No. I use positivity because without it, I'd never be able to force myself out of bed to face the horrors of our world.
Dialogue.99397F994BA52F37B0D2959FA294154F_7D2960E: No. I was not aware of this.
Dialogue.610E588A401BF5A9B418BEA7EFFA9E56_06FC410: No. I will not let this wordy shirt make me cry. (sniffs) Pull it together, Ray.
Dialogue.6AFCD5B94E6C7B7BD0F65DB5C1D609E8_97A9259: No. I'm dressed for grilling. And that's why I smell like crispy french fries and perfectly sizzled beef.
Dialogue.84319F014D3C001FE58C95AEF1618ADB_06FC410: No. I'm not falling for Crackshot's emergency second Christmas grift again.
Dialogue.A084F76E49ED8D0A7E45A3BDA2DC3141_7D086D9: No. I'm not happy to hear that you're readying a stagecoach fleet.
Dialogue.F292E4104EFCC6820807AD86C27196A3_06FC410: No. I'm sorry I gave up.
Dialogue.1BD5C3F845F1020BCAAE6E85CAC93859_4731F06: No. If it helps, we keep going.
Dialogue.17E26890440F4B39F33EF2B0815368C1_14FBFB1: No. In fact, I will now call them "fuzzle cuties."
Dialogue.354779E844216388C7D4B7B3891D8FBE_14FBFB1: No. It is a sword. Slicing through the darkness.
Dialogue.256889A842E82E53B1F1858ABA5D7E2E_F6B1D98: No. It's all, like, a blur. I remember husks. I remember being scared. And mad. But that's about it.
Dialogue.F22CECDD45910435538D2CA2656C05B5_06FC410: No. Maybe. Ugh, I don't know.
Dialogue.8B09B7D34EAD7D4FD4AFC5B96680146D_10E97D2: No. No, no, no, no, no!
Dialogue.2F79145F4B2B61C8C53E66AE37B83F71_06FC410: No. Nope. I'm on my way.
Dialogue.BE7A1DA744A075B82BD38CAF22406885_94F2B66: No. Not because of my hand.
Dialogue.DF0DBBA74C74E8752C1DA3908C742E93_06FC410: No. Not that I know of.
Dialogue.E0CA397045FEADADC57CB7AB08DA2049_47CFF90: No. One impostor at a time.
Dialogue.2B3E9F0B42979E99C88E26BF037DB0C8_06FC410: No. Question 57. "On a scale of one to ten, rate the following statement."
Dialogue.29D3691A4953F4AFC6DFA496B7DC9707_14FBFB1: No. The song of the summer is crushing silence, so that is what we will play.
Dialogue.C426700A40BEC4BBB3B5B2948B0691F7_06FC410: No. They have to have hope. Even when we don't stand a chance.
Dialogue.C21210BA43DB11C96C9528B1455A3257_06FC410: No. They live in closets. What are you reading in there?
Dialogue.9931772F446B42FA12B6E9AFF9F9B4B3_D87E161: No. We could use your help.
Dialogue.119148264B692DBEC4B5DEB629A7FC3A_06FC410: No. We're not going out like this.
Dialogue.55CA69F64A8D2EE56B8EFDA6D9CFA618_14FBFB1: No. Yes. I'm- (grunts) I don't know.
Dialogue.A064F4F848CB096AF5C613B55BBCB1D0_06FC410: No. You crashed it while threatening to plunder Homebase.
Dialogue.AFEF107842B136C50500EE83D2A2F1A5_FB122F8: No. You need to find Anthony.
Dialogue.4C70AA264FF11DF7FE2216B4124B76AC_14FBFB1: No. You only hear it once...
Dialogue.77652B464BEA8709CBEF97B9FB0E40F5_77D814F: No. You'll be part of a team.
Dialogue.D79801BF4F2B8413E7A2FC8BC526AA90_F6B1D98: No... I'm sorry. But I don't think vengeance against these guys was the answer.
Dialogue.0E51CF63454B48CC19149B9418ABEBD7_765440C: No... it won't end like this!
Dialogue.DE37FD604F78E63694022F8444987C44_06FC410: No... just a lot of car dealership circulars and coupon booklets.
Dialogue.2A8ED0D74FFFEA2DC173D5A1B64C3FD1_FB122F8: No...but, thank you. Uh... but I don't need anyone working for me right now.
Dialogue.B46CF58948374AED571C9ABCE421E39B_EC1949E: Nobody ordered husks, you flinging freak!
Dialogue.3DE3BB8641815C0FD54CFDA76D38D411_5991012: Nobody's ever done something that nice for me before...
Dialogue.9241261544205F76FFDFF1916E817F75_9D00593: Nod your head if you understand me, Lars.
Dialogue.6F87080748FA842B393496A4B28C193E_06FC410: Non stop rock, comin' at ya!
Dialogue.5F022BA04C9D18479A51BE8D630061DB_CC240C1: Non-synthetic elements only. No villains, please.
Dialogue.4F33B5E84F729A8E1A0327BAFA8468EA_06FC410: None of the missing items are in homebase. We'll have to search the zone.
Dialogue.F6A67C294A64392D918A5CB588B6667D_B222EAD: None of this is working. I'm just not getting into the spirit of anything.
Dialogue.DEAB327C4811F4E86C4F888537D714D3_B229E47: None of this would have been possible without you and the Commander.
Dialogue.164DFB9E4DB55C92BD52FA85A4FEF4CE_1D2FE88: None of us remember why we continued our perilous trek into the depths of The Grotto.
Dialogue.4F2FEB584F579E8DD30CA99FF1E262DD_FB122F8: None of you are wrong... but I think Sarah has a point.
Dialogue.2FAE91494F7FE467DAA35EAB7F8A7192_97A9259: None taken. I do have hair and thumbs.
Dialogue.400E110D4B8F008A8447E79068CA6C48_06FC410: Noooo! That’s when you yell things like, “AVAST! GIVE US YER BOOTY LEST YER DOOM BE UPON YE!"
Dialogue.1987A1F64A48BF3B2080FF9B47DDF537_FB122F8: Nope, don't ask. I dare not speak what happened.
Dialogue.03219D0545F81D837AAF5C9F261997F2_071921D: Nope, drag me to the trough first.
Dialogue.FAA841774F74B15CFDEA56A74DA676D1_06FC410: Nope, it has to be books.
Dialogue.85C7E9984D05576DA08E609A9AAB24C0_06FC410: Nope, sorry. Can't stop the rock, Lars. Them's the rules.
Dialogue.FA767BA3480CCCBB32908D8D049912F0_7D2960E: Nope. I've had enough of toilet paper talk and enough of your front mullet to last a lifetime.
Dialogue.2AD1DD744CEC61BE8EE09ABA5EDAF63B_47CFF90: Nope. THERPAY-Bot does not have the capacity to deal with this topic again.
Dialogue.4A6316C647C2CB9FE25F6EAE4B113991_94F2B66: Nope. That's the shift change bell. You've still got fifty... oh, uh...
Dialogue.2FFF3DE6447F31E2616D4694D1A2D87B_C2C5A2E: Nope. This is like a Diet Mr. Slip or something. Garbage. Fix it or I walk.
Dialogue.DDE39C6643FD291612C391B6BEA7218A_765440C: Normally I'd be a fan of what's going on in there
Dialogue.A237941D4F61D790C013B1AEC43A4A79_06FC410: Normally I'd find that kind of thing disturbing, but these days I'm all about it.
Dialogue.A5BAF3B74F09134F769CF3BFC53AEFDE_94F2B66: Normally I'd say "if," but... I think you need a "when."
Dialogue.FEDEE37A432B545A26ADE6BD3E615D96_A96EA86: Normally I'd take care of this myself. But I've just not been feeling like myself lately.
Dialogue.5D9582D74AEC6C41DB51F7816F298880_1D2FE88: Normally we'd have you wander these halls until madness sets in.
Dialogue.04067F1541F745C2E234B2B53CE79D6A_47CFF90: Normally, but, this is pirate country.
Dialogue.C44A673F4CDC25B3CE68A38CBC38BDBC_72190CE: Not Blake, Blakebeard The Pirate. You know what happened to the last person who called me Blake? He died.
Dialogue.BD0DC1514959FEBAA4F22D8E2143EEEA_FB122F8: Not a fan of hearing you say that phrase.
Dialogue.D7FB29C2415772E76E1A95B74D9F1C81_C0E27E7: Not a fan. Not a fan at all.
Dialogue.AE14E7F1484CA2675EAED8AA0C3D7AD5_94F2B66: Not a great quality in a soldier.
Dialogue.1B26941F429C8ADCB84F17B78F5C29BA_97A9259: Not a great thought to put in my head!
Dialogue.586140EC436A3075F98C509F49F768C2_9801E98: Not a problem at all. I need help finding ancient organic samples to study.
Dialogue.F2DF8545494C025499F5978C5FF57C8F_D87E161: Not according to the surveys, apparently.
Dialogue.2E056F5A4034DD8DBF273BB620EEB5A6_06FC410: Not according to this box. How sure are you?
Dialogue.0EEF3B114C5D64183995BFA8161D72CC_06FC410: Not after you work your magic... right?
Dialogue.9AB12D5C4ED6FDE01D1A17843D81CAB8_FB122F8: Not all of us are great at coming up with inspiring speeches on the fly.
Dialogue.F8A6B23C452F37D06337128304DAE43C_06FC410: Not all of us are mindless battle drones ready to rush out into the world!
Dialogue.C5CBE24F4FE2CF6574A11D99DFFCE42A_97A9259: Not all of us can sizzle.
Dialogue.480E230B4C4D9E264DB56AAB3A803B64_06FC410: Not all of us get to have life-affirming adventures, okay?
Dialogue.B2310A5F425F6E1EAD15E8BE89051926_C2C5A2E: Not allowed. Part of my release conditions.
Dialogue.4D383318441FDB0E81D321A7B1932D57_AF0DA39: Not anymore I'm not! The survivors of Canny Valley are tired of being ignored.
Dialogue.8D171DCF4ADA4312CCD75481E6087912_7D2960E: Not bad for my first time.
Dialogue.2AFC25264B2B6B775A3AECA26CEFD081_06FC410: Not bad. I think we'll need a little more BluGlo.
Dialogue.CA9CF28E4F9802B829E082A5B06E0D60_06FC410: Not because I'm feeling crippling waves of guilt and am desperate to shift blame...
Dialogue.82A50AAC4EED1DC9EC0A089A7910BF25_47CFF90: Not better. Skulking around Homebase with advanced weaponry?
Dialogue.A1AE8A374A5FA7481039CA8853F8AFDE_861A10F: Not civilized like Rarrnold and Arrlene. Thanks to me, you're welcome.
Dialogue.B57491BE4EA30D7166834BBC65B53E5A_47CFF90: Not comforting, Crackshot. But... good to know.
Dialogue.CB9F60D94FDE91E93709DAB6F99A3FF2_DA0538A: Not even Santa can shoot with an empty gun!
Dialogue.67040204482B099507B3D98D09267E5D_06FC410: Not even a little. Nice job, Anthony.
Dialogue.720A908943509AB8901BFDBB37B194A5_06FC410: Not even if I'm seeing tracks from a 78 Softail Mercerado? Of which there are only two in circulation -
Dialogue.5D79395D42C815E0000CF8833A45026B_D87E161: Not even if you could be your own boss?
Dialogue.2B3241EB4F0EAF8B34A96981928AF568_861A10F: Not for a long time, at least.
Dialogue.869958234B92FA92D143A681925362C7_CC240C1: Not funny. We don't like those jokes.
Dialogue.97EC71654213541400E40B83BF325503_06FC410: Not going down with your ship is a lonely business. You end up talking to your Ned a lot. Okay?
Dialogue.EED7B4F940EFA15456747595D87A32B8_97A9259: Not good enough! Oh, but apparently no one cares about quality!
Dialogue.6640339D4A45BEE0E947989B5E0D1F21_FB122F8: Not good. I honestly have no idea what I'm doing.
Dialogue.AA19A33844F22503908F38A3115B2CD3_06FC410: Not great. But it's a start.
Dialogue.93BADEFC4D1FFF88936371B684C857AC_06FC410: Not if they're raised by wolves.
Dialogue.1FF6FCFB423570AC90037586206CD67E_06FC410: Not if you have their back.
Dialogue.8A680F5249175D337184A38627B46E8F_94F2B66: Not in front of the troops.
Dialogue.D9AB2F2D45C9214A9193D69B5934E494_B222EAD: Not just Dennis... Keep reading the tombstones.
Dialogue.E54A85C6403D14F32047F78923618C6F_FB122F8: Not just anyone gets to ride in the van.
Dialogue.C16A7D1048C12D443E4FEAB5BF00E34C_77D814F: Not just someone who signed up to carry a gun...
Dialogue.36EC8CD74CA15E407D84178C7D0026AA_87F0BBB: Not my dimension, not my problem.
Dialogue.C304CDCD4B40C1E99A27E9B7F827B330_FB122F8: Not my style, but music is music!
Dialogue.C2807A424FF1DED6F10490BDD2D54A58_9F725B6: Not nothing. You've got thread. That's a start.
Dialogue.D45487884AD15A0E2E1D50893C3E5B62_06FC410: Not now! Sorry, Commander. This SEE-bot's got some sort of problem.
Dialogue.10CF1C4D448309D5D4DB9483DF77BFC0_47CFF90: Not now... because Sarah wanted to go first.
Dialogue.6F1D221843C1A33A297D658C321F308C_5CE5FC8: Not on the list, but again, a lot of confidence in this bunch.
Dialogue.408A5C784559D368266237BB97B8CD68_910A467: Not one for conflict, but you might want to shoot that taker outta the sky.
Dialogue.94F0F5294DD6852219B20897D01C3C31_910A467: Not one to complain, but... I’m outta ammo!
Dialogue.80BAE5D5462203036E7AE5BBBE599494_47CFF90: Not only did the Homebase computer consider it a map, it also gave me a D plus.
Dialogue.142805D743F685B75107F7B1D944E89E_B222EAD: Not only do I get to tell you that you're doing everything wrong...
Dialogue.431227A84240B1608A64928538781448_9801E98: Not probably. Absolutely definitely. By far.
Dialogue.C82799174CCE8550CC7012B3D12F854A_06FC410: Not protecting you guys from the immediate judgment of a harsh and unforgiving crowd, that's for sure.
Dialogue.A603D449403C9C5F13E11DB1B6586B31_9F725B6: Not quite, music man. For now, let's just give people something, anything, to listen to.
Dialogue.EAE1B09E4F0B7937811153B04B390FBD_FB122F8: Not really. Energy field is too dispersed out here so everything's just kind of... fuzzy.
Dialogue.38AD710B4E2ECC163FD4398FB3359CB4_861A10F: Not really. Everything back home is lush and green, filled with animals and gentle breezes.
Dialogue.21C62F8F4ADD6296DADAB7A44E69E536_94F2B66: Not since the, uh, incident with the IED.
Dialogue.F375D1AC4E49E502FBF06887C9C01AC1_06FC410: Not so regal now, are ya!
Dialogue.E58CDA624DA0A45C8131E080A5057A1B_94F2B66: Not sure this simulation cleared health or safety regulations... Don’t eat anything while you’re in there.
Dialogue.11B4DBC042735A77397314AAB0715FAA_071921D: Not sure what was in that shot, but I like it.
Dialogue.BEB620714F7F544A1E5A5E9789DCD937_97A9259: Not sure who "Carter" is, but you know I'm here for fires.
Dialogue.9DC5604B4D58E9E6681B54A761AC9846_E090F2A: Not sure. Maybe just go ahead.
Dialogue.0543C10E45E51578E78DACB956DAC6FD_861A10F: Not sure. One second I'm fine, and... and then I get dizzy...
Dialogue.8CABF7E44887691D6089458941390011_06FC410: Not surprisingly, we're running low on gramophones.
Dialogue.358046B8492E0878E33C36A5099697F2_910A467: Not that I assume bad intent, but there’s a smasher coming!
Dialogue.C2AF16E84D6704C0361FD59EAB094896_7D086D9: Not that I don't appreciate your effort. But we can use the honor system, here.
Dialogue.48BCB08E4DED9FFE58BF37AEA5D4BE0C_FB122F8: Not that I think Ray even has any idea what she's looking for. (burps) Huh.
Dialogue.D6026C6E4AFA14881F1C27ABE1EA8765_FB122F8: Not that I think you'll appreciate how much work that was. (burps)
Dialogue.690CA3964F1DD8AAFAA98D89DBDAC7AE_FB122F8: Not that I was doubting that we'd live through the week, j-
Dialogue.CB574BE2414F573E12E5068DB42A0E04_861A10F: Not that I'm a vegetarian, I just prefer to not think about how those nuggets get on my plate.
Dialogue.D682CF16496457D8879811AF187AB5D8_94F2B66: Not that it matters either way. We're done here.
Dialogue.3F9E55454E54B15F90958C82872EC6E5_06FC410: Not that. Just. You know. I mean, that'd be okay, but ha ha -
Dialogue.A2448BB64246EEE521AB1BABFAE2A564_176484F: Not the answer I was hoping for.
Dialogue.2CF9A60648B4C8616A03E39E887D912E_47CFF90: Not the best at climbing down stairs, however...
Dialogue.395E4C3545DB60FBF9044C90CA5AE6C3_47CFF90: Not the kind of pirate we're looking for.
Dialogue.820E6B934BFF293791238AAD1F344A15_FB122F8: Not the point of this exercise.
Dialogue.D8F3B5354F568CC3DF9C978E7D7DC9F1_47CFF90: Not the reaction I was hoping for. I thought clarity might bring you some sort of peace.
Dialogue.C99541A74B87D8441F2830A232352968_AB3C42C: Not to backseat direct, but you might want to find some cameras.
Dialogue.C14537FA48ED71468C58BCADD8FDC62E_E090F2A: Not to be rude, but you're boring my chunks.
Dialogue.B126942847976D4C73070C83F982F98E_84C369E: Not to be sore about it... but think I may have won on points.
Dialogue.A195906F4DD13EB1D90F81852D9E40D4_B222EAD: Not to complain, but I'm still down here.
Dialogue.F58237CB48E59909E6EFC385D5FFFA08_06FC410: Not to give you advice, but nothing you've stolen here is valuable.
Dialogue.F85A928E40091C62C5F6E8A207C7E3D7_E090F2A: Not to make this entirely about me, but I am not scared.
Dialogue.D69BCB84480A6073755C7C9F9DBCDEC8_97A9259: Not to mention all those guys.
Dialogue.3C61BB0247AC16457B87CEBA696A5FA8_06FC410: Not to pressure you, but we really need to find SEE-Bot.
Dialogue.2385FB084806666D6A641DB536725CCC_5AA487F: Not today, my friend. Not today.
Dialogue.DABA40C348C86524F72D8D8CD143693C_9801E98: Not today, my friend. Not today.
Dialogue.CE32B68A4EE12426C28AEFADC722752E_FB122F8: Not until the run is complete.
Dialogue.AA4114CE40FC64F965A2299F03614F2A_97A9259: Not until we've all done a lot of laundry.
Dialogue.5592097844AA8CBED3A07ABF44E35E02_06FC410: Not without our help, you're not.
Dialogue.05E4C0C3490BB755E15818B5FD85EC20_EECA944: Not yet... The world needs me...
Dialogue.B4DE7C634725F91636BC64B45F06393A_47CFF90: Not... precisely how I was going to put it, but I suppose that logic scans.
Dialogue.3679F9184986ECA2DE6ECB91EC690F78_47CFF90: Noted. Uh- Jilly, wonderful to see you. I trust the Teabag family's doing well?
Dialogue.3EFAE22C45E296FEA7EC2BA25E622868_FB122F8: Nothin but noise. Too much signal interference going on.
Dialogue.13D0A5B84E0CF52F092B00A716632514_06FC410: Nothing about Storm Monsters loosely based on historical monsters.
Dialogue.7E78102A44B828A1BF6C1EB541B8E70B_4731F06: Nothing brings them together and they can never combine their skills, so...
Dialogue.84F34FAD44F60A49BBA241BE26B9DC2F_84C369E: Nothing feels better than saving a life.
Dialogue.507BBD3445A67178F71901BA50970CFD_9801E98: Nothing habit forming, the boy's got enough problems.
Dialogue.72DB44A64580AD8568BAAF88B7387607_EECA944: Nothing like someone being chased by a husk. Ready, aim, and...
Dialogue.5225FBE745B6AE4AFCC48BAB876E3531_87F0BBB: Nothing makes me happy to be single like a good angry breakup song.
Dialogue.0DA457384DFFFD5A391562B9AED43CC0_37EFC25: Nothing scares Krampus and his friends! …That they’re aware of.
Dialogue.C98AB7864E1D5432792AD7A9E1C43B16_06FC410: Nothing takes the shine off of people's uprising like stubborn statue feet.
Dialogue.F397323F44CBBDF5C37371A0ECF4D2AF_47CFF90: Nothing to worry about. But now you know.
Dialogue.ACDE9AA647B804EFE49091915DFA25CB_FB122F8: Nothing unusual, Little Robot. I will always love my music and helping the world through science.
Dialogue.65EE1517445CCF891337B989278E4D03_D87E161: Nothing will make me feel better ever again.
Dialogue.CA789C10454E48FE11E6B8AC9A107C00_EAAE146: Nothing! Set sail for the next coordinates!
Dialogue.04922F5D44BFC52D3FB13785B21C77FA_47CFF90: Nothing's happening. Can you try that again?
Dialogue.3D3A15E44FBE5DBD5C99DF82AD1CDBF7_F6B1D98: Nothing. I just can't help shake the feeling that maybe there's something I'm not remembering.
Dialogue.EA26360A493346FFD4C559820078AA63_CC240C1: Nothing. I just thought you might want to know what... They said.
Dialogue.9D0D092147D3C17611D6FF81905FFCE3_EAAE146: Now I understand your ransomware problem.
Dialogue.3177942D48A59DEA8FBF04AFB5D653E6_9D00593: Now I've got these little guys tamed just right.
Dialogue.28345A3A43933C05BE805FA072413A0C_21C1927: Now according to my tea analysis kit, this Slurp is not tea.
Dialogue.DA0A0856428403636E39C3AD0A9E7552_B25AF7B: Now be gone, you rude little potatoes. I won't tell you anything more!

Dialogue.11AB00CE4FA703CC4EE01C888FFE6F30_0BE868E: We are like an avalanche. And you? A bow-legged snowboarder.
Dialogue.E1032EE5406948563937E2BDC6810FE8_06FC410: We are not helping slashers feel better about themselves.
Dialogue.1F3B217944414C93B1053190F9046E4D_861A10F: We are not naming her the "Bride of Rarrnold." That's a bit presumptuous, don't you think?
Dialogue.8488EAB3453612CF3DDE2FA5D464D39E_47CFF90: We are now officially off the map...
Dialogue.42DB57A14C855590125AA9933465DBBD_B229E47: We are now prepared to move on to the next phase of testing.
Dialogue.60B1BB954E2DFB677AD977ABD604FE9B_910A467: We are now up to four legs.
Dialogue.6FF95DFA4B24B4AE69996C825F0092D5_72190CE: We are pirates, with concussions, who have feelings.
Dialogue.896556144FB8CB4CED39BC9AE1A8560D_0BE868E: We are pleased at what we’ve found.
Dialogue.7B6B7C4D4B6DFA7590445081D0A5FA29_A96EA86: We are probing the samples for any signs of weakness.
Dialogue.E2D05B08476DD15DA3613C9C71CEEC17_0BE868E: We are quite comfortable with building, thank you.
Dialogue.12BB8FAF483E0ED9EABADEA920A1E9EC_06FC410: We are running a professional, high quality production here.
Dialogue.B6C207104B26ED68F4CF17B6DA49DF6D_06FC410: We are searching for a solution.
Dialogue.1B6DF2474CE858D40A6AA79DDF9FF3E2_1D2FE88: We are so sorry to say that we have triumphed and you have lost.
Dialogue.5807AFD64EAE3423DBF427A120357EFA_94F2B66: We are the last thing standing between the people of Plank Harbor...
Dialogue.23FC717F4F52F6328AA57A947DF733E6_0BE868E: We are unimpressed by your flying.
Dialogue.00648C6B48FB8BE6B2DA7F9BA44ABE6C_97A9259: We are weeks into pre-production and we don't even have a cast.
Dialogue.07285FC34F03BC3B0056E5B5E90F5D57_1D2FE88: We believe it to be very effective.
Dialogue.639570EB4AADA693898805921AEE9F0C_72190CE: We both get really, really seasick.
Dialogue.555D645842CCE40D64DAEA8A15900835_06FC410: We build a bunch of hoverboards that can fly themselves! Easy, right?
Dialogue.F52D761E41C4AE7F1EA78D92700E9C89_CC240C1: We call him our little miracle.
Dialogue.F4B45746473FF1343491ADB077097C31_97A9259: We call it whatever you call it.
Dialogue.F21285A84AD54D36EE68F595C6005B36_FB122F8: We called it in. A team is on the way.
Dialogue.5840C51D45F0694FD76A199E2F0B4EF7_97A9259: We can damage it again! Do... battle... things!
Dialogue.1BAA54DD475BEB8F51A01991D47837B3_06FC410: We can do better. We will do better.
Dialogue.992A16AA4C651A7CF643BDBB0DA2374E_AB3C42C: We can use this one for photos.
Dialogue.8C367B1C47221C6ADCA002B167D3853E_47CFF90: We can't just set them loose on the world.
Dialogue.3A30FBB342735753FE05E598C5B70740_06FC410: We can't launch in this weather....
Dialogue.A56A32404E387C1C0156D6BE5C733C1B_06FC410: We can't leave him like this.
Dialogue.41DE6FA9436B850E6B2B33B647D72CFA_FB122F8: We can't leave until we've found all those survivors!
Dialogue.ACCF11C344B47468107766881F54404E_06FC410: We can't let the husks destroy the drone!
Dialogue.1212D44643492FCE3DFAC6B9EEB97C6E_06FC410: We can't open the oven to install the new light without causing a major temperature fluctuation.
Dialogue.CA16871F42104AD9E0D65E9FB62E1FF1_06FC410: We can't. Besides he disabled Lars' van.
Dialogue.61774D81420119D92C0407889ECB9210_AB3C42C: We cannot function with this much chaos on set.
Dialogue.99FE65B9482ABEE506C6E98FD7DB613B_47CFF90: We cannot rule out a ghost presence in the hotel.
Dialogue.E0EC9652445CA0FD78F2C48FA16B0707_06FC410: We carbon dated the chrome husks and the results were inconclusive.
Dialogue.647ADA8A4D208BDFBC104084A4860896_06FC410: We cause a distraction, and then Ted... makes a break for it.
Dialogue.F66123094F94209F76AA399ED129A1D7_0BE868E: We certainly hope you have bullets to spare.
Dialogue.59764E0945D4859D6F8543883FA8E9A6_1D2FE88: We consider ourselves a rather elite and exclusive organization.
Dialogue.012D80FB43976BFB46648DBD91890DD4_1D2FE88: We continued on into the unknown.
Dialogue.2A6B3AFD46924911A7D752979D238907_FB122F8: We could be loners together if you wanna join me.
Dialogue.4FC25D1B4B4B878127A184B56CAD4B08_06FC410: We could have made a secret language and played tricks on people.
Dialogue.467190454B0B64DA6449BBB853AA4749_FB122F8: We could hear each other's thoughts.
Dialogue.2BDC778347673EF653C9E6861C0C8573_1D2FE88: We could not believe our eyes! Real life Grotto Coins! And they were ours for the taking.
Dialogue.37D00F01438E6635522E34B7E8C4B0C2_06FC410: We could print out your memory reports and see what that thing was!
Dialogue.D4AA9FA04D9E75716E16A2B8A89C1D90_861A10F: We could really do without being chased by an angry mob.
Dialogue.5748DDF241282A95B1D7C0A2BB88C217_47CFF90: We could try to figure out when the Super Blood Moon is going to be full.
Dialogue.8783A920466894959034AE8C82E3BF14_06FC410: We couldn't if we wanted to.
Dialogue.4E8B841B446F4A989842BF98D921A9F7_97A9259: We decided that even though Anthony screwed everything up, he has a reason for being here.
Dialogue.96F51AF14380E4A2CE7F91B371015A89_06FC410: We deploy the shelters to high danger storm systems.
Dialogue.DB156E854B183D5504E2CDA202C264C4_861A10F: We destroyed your boats, mob! So keep your pitchforks away from my friends!
Dialogue.F567C7FC49BD8684A553ECB72F812DAA_EED9CD8: We did it! Thank you commander!
Dialogue.C4F68627496BB9422DDF13A1F435447B_84C369E: We did it. (sigh) All the dance floors are gone.
Dialogue.B5D9FE754C05AF010304B696F9E18ACB_B229E47: We did not win. But we are still here.
Dialogue.782115654B13EBAEF9E879B58BAF4FE2_06FC410: We did! Sometimes you have to take a risk to do the right thing.
Dialogue.CB33DEF4431A148939C8ECAA0EA2DFFA_1D2FE88: We didn't know what the coins were for... but they seemed valuable.
Dialogue.102AA81E489DF3C5A93B83B3B904FE01_06FC410: We didn't lose, we're just stocking up on some revenge fuel.
Dialogue.7A1050F44656ED6814CB818E3D8D7735_06FC410: We didn't recover any files. {whispered} I won't tell if you won't.
Dialogue.57BC3456425567A613F2F7AA030A3431_1D2FE88: We didn't think twice about the keys we found in The Grotto.
Dialogue.2900227448B774970DFE6491DF517C7F_94F2B66: We do not give up on our teammates! Get them on their feet!
Dialogue.795CD8B34A55D0653BBC43B080658FBB_9D00593: We do not need your help. We are the kidnappers.
Dialogue.8821B6A342FDE3666BEA73B6556AE12B_CC240C1: We do things our own way here.
Dialogue.2AD3EC444F88D9ADBB4CC68DAE80C1DC_5991012: We do. 'Cause we're a team. Don't all teams...do that?
Dialogue.3601D3B54B673B0AA983C9BB83414765_06FC410: We don't even have TV. It's just security footage of monsters.
Dialogue.27B2DBBB477A6C14806968BEA2F12C82_06FC410: We don't even have a shark pit.
Dialogue.E9F91C3D4FDAB22333967A849DF8A618_94F2B66: We don't have a choice. The storm is nearly here!
Dialogue.67C9024341234C0DE87DB38FE2A00810_06FC410: We don't have a script. We don't have any idea of what we're making.
Dialogue.5DFD47C2418DE2BEE00553A5372BA2CF_06FC410: We don't have a ton of rules here, but that's one of them.
Dialogue.311D84024231C90CD23CE0A8A1931432_06FC410: We don't have any intel this time. The attack could come from any direction.
Dialogue.7C943FC442F2FC23B1EEB786DCF9F1BF_A96EA86: We don't have any, do we?
Dialogue.39B755EE457AE3C0F3A104875B73FD57_051E656: We don't have those. We have cricket creepers.
Dialogue.A5451CF84229A54B49933A81DF0886D8_B68F328: We don't have time for infighting.
Dialogue.D3CAF1BE4B6FD21BB7D6B89228463559_7D086D9: We don't have time. We send someone over with the bomb.
Dialogue.6C58DCEF48349617AAD37EABC0B27206_06FC410: We don't have to keep doing this.
Dialogue.F5664DE2416F184CB32F4F9516F3E56E_06FC410: We don't know why it produces a shield instead of a small crater.
Dialogue.46376A514B0C1B64DF6DA59B9769B491_06FC410: We don't leave survivors behind. Even survivors who are determined to get left behind.
Dialogue.C76FBC5A48B3F2F7FEC250BA635EC568_06FC410: We don't need to worry about wiping that one.
Dialogue.4140618943D8FC474521C795ED85F432_AB3C42C: We explore, searching for adventure and the thrill of battle.
Dialogue.DC0ADAFD41F429CED8F2AB8C616A02FC_06FC410: We fight the monsters other monsters wouldn't dare fight.
Dialogue.D82BA9344FE9312A613A95AD1F3AAB58_FB122F8: We find a way to remind him of who he was.
Dialogue.7FB6B70F4E49FC22D6CC2FA56A32D1F1_FB122F8: We fought off their arrows with an all banjo version of "Split the Check."
Dialogue.A741A3A5404824CD598925AD0DF33E9E_06FC410: We found a case of glow sticks and we're ready to sway in unison.
Dialogue.536B78024FE840E80627E19CE9F63DB2_47CFF90: We found our first spirit board! How does it work?
Dialogue.876C3BFB4C7D94EC2A339DB919178F35_97A9259: We found some... very gross... stuff.
Dialogue.5580CF614D65D6CDEB25FA900B0D37B6_06FC410: We found the rift that's been blocking the path to Plank Harbor...
Dialogue.ABFCF91540680A4D3CDCFEB1B7E14768_72190CE: We gave them the coordinates for Homebase and sent them on their way.
Dialogue.10B2E840457B36B9E5AEF2B3A491F0D8_FB122F8: We got a big boy over here!
Dialogue.6534D4F545E2E2737103F0B00EFEFFA6_3D2D55D: We got a thief hangin' around.
Dialogue.D7DED2F94608A2F95CCF9484A7C4F682_3D2D55D: We got a thief hangin' around.
Dialogue.93B2EAFE4A9B1855308B0BA9CAA59740_06FC410: We got all of the files- This data will be invaluable!  Niiicely done!
Dialogue.99F903F2423777162E8FA1BF9B69A762_94F2B66: We got big husks, small husks, baseball husks, flingers, gunslingers, blasters, smashers, elementals...
Dialogue.AA0C1FE1498E1D84F6017BA6C258A8B9_3D2D55D: We got called in for a rescue mission, but by the time we landed… it was too late.
Dialogue.CAB95A1242738DBB022D8AB58A2DC37D_1D2FE88: We got one of those shield drainers. Let us know what you think.
Dialogue.AABFC8D4478DF1A17F07C6A15324BB0F_06FC410: We got ourself a twofer today. Not only will the suit be attacked by husks,
Dialogue.2C72C612499030C8D1045AB222156849_06FC410: We got some Retrieve the Data. Got some survivors getting rescued...
Dialogue.DB989B8B45EA835E66747E85D6BF14F2_FB122F8: We got takers! Don't let 'em... take ya.
Dialogue.9C94085A4BDF2CA250EBEA90D3DFFA36_87F0BBB: We got ticket stubs here! So... so many ticket stubs.
Dialogue.3B5542474DD2A70E1A68A092CBB08A13_06FC410: We got you a little something special.
Dialogue.35EA68EE4B1A73884F201F977E993166_9801E98: We gotta check out those crazy mines we've uncovered.
Dialogue.F8108F034E199031E2ADB5BD05B035D4_FB122F8: We gotta cram a cork in that space hole, fast!
Dialogue.D1F6948941DCF58469E85AB8B0C9FC34_06FC410: We gotta destroy some storm infected graves.
Dialogue.C3B53AC746F09390D4DF2AA7F1C90B8D_FB122F8: We gotta get the full road trip experience.
Dialogue.0652016941EAC5E05B9C8EAEB83448AA_47CFF90: We gotta swim with the sharks, lean and mean. Haha!
Dialogue.B406E85246E618BD2A1CF293A390353C_47CFF90: We greet all visitors with a full heart and an open mind, and I suppose this is the cost we pay.
Dialogue.DBC0DD6242BE0FCA2E023A9005263A6B_1D2FE88: We had been tricked by trolls!
Dialogue.73166C5F49BFB1E44B5C7C9D7F2C73B4_06FC410: We had cornered the blackbooted devil, and nearly had him bested,
Dialogue.FA6479A14ACA87F3C643688418AFA9A2_1D2FE88: We had done our best, but our best wasn't good enough to best The Grotto.
Dialogue.E1D85F7748F731B96793C787DA5E1751_1D2FE88: We had found a secret door.
Dialogue.E9F0AB0C4775ECA3A28ACA9F3C11D92A_1D2FE88: We had found all of the coins.
Dialogue.E162A6A940A87879E151CFA25294FB16_06FC410: We had some. And now we do not.
Dialogue.5CBB8CCE4B4CBD61D74A68B928008986_06FC410: We had to lose the weight!
Dialogue.3CE426074EAD03E10C4FDC82F02FA133_1D2FE88: We had won. We couldn't believe it.
Dialogue.EAABE8684438E7EEE4A5C29C8E609B08_06FC410: We have Vindertech's second-in-command at our side.
Dialogue.0781A61748D4FD5C3AE7D1BD130F94C0_06FC410: We have a break in the action.
Dialogue.E040E42F45DC83876733C4A23A05B98E_C9708CA: We have a chance to win this thing!
Dialogue.4E0902714AE1EE2D688F86BD692D0196_06FC410: We have a comet from the past that's apparently too cool for gravity.
Dialogue.13B819C145D265F4916FF4A35E943AE0_06FC410: We have a confirmed Vlad sighting in the Crawling Terror quadrant of Hexsylvania.
Dialogue.A6FD74804A694FD6B188B58E97941A7C_97A9259: We have a leftover ghost vacuum.
Dialogue.70131BBD4CDB0CBA39D337ACFCE37C47_94F2B66: We have a love storm incoming.
Dialogue.CBA7BB7F459ABF1FA11FF4B27774342B_06FC410: We have a monster army gathering near a crack in reality, and everything we've done up until this moment means probably nothing.
Dialogue.1D836911422F512A48B7709DE46DF5FE_21C1927: We have been called upon by Homebase to rise to a new challenge.
Dialogue.A41235B545B7BEAF458BDD83D3CFC155_94F2B66: We have been weak, we have strayed, and backslided...
Dialogue.A19F73264DB4C8B6D1F8D6B48FFDEBB4_5991012: We have come so far together, humans.
Dialogue.2AF8F08F487F374DE04C2CAE40FF2A62_47CFF90: We have cookies and milk back at Homebase.
Dialogue.2D1CE2824DB35FBCE2583A90B17310CB_06FC410: We have enough wakey-wakey juice to raise every vamp in town.
Dialogue.16D2A5CB4F20E0A057E25DB508FD53CC_94F2B66: We have got rifts! Look out!
Dialogue.414DDF9D42157912171CEBB84428C1E8_861A10F: We have got to get you out of that van.
Dialogue.ED8D943042BB439B0FBFB28D52FAED7E_FB122F8: We have just a few minutes before the Door to Darkness opens.
Dialogue.14D0785B4C478A49A1A779BB7B2B19CF_06FC410: We have just the guy for that...
Dialogue.0A0857514B3BF627CFF6A3857FBB37A7_FB122F8: We have more important things to worry about right now.
Dialogue.942F59014FAEBA2E359156BA3044133E_06FC410: We have our best and brightest working day and night to solve the... opportunity.
Dialogue.517B49D242087BB3249CCE8B410ABA2C_0BE868E: We have slipped through death’s fingers once more. Stupid death.
Dialogue.80E333404CC08CFE3C28B4A76C80265F_06FC410: We have some highly-experienced piracy experts right here at Homebase.
Dialogue.E75C7AF14312ABEB4B4843957CDF3A44_06FC410: We have some time before they arrive.
Dialogue.2D8F0C4145A3392C945EEF9EB4C70AEB_06FC410: We have survivor shelters there. When will it hit?
Dialogue.3CD43E234D1C4E0F4D487E83EAFE4B00_94F2B66: We have suspicious packages in the AO. Call in the bomb squad.
Dialogue.7A174F044162B2C2E85A6C9D24FE3C4E_06FC410: We have taken every precaution available...
Dialogue.CCE6FBED450F44EAAFAD1DB243D2126B_06FC410: We have the best team of heroes the world has ever seen.
Dialogue.14D01E574707747158CC4A87E2269425_97A9259: We have the cans of food, and I also put in there an ice scraper and some double-A batteries.
Dialogue.2CDF505B4FF9DE1C1FBCD880354F6B5F_06FC410: We have the classy entrance carpet, so this can be the fancy exit carpet.
Dialogue.89F9327D486905B4C0B616B8ADF3751C_06FC410: We have the hate potion ready for deployment.
Dialogue.F9C89FE34B146D63D363CBA364F04E3F_861A10F: We have thirty folding chairs full of monsters out there and they expect an event.
Dialogue.B015A3D249A36E955D5D588F97E74A23_06FC410: We have to destroy Vlad's grave...
Dialogue.8981CBA14EB577167D98E1805185D84C_97A9259: We have to destroy the network before the time husks get Summer.
Dialogue.7BC452A94DD0A7ECBD31CE8D8E066D95_72190CE: We have to destroy the pirate punch stands.
Dialogue.8F964663454C6F5D0E0C748E3C2A8F18_06FC410: We have to find a way to keep her here.
Dialogue.297CCC4F4CDC33708C80598E03FEB29D_9D00593: We have to have a terri- Father Christmas forgive my jolly old soul! I can't say even it.
Dialogue.5D7B06374CA2CF31DDF1AFB7E9D4671A_861A10F: We have to keep Arrlene and Rarrnold safe from the mob!
Dialogue.44D4AD6F47D683B450C68E9B92C2FF79_B222EAD: We have to protect the fort!
Dialogue.A5DCF40C4DB865BB52DC7E8D64623F54_181CD3E: We have to protect the fort!
Dialogue.535896BA4F55834268E8D5BF20811B08_CC240C1: We have to stay the rest of the week.
Dialogue.750B203A4F8877C736A2B3BB7E046502_97A9259: We have today. We have Steel Wool. And we have cannons.
Dialogue.47072CBC46E636990862FFB3D11438AD_06FC410: We have two weeks to complete the project, stay focused.
Dialogue.D888F612489160863234DB963269B6C1_06FC410: We have... the opposite of liftoff.
Dialogue.4C1E89B14BC59E616A8823B76F147860_9D00593: We haven't built the peppermint pavillion, or the hot cocoa lake...
Dialogue.A34DA726497CF513FD1825ABCB771B7B_97A9259: We haven't made contact yet, but I can tell we're getting close.
Dialogue.D2ACB5E042EE4996A89044976EAF2180_06FC410: We here at Homebase wish you the very best.
Dialogue.A0E34E0943F6B9DB00A659903C0CAB42_1D2FE88: We hope you find your stay so satisfying that you never leave.
Dialogue.E70E68794B043FBAC27CEB9360E73EAF_06FC410: We intercepted a transmission from the Dark Voyager.
Dialogue.D4D983514510112CF37111A5066F0727_06FC410: We just crossed the threshold, Commander.
Dialogue.12193682497421029ECA87A78F82DD7C_D87E161: We just don't wanna get ghosted.
Dialogue.AE75E13A418F97D9E7D9E7A792327E8B_06FC410: We just gotta let him finish.
Dialogue.4A18CDBD46826433170B318C94B9F3CD_B25EA52: We just need a little more.
Dialogue.018A3DE24263605C0553BCACA8A351BE_FB122F8: We just need one 'scope to survive the test.
Dialogue.5C3EA4D148534CEDBCB9F1AAAE811988_06FC410: We just need to know what to do about the werewolves and--
Dialogue.5F6A070F44F210091ACF4F8E6E40AAFB_06FC410: We just opened up a huge region of Plankerton!
Dialogue.F25952B04036E3F6DE70519D990546A1_765440C: We just want you to stop using your science to change the world.
Dialogue.A8AFB54F40334159428BD2824568B893_D87E161: We keep playing fair and acting nice and pretending like we're not fighting a war, but we are!
Dialogue.A6BC69104F7B00EDE6E6D6A401A562EB_D87E161: We kept going until we were no longer in love.
Dialogue.16B66066475F623C678B22AB741F3F6F_97A9259: We knew and we did it anyway.
Dialogue.FF83671E411C93007C9115806FF347AB_1D2FE88: We knew that somewhere a dungeon was preparing a greater torment.
Dialogue.2E7B9C1A4BEA39846694F19E2658D53C_97A9259: We knew the dangers of Taste Wizard. We knew that one day the system would turn on us.
Dialogue.50F62F704DB5AA7AF7F97EA7DFD4F379_1D2FE88: We knew we'd have to search for more of the coins.
Dialogue.FD34B4844BDD8DDD6FD8C9980589BC4E_1D2FE88: We knew we'd need to find the shadow key.
Dialogue.65FCD5B1456D12CFA6C9FF8211B6F4B9_06FC410: We know Carlos went to the southwest, but we have no idea what's out there.
Dialogue.D85C2F30442798E0BC3D89B88CD40A6C_EAAE146: We know how to loot, pillage, and burn. That's enough.
Dialogue.9B13EE154B8936AEF26F64BC42CDF23E_06FC410: We know it's dangerous, but someone's got to do it.
Dialogue.49253EAD4FB5A1ACF10EEFA49DFEB278_0BE868E: We know just what to do with this.
Dialogue.EE11C65A436840150FC87B910B7D2A20_06FC410: We know when the Super Blood Moon will be the fullest. Now what?
Dialogue.DFAF5E9E45ED6D47EA73BAA93DC9CF5A_B222EAD: We know you can't move on until you've got a killer reputation.
Dialogue.DE781AB04A29B431F1C95FAA245570DC_1D2FE88: We know you have a lot of choices when it comes to misery and dread...
Dialogue.91E76D4549C771C57E4C7D8F5D114687_06FC410: We know, but we don't agree.
Dialogue.93856FB4484C5B1639E89FBA34D0A3F7_1D2FE88: We learned a lesson that day we'd not soon forget. Sometimes... evil prevails.
Dialogue.3FDBFD444328996556320F8D22F54227_07E024E: We let them destroy the fort.
Dialogue.AE0E630A46A69250AF2367BB39AFFC5C_CC5E92B: We let them destroy the fort.
Dialogue.DAC71D1A4CFAB4495E2ED5BAA47AFEAD_14FBFB1: We live in the shadows! That is our motto!
Dialogue.D7557FBC4BFED67154B3738D98036E18_06FC410: We lost it. We need to try again.
Dialogue.DBD1BC364164C592C3A00688CEA7E8DB_06FC410: We lost one... Better than the pirates finding it, I guess.
Dialogue.AF15D79E4995D99021A1A8B168D2ED3D_06FC410: We lost that siphon. It happens.
Dialogue.1E49F8D947C9A0977408C295475A0B27_B68F328: We lost the probe. We need to try again.

Dialogue.1C0AB4A745EF12CC2A946A8F97B47545_06FC410: We may not have the most amazing script, but we can have an amazing table!

Dialogue.0BBB4A024C795BD8B6BECABB28CCF71F_06FC410: We might want to destroy these. They can't be good for morale.
Dialogue.6CBF765A48C38E95F8CAAEBFD0567936_5AA487F: We might want to exercise some caution here.
Dialogue.DA79C28F4C98A3337324A6B992619E2C_9801E98: We might want to exercise some caution here.

Dialogue.43B523974BE18B86C55E298789F28AE6_06FC410: We need Ted and the Misfit Toys.

Dialogue.AEB2A6BA4D15BEC96E2283A44D135089_06FC410: We need a humane way to get rid of these bees. Search for fans... that might work.
Dialogue.E3AC0CA04DE2A7E36AA42B98BB073727_06FC410: We need a lot of wolfsbane for the amulets, so let's start gathering.

Dialogue.4D10343B4A0992CDD2402F8058F555B4_06FC410: We need at least one sensor to survive!

Dialogue.0461D9244D0F504900D2B7B2496F6AAE_06FC410: We need more data before we can push ahead...

Dialogue.8FDE96BC4AD683B9B8BFDB99FB7E18B0_9D00593: We need more. MORE! Or there could be... consequences.
Dialogue.5DDE3993483FB217A5934EA91AB4F6E3_06FC410: We need processing power to extract the AI.

Dialogue.F68D055144D44FFE20103D8E6F34293A_B229E47: We need to  - I need to break the design down and focus on containment.

Dialogue.9E8F02154E82ACDBBFC72B88D2DE0D95_FB122F8: We need to build a full on telescope array, so stock up on the primo optics.

Dialogue.C89431034E2A5A1D45F157A895DEF79E_06FC410: We need to deploy the trap before time runs out.

Dialogue.EDFCAB01410007230BDCAB946CB11FBD_06FC410: We need to figure out how.
Dialogue.9613659844775A5F79C29F9A10BC3BCC_06FC410: We need to figure out what it was.

Dialogue.86981A7C4EA446B7B3575E978749928C_06FC410: We need to find out how Lok was locked out.
Dialogue.D75284D24EFDB3BF4F86878C62C49BA6_06FC410: We need to find out what happened to these two.
Dialogue.09DFD2B14C0EB663C5C3E0B9C38C77DD_06FC410: We need to find out why the shields go down and when.

Dialogue.E511DE1A43550E6842DA2DB9425AC5AC_97A9259: We need to find the location of Taste Wizard Prime.
Dialogue.7AD7810A468F92A637A346B6B2EE364F_97A9259: We need to find the source and destroy it.

Dialogue.928B0CB64094DCC22FAAB091437AF6EC_06FC410: We need to fly under the radar.
Dialogue.C33F9B3B4CE79A6B5498CA9EA4E1729D_06FC410: We need to get Brainstorm's brain resituated in a fresh vat of brain brine.
Dialogue.1770D1D84DBD9D0FE4A96AA25394649B_06FC410: We need to get Lar's van back in working order.
Dialogue.1EEBBB544F7F104F38D7C9B3E2FCF656_06FC410: We need to get close enough to send him a message.
Dialogue.2EC8977E43E4F1540AA979BD02FE82E8_06FC410: We need to get him back to Homebase.
Dialogue.7C6541F140381695C2CCE2B56CC24D34_06FC410: We need to get there before he does.

Dialogue.E31F54DE4A84775B922717977A44E9EE_06FC410: We need to give him some options, and the rest is up to him.
Dialogue.E3BAFFC64BFE7603E4DE70BDF03B1E55_47CFF90: We need to have a discussion about Crackshot.
Dialogue.B523FFE14CAA860CBE786FB4429795B8_06FC410: We need to head back soon.
Dialogue.55292E4E40BBCE10E9E2808D8D783FF4_06FC410: We need to help, but Gravestone isn't showing up on my map...
Dialogue.43BB80E747B82DF28EF64FB1EF600F75_06FC410: We need to install a generator.
Dialogue.B7ED8948436B49FBD22259AECB26AA7A_06FC410: We need to keep that rocket safe until launch!
Dialogue.08EE64A446B291F1E7D3E7A3F01C0C5B_06FC410: We need to keep the landing site clear.
Dialogue.03E8068B4903A2704B4BFDB9540CD70E_06FC410: We need to knock 'em down before anyone else gets hurt.
Dialogue.F02006354618725B6722F5AEF3019566_06FC410: We need to know what's on that page, Commander.
Dialogue.0175A73942630D4262A9FFBD9E4C2459_FB122F8: We need to locate and repair two radar towers.
Dialogue.F56B88BA4636EB56507CE6BCB64D4200_06FC410: We need to make another episode.
Dialogue.7E6A001D4CAB99B805CD29B574B5F99A_B222EAD: We need to prepare for the army of the dead.

Dialogue.F37BF91E4A54BC8DFC2613849E2C4DE6_06FC410: We need to protect the telescope array while the experiment is running.
Dialogue.16CB11AD4BB389BAC107DCB3D8CB3EC3_06FC410: We need to protect those survivors!

Dialogue.CDB347D04BBF210E5C88058F5EBF1664_06FC410: We need to rescue the survivors, and make sure all shelters are evacuated ASAP!
Dialogue.51F0D12140C30857ED4677BBA75ACC27_06FC410: We need to retrieve the data as usual, but this time we need to watch the storm.
Dialogue.AFDB11B6424608AC8A7977A8AD5033AE_06FC410: We need to retrieve the data before we're overwhelmed by the storm.
Dialogue.03BCE8B44E9BE26C79462BBF882213FE_06FC410: We need to run a full storm reading on the castle.
Dialogue.9C4F0FEE4EABEBA6E5D5BF8E5A2EEA01_7D086D9: We need to safely transport the test device through the rift.
Dialogue.C84718DC4F5E6E38EE93DFB4500A4689_06FC410: We need to salvage what we can from that drone.
Dialogue.43AB16374B9E54890967A487039CFF80_06FC410: We need to see if there's a link between the rifts and the anomalies. Maybe they can observe.
Dialogue.D2A0661C4D8FADAD83AD9F8402E1658D_94F2B66: We need to send a message to the people before it's too late.

Dialogue.92E7019F4ECD32383CFC6CA495910BFF_06FC410: We need to send a warning.
Dialogue.C995EE314BDB48FB1AA733A7E6DE79BB_06FC410: We need to set up equipment for the reshoot.
Dialogue.2F7E2A9F4235F994AD14BC8A5DE73307_06FC410: We need to track his distress signal.
Dialogue.6823D4464A7ACFDAA373F6A96539BEC1_06FC410: We need to upgrade the generator before nightfall.
Dialogue.776314B74AFAAF45795BF5AFED530ECD_CC240C1: We need you and your weird brain!
Dialogue.4AE1076548F227D3CF0ABFB897EF25C5_06FC410: We never should have listened to you in the first place.
Dialogue.D4F38CDD4958941717E3A7ADB60E98F0_06FC410: We now have clear skies for launch -
Dialogue.8F64FC28451742127EB5A5886E0DDD58_06FC410: We now have multiple cameras... and no idea what to point them at.
Dialogue.7090D7D144E9F4E2DDE1C1B9DBF9A19B_06FC410: We now open the floor to questions.

Dialogue.EB55F2C34E85398CC979F88D22677B46_CC240C1: We now return... to Lok's Tales of Beyond!
Dialogue.B0CFA2734431D373770DDAB6751C53CA_06FC410: We only have one cast member.
Dialogue.0AADEE1A4156A3B5EE877DBDE663C961_06FC410: We only need a few more bones for Dennis!
Dialogue.A7ACF8FB440594702D98A1B32704C156_06FC410: We only need to worry about active encampments.

Dialogue.FC2991FF42B0890265CF6287B9A4D792_0BE868E: We prefer snow, but... this will do.

Dialogue.F62DA97A4E738562E2C84F8A446F8C89_06FC410: We really need your help. Things are… bad.
Dialogue.1145C25A4F71FECE3B8652965A1600CF_06FC410: We recovered one file! That's not nothin'

Dialogue.A476F09646863116426EE5A418741641_0BE868E: We regret to inform you there are Takers here.
Dialogue.9B9CA6AB45239A46D2583492BE946447_94F2B66: We remain vulnerable to love, and the storm is closing in.
Dialogue.2C4E1FDC4CABF38CCB3E0697776FBE2C_CC240C1: We replaced the rails with a waterslide.
Dialogue.CE2F3237429F23BA5AE58A81C3AD807D_97A9259: We rescheduled the meeting one hundred and four times.
Dialogue.2C887A37445D4A7BD0334BB10613451D_1D2FE88: We reserve the right to drain your life force during your stay.
Dialogue.C30B06A940990374EF8D919332E6DC98_CC240C1: We return to Lok's Tales of Beyond.
Dialogue.930E66D24FC6ECD0E1279D8F6BF928E9_B68F328: We send someone through the rift to manually activate the bomb.
Dialogue.0E5F9C3E4E3930B97826E5BCEC54F083_06FC410: We seriously have to go talk to this guy?
Dialogue.C9A23051428C8E4C54ADDCB721272173_0BE868E: We shall add you to our collection of frozen weenies.
Dialogue.0B252B7D4AC6D3D8BE8D36A0864A076D_0BE868E: We shall feed you to the ice, smasher.
Dialogue.896329474E36CC2BF7E2FC93219246B8_97A9259: We shall grant it both no quarter, and also no quarters.
Dialogue.2A94A2D84C592F38F05796A4CF5376DA_97A9259: We should ask the vampires for help.
Dialogue.895A61B7481F72D070E16384738E35C8_06FC410: We should be closing in on the rifts.
Dialogue.C3D67D3F4337ED05178E71A543673F46_7F95CEB: We should be singing bridges, not burning them.
Dialogue.B21F45EA44B3F3755E18F8A7A5D1613E_97A9259: We should be throwing these at the husks.
Dialogue.7578D0D543B338A48EE233A6D62B5EC0_7D2960E: We should call this in, right?
Dialogue.923050A74A0D734BDAB850B751EBC27C_06FC410: We should check out those old cars.
Dialogue.BF5A9806433F547E8AEE08AB76E1FCDC_C0E27E7: We should do something about that.

Dialogue.3920070D4A77A7C3ED707D89504F73C4_06FC410: We should go check in on Tank and Ted. See how their terrible Christmas preparation is going.
Dialogue.06239E38472E581BFFF3808EE7EBE092_06FC410: We should go talk to Lars.
Dialogue.50B2F5994DC68703A8391CA1A187AA84_DB7CBEB: We should just act like we know exactly what we're doing and it's all very deep and meaningful.
Dialogue.BEC60B0246A1F32AAC1A2DBE4724FD32_06FC410: We should just focus on the fact that everyone's out here trying our hardest and--

Dialogue.C5E613074E9EF89F23A04CAA40BF5CCB_06FC410: We should maybe not do this.
Dialogue.CA82F80041AEED7D45E475B8664C812E_84C369E: We should probably close that rift, huh?
Dialogue.3CA23F7B4D4CA867453FE08991D4C2F3_B222EAD: We should probably just leave Brainstorm here.
Dialogue.8F6E4EB44E53CA573E23AEB838E6B1FE_06FC410: We should screen it for home base!
Dialogue.F01A038640619DF0AD032BB330A5C963_06FC410: We should start measuring the quakes. Deploy remote seismographs.
Dialogue.F37FEC104115EC45FAD34DAF0BECF011_97A9259: We should stay and keep him distracted.
Dialogue.976D0A224E1DCA02D53FEE9DE2320A45_06FC410: We should stop the storm from doing whatever it's planning on doing.
Dialogue.64DDAF7043D2F21854B5A9BB5E8422D4_06FC410: We should to team up with some other commanders.
Dialogue.3BBF944949DBE4036E9934B23FDDB851_06FC410: We should work on the ending.

Dialogue.1E503E27449FC5DA05E48692438D7D33_1D2FE88: We soon learned to navigate using the purple flames,
Dialogue.4B23DC95462656E68148FB94EBA92A92_D87E161: We stand and fight, even when it's the stupidest thing possible to do.
Dialogue.A8C44CEF44E9C96751D443B354BDBAB4_9D00593: We stayed up all night making it.
Dialogue.49EB959D44756B072228C7AFAF6BB13C_06FC410: We still have time to make this work.
Dialogue.F083A5464A399FE8A8285AA3615EC87B_47CFF90: We swabbed the deck after losing the battle with seasickness...
Dialogue.822A85564085B88F8B1CDF83DB318272_72190CE: We swore an oath to each other. Pirates for life.
Dialogue.D1002D234999B6331B02AC9DD515855D_47CFF90: We take a multi-pronged attacked, starting with scream therapy and following up with team-building.
Dialogue.99C276C04CBCDB1F777DD098C679B009_97A9259: We the soldiers of Homebase are very afraid of you.
Dialogue.8966635D479343784DD3C5B9144D7574_7D086D9: We think they're responsible for some of the strange things we've been experiencing.
Dialogue.1071506943E9A7C21A0FF7B03783BDA9_0BE868E: We think you should focus on the Takers first.
Dialogue.220BB6E34A0F62E228D683BD209386A4_97A9259: We three judges find the defendant guilty as charged.
Dialogue.E7A92ECE4B523D33206E8E833D158096_EAAE146: We tracked down one of the actual crowns of the Seven Pirate Kings.
Dialogue.460699DA4EBEC63125FC6BBE92DF06D8_72190CE: We trapped you in a box for reasons I still don't completely understand.
Dialogue.9C9172CC4CAFDBED12BFDA878D5E6573_9801E98: We tried to explain to him that you can't do that... but he wasn't having it.
Dialogue.6E0F83F54FF78F96C195679B9ABAB445_9D00593: We unleashed so much joy to the world that every single monster in the storm took notice.
Dialogue.12E2CA1A407D48C4EA5E9F91E55C20CD_D1275FF: We use our powers for good, once we know what they are.
Dialogue.68E34BB94AEA8E0900097383483930AB_CC240C1: We want that burner super hot, so add some of your BluGlo!
Dialogue.3461386B4ED201F9687174A4310EBA4B_FB122F8: We want them to know... y'know... we're there for them.
Dialogue.A3584F96477FD0F51B327BB96546CAFF_06FC410: We want to have the worst Christmas ever. On purpose.
Dialogue.25A983B349E7B34968BF25B25989A5C4_06FC410: We want to let the suit take 20% damage to test its capabilities.
Dialogue.984FE3384C9C60CB78E5659ECC770F67_A96EA86: We want to place it as close to the point of impact as possible.
Dialogue.1AC7A2674491662E7E2CFC9B5CAE45D8_97A9259: We want to see what peak performance looks like... from a schnoz-sniffing perspective.
Dialogue.E83A94FB42CC7C7891E5C681BEBA700D_7D2960E: We weathered the storm a good while, but...
Dialogue.089D144649A6BD7564C60E89A74669EC_94F2B66: We were completely surrounded... I lost them.
Dialogue.C0941A4A46DFD8165747BABAB90770EC_89ED452: We were defending our Fortress, keeping everyone inside safe, when there was a huge wave of husks.
Dialogue.45DB161C418B1A996EF33696B095333D_06FC410: We were going to use everything you collected to make presents for the survivors back at base.
Dialogue.D73E86EE4AF001170BC0B8955B63E2BE_97A9259: We were just blowing off steam.
Dialogue.0F9D732B4318E163A034748DE6910AF3_FB122F8: We were on the "Love is War" tour, so we all wore wings.
Dialogue.34983D684E5A2F8D02034CB96FC80E1F_06FC410: We were pretty close for a while.
Dialogue.D81188B147C7A3F6311E30BB2BE8CF68_B222EAD: We were together before I went to the hotel. Before all... well, all of this.
Dialogue.867B188D4A452554016BCDA27C47543F_4731F06: We were under siege for what felt like weeks.
Dialogue.D4885F804268C3BA4019A2A7D0269979_7712BEE: We were very close to slashing our way out of here.

Dialogue.14C56B8543DDA8A68C6BAE98D3FE9C80_94F2B66: We will all do our part, soldier.
Dialogue.1EB8F0454B943BF360492FACB679D81C_94F2B66: We will be acting the role by assuming the identity of fictional character, Santa Claus.
Dialogue.EB204E924559380A075F6E91A1031644_861A10F: We will call upon the most monstrous guest of all... Jeff!
Dialogue.D552339B4F1144756F4125AF082DB43D_D1275FF: We will carry out the plan that ideally someone else has prepared!
Dialogue.F38FF5664B579E143288B8A4BAACA315_8106785: We will emerge victorious or choke their rivers with our dead.
Dialogue.C778CBB74B565683111683B050B72A5D_06FC410: We will fight on in your memory.
Dialogue.2DDA0A25417B2D93E269E8BC78905714_06FC410: We will figure out what to do, but you have to keep this secret for now.
Dialogue.274EADB645598DBDECD8BAACE9B7A052_06FC410: We will find a cure for this and you'll see, at heart, Rarnold is no good.
Dialogue.FD63322744A7AEDD6636C790B91F7AF2_06FC410: We will find a solution for you and for Ted.

Dialogue.34A284E44579EAD338D0FBABAA6F081D_94F2B66: We will not make the same mistake twice.
Dialogue.CFF042444D8E6B7BB2B08C99DEBD41F6_9801E98: We will… take what we can get!
Dialogue.CCD765234E5B377BD44E018A104F1FDE_DCC9B6A: We win and look cute doing it.
Dialogue.F84F0811446A9931BED47BA1BA5582FA_025DC3B: We would like to welcome you to...
Dialogue.22CD2F0F4A951D805149E285145A6C00_06FC410: We wouldn't defeat you, Dire. You're one of the good sometimes-guys.
Dialogue.1827021E4D671C0EFD464AA3168F1EF6_06FC410: We'd better disarm the ship before the pirates come back.
Dialogue.858EA9204BF6416A702D7E9F1B03A581_A96EA86: We'd better figure out what we're dealing with.
Dialogue.08755B5345EB5C51D9B641AA489A262F_FB122F8: We'd better keep deploying sensors if we're gonna cut through all these pheromones.
Dialogue.2F8AD0E8485C04A39DD6A99BF8B8B38E_A96EA86: We'd better move to the edge of the crater before dropping the next scanner.
Dialogue.5FF847D24F094CA36E86EA8E2DC85EA0_47CFF90: We'd better search the wreckage for Blakebeard and Keelhaul.
Dialogue.6E7A625A41688C4340F4F0B6E1D13051_FB122F8: We'd have to send an expedition...
