Dialogue.BE18A3AD48369D9FB278D9AC649E6DC5_724DAF1: Well, look, let’s not celebrate prematurely, alright? We've still got a lot of work ahead of us to beat this thing. I wanna get back to the lab.
Dialogue.5224BB5E4EBFEC346F171A91F7E4AA01_FB122F8: Well, looks like the Commander has finished lighting all the candles.
Dialogue.5CEE636245475598DF787784645093AE_06FC410: Well, maybe Vinderman's mansion is near a pig or something.
Dialogue.3A8E58E14C896A50FA9F9CB97EB0E15A_7D2960E: Well, maybe my backstory doesn't need to involve law school AND my rivalry with a jewel thief AND training at a moon-karate dojo.
Dialogue.56B8387E45B927B55E107EB4DE5C76C5_06FC410: Well, maybe this will take our minds off of the horrors to come.
Dialogue.17C5AD59466DCE6773BB9F914AD47B66_9801E98: Well, maybe you'd better just come see for yourself.
Dialogue.3010364043782202277640A07D68A577_14FBFB1: Well, my brain feels like it's being put through a taffy puller, but other than that, utterly terrible.
Dialogue.E643F2884AC05738E1E6E98DAE51A4AB_B229E47: Well, not for Dr. Vinderman, of course, but... but I get a chance to help solve the very problem that killed my maker.
Dialogue.E4FDD01442769E9CE0B878A2B4BD0D97_B222EAD: Well, not me... but one guy at the Oakdirge would push people off the balconies then laugh and laugh.
Dialogue.BBADD56F490465CABF22F6B580E2D676_06FC410: Well, not today. Because I am three exasperated sighs past give up time with no sanity in sight.
Dialogue.B94411EE4CB2B10D77D83C86FC264F1D_06FC410: Well, not true. I am down to my last idea.
Dialogue.46DA928A4F4F7B4310471D9246395285_DA0538A: Well, now don’t you look friendly.
Dialogue.5BD36F2145E3550FEC6D3DB9450CAB0E_87F0BBB: Well, now we need to learn about the past.
Dialogue.649D7AA7466317746DE19B9084461071_06FC410: Well, now you know everything I never wanted you to know while I'm alive...
Dialogue.543CF72A48236B858B05968E682EE363_DA0538A: Well, now. Merry Christmas to me.
Dialogue.8B066EEE432603CC1DF7BCBFA90142CD_06FC410: Well, our goals are aligned even though our intentions are not.
Dialogue.A3801C254E850A0E26C0A691A88CDA9E_4731F06: Well, ownership is an illusion so... I'm over it.
Dialogue.3A28554C4F05B75FAE5049A4F8702721_06FC410: Well, slashers. If you're out there... lurking in the woods.
Dialogue.03ECB61A448ADF2C429FB29B54F07025_CC240C1: Well, structurally speaking it's a bit late in the adventure to introduce a new threat.
Dialogue.8D5EF8344780B1801A55B5A58D4ADE3F_861A10F: Well, summoning the guests. And that's why I need you, Dennis. The summoning soup!
Dialogue.B2376093452501784956769239740130_97A9259: Well, swap out the magnets for first dates...
Dialogue.55368F904CE2BFF5CA49DC826B2DF46C_47CFF90: Well, technically, I've never seen that husk before so...
Dialogue.60F291614E5C584EC8E882BFAD68DE4E_06FC410: Well, thank you for keeping it short.
Dialogue.CA3F5D3E41A5955DECF4B9B71CEAA589_97A9259: Well, that doesn't have to be your job.
Dialogue.396F9F1C4180AECF748368ABC539A769_DA0538A: Well, that wasn’t Nice List behavior.
Dialogue.C297EE46499FE2C42AD3CDB3B5A39507_06FC410: Well, that's about nine down and... a few thousand to go.
Dialogue.C30BD46C4E543479D3016EA1317C522B_47CFF90: Well, that's another adventure in the books.
Dialogue.649C5AE844C06C5DE63EC68CD70977F5_06FC410: Well, that's easy. He's out of his mind.
Dialogue.174193A5460120E058C1AC92E8D3430C_21C1927: Well, that's me! See you real soon!
Dialogue.E57B2187477B4BEEAF5F10ADC6056EFE_47CFF90: Well, that's me. Good luck, Commander.
Dialogue.F486D28D4A02D85801F0A8BF18E2D98D_C9708CA: Well, that's not what really happened.
Dialogue.AAA2C18A420BF4E9911CE0897D82EB29_DA0538A: Well, that's the least holly-jolly troll I’ve ever seen!
Dialogue.1C42DB9A41A6EA186DDD9EBE0A38D07E_14FBFB1: Well, the pleasure is all yours.
Dialogue.F7EA53C34798A0A33A6D25BA15AE6FF8_06FC410: Well, then, you are no longer welcome at Homebase.
Dialogue.1B6D36B64B1521FF95CF6E8CB8D9A1E1_FB122F8: Well, there are things we can control and things we can't. All we can do is make the best choices with what we have.
Dialogue.A002C51E478F832411C5B6A9BE1B2D38_06FC410: Well, there goes that warm, glowing symbol of my life's work.
Dialogue.F66AF4404768AD84740973BA9BE15389_861A10F: Well, there is a lot of snogging going down in the zone. Ooh! Are you getting your horoscope read?
Dialogue.1E2964B147E6A775E7058A8A8C54B51E_FB122F8: Well, there were four of us working together.
Dialogue.396537944E51A47714B95F86453BCA33_FB122F8: Well, this explains why Ray's announcements yesterday were cryptic and apology-based.
Dialogue.1447A390419F246184DED9896251BC0D_06FC410: Well, this is a map, but it's a map of the Durr Burger Kingdom.
Dialogue.B2911C3C433190E5FAEA5C8932F374F8_94F2B66: Well, this is me telling you.
Dialogue.1EC0613B48E3F810E783338183E50B2A_97A9259: Well, this one quake happened when I was looking at a clock.
Dialogue.D62E3B2A4F336DE6776CC9A2D6ED4F1A_FB122F8: Well, to really analyze the new data I need to compare it to my old research..
Dialogue.1F3B1E9140DD0713BFD4AD8BFD61EAF8_FB122F8: Well, we didn't react to the news that everyone is going to die with the appropriate amount of chill.
Dialogue.060F20E14F5C5DCABD19B1AC96E96FA3_06FC410: Well, we know one werewolf who can.
Dialogue.151D6C2642C4508CD30D02B5259EA564_06FC410: Well, we might not have figured out how to fix the energy field, but at least now we know something magical is causing it.
Dialogue.BEA2DAF84B39AC11E2B6B2A63F1C9FFC_FB122F8: Well, we should probably investigate it unless we want to suffer the same fate.
Dialogue.93C705A54BE475C5CEB8FA82178610B5_97A9259: Well, we think we're mindfully recoupling, but we might be mindfully uncoupling.
Dialogue.529602124076F9CC579701ADE7D3769B_06FC410: Well, we'll never know if we don't try.
Dialogue.221A6AD8408BE78A0703F1B0919F9733_06FC410: Well, we're out here trying, at least. And... maybe that's worth celebrating.
Dialogue.16ABB1C5459EE22D82165CA29B67BFA1_94F2B66: Well, well. Guess I owe THERAPY-Bot twenty bucks. Nice work, rookie.
Dialogue.5C2F061948E82B0917802CAFCF2B2C1D_06FC410: Well, what does all that scientific equipment of yours say?
Dialogue.BAFC92FB41448BF3D646C8A47DA00318_72190CE: Well, what if I don't want to?
Dialogue.3BF314D346DF8289EB2DCD8D0877A1B3_06FC410: Well, whatever's happening, I'm glad I'm not affected.
Dialogue.0E49B48C4EDB564829E5BE9D3D00D02B_97A9259: Well, when I started it, I thought it would be simple.
Dialogue.F145E8A343B6C9AAAF9A40B6301B14C3_06FC410: Well, why don't you take some time to think things through?
Dialogue.EAD53E494995068B0ADF618EE3A5FE3B_97A9259: Well, yeah, most of my plans go horribly wrong, all the time. Because I'm not, like, a time travel scientist, or a superhero, or a licensed landscape architect…
Dialogue.3C66EBA54E576D4ACECF148374F0314A_06FC410: Well, you can't have a list of demands without hostages.
Dialogue.9CA084D84CE834896245D2B153233338_06FC410: Well, you could say we already have.
Dialogue.0BF93FBC4C77819ED06706B8797003A6_B222EAD: Well, you guys are so capable and really seem to know what you're doing.
Dialogue.148DFFA640D7D785BE3CE38A4F49D61F_AB3C42C: Well, you know what your vision is...
Dialogue.A078F4EC40D78ED3E39664A84D870551_47CFF90: Well, you'll get there. One ahoy at a time.
Dialogue.E42D9BAA42C4D01806F8BD8DB6BDFB47_B222EAD: Well, you're at least a semi-functioning cluster of people and bots.
Dialogue.C83472EB4D6EEC0721BC6FAE0CF94CA1_21C1927: Well, you're not gonna like this, but the mission is to destroy all the Slurp we can find.
Dialogue.286EF2FD43F7772763FB3B8971C01329_06FC410: Well, you've been eliminating, "like, a bunch of us," too. And you did it first.
Dialogue.63E88C3D4F8FD03F3986F9B26ABBD855_765440C: Well, you've saved the day... from being saved!
Dialogue.A042598542F8620036765A8DED5FC0B3_47CFF90: Well, you've seen my team in action. What do you think?
Dialogue.1E3D44634ABE25E865B639AF8B855086_97A9259: Well, your Majesty, here is your kingdom.
Dialogue.18C363AB404521987C7B8083105C0963_FB122F8: Well, your weather balloons are perfect for the short term forecast.
Dialogue.3B3693C340F472A5A9AAE6BEE3BC4578_06FC410: Well. Here you go. One fancy suit.
Dialogue.02F13FD6434EBB3D69F8D2A7490069C7_21C1927: Well. I didn't exactly rally the troops.
Dialogue.4DE53D4442CF57CBA24DC6AE7FB00471_181CD3E: Well. I guess that's the kind of lukewarm sentiment I can emotionally get behind right now.
Dialogue.1DE915B14FEDBFDBF3F3F4B646C78893_06FC410: Well. Neither is losing a ghost fight because a.. a very well-dressed jar's brain juice got weird!
Dialogue.B301660047B3721C532E12BF60ECF39B_CC240C1: Well. Nobody likes it, but we've come to terms with its presence.
Dialogue.C97C18D347C178ECB0475F83A50677CA_5CE5FC8: Well. Thank you for acknowledging the artistry.
Dialogue.F03BFD6E483C04D0FB02B7BF1168EB5C_37EFC25: Well. The Krampus is not usually one for physical labor… but, for you, I make an exception.
Dialogue.17A83C794DCE173D9F88098329B0A53F_06FC410: Well... I guess that's a problem for future us.
Dialogue.995639F346CB1D5E7D390B9C4E3577D4_06FC410: Well... I have a backup plan.
Dialogue.6F4DC6B944F66F2B2A539A84BC7BAD6A_47CFF90: Well... I think Ray was prepared for this exact moment.
Dialogue.E674D34040DA9C5283EA35AB024C9EF8_CC240C1: Well... I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise.
Dialogue.31EB66A3437D3E192F2D37BC8A5763D7_CC240C1: Well... I'd like to be you when you grow up when I grow up.
Dialogue.23A3B6814E278E058678E0B609509293_CC240C1: Well... I'm always happy to see you.
Dialogue.CD8B84044867E319738DA89C4A35871C_06FC410: Well... Let's look for more data. Or socks.
Dialogue.616BD08B43BC1BEBB34F249219DF8CAE_D87E161: Well... Penny will. I said that's who I was.
Dialogue.88B8BE674C7AD5BE0B44EA92E78146A6_06FC410: Well... best case we've made this place a whole lot less evil.
Dialogue.D384DE354332F41896C10BA4BDD1FED7_06FC410: Well... let's tell Ned the bad news.
Dialogue.220BC88040903D86958E689EF9D6A72F_06FC410: Well... on the bright side, I think we have everything we need.
Dialogue.9E2457AC40DE3F5CCEC0F2A315E401B7_97A9259: Well... picture this. You've stolen a bunch of primo ingredients for a world-class burger out of the dumpster. Top-skimmings, so they're still mostly fresh.
Dialogue.E7740A5F485E286A5935EBB98567A839_87F0BBB: Well... sorry, Lars, but deleting your ex's pictures off your phone just isn't as satisfying as rippin' em up.
Dialogue.38CB03FC46DBFA646400689A6FC1DFF1_B222EAD: Well... that depends on how honest everyone is being with themselves in this scenario.
Dialogue.F5AA1DFD43F37DA7002BC28346700EE4_06FC410: Well... that started an arms race.
Dialogue.7F34BE0E479B0C7AD942FCBDD2CCE435_CC240C1: Well...okay. I only asked five people, but, of those who responded, uh... they seemed to think so.
Dialogue.178B6D9D4196D84DD0CC5BA4C56EB589_B68F328: Well… alright. What’s the worst that could happen?
Dialogue.F3AF1D124A2FF6C0079243892EA7A0A2_94F2B66: Welp. Goodnight. Don't let the bedbugs... burn.
Dialogue.0BCA48EB4B5001FCE856D2957C9B16DF_724DAF1: Welp. That's it for the pilot.
Dialogue.04D564EA47001E371F201CB43D8FF814_06FC410: Were these attackers from another nation or tribe? Or something more sinister.
Dialogue.541EDA1640B95300EDB6AFACAA6F3E53_FB122F8: Were you being serious about that library of silence?
Dialogue.0E60CB85412DE18FFC7C649150B4CE21_FB122F8: Were you listening to me sleep?
Dialogue.613C83F747E45CB7CC8ECB8D2B613084_47CFF90: We’ll go over proper procedure for peg leg care and storage later. I’ve got a pamphlet.
Dialogue.FC948FAE4F2B14FCC139A193050D2B90_06FC410: We’ll have Spitfire’s suit completed in no time.
Dialogue.D89FE1E245D495DD141A91B74429D8F4_06FC410: Wha- I thought we had that whole situation wrapped up? At least I thought...we did?
Dialogue.729C2CAB4C5E527C452A6DB7B5EEF032_84C369E: Wha-?Throwin' each other? That is cheating.
Dialogue.2DC42F674154D37B4C3E79B5FE2CD0B2_CC240C1: What I saw was really, really scary.
Dialogue.39E4F2EE463F2CB3D804C3B6B1661823_FB122F8: What I was getting at is we're looking at a triple cell storm.
Dialogue.B33395DB4EAE0C21FC87CD8634E49E71_AFB40E2: What I would love... is for you to pick me up.
Dialogue.05D9DE7B4F042E6A925328A97C16483A_1D2FE88: What I'm saying is he's a bit of jerk.
Dialogue.4FB7014E427E2CDC998F5E8F25CF2B37_06FC410: What I'm saying is... there's a Mega Gunslinger husk on the loose.
Dialogue.6F0F127E46DC8F209ECBFB8EEC019A7E_06FC410: What Lars doesn't know won't hurt him.
Dialogue.00586F3C469120784ABEFFB8C376F12B_7D2960E: What Lars said about me not being my own man...
Dialogue.BC34185A4CC3D630E63A82B131A57943_B222EAD: What a coincidence. I'd like you to meet my friend, Blakebeard...
Dialogue.373CB8AD4D423C72ED043896DAD224FF_861A10F: What a fascinating glimpse into animal behavior.
Dialogue.2E0FCF6C486789373302A7A8EFA6C34C_1D2FE88: What a miserable little cheater I was.
Dialogue.FCC84090431D0BEB295893944F3052B7_1D2FE88: What a pity. The last key has been found.
Dialogue.C2C114C8405496EA56A8D482A50D3C75_21C1927: What a tasty cup of tea.
Dialogue.A34D2D014AADCAA245AC30A8616E457E_06FC410: What about Cloaks? He can do darkness!
Dialogue.5714AED843E293123498FAAF15D896B5_14FBFB1: What about lone wolves? Rebels without a cause, serving justice as they see fit?
Dialogue.CDB461044D7D5E366D81C7B834AA3982_06FC410: What am I doing with my hands? Why are they so dumb and wrong?
Dialogue.E14025AF4DD53B61C1F98A97C8D8B461_21C1927: What am I even? A- a doll? A weapon of war?
Dialogue.EA6913594899C7131C553296F22BF68F_21C1927: What am I gonna do? Oh fudge packets, Director Riggs, I'm not sure if I'm ready for that much responsibility.
Dialogue.62888CA34F5550DD38F31CBA65D404B2_FB122F8: What am I looking for, exactly?
Dialogue.DAEF83EA4DE68C40ED2D57A87036C39B_7D2960E: What am I supposed to be doing or learning here?
Dialogue.2FEAB0A34F74444F5B1164BA4CFC482A_7D2960E: What am I supposed to do then?
Dialogue.A16B1D2540B2037763139B9A4BB2CA9C_47CFF90: What am I supposed to do?
Dialogue.02789F03495BF46410CD80AEA2CC6A60_94F2B66: What am I, a hippie? Need ammo.
Dialogue.C84264E8494E49472250DDA4E55159FB_2DD597A: What am I? Some sort of rare ore in a cave or something over here?
Dialogue.25CF36D6435C64A03DB145B6BB2A08CD_AB3C42C: What are our orders, Captain Ray?
Dialogue.C2A422C2405D32EDFE47B592FE8F0AD0_06FC410: What are the chances Dr. Vinderman uploaded some sort of program to SEE-bot before, um... the accident?
Dialogue.531FD703464625930033B49A2B7A98AC_176484F: What are we gonna do about it?
Dialogue.34C3F9DA4974419F66A450A32F32E3D5_06FC410: What are we looking at here?
Dialogue.644C522F4702D1ECF19A5DB38802AACC_1B31EE2: What are ya waiting for? Get to jabbin'.
Dialogue.CA17DFB8467C3D7C0CF988AD32F01601_06FC410: What are you doing here? Is this... is this Meisner?
Dialogue.7F6C365B42E6F036EC61199BB969E5A3_D87E161: What are you going to do about it?
Dialogue.1C1E48FE4A0F26DD27E0A08DD2E82E94_FB122F8: What are you guys doing to the Hope Lanterns?
Dialogue.AD9BBF1D43871F46799D539CF73DDD6F_06FC410: What are you talkin' about? That's when he starts getting good.
Dialogue.95235FB64C9CCAF4F932FFAF95EECF7E_97A9259: What are you talking about? All I want is to find someone who loves me like you love Homebase.
Dialogue.DE26AF444353DCC5D4537FA794AD493D_FB122F8: What are you talking about? I have very eclectic tastes.
Dialogue.EEBA15654443F32856CD60A2BF1D1A8E_861A10F: What are you talking about? I'm over the moon!
Dialogue.E46CE8944B3821AF71FD20BA3CC168C1_06FC410: What are you talking about? Oh, wait. No. I just got the table thing.
Dialogue.4D6C678D419EE394B89554A48D904F23_06FC410: What are you talking about? Where are you going?
Dialogue.5311B43B4648754D6D3E8AB3EF9B3A5D_9F725B6: What are you thinking? What do you want to make?
Dialogue.4866C1374E90DB47984FD5A717F7C7F2_06FC410: What are you waiting for! Let's launch!
Dialogue.C2BD704D4D025838990C4D95EA468866_06FC410: What are you waiting for!? Crank 'em out!
Dialogue.3540E25445507EC0079448962AB92B44_97A9259: What are you, scared!? I double-demon dare you!
Dialogue.C36A614F499359C593DCA69C6216FA72_7712BEE: What are you, some sort of antislashist?
Dialogue.DE8960B245BB0DCC91FAF6B776914F83_06FC410: What are you, some sort of summer camp slasher expert?
Dialogue.1247007A4092634D56BD2AA5F005ABA8_87F0BBB: What are you? Homeschooled or somethin'?
Dialogue.88EFA28C415298B8318F2D81C167E266_97A9259: What can I do before Dennis Jr. leaves to make it up to him?
Dialogue.D1A3665540539370D2328DAD9FBDF66D_94F2B66: What can I say, I love ignoring things that don't matter.
Dialogue.17E07C2041FE61944E353CA2A335AF4C_87F0BBB: What can I say? I have a gift for making people realize how terrible other people are.
Dialogue.DCF6EA6941F32329C72BBD942D0A7AB9_0A979DB: What can I say? I love animals.
Dialogue.B97934EA4EA70C77338295BBAA5EAA20_FB122F8: What can we do for ya, Little Robot?
Dialogue.FE003A2B43D358BE96876E9AE71AD75D_07E024E: What did we ever do to you?
Dialogue.4B6DE1C74EF1BCDB515EE89428103E86_06FC410: What did you find? What's it say?
Dialogue.AAD3181547FF9189704C50A167E4CEE8_87F0BBB: What do we got, uh... dried rose petals, a bracelet, a stuffed molar that says, "I love you, that's the tooth."
Dialogue.B03E7C2B4300BC55E15A348EC8F60C28_0BE868E: What do you expect us to fight with? Snowballs?
Dialogue.B8D6AAE24813DDA3F517AC8E9CB39556_D87E161: What do you expect? Society doesn't want her to get it. It's not her fault.
Dialogue.97E172534E96FCE24415D99ADE4E23F3_DA0538A: What do you know? Just Santa’s size.
Dialogue.4A0FA84C4794E43F41ECEA99870818B7_CC240C1: What do you mean we don't have a Battleforce?
Dialogue.FC01F2BB4584AB860DB1AC8BE0277C96_7D2960E: What do you mean, "This is a test?"
Dialogue.B2E90CBF401ED76EB840CCB72DA75275_94F2B66: What do you say, Commander. Wanna check it out?
Dialogue.7EF53E7D409D2F2C984BC3B0710D8906_94F2B66: What do you say, are you ready to see some real action?
Dialogue.BD5377D4489A4C9415A097BB77508003_B229E47: What do you think I'm doing here, Desiree?
Dialogue.0BC3DCE14888543BFDCC37AED8ECE304_FB122F8: What do you think she was doing?
Dialogue.9E94474E46344A823DC964B8B992DD8A_06FC410: What do you think that means?
Dialogue.CEACD3FF4732DFF7D0BD90A03C432CD4_94F2B66: What do you use, the scientific meh-thod?
Dialogue.BEBFE80647B7FE4259B4B98081414613_FB122F8: What do you want me to shoot, finger guns?
Dialogue.8FD42EBE435CCBBF6502E5A256DF4B59_06FC410: What do you want to do, Commander?
Dialogue.43B9FB6F484117572025768ACC9E95D7_FB122F8: What do you want with a radio station anyway?
Dialogue.19EC36F741F2B8375C38A79FA942A5FB_06FC410: What do you want, Cloaked Star?
Dialogue.FC511BEF4111B61BE04CC38EC9E175CF_CC240C1: What does happen to the leftovers, hmm?
Dialogue.AB469F3A4C7C72D64F9AA6BBEC7630E1_21C1927: What else am I gonna do, stuffinhead?
Dialogue.B31E7F7741C344FB26D57A8ECF8C84A8_CC240C1: What else do ghosts do for fun?
Dialogue.0410F8F34264BD2A3B26CCB8ACAAB14B_7D2960E: What else do you expect me to do?
Dialogue.084B8B8C47D44FE2E571B0B8C4E00D70_89ED452: What else have I got going on?
Dialogue.35E21A78404DC121D718978DED0F65D5_47CFF90: What else were you expecting me to see?
Dialogue.32C30FF84DFD56D58F55888E2A6C5CC5_06FC410: What exactly are you making and why?
Dialogue.1A0D20F846A89454FAF5A787E64F3CEF_9D00593: What games can you play with a train, Lars?
Dialogue.F81AB99D42E3BB8058D9ABA099FA3524_CC240C1: What happened to the major's hand? In the story?
Dialogue.0882FB2E4F66FC33C65B8F85BA25ACE2_06FC410: What happened? Please, just tell us. Don't make it a game.
Dialogue.AF4E00D147DCA1F1309F8FB95783708B_7D2960E: What happens if I decide I don't want to have a change of heart?
Dialogue.7C450EFA4BCCF4293BE4FC9A4F30E6FC_CC240C1: What have you been up to?
Dialogue.39A0EC8A4F624CF03F1087BD3A38F2C2_97A9259: What if Dennis Jr's timeline is so good now that he doesn't need any of these cans?
Dialogue.54D6B00C4EA6FD5DFA57EC8559948E7C_7D2960E: What if I don't know how to be my own man?
Dialogue.2A438B9C409FDC851807EF982684F0FD_72190CE: What if I get sorted in with all the other pirates?
Dialogue.987168234F1AD7F38D4A46A157E7B6D8_97A9259: What if he's so afraid of his destiny that he runs away and causes a time-shame paradox?
Dialogue.4674262148161D8C8B000BABB5BE986F_06FC410: What if moving forward means we start making something bad?
Dialogue.09233C7D48CA306FFE6E8BBBEE8001A9_CC240C1: What if my monster is like the dinosaur meteor?
Dialogue.885BD64C43770B6F9D1D389282256808_B25AF7B: What if no one likes me? Am I getting the flu? Is Sophie mad at me?
Dialogue.59BBAD8C4CB4175AE582A8A5B835C1FA_97A9259: What if there are all kinds of were-things out there?
Dialogue.2B5881F74F9F3700BDB4E794E31FBDA6_47CFF90: What if they throw them back?
Dialogue.1A0773444C9B4AF95A2D2DB9AE5700A9_861A10F: What if we destroyed the helmet instead?
Dialogue.D8104E074B3260D5C19E629A14956D8D_14FBFB1: What in the dark skies above is this man talking about?
Dialogue.70960C5647EC228C16FFF2ACEEC9D0FC_F6B1D98: What in the world is wrong with you? I thought I was your friend!
Dialogue.30E25B704052D10DB932688A7C8CB9DF_724DAF1: What is it about legendary gunslinger Blackboot Ayers that fascinates us to this day?
Dialogue.F657893E4604EBC4A09ACB896C0A0141_06FC410: What is it, Dire? You got the secret to defeating the wolfpack?
Dialogue.7A8C15144FA3BB616E4A9BA264963E52_06FC410: What is the status report, Dennis?
Dialogue.3B8BDC6B4B5CE6BFDDB2C68CF1E9651A_06FC410: What is your deal, Owl Troop?
Dialogue.35F938524BE0EC5B8C0C2E851821E59F_06FC410: What is your plan, exactly, with these containers?
Dialogue.D332420645E4170E122678A70B3D3559_9D00593: What kind of dino are you holdin'?
Dialogue.17F386774F24ED023E2CCF87DBB0545B_06FC410: What kind of future do you see with Rarnold, Penny?
Dialogue.4903707647AE45922595318789693F02_47CFF90: What kind of werewolf goes to a meeting at the Super Sprinkle Birthday Cupcake Moon?
Dialogue.CE87355F42AE80D53A9FCAB005F8D5C3_77D814F: What makes you think that would happen?
Dialogue.CFD9C73B44C29F9155BFD3ADB481191A_94F2B66: What makes your monster so scary?
Dialogue.A706EA8A4D2BC0B133C7539067BDAAE5_06FC410: What script-- ...Oh my god, Dennis, what have you done!?
Dialogue.CFB7BCDA442EC774183AF980118AD0E7_06FC410: What she's gonna do is shoot you with an adorable gun bear.
Dialogue.63903B67427B6CBB1FEAFF8998C63A98_06FC410: What sort of messages are we shootin' these days?
Dialogue.079E45EF4BB969ED886BC5AF62953425_B222EAD: What television has done to this generation of ghost hunters is unforgivable.
Dialogue.18222D044B48044C3E8489829280F50D_2A04943: What the hell is that thing?
Dialogue.A54BA5994729A66F47E96FB1A863F543_97A9259: What up. I'm Dennis. Semi-pro ghost hunter and Ghost Boss in training.
Dialogue.A8DC2F5E4D78DA50BBFE04A3E9F33E86_97A9259: What was that, Lok? Oh, you're right. We should go walk... over... that way.
Dialogue.C2B3652C4BCF7F28F5D3238F8926135A_06FC410: What was this strange cipher? A warning? A prophecy? No one can say for sure.
Dialogue.88DBE1784B1D5FE5C26B068C793AB492_9F725B6: What was your favorite toy when you were a kid?
Dialogue.A3899F454AF0479AA3F5ABAB755138D8_AFB40E2: What we think of as love is a simple chemical reaction.
Dialogue.EE56D3294F69086B550BA9AE2AA41029_910A467: What we've made stinks so terribly, you can smell the failure in space.
Dialogue.9DEE0B3945057FE1146B8B811D18C50D_97A9259: What were we- oh! Have you seen that racoon video? With the cotton candy?
Dialogue.8664C1B54F86F4A7531B428338C83D1A_06FC410: What were you even going to do with this stuff?
Dialogue.9756E0E34D0BCC72FC238A860EFFF187_7D086D9: What were you hoping to accomplish by whispering into an open team com?
Dialogue.601A012842841F0E0F3EEEBA3B292878_06FC410: What were you hoping would happen with all this?
Dialogue.45BE51D84CD765A5E7B8CB892D2F53BF_B222EAD: What would she say if I put on a box and called myself her robot friend? "Beepity boop!"
Dialogue.C14AAD6A4E07BD1A4E8E339D757A3235_94F2B66: What you have right now is a job.
Dialogue.4C334FBA46F839BB2C6BDC9E30231295_06FC410: What you just did to Lok was really, really cruel.
Dialogue.C82DC13E4A2211AEE213EC994B4EBE7A_94F2B66: What you meant to say was "Sir. Yes. Sir!"
Dialogue.E90D5F0B438E83FF394D05A4F909BD82_C0AFF0C: What you see is what you get.
Dialogue.90CEF4A8428405B50700A99A5FF9DD97_06FC410: What you'll see through these telescopes will be frightening.
Dialogue.ED482EA0418C41AD3B87FA8F912E5CFC_84C369E: What!? I was still mastering my Running Man!
Dialogue.8AA678AF47A31B748582D78FC8DF83D1_06FC410: What!? We need to find those balloons!
Dialogue.A2C0E0B44216A1670EC147A6B2F94F88_7F95CEB: What'll it take to change your tune?
Dialogue.C3A3652A425BE3AD7B7EDCA5E9C7BB4C_21C1927: What're you tryin to prove, Ted?
Dialogue.E50A909445B664618F499B922E061099_94F2B66: What're you, writing a novel over there?
Dialogue.518F98C84324CE0C303CDCBD2D677119_9D00593: What's "up" is that no ghost would bother wasting the energy to haunt a stranger. Who's the spector, Clip?
Dialogue.C4EEF9654A3E4041E11A81859E2CEE68_FB122F8: What's got you all riled up, little robot?
Dialogue.362CF9224C5A8B10752FEE89B01D9B44_9D00593: What's jollier than a snowball fight?
Dialogue.CC12F8C04B2BAF815FB7BB9DB85651EB_06FC410: What's life without a little romance?
Dialogue.0ED9703542A29AD12582738FE70C211A_7D2960E: What's my focus? Contracts? Tort law? Criminal defense?
Dialogue.FA8559604C78DAFCE8E2139F968DD19A_B222EAD: What's one more ghost in a place like this?
Dialogue.D6C0D90E421759EBFB7480A0F31982D9_06FC410: What's that? You're breaking up. I can't -
Dialogue.A6E06B244BB640BDCBBA57B7D1F9B7FC_21C1927: What's that? Your hostess has been attending public speaking classes and wants to practice on y'all with a toast?
Dialogue.039FD9C64111BD147A45C49FE5EAA6E7_06FC410: What's the answer you're looking for?
Dialogue.6CF2BDAF4F99FBE46B805DA7F647EA78_B222EAD: What's the matter? Got somehwere to go?
Dialogue.4DC82C85444B72AF955D1599EA15E78A_7D2960E: What's the name of that brooding guy? Blanket something?
Dialogue.F10CD00B4F3DF35E1C27FF9173C3EC60_94F2B66: What's the name of the song?
Dialogue.1C019E3D4CEF8C42083E3D9EF90A1436_B222EAD: What's the point of my even being here?
Dialogue.8ADA1E584310443C7A55E5B41DF526E2_7D086D9: What's the status on retrieving SEE-Bot?
Dialogue.DADB7D724F882444437ED28D427DA381_06FC410: What's the worse idea, taking direction from dried up weeds...
Dialogue.7536DCC04DD101A9F002118DEC10ED66_B222EAD: What's the worst she could say?
Dialogue.A19AE29F46410146F580199090596BCA_06FC410: What's this? Wrinkled yellow pages, strangely perfect penmanship..
Dialogue.6508640B4CBB61BAEDF79B9F1CF494D7_724DAF1: What's up, you found the secret track.
Dialogue.D934196B45367EA053C58D9597604811_FB122F8: What's with the guitar case on your truck?
Dialogue.86E0F0C84EF52DAA7676D79FA8B8CD12_06FC410: What's your situation out here, Ramirez?
Dialogue.E7FB2955439E44AFBA901CA222E2C8E5_D87E161: What, are you all soft now?
Dialogue.0F4A8389434963B9D2984AB9317911B9_06FC410: What, you didn't get the invite?
Dialogue.FCAE00424A2C0538660F589F7C257D2D_06FC410: What, you got a hot date or something? Heh.
Dialogue.CA07F92944B82E99485B7AB301C087C0_06FC410: What, you want me to read their diaries or something?
Dialogue.4D20884A4262142764A16D8CF2C3603C_FB122F8: What... exactly am I looking at here?
Dialogue.B0798B2F4F5CBB9E41EAFDA78C783D3D_FB122F8: What? Alone in the storm in the middle of nowhere?
Dialogue.E707DC0A4BC85AF3FA19D2AF628A6CB3_06FC410: What? Does this mean all my dreams are coming true?
Dialogue.073716F445DF9C10B301AF9E5E32F1AA_CC240C1: What? I just want to invite everyone to my Jonnie Galactus marathon.
Dialogue.0112055E4D5581735749BC927223816E_87F0BBB: What? It's got a lot of pictures. It's not like he can read.
Dialogue.970196BD4D6DF780A83898B88ADC5B89_47CFF90: What? No! Have you... Do you have any idea what a “simulator” is?
Dialogue.298581DB49609658C81309AB31A0F09D_FB122F8: What? No, no! Other people are scared of those flags. You guys are supposed to be doing the scaring!
Dialogue.717C4ADD4FA277FB17DA51A84D8F38F0_47CFF90: What? Ooooh, Rarrnold and Arrlene are holding hands!
Dialogue.C1E42B5C463AAF21D4D922A9EBE1E993_06FC410: What? What is it? What is so important that it couldn't wait?
Dialogue.F5A07B9E4D7F74924CE8829B819AD4FF_CC240C1: What? What is it? What should we do? We should panic, right? Right!?
Dialogue.55B8C4224F20891FA2631FB0D9F165A7_FB122F8: What? Whoa, whoa, no no no no no no. Nothing like that. It was fruit. Gotta get my vitamin C fix, y'know?
Dialogue.D742CD1C485F8C8996C7D39ABA0EE8AC_06FC410: What? Why didn't you stop them, ED-EE?
Dialogue.2305812B4C5507589EAF80BBD66BE465_94F2B66: What? Why didn't you tell me sooner, son?
Dialogue.290B24184F4466F0C78E8E8E4A965207_06FC410: What? Why hasn't he been helping?
Dialogue.1003E3B4478C923853FEA9B8B7933318_B222EAD: What? You gonna eat me, Dennis?
Dialogue.90F8578241AE0CAAD56901B1CBCAC0FA_7D2960E: What? You think I can't handle watching a little fight...?
Dialogue.CDD73E7D46A524EBE52ECE9CB4F6589F_D87E161: Whatever gets you through the night.
Dialogue.72F3403E407678103F7E17A8866A1ACF_7D2960E: Whatever guy you want. Bats work on everybody.
Dialogue.E7BB9E4A4E4D3E9338E93D938019F200_FB122F8: Whatever it is, it's sending out enough romantic vibes for a mega ballad.
Dialogue.EEA1348542490EB3DDC90E8594CE928A_FB122F8: Whatever it is, we've got your back.
Dialogue.5C61DA8F4DF9067665B0D5BFAECA079B_9801E98: Whatever that is, I like it.
Dialogue.7E6D9FEC45A11E8EC045D6AB6A4D1693_5AA487F: Whatever that is, I like it.
Dialogue.1DECFC5A487979755C4B50A70389E273_06FC410: Whatever the evil version of crickets is...
Dialogue.CAF4DA6448CBD5CD04587F848C3281E4_181CD3E: Whatever was in me that made the Morpho Gear Gang... it's gone.
Dialogue.22BFF41E4503F3927763449B46A10BB6_06FC410: Whatever you do, don't stop running.
Dialogue.871A4EDF4EF4D6C1B2B48082A53EBE86_FB122F8: Whatever you say, Little Robot. But if I sleep, I'll have that dream again.
Dialogue.9F19DD9546D97AD9B8A64B991866AC1F_E090F2A: Whatever you say, kid, I'll do it!
Dialogue.A280A3004492F04F403240A826E81016_47CFF90: Whatever you think you should do tomorrow, do the opposite instead.
Dialogue.26FC867E4BCCA0165509138FAC390B91_97A9259: Whatever you want to do, just go nuts.
Dialogue.576633D94042F5C02C66E08ABF01F964_B222EAD: Whatever you're doing with this ectoplasm, you definitely have enough.
Dialogue.A1EEF82B4A24BAD11EBAD7952A9429FA_06FC410: Whatever's happening, we need to stop it from spreading.
Dialogue.F6E1C7D84B6E9344C621909CBFC7E0E1_FB122F8: Whatever's up there.. it may be calling out to them.
Dialogue.560EBB544BF60524315005BDD52E615B_06FC410: Whatever's wrong, we can fix it.
Dialogue.2B07A015448E74DE24786DB6BA3C5654_21EB734: Whelp, I reckon that's the end of this particular adventure.
Dialogue.0D4C43D84C643A3E2E345E9D3ABA0AB4_06FC410: When I blow the whistle, the game begins.
Dialogue.FA7598E742A35758E6088B82F9031455_F6B1D98: When I found out, I got mad. But the truth is, I was just so happy to see her again.
Dialogue.EB9E58344B148B98FEB896935B1C6AFF_94F2B66: When I look at you I see a lot of things, but what I don't see is a hero.
Dialogue.141145804A6F508E19124AB1FA7643B6_FB122F8: When I played my music, I noticed something. The husks hated it.
Dialogue.DC851FA84CCA2FD8864F92A5444BCF91_D87E161: When I received a bone-chattering instant message from the meanest girl I've ever met.
Dialogue.5F8DFF27472CC53A57D4988A1657D721_9D00593: When I saw this beautiful head, I was ready to call off the whole holly jolly bomb plot.
Dialogue.AA4DE8E5474D650DF06314B089A08BE6_7D2960E: When I tried to hit you earlier... Are you always that fast?
Dialogue.17F9740E4BF7928A1085AF9528A096DF_97A9259: When I try to feel a feeling, all the other feelings get jealous or whatever and want in on the party.
Dialogue.1BE6B2B7437C573A219AD9A4D1EC2BDA_FB122F8: When I was floating there, eye to eye with the Storm King...
Dialogue.7E3DB08F40620A5D212085BA155956D6_CC240C1: When I was guiding the others in lighting fires to light a way to the other side...
Dialogue.01B1B41641FFA774DA733E8F4D9B0F96_77D814F: When I was nervous about my first mission, you said when you looked at me you saw a soldier.
Dialogue.E8B24C6F47EE43C9C4B939A21893839D_9D00593: When I was sixteen I lied about my age and signed up for my first tour of duty. Santa Town. Oresville Mall.
Dialogue.47827ECE4CD3A72821018F8FCEBBD112_47CFF90: When I'm a monster, I'm a monster.
Dialogue.B8ACDB7D42E30B1DCBD5659D7DEA846C_FB122F8: When Lenny over at RiffFreak Monthly called my playing "overwrought" and said my sweep arpeggios were muddy...
Dialogue.B1040DD14316EE6469E3D0AEBE490AC9_FB122F8: When contructors stagger or knock back husks, there's some sort of... Kinetic Overload!
Dialogue.2A0AA6834CC7A163B0C1A7A9ADFA9F9C_06FC410: When gold's too good, you turn to fool's gold.
Dialogue.3F3756474FB459D7A5FEBF8A04780D15_FB122F8: When he wasn't off causing trouble.
Dialogue.DFD745D3464A211E6E5538B270E2DD93_06FC410: When in Canny Valley, be sure to explore our iconic abandoned junkyard...
Dialogue.FF8035FB4CD68D6EAA40ABB9BD51E74E_06FC410: When in doubt, disabling surveillance infrastructure never hurts.
Dialogue.73ABD8B64FDA6670F3592D821CCEFE91_CC240C1: When it came near me, everything felt dark and sad... and it seemed like it would never stop being dark and sad.
Dialogue.404233AA431145EF1B61EC8673E455C7_06FC410: When it comes to seein' pirates, he be yer bot.
Dialogue.AA3670A7444454EA4732329B7D09C5AC_47CFF90: When it comes to staffing and HR, you could reasonably say that.
Dialogue.6AEE76144C00A429E347CE9885CCFC10_9D00593: When it goes off, it'll just shoot confetti and candy canes.
Dialogue.9BB143D543F8F623B27666A13C21B47B_06FC410: When it's complete, you'll be able to see the disturbance at the end of Canny Valley.
Dialogue.DEF570A64B55B7B9571414BFA003E65C_7D086D9: When it's time for you to know what I'm doing, you will know.
Dialogue.D4961199433E8ADB33273887FA4B6F92_9D00593: When life hands me a nutty problem, I open my jaws... and I chomp.
Dialogue.3C789C334FAD9199BD90E9AB2020DA82_D87E161: When she's back, she's gonna need a consultant!
Dialogue.D2B36A6243649BB5381F90A09313C11A_06FC410: When some of us make a big loud deal about Christmas...
Dialogue.CFF95A94479B36C06C437CB8E7F61270_D87E161: When someone hurts our ability to take care of our people, we make it right.
Dialogue.969BC5BC4937453A3B1222B772FC8E51_21C1927: When strangeness hit Homebase, who did they call?
Dialogue.A6439D234B6AB86DDA618BBBCEAAEBD5_06FC410: When the ATLAS is charging, the storm is going to do everything it can to destroy the weapon.
Dialogue.74F9AFA54EA1BFDAA69BBDB1ABCD176F_B222EAD: When the Door to Darkness opens...
Dialogue.9D0A03B2447BCC933522AC825028C041_47CFF90: When the MED-bots aren't set to flash fry, they're pretty ingenious.
Dialogue.15A98B544CFC5AA6819D53B98F756AEC_9D00593: When the toy harvest is blighted, fault lies not with Homebase.
Dialogue.523AECAB44412EFC7D190A8D13C15E3E_B25EA52: When they rip off our arms, we race to find the cure.
Dialogue.35D4D7D94B227AA79F3ADE985C6F7084_910A467: When they took it, they found a solution to their problem.
Dialogue.F9879E5A4BF7282884D8C6927A5AC5A7_06FC410: When they want to be, which has been never until today.
Dialogue.55E5CFC843C48508DE4838AF4DFA0125_06FC410: When this happens, expect a big fight.
Dialogue.B7D9C3FB45DB0DD6AFB6CCA7F17A9AE1_94F2B66: When two people love each other very much...
Dialogue.B197999B4987A8B59603C496CDB7099B_06FC410: When we arrived in plankerton, I received... part of an update file.
Dialogue.49D00FE048C26E9D1D00CEB87526828D_1D2FE88: When we defeated one of The Grotto's monsters...
Dialogue.1B7C40E44C1F3B355ABFD0965A361694_9801E98: When we get through this, we're gonna have to write some new songs.
Dialogue.8EC8C51745296D021852FE9DBA4E70B7_77D814F: When we have each other, we can do anything.
Dialogue.FC349B6E43B3B63A0C3EFB8C852FCE6C_1D2FE88: When we returned home, they would greet us as heroes.
Dialogue.BE3BFDA8420F0111415C9D92D0B27782_47CFF90: When we're done, you will be yo-ho-ho-ing with the best of 'em.
Dialogue.550683A3465A223FD2E926B3D8B67FE1_9D00593: When you buy the ticket, you gotta take that sleigh ride.
Dialogue.A241731C413F64F6BC858A92ACFB1152_EECA944: When you don't take the risks, you don't get the rewards.
Dialogue.5DB8283846000719870E57A5A5A6729D_06FC410: When you find an active encampment, be ready to fight until the end!
Dialogue.08751D934046A994C7F37D922B0D1E8E_CC240C1: When you find him, your heart will drown!
Dialogue.4668E6214BD4A8D0EC4C63A610582F36_94F2B66: When you find out who did this... (spits)... you let me know.
Dialogue.054308F841437FDD6E8262B74FB5FD1E_97A9259: When you first eat that purloined patty, it's delicious in the way that only forbidden foodstuffs can be. It's a taste you think you'll cherish forever.
Dialogue.9D4CC8004E6EA3AEF1A3DDB069BD955C_0ADEFA4: When you help me, I bring it to him.
Dialogue.27B49A32439989A66523B990759CF9D4_9D00593: When you know everyone knows that's your main thing?
Dialogue.80DEBEC44613460CD1E119898C3C39B8_06FC410: When you look through the telescopes at... what's coming our way...
Dialogue.C91271F042144857DBD466A729985597_CC240C1: When you need something sent fast, use Outlander Express.
Dialogue.A801691A4688BD81A0E11FBE703EE072_97A9259: When you sang "Dr. Blackwell, We Hardly Knew Ye," I really felt it.
Dialogue.AD47B97948D59187CD3BBA8AAB51C07A_94F2B66: When you say the generators are failing...
Dialogue.0CF14321483A1E0BFDAB699A61048D0B_47CFF90: When you say you can't take off the uniform, were you being literal?
Dialogue.95B2101746A47EFCD75520873BF05EC5_06FC410: When you threw me out of Homebase, I came up with a plan to save Ted.
Dialogue.234A789A4FD1FEF25DBEF2AF207C713C_06FC410: When you weren't looking he threw his eyeball at me.
Dialogue.96EA1E074009FCA3730ECCA3791B049F_910A467: When you're adrift in the magic of the cosmos.
Dialogue.15EF7A3E474DB9FB608D8CA678729297_06FC410: When you're done being a monster you can come inside.
Dialogue.E3EC18114DDACB3607BCA79324B17AA0_724DAF1: When you're famous, you pick up on things you can say to make people feel good.
Dialogue.8998DA994E6803B7194C1B92A9CB64BB_861A10F: When you're feeling sad, you can't just mope around. You'll never feel better.
Dialogue.CB6150A94980C04ED5AA0D9C3BBF965F_06FC410: When you're in the build menu you can also place traps.
Dialogue.C17A28E44FAB25BD1A77FAA0FD1B480D_06FC410: When you're ready to defend your amplifier and your storm shield, head to the Storm Shield Console.
Dialogue.1BA08458411AF8687605FA9C9A12BAC8_06FC410: When you're ready to start the fight, select "expand shield" from the Storm Shield console.
Dialogue.278DF4A14EFDD831251B43ABC4E65DB8_06FC410: When you're ready, connect the armory to the launcher.
Dialogue.04674E8C407C7B3209A248AB9C17438E_47CFF90: When you're relaxed, or at least better at lying.
Dialogue.C12D0C9840E43E80ABFAA6BB92DD4252_FB122F8: When your Outlanders strike an object with their pickaxe five times, it activates a passive boost!
Dialogue.E2C773AD4797A01D0C321DB1046E5774_06FC410: When your design is complete, exit the staging area.
Dialogue.0544C8804F06B8A521BFA9B5563D6664_77D814F: When's the last time you went on patrol?
Dialogue.8B45C7024BCAF3D8D8BD4ABC207BA27F_97A9259: Whenever I have a secret coming up, it feels like I'm gonna hurl if I don't let it out.
Dialogue.B08A3E3340B7663E8AA739ADBC6BC4EE_06FC410: Whenever I look at the rift I feel a surge of white-hot, searing hatred.
Dialogue.7024623B4596F82DDA61619D1BF73EF5_FB122F8: Whenever one of your soldiers lands consecutive hits on the same target my passive spectrometer goes haywire...
Dialogue.B5A41E024114C2F61D19E2BDB43FFDBB_06FC410: Whenever something is blocking your path, try destroying it.
Dialogue.9E6712F84DEE909027DA6CA9BBA5363C_B222EAD: Whenever you hear strange things going bump in the night...
Dialogue.01294535402D1A56B5416985DFA23427_9D00593: Where Homebase is tinkly, I want tinkly-winkly. Where it's sparkly, we need sparky-warkly!
Dialogue.5219B38443E1001BD9A78CBC025CFCFE_06FC410: Where are you? You're not showing up on our sensors!
Dialogue.1AA9544C4A2FF4A7675CA8BCA78E8D6E_FB122F8: Where else would I be? Hanging out at my lab. Making groundbreaking discoveries.
Dialogue.8DDA896B469B23F113CCF5A7565382B3_C0E27E7: Where have I seen that before? Oh, right. My nightmares.
Dialogue.D928DD314361485B5AB390B0C1817F9E_97A9259: Where he's discovered a huge monster!
Dialogue.FEDA8DF645DB6478154AC8925092A3F3_72190CE: Where is it? There it is. Now it's mine.
Dialogue.99F611E049501C02135BF397DF5AAD5C_7D086D9: Where is this even coming from?
Dialogue.C7B09B7D40926C56478E408BF82403A5_06FC410: Where my Bad Rays at? Hello?
Dialogue.7F95AE194268B217106514B626389DA1_06FC410: Where you're like, "How can Ray be there and also here?"
Dialogue.B0F8ABDE45D594130414518BDC548D0A_7D2960E: Where'd I go to law school?
Dialogue.2B1E7D324967F6F5EBCE76B5A89895AB_D87E161: Where'd you land on getting back our stuff?
Dialogue.EB20F5C74C8058E0E30348A3DBE9CFC6_72190CE: Where's your survivor's guilt? That's what I wanna know!
Dialogue.711029FD46ACE7ACC395578D743E4A65_06FC410: Wherever he's going next... I hope they're ready.
Dialogue.EC41F49B4D5E7BCF0A17F8B67792319D_9D00593: Whether they want it or not!
Dialogue.FBD83B944A056F6E5736869BBF3B7A8F_9F725B6: Whew! I feel like me again!
Dialogue.3FEB847048D525EF557FF7816A6A875E_06FC410: Whew. Staff Reporter Tina Albright, you are not subtle.
Dialogue.718C8FC94FDD2E5A845F7E923CB9449C_47CFF90: Which I grant to hero trainees. So congratulations, me. I'm approved!
Dialogue.B935AB754F8BD7AC48453781D1E284A9_97A9259: Which I probably should not have picked up. Eugh.
Dialogue.AB37F4AE42E60700737B3BBB11D5D3C4_B229E47: Which I should have mentioned before my hardware started to... fail.
Dialogue.7CC02D574958A0F83822EC91D6582681_06FC410: Which I'm sure is what you were trying to do....
Dialogue.8DFBABDE43DBDF362823AB99F84C3BF6_06FC410: Which according to the guidebook was twelve days long.
Dialogue.8C7F647748E018C031859DA7EB56DC58_06FC410: Which again is not his weakness even though that would have been really great.
Dialogue.96973E1847EBC47A937D6CA1CBBBA7BF_97A9259: Which are things I've heard of and also understand.
Dialogue.EF461C4740665FE1F7A822BD02D25AC5_06FC410: Which both doesn't officially exist, wink wink, and also doesn't actually exist now.
Dialogue.77261D31418ABC5BE4ED54B36B89CF93_06FC410: Which brings me to my next point.
Dialogue.3257168049CEBD4E15261EB5EBDD9574_9D00593: Which brings me to the crux of our shared mission.
Dialogue.857563204963AD9EB63C5994E9CAF354_C2C5A2E: Which for cowards tends to be quite some time.
Dialogue.D05AA81D4D34F3F626EB1DBFB001A1FB_06FC410: Which is a feature I did not know our sensors had...
Dialogue.1693889048476CF63A4F9390CF6C8A9B_FB122F8: Which is actually starting to feel like a possibility...
Dialogue.69B780D5448E5D34D128EBBF3A7F8026_AB3C42C: Which is fortunate because I expect to see nothing less.
Dialogue.7AAF967A400FD0C2D54B56B355B9B17F_06FC410: Which is great, because I really needed a win.
Dialogue.F2D778FF4C2DDFC5541CE3AE323F8D3D_06FC410: Which is not a comforting name for anything.
Dialogue.6FFC78E84C6F8BAD8E3EF6903A82A88A_06FC410: Which is not energy efficient, at all.
Dialogue.92A5DDA54159941401E93E92A901D046_E090F2A: Which is not technically scary, but I am here for it.
Dialogue.F62AC932446583EA489686B6297BE4E7_72190CE: Which is now gone. As you can all see.
Dialogue.CC4EB7E94893D72B3FE7DCB2BFDBDDAD_06FC410: Which is the only option if you want a gravestone these days I guess.
Dialogue.4133953D4D352DE3B468CFB74DFA6176_47CFF90: Which is the sort of thing that happens when you break time.
Dialogue.C4DA00AE48E7355B514DB39D880BC427_06FC410: Which is weird. High profile writers make millions, so exposure should be the best payment.
Dialogue.17993A284C01D65C9D88EDA17772D356_94F2B66: Which is why I am allowing you to join in the next survivor rescue mission.
Dialogue.C49342FB4171E428B21F749333BF7379_FB122F8: Which is why I specifically asked you to always ask me first.
Dialogue.C88969D64F8D6F5D2E7A918A2CBF0136_14FBFB1: Which is why I want to tear it to pieces and burn the remains.
Dialogue.2DE27FFD4F3FA9481A53D68B027D5602_06FC410: Which is why I'm just gonna lay it all out on the table.
Dialogue.06BD95EA4267E1C1C1BF10A3E25B4628_47CFF90: Which is why all of you will be calming yourselves down at the SnareRanch spa.
Dialogue.73744B04437F65267820EC86E2CC4CD5_06FC410: Which is why he decreed that all existing Vladamantium must be fashioned into things that are absolutely not knives.
Dialogue.1229EB55487C729A5E34A599F9511F6F_06FC410: Which makes me think we, collectively, are not ready for love.
Dialogue.CBA6C55F48B57AD0F445BDACF81BAE2A_06FC410: Which makes this the... most alone I have ever been.
Dialogue.F229C5784EA89EB5F7C393B3B327CBD6_06FC410: Which many claim to be haunted by the Legendary Gunslinger Blackboot Ayers.
Dialogue.568FADB048FAFB7BF622A3AD333AE412_06FC410: Which reminds me, we've got you booked for exploits right after this.
Dialogue.80F6094844B5304F734C408B64A78A7E_47CFF90: Which reminds me... Nice job, son. You're really going places.
Dialogue.AF3773264F5BAAF3F704E98D1A46CE89_06FC410: Which should offset the damage I've done by releasing Vlad the Vicious the Second...
Dialogue.6D11B7BA4AFBFCA3ECD394B1EB8E4E70_06FC410: Which sounds very boring, but honestly it is a great time to be in the dust market.
Dialogue.22C86250493083150D205CA06B38CF9E_181CD3E: Which technically counts as a success.
Dialogue.334F9992440AED131FC1F18C32B25D86_7D2960E: Which was the right answer, I guess.
Dialogue.8B1185BE4814D9B93845B38EAC5C6E06_06FC410: Which wise thinkers of the age agreed did not exist.
Dialogue.C9A37FEC4C943E4A2F87CBA468CEDF71_97A9259: Which you would know if you read the memo.
Dialogue.F6B144A04331BCABEA0F5BBCC9A99736_181CD3E: Which, I mean, okay, but where do you go but down from the Murderous Mobsled?
Dialogue.E785E3B04D1736C2B9B089B3E3440EA6_06FC410: Which, if any of the hoverboards happen to ask, are very very good.
Dialogue.109CA8AA4DB636A3D7A71C82F030D148_176484F: Which, if we play our cards right, will not be on fire.
Dialogue.7202DD994548BED952B6358369C581AD_47CFF90: Which, if we remember, is just an expression, and not official Homebase fire safety practice.
Dialogue.58F3FC8A4F5D8C4293C943ADCBDDFB8A_9801E98: While I am an accomplished Jefe player, I really don't understand why.
Dialogue.BB3EE9CE46C2C1A837439DB49B814D16_21EB734: While I am not a superhero I have seen many movies about superheroes.
Dialogue.EB4D23A14DD478B49CFE33A061924509_AB3C42C: While I appreciate that you want to include everyone in the creative process, Ray...
Dialogue.27B27692489DCCA401D2F69E11BD701B_861A10F: While I can't fit the one circle inside the bigger circle... It was ghastly.
Dialogue.8545DA294C467DE313E800BB36F853D4_94F2B66: While I do that, you go get some shuteye and think about what's next for you.
Dialogue.0465B3E743F726E58485348A7AD61CDD_06FC410: While Lars thinks let's gather more husk data.
Dialogue.50BD23EC44067C3A531F4EACA1CD8052_06FC410: While Ray-anne was an ideal camp counselor, who always gave her campers great advice...
Dialogue.061EA1DC41F3EA4A11F9709FED1DE6D2_06FC410: While drum machines just play loops and beats,
Dialogue.C5B7427B4EBB6504F68ADB867EBB6270_21C1927: While some fish watches my life fall to pieces.
Dialogue.BBE89C4E49932196A9B9B0A0BC794FEC_06FC410: While the cause of the near extinction is unknown,
Dialogue.99B912884C8C63B7542AF28B42F30A99_06FC410: While the other campers use that opportunity to search the area for, you know, things.
Dialogue.E3BA44E44A9A273E034E3E8882345822_47CFF90: While the storm tracking equipment is no longer on fire, it's still too hot to touch so... we could use some scouting.
Dialogue.1C026DF2497333BE3E3BFC8B34960895_9F725B6: While the sun does one of those obscenely gorgeous four hour summer sunsets.
Dialogue.E06439D94A720C368F6BF8A56F469412_7D2960E: While we're on the topic of things not making sense...
Dialogue.77F6BFCC4FC173C8BA7FAF81BF6653EF_FB122F8: While you guys were out, my instruments picked up a bunch of mist monsters coming out of new portals around Hexylvania.
Dialogue.7C766E2D4AEAF3BCA409D9AB225AF70D_06FC410: While you're down there, I'm just gonna take a liiiiittle sample of your brine...
Dialogue.6E25E5BB4C59DD5895D58C82E7727BD4_06FC410: While you're there, use the V-bucks in your account to purchase your very own Upgrade Llama.
Dialogue.805DEB524B7167698F03429DDCCB18F2_47CFF90: Who am I to begrudge you the odd comment about... oh, I don’t know... scallywags or doubloons?
Dialogue.0A74E53549D958C0599EB1819068DA7E_94F2B66: Who am I to say it's not? But it's not. Alright, back to the monsters!
Dialogue.ABE3E0C64FF2F571B0CD6EAA6B4BC268_21EB734: Who among us can't burst into flames once.
Dialogue.74EEAF7A4F8C68521B51E4B4D7AFC76D_97A9259: Who can be sad when you're smashing faces under foliage?
Dialogue.766274D34616F738EC153AAA072C2253_EECA944: Who does that to their child?
Dialogue.CFB4F3E44D6B389FAE26118D320B3855_B222EAD: Who else is gonna do it?
Dialogue.8C6A8C104D25F5E7CF2D5BA6C9FD721E_06FC410: Who even knows what awaits us out there in the storm. Certain death? Puppies? Something in between?
Dialogue.3408E8E046CABD54129447B6DDC8FA3A_1D2FE88: Who fell into a pool of lava...
Dialogue.F22B2ED841312A55F4DE47A703E7906D_FB122F8: Who gives that as a gift? What were they thinking? Don't they know anything?
Dialogue.E3240E8E4EAC15D69057EDAE3BA42678_06FC410: Who is incidentally the guy we're actually SUPPOSED to be scaring.
Dialogue.EA2B1EEC451BA3A83C5FA7A33B42CDDB_97A9259: Who knew clocks could teach us so much about time.
Dialogue.4ED169F6423099EE147CDDAA49592FFF_B222EAD: Who knew resurrection was this easy?
Dialogue.C1345F5D459CE36DB814C4A18ECD755A_37EFC25: Who knew the Krampus had so much blood inside him?
Dialogue.0C70AB534A6AE2404C0EA7994F1850F5_06FC410: Who knows when we'll be back. Hopefully this will help.
Dialogue.815DCD1C478C3FE2995290900A8FF12B_06FC410: Who knows, maybe this will be fun.
Dialogue.EA7565DF44503C2AF95E7D95EB0EFC0D_FB122F8: Who knows. Before the storm hit, Carlos invited me to join him on a research project out in the desert.
Dialogue.26E101FF43094CA95734419C66F016E9_B25AF7B: Who knows. Maybe you can hear it too...
Dialogue.E64B81334E7AA4C17C3C4DA0872D0D07_06FC410: Who knows? Maybe we'll find something helpful.
Dialogue.D724F0774C1FB38ACFF8E3BD4CAA2B98_97A9259: Who knows? With your tools, I could even find my lost keys in Hogslop's famous Slop Pit!
Dialogue.2FE599B84D1551DC708D1EA8CEF68EF6_1FCF39D: Who let the troll onto the battlefield?
Dialogue.E210D9D149CDBEE4FE1421873C8BF041_06FC410: Who maybe doesn't understand what paper is.
Dialogue.B34CB5134DE2E0139A2DC584E9E06E76_DA0538A: Who needs tin horns or toy drums when you’ve got this?
Dialogue.749A4D95443CD4116189298F93035F9E_CC240C1: Who said I don't have any secrets? I have many, many secrets.
Dialogue.B109508B4ED949A24C717AB30CCE9D5D_DB7CBEB: Who saw that? That was good, right?
Dialogue.4BE5958C4E29ED73B47271A16149E410_06FC410: Who should be here by now. What gives?
Dialogue.9A8D26E44FFAB203E702F0BDF4DCAA97_06FC410: Who should come home to see a doctor and not die in some quarry or whatever.
Dialogue.CF6E8CE346C276E759A4EBBF5CADA409_7D086D9: Who taught Seventeen the words to Jonnie Galactic?
Dialogue.E249CAE54C3D3B73FF5676AEE6F903DE_06FC410: Who wants to eat everyone in Homebase? You do! Yes, you do!
Dialogue.894F63984AE65F2964D1258AFEF12D03_06FC410: Who wants to wage war on their molars?
Dialogue.449E3CC646074FF624E84C9A0E164440_CC240C1: Who will answer our call for help?
Dialogue.0AFFD2534D0D8AB69B4A13BCED50A1CD_06FC410: Who's a good boy? You are. Yes, you are!
Dialogue.978AA0EF4599033BD70739BF67E847D2_F130B8E: Who's a precious metal! Hint- it's me.
Dialogue.775FFC414042A3BA72BF3BB153DCFB34_CC240C1: Who's about to give a gift that truly keeps giving...
Dialogue.12D0A7734380C71A9BBC939F52D607A5_FB122F8: Who's gonna cuddle with a tooth? Who is gonna be crying and sad and say, "Oh, at least I have my stuffed tooth."
Dialogue.C0152EE04C3BE8CC68C1B0B9300910E7_94F2B66: Who's in the mood for a friendly competition?
Dialogue.BE3365134EDDB79E994717AB0DBE50C9_AFB40E2: Who's in the mood for love?
Dialogue.3CA453D94C066CE18BAAE7895935C94C_1D2FE88: Who, incidentally, is an ancient sentient cloud of pain and torment...
Dialogue.0E1BC4F14413FCCC258B3C873A39C549_06FC410: Who, let's face it, may no longer be with us.
Dialogue.4914A1BE4C962B11B733949C71861F06_06FC410: Whoa whoa whoa. That is not where we landed on this.
Dialogue.4AF68EBE45EAEC692968F59868A982E1_06FC410: Whoa! Dennis, what's going on, buddy?
Dialogue.4EB51D5A449C0A5963DE2A91EB6EEF63_06FC410: Whoa! Ha. Hey, Cloaked Star. Like... you offer to tell a secret?
Dialogue.58EE11964B90F64A3789118831953A46_97A9259: Whoa! Hey! Alright! We're all freaked out.
Dialogue.8FD79927425CEAC78648BAB931F4B4FA_861A10F: Whoa! Hold on! Humans... and holfs... anddddd.... Basically all non-dinosaurs.
Dialogue.AEC1B0D647775D81AC67359EFF1C556B_06FC410: Whoa! It just blasted a hole in the clouds!
Dialogue.84CD5F0C4CDD2210970CBF9326C8BBFB_06FC410: Whoa! Let's not go straight to watery graves, right? We're just here to make sure you and Blake survived the crash.
Dialogue.99D8715544B6200D3A7874A6E3FC1A2D_06FC410: Whoa! That is a... a lot of whiteboards. What's going on?
Dialogue.38F6DD854FD6FF2F95523085733715E1_CC240C1: Whoa! That thing dropped some BluGlo!
Dialogue.9B703B624990C224FEBBFC91CD65F08E_3D2D55D: Whoa! Was this here the whole time?
Dialogue.BFED01B144982FC51EF8819B32C7E6A6_97A9259: Whoa! Where'd you get the recipe for my mom's special sandwiches?
Dialogue.842E373142FFCDCAFB71C291ECAF4C1C_72190CE: Whoa! You see that kill, Keelhaul?
Dialogue.DFCB966240CA697BA9EAC09B876E1932_7023BF2: Whoa! You'd make an amazing pet.
Dialogue.D053A39C4558283BE2E0078A2CF893B2_EAAE146: Whoa, Commander. You are really on a roll here.
Dialogue.375954F64F62B08245F2F1AA0CAE41C5_97A9259: Whoa, I'm down for Horizathon any day of the week, but how's this an emergency?
Dialogue.6F27F4A24B47FC1BB75A54ADD309F3A7_FB122F8: Whoa, I'm gettin' ahead of myself. We don't even know if passive physics applies to ninjas yet!
Dialogue.7CB385A048B06D6FA696589BD43047A0_97A9259: Whoa, cosmic do over, let's go!
Dialogue.B6B05075484CF8D630C1C1A89633B517_724DAF1: Whoa, hang on. What's “Sour-Empty-Stomach?” I think I get that one.
Dialogue.BBEA4DAD4FB38E2A6F64538F9AB6DAA2_06FC410: Whoa, has it always been this bad, Ramirez?
Dialogue.7B25293D4E3811F5CAE26D9CFAF9F01C_97A9259: Whoa, okay, that's definitely not me.
Dialogue.348D27C2415B0C688BD605BB3132BA37_AB3C42C: Whoa, that camera's in great shape.
Dialogue.599596BE4DA3EF32BDC3DFB7A4E7BDD2_FB122F8: Whoa, the husks seem to be moving with a little more.. purpose. I need more information.
Dialogue.C2AAFAC74AD5ACA60EDD49B1A5103622_06FC410: Whoa, this tree is all scratched up.
Dialogue.EC5A6BD14EE700844C421798285F6B34_06FC410: Whoa, wait. You're still in love?
Dialogue.F00FFBBF4B6FE80BC39F1CB44F8B1C71_071921D: Whoa, was I mauled there or... or what?
Dialogue.B1DD7B0E424750CBC671FE9B6DA2E938_97A9259: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Surprise zone! You can't see!
Dialogue.EF74EB2A4F9E2C08EA7461B658485279_06FC410: Whoa, whoa, whoa, Okay. I'm shutting this down.
Dialogue.69E4DBF545DE9BDE6B1C019A82EC1F33_97A9259: Whoa, whoa, whoa. I'm not ready for catharsis yet. I'm still in denial.
Dialogue.A9D5FD4448D9C104B0AD759A8C0094E7_06FC410: Whoa. A ton of... nautical maps and shipping routes?
Dialogue.2D1BCD9A401AE93B08A518B843BFCB85_97A9259: Whoa. I don't hear that much.
Dialogue.623A652A48FAA8D063A5F68761CDFFFB_06FC410: Whoa. Lars? Tell me about Mad Science.
Dialogue.7050D2814127F563B50042A0943F902B_06FC410: Whoa. Look! One of those- One of... the big guys! Smasher!
Dialogue.ECEBE6514516548EE1BFA38B96395D56_06FC410: Whoa. Okay. Don't love this energy, Dennis. Let's pull it back.
Dialogue.A747C275439E5A8B655CC6BD37025030_97A9259: Whoa. That is super duper deep, Ray. And I love it. Yes!
Dialogue.ED6F816F40EC87C5694C34A6582D2AD0_97A9259: Whoa. They look just like you said they would.
Dialogue.4950560745B852201EC0909778AD0781_06FC410: Whoa. Things are getting a bit dark.
Dialogue.8687D718416F7BCF16351292C17A0F6E_06FC410: Whoa. This track listing is weird.
Dialogue.89D226AC49E5E25D88706ABCE69C8789_06FC410: Whoa. We've got some rare Steel Wool here.
Dialogue.8BF3C0D24D78300521F813AEC6328A68_06FC410: Whoa. What is this doing here?
Dialogue.3F0FB74A43BFA44E9C3BD98BF74A991F_FB122F8: Whoa... rift stabilization in a lab environment?
Dialogue.0F98CE61464BB1A89D2C378C857F1C23_06FC410: Whoa... so the legends are true...
Dialogue.8A5064DF47AE5540F7306B89749596B7_06FC410: Whoa... storm readings are off the charts here.
Dialogue.9B51B2414768F70C534049A330F07DC2_06FC410: Whoa... this is interesting... in the lead up to the storm, Vindertech labs began developing experimental weapons...
Dialogue.CFDC26974BC6F7CA9A941294E351DABB_94F2B66: Whoever brings home the most ten gallon husk hats wins a prize.
Dialogue.B613B648409747E7438BBFA7470C17B9_06FC410: Whoever drove it was definitely prepping for something.
Dialogue.F7D515144DC5B9FD53872CB429BA9299_06FC410: Whoever launched that balloon really doesn't want to be found.
Dialogue.16AA7A3E4EBD24C284660787FCA99E9C_9D00593: Whoever told you that is a no good, fur-faced liar!
Dialogue.ABC58F8849B07BFE164B4DBA5D3ABCBC_06FC410: Whoever was driving it was transporting stacks of food.

Dialogue.E9E20D424E15BD5B939B80B6DDE9D3F7_06FC410: Whose party set out in search of the fabled lost city of tin,

Dialogue.7E0E49134BAB36B1B30290A4FB1C0FB8_06FC410: Why are we all having nightmares but Lok has happy dreams?
Dialogue.9E42531B438CABB6497BD9A73D85F128_D87E161: Why are we freaking out about jars when there are zombie chickens everywhere?

Dialogue.1DA498D94870CD856A2A19AC1435589B_7D086D9: Why are you here? You don't work here anymore.
Dialogue.57EFD15B4F5C7AE9554EF2B58005BBA2_94F2B66: Why are you paying attention to the Commander? You're supposed to be crashing.

Dialogue.06AC0B194911BA972220148CCB38C8C7_FB122F8: Y'know, I was thinking Mantis Leap for that one, hope you don't mind.
Dialogue.7FBB8E4C4D743E3A038E89BDFEB944FC_89ED452: Y'know, what with you being a rockstar and all.
Dialogue.B539800D4E01ED49ADE2A8B503E19A22_72190CE: Y- Oh yeah. Just really excited about my army of the dead. Can't wait.
Dialogue.C30C8D5D4282AC722A86F3A64DB855C0_06FC410: Y- you remember me, though. Right, Doc?
Dialogue.F2C4269847BEB3086840C498AD166845_EAAE146: YAR! Surrender yer loot, ye bilge-sucking scumbags!
Dialogue.9C3B681244BE42DAD4069E8F62912352_B25AF7B: YAR, IT BE TOUGH TO TELL AT THIS DISTANCE.
Dialogue.44E7885C440514B3184CB7A8430DD98F_B25AF7B: YE BEST BE CLICKING ON THE README FILE, SWABBIE.
Dialogue.8982EF0F4754B930181E2E99FB207263_E090F2A: YES! I could not be CLEARER about this!
Dialogue.2A2BE20A4DB2BBE261748F82757361D0_94F2B66: YES. AND DO IT RIGHT. BABBLING BROOK. SPARROWS. CLOVER.
Dialogue.87EA2B424AFF72117A8FAB93A30D21DB_B25AF7B: YO HO HO, WE BE SHREDDIN' YOUR FILES.
Dialogue.EA95B33149F78C052FC7E4BA0B2B26E5_B25AF7B: YOU RECLAIM THE ANSWER BOOKLET FROM THE HUSKS.
Dialogue.725884B94E4BDEBE99854D8447D10414_7D2960E: Ya can't get rid of me that easy.
Dialogue.E936D0494613189A147456AABE84A1F6_06FC410: Ya know, I'd never get in between a menacing lurker and his shadows,
Dialogue.50839CE343E4AE5D381E1DBD37A65DE2_724DAF1: Yah! Is this the best you can do?!
Dialogue.F086E6484D990082F58FC082455775B0_94F2B66: Yammering on. And the whining! It's non-stop.
Dialogue.09BE603749DB9F226FFB9E9CA6723E21_06FC410: Yar, I be suddenly noticing we are... landlocked.
Dialogue.80EF54EF414AE5546624F2963753BC55_72190CE: Yar, first things first! Ummmm, wait I know this...
Dialogue.ABE4829548E9312BDC49E28EE79BA7EC_06FC410: Yar, maties! I believe ye built the finest ship to ever catch me eye.
Dialogue.6CFDEEC948AFEECD3768C6A7705F112B_06FC410: Yarrr! Raybeard the Blue be lockin' this door, me hearties!
Dialogue.9220FFFB40FF2C51039C76825FF182C2_EAAE146: Ye call yerself a monster? Ptooey!
Dialogue.25F73EA04121B03504E283BBEE44FD89_F2F813A: Ye can walk the plank, but can ye talk the plank?
Dialogue.9C83F5F340D581ED4E3134AD1EE36A79_FB122F8: Yeah I don't even know what that one means.
Dialogue.B93A3A7A456EBD6BFF4023932F46E95A_9801E98: Yeah I'm with Lars. What if we get out there and it’s just… nothing? More Whatever?
Dialogue.33EE3A2942BDEDA00ECFEBB75C5ED912_89ED452: Yeah and It's today. And it's still happening.
Dialogue.7012BE8D49040A4EC2E4E38FCFEAFDFA_72190CE: Yeah and “Whoa, that's where they buried the leftovers of First Mate Smitty!”
Dialogue.B43D599943EA8803EEB54DA3E4404136_06FC410: Yeah dude. I thought you already did.
Dialogue.3E72024E489383BA42412A80131B8CCF_06FC410: Yeah haha, oh yeah.  Always need more yaw. Definitely.
Dialogue.825131734ACC399A9606F1911CDBB709_06FC410: Yeah it was like... round. Icy. Evil? I think?
Dialogue.DA78FF984DE7F825C7A6CB92C92CA950_FB122F8: Yeah listen man. Uhm. We need your help, something is coming.
Dialogue.E286DB0F4EADF6DC00A2EEBE7D188C03_06FC410: Yeah really. I mean... I would know. I'd definitely... not not know...
Dialogue.FBA0598647605ADA6339AFB9D5128D24_21C1927: Yeah that felt off when I said it.
Dialogue.03D766894490B63F1B613EB8A6D336FC_97A9259: Yeah there is. I call it all the time.
Dialogue.03E208E9487FED6E467B98A80BC141B2_97A9259: Yeah they were shaking all over the place.
Dialogue.2B023322454C74623A993AA78C6C4EA8_06FC410: Yeah um... I kinda noticed that you haven't landed in a few days.
Dialogue.BF3DBBED4098810DFBAE20902586A4BF_06FC410: Yeah you do. Gotta get back to work on that, uh... (tongue click) you're making.
Dialogue.558D6EE3407FBA1B23EBA8BE55BC4377_97A9259: Yeah! I should! Now I am!
Dialogue.8918540348421B77EAF178ACD09CDFCE_97A9259: Yeah! I've been recording footage but I need editing software to actually put it together.
Dialogue.3ADC53EF4BB238E5DFFF0E9991AD499C_EAAE146: Yeah! Is this where we should start digging?
Dialogue.35CC7627478FC8533E9AF68A9E51AA4E_EAAE146: Yeah! Like check this out! (attack effort)
Dialogue.03990D8141F344A69222B6916974DCE3_72190CE: Yeah! So weird. What's up with that?
Dialogue.99370F374AE7697147B44DAE48345049_B222EAD: Yeah! That's exactly what I was going to say.
Dialogue.97E79295481D2E262379F6A5109849CF_06FC410: Yeah! We have the skill, the knowledge, and most importantly... the need!
Dialogue.CDEA2F934EEB4F743B2E19956BD9FB83_4731F06: Yeah! What do you want to do?
Dialogue.412041E741187B9186A1F7A1C65D05C8_72190CE: Yeah!! Thank you, everyone! This... this is amazing.
Dialogue.E50C8A5341F22D0ED0B2CB997E794042_06FC410: Yeah, I bet Daphne quits her job to follow Perry when he starts his own company with no plan.
Dialogue.47F64BEA43AF26A26CFF8885C92ED634_97A9259: Yeah, I can't even be depressed right.
Dialogue.54D300B74A6469B406AB6E918677C5EE_97A9259: Yeah, I figured he'd be around for the Packstravaganza.
Dialogue.7495203C42A46C22E6AAC3A86E2BE0AA_FB122F8: Yeah, I figured it out right after I stopped speaking.
Dialogue.3E310FAE4EC2C1464C8977A1D9CAD00E_FB122F8: Yeah, I get it. I'm kind of a loner too.
Dialogue.71AD98A04DD080152E38E192CC0A6A3B_06FC410: Yeah, I had an idea for that...
Dialogue.EACB9BFA4EA8F85BFB79AD959D6B018F_87F0BBB: Yeah, I just have to make a call.
Dialogue.DAD0AD9147A0E9A31623819F2A862C92_861A10F: Yeah, I love that part, too.
Dialogue.7885C44B4FBB6F53CCCCA5829E52B27F_06FC410: Yeah, I see why this was burned.
Dialogue.FBA53AD34FDB48AC0531A78459F750B3_06FC410: Yeah, I think this one is my bad.
Dialogue.6CA5BFCD42B194DAA69FE79546AA0CAD_FB122F8: Yeah, I used to like the guy.
Dialogue.B27393434D744D2DAAF81FB9A3C8B265_B68F328: Yeah, I was told I might want to ease you into this conversation.
Dialogue.2424071047BA5867AA7B86A26CCB357C_97A9259: Yeah, I'll start editing together the beginning now.
Dialogue.AEF576214554DBC7EA4C0EA4D2FB6E33_21C1927: Yeah, I'm a toy, and I came to play.
Dialogue.1D18AF45477A1B04FAD513B9B6BDCFBB_D87E161: Yeah, I'm awesome at swords. Sick burn, bro-mando.
Dialogue.06E5B15D4510BF6789B203A66B493191_9801E98: Yeah, I'm gonna need some ammo.
Dialogue.FCE0DC6048988CE73BCCE0B5C00BB52A_5AA487F: Yeah, I'm gonna need some ammo.
Dialogue.9A61DB3144E24F87510CFE93E92C1300_97A9259: Yeah, I'm gonna take out his batteries.
Dialogue.AF40699F4789AF6D25002484B1027B56_B222EAD: Yeah, I'm not so good with the whole "friends" thing...
Dialogue.334702D54798552388F0599A76BC34F7_06FC410: Yeah, I'm sorry. I guess that's what I get for stereotyping apparitions.
Dialogue.FD68BDD14FC45435D79349B7288AA241_06FC410: Yeah, I'm sure it will be fine.
Dialogue.93D41BB742409E787EE114ACB6A6E0B6_97A9259: Yeah, I've been getting that one a lot lately.
Dialogue.C59F42E54AF182E7FEC509A833F6F7E3_06FC410: Yeah, I've noticed. It's real great. Real fun for me.
Dialogue.DD05FCC04C6D53E7ACD056A7A6938D05_724DAF1: Yeah, I, uh... could have done without that information.
Dialogue.18D1027848CEEF75857116AEBD7D20C9_FB122F8: Yeah, I- I don't believe the universe sends us signs.
Dialogue.4DB0F6884D7087E86173278C9BD9A0C2_E090F2A: Yeah, LARS. It was COMPELLING. Doy.
Dialogue.82EAC9E44C4DC6170660F5BD51DB7498_B222EAD: Yeah, Lok's message was informative. Yours were just for fun, heh.
Dialogue.598426BC405AA124908B19A7C147BCFF_06FC410: Yeah, Pop, you heard me right.
Dialogue.FD157109434E1E1B771CA988C41405A2_FB122F8: Yeah, actually half miracle, half intervention. But close enough.
Dialogue.E6654E424D178EA515A6A7BDE3EE7A0B_B222EAD: Yeah, buddy. You can't have a ghost army without crackin' a few skulls.
Dialogue.26F7F55F4B7919463F7DD09907E5EBFB_97A9259: Yeah, but I don't know if it was cut out of a magazine for the ransom note...
Dialogue.866584EE446FAFF421F1869AEB982F37_FB122F8: Yeah, but I just assumed you didn't know how long people lived.
Dialogue.4D3C83DC468C085B9090749646A14D4C_97A9259: Yeah, but I just sold a bunch of presale tickets for our next production.
Dialogue.ADBD569B44E33C70A8A8A788F7DB7CA5_C2C5A2E: Yeah, but I'm not weird about it.
Dialogue.F9D663D446FEA1324B401CA5FF131CBD_FB122F8: Yeah, but getting there is gonna be a whole thing.
Dialogue.85C6D2B54D53FF54CF440D84F9EEF220_4731F06: Yeah, but in this timeline, we melted down all the can openers for resources, so...
Dialogue.209AEDD8498F1CDC717CBDA9935EF10F_EAAE146: Yeah, but it was yours and now it's ours.
Dialogue.D7EB32994CB22DA67FF51C9BAEC68499_9F725B6: Yeah, but none of it will do you any good.
Dialogue.4D8A7BB7411A395FBBC23D88A730B3ED_FB122F8: Yeah, but some people never learn how to ask for help.
Dialogue.4361A8BA480CB0B4E94FA38C3A898283_861A10F: Yeah, but that might be the appropriate reaction to a machete fight.
Dialogue.26B7BB434DF18CFB84690197B1E38955_06FC410: Yeah, but the totally-not-evil me was still me. Dennis Jr. isn't you.
Dialogue.CEEA5FAA4092565B438CA9A2E5BA40A1_724DAF1: Yeah, but then she yells about how you never really change...
Dialogue.08137F5D466142231776908F4FF67296_06FC410: Yeah, but... no offense, I am not building a state of the art lab for a musician.
Dialogue.85187DB741BEA3239C08E9BF5D3E1651_FB122F8: Yeah, but...who are we to judge what's in someone's heart?
Dialogue.5B46237845186DF2478122B23093A936_FB122F8: Yeah, depends on how you feel about building a state of the art lab for a musician.
Dialogue.950CF462427B1DFD1A89C1B862F44D78_06FC410: Yeah, didn't do. And I'm... sorry.
Dialogue.4F852BA74BDEB1BD14D25DA771267EA6_06FC410: Yeah, for war. Not for like dinner. It seems pretty glamorous.
Dialogue.41F3085A4B0FF8481C7CB5ADB2A9DFC4_FB122F8: Yeah, if anything we've identified some new problems.
Dialogue.71F3292E4480037E3B5815867AFC7B78_5991012: Yeah, it was like a little teeny-tiny version of you. It was covered in mud, down by, uh... Garbage Stream River.
Dialogue.DEA1D9B943F6095D02BE55A45F5E65CB_97A9259: Yeah, it's like.... neck or leg?
Dialogue.A7E8D6324F9FA07C6EF74CA822D24653_06FC410: Yeah, it's not. But that's the universe's problem.
Dialogue.E26783B44D1F104F6FA588AF7229F0D2_06FC410: Yeah, it's pretty dreadful right here.
Dialogue.2D4343444D116EC9D6B4538CF0F22899_97A9259: Yeah, like, "For sale. Beef Patty. Never sizzled."
Dialogue.95A66DEE41ECD99EE1080092258EB8A7_FB122F8: Yeah, look at that! That was a good show, too.
Dialogue.825E3B35469322473E37ACACCADF2A59_87F0BBB: Yeah, maybe that's a little too basic. Let's keep looking.
Dialogue.3F66A0FB4AC94D02CDF23EBF50D813E7_06FC410: Yeah, no doy. But you hate me so I don't trust you.
Dialogue.4199A99049997529552B71B3830E80DF_97A9259: Yeah, quick question. Am I supposed to protect these headshots with my life?
Dialogue.868F0A994F516D175130F7B1D7D4B9EF_06FC410: Yeah, really. You're the only one here who speaks Rock.
Dialogue.201BBE494D25A0AC063D0F85463114F5_84C369E: Yeah, running low on ammo here.
Dialogue.DC33F0E04C6D3D0BBEBD6BB4816B9F9A_06FC410: Yeah, so far that's the winner.
Dialogue.55D9C6AD4A4F49D29DE1A1981B03C0D7_06FC410: Yeah, so that might not have been nonsense.
Dialogue.9B4A00F1433D7C77A9809EA270B5FAF2_FB122F8: Yeah, so uh, mainly he just kinda taps on stuff, and doesn't leave...
Dialogue.D100C8E14FBF3997921EAE8FBA32DE4A_765440C: Yeah, so, it's your classic Jekyll-and-Hyde situation.
Dialogue.9C62B9BC45489691BF22CEBF8482F014_06FC410: Yeah, space is really something. The mysterious endless expanse, sure sure. Anyway.
Dialogue.F87751194CE74A450D186B8AE8A5D13E_FB122F8: Yeah, that was a rough one.
Dialogue.0BDD1A794AFF1C23F4080CBF30393F28_94F2B66: Yeah, that was... that was pretty good.
Dialogue.146E597645885FD16DF810AFACC33245_FB122F8: Yeah, that would be...great. Uh, graph paper's in the glovebox if you want to do it to scale.
Dialogue.BB472F944F280A2AEA1B9BB49FDF2433_06FC410: Yeah, that'll put a chip on your shoulder.
Dialogue.97CCA2414BC8B6915ACA8093C598214F_97A9259: Yeah, that's a great idea. I should do that.
Dialogue.480DDF46444E5DEB2BD31EB415AAD102_97A9259: Yeah, that's a keeper. Right out the gate.
Dialogue.C24395864D6ADD9F2B87BF84245A8E55_3D2D55D: Yeah, that's how trolls get shot!
Dialogue.0A6275124043D53F0EF1DB8F80E5EDAD_3D2D55D: Yeah, that's how trolls get shot.
Dialogue.FFC7EFFD4C742219C14FAC9EC87AA31D_97A9259: Yeah, that's like two kinds of ghosty.
Dialogue.C4DA52EF437E701984EBB1A7EFCB4AD5_06FC410: Yeah, that's not great. I'll have a talk with him.
Dialogue.8A4D9FE844E90F66699F4E98E8313A17_89ED452: Yeah, that's perfect. Thanks, you guys. You get the scans Ray was asking for?
Dialogue.1511DACF4A3361ECB0E2CEA415EF51C8_06FC410: Yeah, that's right. Don't test me. One slice and you're out.
Dialogue.1FADB908432AFF3DF8C2EFA5E2F4100B_051E656: Yeah, that’s me. And why’s it any of your business, eh?
Dialogue.466CEFFC40A56AE97E036399805DD227_06FC410: Yeah, there is. There's this world.
Dialogue.FE6293524E784AC55E7B8883818A4FDF_FB122F8: Yeah, there's no boss. We work together.
Dialogue.970D10264523D9ADF9C5889E092F4F64_181CD3E: Yeah, this battle lawyer thing might not have legs.
Dialogue.EAFEA64247DA2AE21BB0E596D9B8CCE3_7D2960E: Yeah, this is how you roll.
Dialogue.CC43E8584437AB9D07928E9A4553596D_4731F06: Yeah, this is nice! Comfortable, good stretch... think it's even moisture-wicking.
Dialogue.3A7859A840562B4032ED0CACD4325ED4_06FC410: Yeah, this isn't helping. I may be beyond the reach of romantic comedy.
Dialogue.6A59FECD4DBB4549A2C5D6B6A8BAFB8C_FB122F8: Yeah, touring does that to ya.
Dialogue.61D0E6CC4AFA6A805F765AA7C28FFA2C_9F725B6: Yeah, turns out I don't want to play it that way.
Dialogue.8C365DEC4635E9792DD77281ADF38584_EED9CD8: Yeah, uh, people keep saying "Hey, Dennis, gimmie a burger...",
Dialogue.2A1E324E49302217DEDC5F81188713B4_84C369E: Yeah, uh... that was a joke.
Dialogue.5B172CCB41010336154C7FAF5B176482_06FC410: Yeah, we get it, dude. You read books. Don't you have a barista to bore?
Dialogue.766D277F42F56F506A184DB47AF2F2B0_14FBFB1: Yeah, we got it. Thanks a lot for all that time to get ready.
Dialogue.F6954C2B4ED3FBAD3CFB97A76677E2D1_06FC410: Yeah, we might do that. But we didn't.
Dialogue.8F8A3C124D9F1DF6DE120EB41E648C6B_724DAF1: Yeah, well life ain't that simple. You can't just tell us to bond.
Dialogue.4DFB9C38474252C065207FB43E096B4D_06FC410: Yeah, well, it's a real good disguise.
Dialogue.AC0C908242C05D2998F0BAB2EA0156F3_77D814F: Yeah, well. It takes one to know one.
Dialogue.86DE859A484065330A0291B07BAB95C6_181CD3E: Yeah, well... Merry Christmas to you, too.
Dialogue.8E0A98C64A58F0224EA704985982CA2D_724DAF1: Yeah, what's up? We wanna order a Pizza Pit special.
Dialogue.EAA5DAF745B0A5B0A0B49587096C9333_06FC410: Yeah, who knows why this isn't working.
Dialogue.B179E7F441D4040C453F2D826F54849F_06FC410: Yeah, why me? This isn't fun for me either.
Dialogue.2D331BFE49F7CD80CFE1BE8A0BF2A723_97A9259: Yeah, yeah, yeah, you're killing it, but just like, energy, you know.
Dialogue.EC320D4F492145E9C2EF909A6BBACC28_72190CE: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I knew that.
Dialogue.413E8CAC4E10F9A9CBCC419BDC3F8D9C_97A9259: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Let's all take a five.
Dialogue.4A040C5A497EE5E665F3C68A6DA132DE_1D2FE88: Yeah, yeah. Breaking urns gets you loot. Have fun breaking all of my stuff.
Dialogue.7AFBC9BB40F4599E6F6C1AAB23999D9B_06FC410: Yeah, yeah. I'll do the thing.
Dialogue.946D3EE8457F727654559CBEED803338_B222EAD: Yeah, yeah. It's the buzzy kind in real life, but I love beeps.
Dialogue.260EE1944572382C65286CBEE4DBA89D_B222EAD: Yeah, you can meet for dinner and stuff.
Dialogue.3CE054314CC0EE68E1C3E29283999C9C_EECA944: Yeah, you got ‘em all! Tracking beacon information, triangulating, cross-referencing... Boom! I think we've got our treasure location!
Dialogue.F79A912D4F508E4378440BB739310078_FB122F8: Yeah, you know what? You're not. And you KNOW you're not.
Dialogue.6D1B5221454DB7D5ACDEC4A43E03556D_724DAF1: Yeah, you know, the thing is...they can't.
Dialogue.098AFA9B4B529A3A033FF986188CE463_FB122F8: Yeah, you know, those pesky things that aren't rocks.
Dialogue.FCA58C30487440DDAF980693AD01909A_B229E47: Yeah, your friend, Dennis, tricked you. This is Dr. Vinderman's AI, not Pizza Pit.
Dialogue.9006BC6A43EFAE6AE1BB41B36D3A37BE_FB122F8: Yeah. After all these years as the Cloaked Star, dude's basically more secret than man.
Dialogue.65CB9DF54699EAB3A336C6ADC6112CB6_97A9259: Yeah. And before you ask, yes, it's very literal.
Dialogue.79C51D3649802239596402B4D1E2C78E_97A9259: Yeah. And they didn't respond well to my notes.
Dialogue.E02AF406473F63B3D9E79F8ADAD679D4_97A9259: Yeah. But still, it would be great if you said it now.
Dialogue.7D23085641D339089A073B9704604378_06FC410: Yeah. But then they went their own way...
Dialogue.D8FE91BF490C1A54636A3CB6FBF54CC4_7D2960E: Yeah. Goes by the name of Tank Gatling.
Dialogue.3590B5EF474C6C39C2436481F0B10DE6_97A9259: Yeah. He's not like super great at being a kidnapper.
Dialogue.EB2C27C8488AFAD38A7DAF89FCF0056D_06FC410: Yeah. He, uh... he got mixed up with a load of strawberry preserves I was storing.
Dialogue.AA693D1342B7F5A8DD9ADC83936352E2_7D2960E: Yeah. Him. Heard he's been stuck inside a lot lately and wanting to redecorate his secret lair.
Dialogue.64B550BA408775F6F62CFB9FFA5E56B9_84C369E: Yeah. I fell madly in love with a robot last year.
Dialogue.BA4AA5384C751A65FEDB418E7C243556_FB122F8: Yeah. I figured. It's just... this has not been the greatest year for me.
Dialogue.D9D24069489E769471D3DCBF13DAF282_D87E161: Yeah. I get it. Canoeing sucks.
Dialogue.9E4DA6684E06F1B137A795BD99162E86_B222EAD: Yeah. I guess I'm happy for everyone...
Dialogue.2FAE51934018A732F0AF4A9283DFA902_89ED452: Yeah. I probably need one of those.
Dialogue.3BCEC08B475C05C0514619AAB7FDA315_06FC410: Yeah. I sent them across the ocean to check on some of the other human settlements, deliver supplies… that kind of thing.
Dialogue.0E35BA4443262940F612D993045C4455_21C1927: Yeah. I tried not to overthink it.
Dialogue.4A8BF8EA47D91E127D3894BFEB4227BC_97A9259: Yeah. I'm gonna be a dad.
Dialogue.979D6F3C4891F2944F8D16AD8EF9E3C6_21C1927: Yeah. I'm kind of a big deal in the beverage world. I called in a favor.
Dialogue.5390CD8A409CD662D2741D99A1A8870E_97A9259: Yeah. I'm not so sure either.
Dialogue.FAFB118C4FF8326EE7932F94F3F534FC_97A9259: Yeah. I've had like twenty-five cups and I feel, well not fine, but I mean, what you'd expect.
Dialogue.CEDD54C145013CCDC717ECA67B87F880_97A9259: Yeah. I- I know. But this sort of thing always seems to work out for Ray.
Dialogue.6F23BF774B6422AF424640879AF47C42_4731F06: Yeah. If anyone can prevent those shields from going down... it's my friend, Ray.
Dialogue.1E805C9145ED037E747D138BD58CC936_21C1927: Yeah. It did. But I don't have another concept of the afterlife on deck, so uh...
Dialogue.2254A0F54C2E08671D86DEA08A00EC19_97A9259: Yeah. It's kind of our thing.
Dialogue.AFE056794263E3FFACC536A14FBD7036_FB122F8: Yeah. It's one of my favorites too.

Dialogue.EB84EB3B4ACFAB54C43E13BF74B299CF_97A9259: You can never tell for sure this early on.
