Dialogue.A47DA50F4DB66F87CDAD6F8082D9BFA1_06FC410: You can open your inventory, and select the bullets you want to craft.
Dialogue.FC676EE54ADB3EA992D00796C9C82FCB_06FC410: You can place the amplifier on any of the locations on your map.
Dialogue.AC44871A416EF1B6F316FC8928A09F58_1D2FE88: You can revive yourself at a cursed statue. Once.
Dialogue.458E94C040611F75E80B69BF0E17F75B_06FC410: You can rumble, but you can't hide.
Dialogue.41BC3ACE41565AC682BAF29B8479B28B_06FC410: You can search for missing parts now, or reinforce the shelter.
Dialogue.59D409244A893C9E6C3D198C76BC6032_06FC410: You can sit this one out.
Dialogue.CCFD104143A9E6CD792F25A0ACE89AB8_97A9259: You can stay or you can go but this is the thing that happens next.
Dialogue.8B99F2764DEFC36E2416C5B75373BF9F_B222EAD: You can step in here at any time, Blakebeard.
Dialogue.D466C6A4422662A51EAF4DA4F21A4E19_06FC410: You can stop now. There's no trace...
Dialogue.2FABBE4A4E6590536EDACEA60E3C2880_97A9259: You can take off if you want. I know you don't want to be here.
Dialogue.CF5CF52C4E19EF5C1C352783C02F40DD_724DAF1: You can tell it's not important.
Dialogue.AC5F2390421AA91900A7B6B0C72E9531_CC240C1: You can trust a mysterious cube that goes "Vroo." Sure you can.
Dialogue.1CE192D14FCCF69AD7A048B8048E2446_94F2B66: You can try to hammer the husks. I'll keep shooting them.
Dialogue.1AEA65CF44275067E2BE36A82781E825_06FC410: You can't build a laser without glass...
Dialogue.4E44DCF04BE9289FA519569207C688DF_06FC410: You can't call a band meeting when you're on band probation! Get it together.
Dialogue.48E43BE846756F796F442BAE67EE3491_06FC410: You can't domesticate a husk, Penny, no matter how much you think you love him.
Dialogue.F0FE76EA46577DA25CF6F5B2DA1FA1D4_97A9259: You can't even convince anyone I exist.
Dialogue.E82E0C954C27DEB47A0DEBB2493336C3_7D2960E: You can't fix that if you're dead.
Dialogue.95C199034C81D12D309A89BB7CC74371_21C1927: You can't get rid of Jilly Teacup that easy.
Dialogue.F88519AA415593D2C10484851375F787_94F2B66: You can't get yourself back in the game. You'll need your teammates to bring you back!
Dialogue.98343E614FC2776E3DF3CEBF52C28F89_72190CE: You can't go on without me. I mean... you can, but you shouldn't.
Dialogue.4C758A4C421139CA9DA672A2036B6745_06FC410: You can't have coffee. Liquid makes you catch on fire.
Dialogue.FC7F031C40B37B084963BA858BBFB571_47CFF90: You can't ignore without learning to listen, first.
Dialogue.D147EB964F21E316568D09A2CB2D720A_181CD3E: You can't just sentence me to death!
Dialogue.EDFCCFBA44E92C248DCBAD88AEE3C959_97A9259: You can't keep doing this to yourself, Ray.
Dialogue.673763F24FEC51782BBD2F8C02E46211_07E024E: You can't kill me that easily.
Dialogue.950C4AE84D6C3561B3F054A0DEE588D6_CC5E92B: You can't leave me like this.
Dialogue.6765E10C4D8436DCDCDBC29092F602E0_B68F328: You can't let it in. It'll drag you down and swallow you whole.
Dialogue.8E9777DD4E183073CAB8DF932561A9D6_AFB40E2: You can't love someone if you don't first love yourself.
Dialogue.CC5B79A74FFF5E69DA1D68BB07666070_72190CE: You can't make a map, dummy. (laughs) Maps come from the store! Oh, man. This is rich.
Dialogue.E14ACD4046A2E2919280FF8417E618DA_06FC410: You can't make friends if you can't be found.
Dialogue.002E976845DDFF31F95BCA9351BE0F74_AF0DA39: You can't make me come to Homebase!
Dialogue.B19220684983772F69C5E48CA70C21A0_06FC410: You can't say it's healthy and also that it's candy.
Dialogue.4889D2AF4CA7992A06A160ACE20A56A0_5AA487F: You can't solve all your problems by smashing them.
Dialogue.AC2CFDB8438DF6AC584CAFBCB510066E_9801E98: You can't solve all your problems by smashing them.
Dialogue.9D7D1A3B46FC6961B51F5A82C9CAE48F_861A10F: You can't tell someone else who to invite to their wedding, Dennis.
Dialogue.D467FD804EF005BD333830A3784306C1_5CE5FC8: You can't trick a trickster. Classic rube mistake.
Dialogue.C9C0D729495D207ABAAEA8B53756C47D_FB122F8: You can't. I removed the thing.
Dialogue.693AD4D546253D51C86A4A8BF2C761CB_FB122F8: You can, uh... guess where this is going.
Dialogue.F112D7174329E314EE0A4AA02CA5BCCC_72190CE: You can... touch it if you want.
Dialogue.A850ACFA4BEC873EBF6ED980EA97AC51_0A979DB: You clearly want to tell it. You tell it.
Dialogue.CA0A1A634A4201146BA2E2B9F7633DB1_06FC410: You collected a few files! Still good!
Dialogue.B35D6F294413B2D4031AF982D8FDABB9_06FC410: You collected all of the files! Amazing!
Dialogue.FEAC7D0B4C4529C83921D6844865C2BB_06FC410: You collected some of the files! Alright.
Dialogue.35DFF09C4A50133CDA719A8273153519_AB3C42C: You convinced ED-EE to get into the rocket.
Dialogue.38A433F24FCC61B6FDEF04BBD93104ED_1D2FE88: You could always... fry again... (laughs) See what I did?
Dialogue.FD3A9D30432517B6A4FBCE97C1058A72_97A9259: You could die out there in the storm.
Dialogue.5FCC0C4A4A8EEC3B3FD6C9A02A80BE69_77D814F: You could have told me that back when I was a nervous mess.
Dialogue.FB47683445E3E5B0130D71A01CD1AF0A_06FC410: You could have told us how you felt instead of acting like a creep!
Dialogue.2F208A7A4FCC4BB3A47D7386E4FCF0C9_4731F06: You could make me one of your signature burgers.
Dialogue.FD1BD0CA4EA0ABD3C34202ACAB4F218E_97A9259: You could say watching a movie about the parents of an unborn rebellion leader,
Dialogue.F9828B7D48FC5A56FA817A84A30B45BD_5991012: You could shake some paws, you could kiss some eggs, you could show 'em why humanity is better than "The Worst, Actually."
Dialogue.A852DDEE453A9B211C1980B9AF4AF1B4_94F2B66: You couldn't do that the first time?
Dialogue.D90E43354F1179646D56E5A0D34F9AF6_21C1927: You couldn't even flip a coin?
Dialogue.C813A2D64FFA962D52C7CD8F741129E8_47CFF90: You couldn't give me my moment?
Dialogue.8784D11A45203AC888A918A022A1911D_861A10F: You couldn't help people at home?
Dialogue.6E516EE143EDB418B56F1DA9A81B83FF_06FC410: You dance even though you are definitely not good at it.
Dialogue.1B9FC6A448C14C261FB183A12555CAFF_0BE868E: You dare throw husks at us, flinger?
Dialogue.C0DC5D4E4EA6B08AEF69DF86C3514E85_FB122F8: You delete a lot of super critical data. We honestly thought you were a spy for a while but, uh... yeah, no.
Dialogue.67183E6945AF5C6C3274BF99A5497C1C_06FC410: You deserved so much more and so much better than what we gave you and--
Dialogue.9B2693144426D318E9AFA3BB1B08FF40_7D086D9: You did more with it than I ever could.
Dialogue.1D1817CD4C2866EEE374EC98724292F7_AB3C42C: You did tell them to write an episode of "Beyond The Stellar Horizon," right?
Dialogue.348E0BFB4BCE80F6B4BB51A267A77E9F_0ADEFA4: You did what needed to be done.
Dialogue.B02D6D59417D63DA99F86DB64BCD1ADF_861A10F: You didn't cause any of this.
Dialogue.0EEAFF27474D2AA5D2876E9C9A1CB96A_94F2B66: You didn't die in there, did ya?
Dialogue.0E0CBC27479D92DA1344ECA50DADAC87_9801E98: You didn't ruin everyone's life, man. Just mine. And Carlos'. And Anthony's.
Dialogue.F675FF0549F74C9337ECE0A24A5CD30A_1D2FE88: You died. But now you're back.
Dialogue.7D16F0554B1D726BD4FC289C499D73CA_06FC410: You do bad, you know what you've done.
Dialogue.4A77549243A3D72D6C3FF595C8D16440_EAAE146: You do it. You've earned it.
Dialogue.FD2D54A4403A5C0022CFB08D255CD7DF_5CE5FC8: You do know you're rubes, right?
Dialogue.8E5742A44ACD67B801A503B250A4BB75_47CFF90: You do mention this video often...
Dialogue.A7D2810F4FBD446BC8C06FB54879FA9B_0BE868E: You do not fail while in my employ!
Dialogue.5DD96F434D37BFF13A8EE0998014961C_97A9259: You do remember we're his hostages, right?
Dialogue.4247421144144CA0C05F56A01DC7244C_EB81C5B: You do this to everyone you meet?
Dialogue.AC476F624B80742BE636E4B4ECC83A3B_06FC410: You dodged a bullet. She was literally a monster.
Dialogue.1E8FECF043552C1B60F303ACE9D354D6_7712BEE: You don't become evil simply by not being good.
Dialogue.7166DD3745C6EC27483631A5D4964EAE_FB122F8: You don't come back from plaid.
Dialogue.04C0A340495CF5720F537893884BBBF4_7712BEE: You don't do that to the ones you want to keep.
Dialogue.E4A13AB64241C3C8A415528E0015B236_9D00593: You don't even have stockings hung from your fireplace.
Dialogue.12606DDF4BC50711E401A3892B8BC58C_06FC410: You don't get to be in our movie, husks!
Dialogue.E4D3BB67426E1BCDE44903B8AC53CB4C_97A9259: You don't get to the sovereign nation of Lovesylvania without crossing a few boundaries.
Dialogue.85D641964EA15D381AE0E8850ABD789B_06FC410: You don't have a son and that is not where this is headed.
Dialogue.DC59274349E0053BD635188A35482C22_06FC410: You don't have any BluGlo to deposit.
Dialogue.CD09AA43477FF3A98A7A0399B5ACA94E_7D086D9: You don't have any other choice here.
Dialogue.85D3573B4341FABD45778C89A341430A_06FC410: You don't have to believe in us, just know we're here if you need us.
Dialogue.43C845504629D6A4770264A6596772C9_06FC410: You don't have to call me Miss Ray.
Dialogue.6A14A8E74388C001271DBD9BEA063411_97A9259: You don't have to convince me.
Dialogue.27B4845A45C29F7B2F7D429C73819E96_06FC410: You don't have to cook for the pirates.
Dialogue.4C4BC3DF483765206E9431832F6939A6_06FC410: You don't have to keep saying that...
Dialogue.B22726B24907E75D0BD805865A48BE80_6E5AC35: You don't have to let it end this way.
Dialogue.315F44B54CA74F322BE41FAB1B63D7B5_FB122F8: You don't have to say anything... I've calmed myself down.
Dialogue.ABA603AF4AFEDE5E124C298291010CEF_C0E27E7: You don't have to smash! It's a choice you're making.
Dialogue.3D00A08249B4F034BAA62F835C520B8F_97A9259: You don't host a call-in radio show about love without learning a few things.
Dialogue.D7E4136E4B076C87E872B1AA31DAA821_861A10F: You don't know him like I know him!
Dialogue.B2CE42DB48B735C3D9FDE59BBDA1BD0B_06FC410: You don't need to apologize. We've all felt that way.
Dialogue.E1203BED4613393428DD0E9D7D4E8055_724DAF1: You don't need to be any of those things to make a difference. You’re Dennis.
Dialogue.32B492F0401803428FA5EB92E3A6AFE8_06FC410: You don't need to send a warning.
Dialogue.A12937F04FDE18EA211CE28748BC9433_89ED452: You don't say. Let's find some TVs.
Dialogue.FA3502954D813AB93F5639B5C639F951_861A10F: You don't seem to mind having Rarrnold around and he's a husk!
Dialogue.4572AD1E4F18925A0970898C5EF9F33C_861A10F: You don't seem to think my stories are all that scary, so...
Dialogue.F1CC426A46A91CAC59B2AA9250A84996_06FC410: You don't survive the end of the world just to die in some lab accident.
Dialogue.FBF609044B5CFA28B40711A58AF11B4D_47CFF90: You don't understand... which is not surprising.
Dialogue.B581AC664312AC0A7E008CBEDA4BDD1F_B222EAD: You don't want to move on until you secure your legacy as a bloodthirsty pirate.
Dialogue.5785D07B464B134C55EB7CBFE1E4DB55_FB122F8: You draw two cards for referencing a rule.
Dialogue.149778B340DAB9ED2EFA859224AC4F86_47CFF90: You earned your place in Homebase long ago. And that's a forever thing.
Dialogue.53AC59E3484B346E1D01729D442E9347_06FC410: You eat food knowing full well what's going to happen to that food.
Dialogue.DDB25A134A22E6D7C9A806B7DC2362C9_94F2B66: You enjoy that anomaly slurping down your life force, rookie? I didn’t think so!
Dialogue.4C437E6B437E290453CBED8DE5D04097_06FC410: You even kiss each other like germs aren't trying to kill you dead every second of every day!
Dialogue.7918719D4040149F5C70A5857EBC7859_2DD597A: You even know how to use that thing?
Dialogue.5054912D448FF4F3B59AF793E1FF2520_9801E98: You ever seen a land periscope?
Dialogue.B9BB084F45FD8ABE7F5CE0AC41640912_21C1927: You ever seen that video of the racoon trying to wash off his cotton candy?
Dialogue.EAEEFB0C433CCDD9EE2B869F24809103_06FC410: You fall in love even though you know things probably won't work out the way you want.
Dialogue.74CD07164D75A516BF6FDABF37727B3B_14FBFB1: You figured right. But... I got to thinking.
Dialogue.1593890B4E8DB6EC0AB3C49E182E37D2_06FC410: You find the control circuits we need, I'll learn to solder.
Dialogue.0457980641A1E8E4EC9B3DAC397B7121_06FC410: You find the targets, I'll warm up the ATLAS.
Dialogue.A37F9D4048B98DDA5B72EA9B3E04DCD8_CC5E92B: You focus and plan, I'm just gonna go win.
Dialogue.B146FB8745A54E5352D3C6BF93134CFD_06FC410: You found another of Carlos' research setups!
Dialogue.D533B37D45EE24FCADFABC885BF39AE6_06FC410: You get the gist of this one.
Dialogue.E1AA56174899BBBBBACD8B8B9C282043_06FC410: You get used to the terror after a while.
Dialogue.9D9FC77C4F915161943946BFAA760166_B222EAD: You give gifts to people that don't want your help?
Dialogue.B0D12B3543B4857ECD25F89BCD4450EE_06FC410: You go ahead. I need to sit here for... however long it takes me to not want to yell at Dennis.
Dialogue.D204EA4A4722ECB3FC47C4852E15B417_7712BEE: You go on one rampage and suddenly you're a monster.
Dialogue.2DA510BD448BDEBCDFFDDDAA3D9B5922_9801E98: You got chops, my dude, but you're confusing.
Dialogue.BBA6BC1747B3A2697E30C68B8630DB16_FB122F8: You got it, Little Robot. This is an air current chart between here and...
Dialogue.854D59754FEB9196F38AA99DE63DE740_FB122F8: You got me thinking about my touring days, so I broke out some Steel Wool.
Dialogue.4953B6604471039D80695083FEF269D7_06FC410: You got me twice, Jilly Teacup.
Dialogue.A4787F5445FBDE999AE3A792501FDFE8_97A9259: You got the spark, Ray. Now share it with Homebase!
Dialogue.36F178A34D38549F8E6835B0B207F8FE_A96EA86: You got those first day jitters, I get it.
Dialogue.64B2DFFE4D3F709C46D57CB2D9043502_06FC410: You gotta change that right now, Ted.
Dialogue.987368B44D9AEFF44A36E0AE77A09DCC_9801E98: You gotta do something while the samples process.
Dialogue.1858B13A48ACC3432BA419AD14083E21_9F725B6: You gotta find your own way.
Dialogue.38C68A4D401A1DC2F4D604B8D0DF3AD8_97A9259: You gotta know your limits, Oakdirge.
Dialogue.6057D7A942C86F09AF1A4AA35F26AAAE_06FC410: You grab his... head, and I will grab his feet.
Dialogue.59075923473A47BF29A6AEA074EFE696_1D2FE88: You grew up wishing you could be an adventurer in one of those classic movies...
Dialogue.7058592A40B20EDF409B19AB1336D9CD_FB122F8: You guys are dealing me nothing but trash.
Dialogue.75A6EAD34C00C17C9CC637B262E7058A_EAAE146: You guys are pretty good at fighting those... things.
Dialogue.E11ACBAA4BDE4C660AAAA882C98DB1D9_87F0BBB: You guys have put in the work and... I think we may have a team here.
Dialogue.BFB2A3BA479A32F3AC823D8F33C34942_724DAF1: You guys should listen to Dennis. He's wise beyond his words.
Dialogue.5F8C08C045FA05F9F776BC8F517AEE14_06FC410: You guys were doing so well.
Dialogue.5CA92911451AB60A467E3780BCD3C148_97A9259: You guys will never believe what happened. I had the craziest dream.
Dialogue.D805217C469FB1FD098F568843C51051_C9708CA: You guys... I'm serious. You've got to take care of each other.
Dialogue.D2A4F2B6414E4D705707E3A04817895C_06FC410: You had a bad guy named "The Mobsled?"
Dialogue.D78BADFF4A6BCA635ED380BD8D9D783C_EAAE146: You handle pressure worse than a worn out kettle.
Dialogue.16EF9A504F08357DD5430EBCDB379F29_FB122F8: You have a bridge out ahead. Time to get crafty.
Dialogue.808A5CAA4078EDE49FE6EDB5C7389597_06FC410: You have a generator to install. Check your map.
Dialogue.85D961D6445358E0077264BE175C3AA1_FB122F8: You have a recording of crushing silence?
Dialogue.61D2661A411F12759C059FA59C02051F_06FC410: You have a secret lair? Can I see it?
Dialogue.2B7334F14AD56B57E485DE927B244D2E_1D2FE88: You have empowered the curse with your failure.
Dialogue.68475277404428DB3D658687232B9A3D_861A10F: You have every right to be stubborn and boring.
Dialogue.3309552147F139F142E15591DAD83E22_87F0BBB: You have no idea how long I've waited for someone cool to show up here.
Dialogue.5DD630E541C5C1513597EC8A6F5990F0_06FC410: You have nothing to be embarrassed about.
Dialogue.8F284D1342DC49DFB0C31D9DB2FA07D6_77D814F: You have people here who care about you so much...
Dialogue.E4C468684946BDEDE5E2508A56C398BB_47CFF90: You have seventeen people on hold. I could let you get back to it.
Dialogue.47F1AF6044D1042DB2FFCF95EE022AE6_AB3C42C: You have talent, Ken. Don't hide from it.
Dialogue.26DDF546432867674BA6D8A0935B34AA_0ADEFA4: You have the chance to change the future and save Homebase...
Dialogue.C5E074C14469BE9556170A95ACC4C226_B229E47: You have the tools to save the world.
Dialogue.03A5908B4D92758497F878AFC2433344_06FC410: You have time to keep building.
Dialogue.2AC9D41D4F3C93804809BCA2F3D24F79_7D086D9: You have to at least remember if he has any ports.
Dialogue.A51DE2E0481195439A96469DF29F8CB1_06FC410: You have to give me something. Give me a reason to trust you.
Dialogue.817F6A234D61255D4F5165A58346F872_97A9259: You have to know no one's buying your backstory.
Dialogue.31C2FE7F4AA67D572AF9EEB24F58C83F_D87E161: You have to know what you're deciding between before you flip a coin.
Dialogue.E445150842332E182B0D25BC02DDCD78_72190CE: You have to teach me how to do that.
Dialogue.2AD942ED47BE4D126D6858A1644BC346_724DAF1: You have to yell, "I have the capacity to change. Today is the day I become the real me!"
Dialogue.2BBC7B4841BC0D179E443CAF2A3EF7BA_06FC410: You have twenty minutes to build three towers.
Dialogue.0A8DE7454C2BF6D02D6E099EC48B2435_06FC410: You have wood, stone, and metal.
Dialogue.BD1D18CC41BDFFB031303FA1133695C9_94F2B66: You haven't even picked a target.
Dialogue.25B5448A43CFC3F15CE9E7A81A35834C_06FC410: You hear me? Take me back and I will shower you in Nedkits.
Dialogue.1926102C46871D50CD66F5ACA4E8AE7B_94F2B66: You hear that, storm? We give up.
Dialogue.8B239436426F10DA06A8CE8AFEB81239_94F2B66: You heard that from Ray herself.
Dialogue.7600305D4E942CA0D20A68A0CF503567_06FC410: You heard the Captain, we're officially at pre-production... whatever that means.
Dialogue.E957ED1141E7FE353EEA8E943EA933D4_47CFF90: You heard the woman, let's go!
Dialogue.E1D7EA7441B4449B838384B78B02FA29_A96EA86: You just bought yourself another minute.
Dialogue.EDF5A0774628E0E7561B82A9DFD4B755_97A9259: You just eliminated, like, a bunch of us.
Dialogue.DEBC961044E343793EBFDD9CD5514F10_06FC410: You just get ready to rock...
Dialogue.6BBAABF24B8BFB4B38F3BE9FB84E058B_37EFC25: You just need to believe in the Krampusnacht spirit!
Dialogue.DDC0206A45D7FDAF9EBFD192D310ED92_97A9259: You just want to flaunt your water privileges.
Dialogue.DAC0A1434D3F44F43507A993F032E018_06FC410: You just... get out there and make this the most terrible Christmas ever.
Dialogue.D72FF2564740E636AD593EAADADB0A0E_06FC410: You keep it up and you're getting wheels!
Dialogue.8EFB94724C89109AC9204482783575AE_87F0BBB: You keep rocking on against love, Lars.
Dialogue.D9FBC20548073E9E0DB7AB9B9C7791BF_06FC410: You keep talking about my vision. What if I don't have one?
Dialogue.260967C842C51AD44F6BE1826675217E_7D086D9: You kinda do. But let's focus on impressive, showy plots of land.
Dialogue.09FF7C2B48125443B95B00958F56025A_765440C: You know I can't let you do this, Good Doctor.
Dialogue.A01878DB4830638D0A80A7B2522BC4CD_FB122F8: You know I can't open the vault for civilians.
Dialogue.E7044B8E459FAD61FC1C95A1477FEBD2_06FC410: You know I was lying about letting that strange weirdo die out there in the storm.
Dialogue.8133BFAE496A27F914449C93915159F4_47CFF90: You know I would if I could.
Dialogue.ADB1DE4F42B47B1D7EA643A7FC47B2F7_97A9259: You know I'm avoiding spoilers. You can't avoid spoilers if you listen.
Dialogue.A99F3A2F4F2CD5D6582437A7C485B7B5_D87E161: You know how I feel about flattery.
Dialogue.A70C6E8342CE8A7D7670A083D0DED11E_06FC410: You know how the story of the Blackboot Ayers seems to have influenced some of the husks?
Dialogue.831D613A4A588BD993D517803E983BFC_B222EAD: You know how vengeful spirits are.
Dialogue.87ED303440591D95F627C38CBD3AEF36_06FC410: You know how we have that bot that sees things for us?
Dialogue.2B6621AB4AAC5161B3A2469CAE688B30_06FC410: You know how we're always coming up with gadgets to outsmart the storm?
Dialogue.16312EF04B17124696D8BB937A0B4A2A_06FC410: You know in your heart what the truth is.
Dialogue.88E3F17740FB6B8A3CA95C959FC5E819_FB122F8: You know it's Carlos... or you hope it's Carlos?
Dialogue.030C6C6C4196394066DD59935F282F51_D87E161: You know it. My love life is a dumpster just waiting for that one romantic spark.
Dialogue.BC138C424DD3D30A4A6F06BC317C4EA9_06FC410: You know logic loops break my brain-- (glitching out) Brain, brain, brain, br-- See?!
Dialogue.A1704515473AEA52AD317AB9059B550B_77D814F: You know my number. Give me a call.
Dialogue.945A654A4D809AA75035D5A9B2740A38_06FC410: You know once we get rolling, husks are going to try to bust in. They're so hungry for the spotlight.
Dialogue.06FE902C4913E4F7CEA9C18494943717_861A10F: You know that can't possibly be true, right?
Dialogue.F4D870A342B849DB921A45B270F16ECD_47CFF90: You know that's not going to happen.
Dialogue.10D20D1642500144CCA34B8C816CED89_06FC410: You know the answer to that question!
Dialogue.A35012944858C2F4A341C4A4D72ACACA_06FC410: You know the drill. Stay cool. Don't die. Kill clouds.
Dialogue.5A9908374A88F23C745916BCE3ACF2A8_06FC410: You know the drill. We have disabled the Storm Shield, which means there is no barrier between you and the hordes outside.
Dialogue.D36B097E4C8509E6F85077872EBC07A9_FB122F8: You know the musicians aren't actually in the radio. Right?
Dialogue.47656B3E4B614C4EF6E9649A34E715E5_77D814F: You know the way. All that's left is the marching.
Dialogue.41A1AA864A97DCDF4460708BB5E1B742_B222EAD: You know there's a gigantic hole in the floorboard, right?
Dialogue.54F1A8E84BEB8087F7873E858BFF0A51_861A10F: You know they won't RSVP. They're monsters.
Dialogue.86D2ACF84626A7CDB886E5958EFCBA3E_06FC410: You know those rumors we've been hearing about an even more dangerous part of the storm?
Dialogue.4948CCE64BB8A6FF509AE89EB47775D2_AB3C42C: You know what Captain Clark would say about this?
Dialogue.B3BAA77B4D48F7268ED7A7AD1427AE94_EC1949E: You know what I think, Lok? Sometimes you just need to distract yourself.
Dialogue.3D26127E4C4B4451AF3C09A6027A77C0_9D00593: You know what I think? I think the husks came because we have strayed from holiday cheer.
Dialogue.A564362A44B1D90EA7501383EA7451B9_DA0538A: You know what I’d love for Christmas? Some bullets!
Dialogue.5A72738E4E7A8DCA093E6696AB45AD34_CC240C1: You know what always makes me happy?
Dialogue.54496F4646C37E9E5C93CFA1C612AC9E_97A9259: You know what they say... Mess with the fox, get the problems.
Dialogue.386C5EA44EDEECC3A143FCACCA7CFD99_06FC410: You know what, I'll do it. It's fine.
Dialogue.861FD08B43185DA7072BAFBE85CFBB7C_C9708CA: You know what, no sense in dancing around it. I'll commit - I have had the worst week of my life.
Dialogue.81DBF688400449DABE9BB69A0BD66ACC_06FC410: You know what, screenwriters? It's not that easy!
Dialogue.A6AA0B5E4EBBCBC83A16E7916C234499_06FC410: You know what, we've got enough pioneers.
Dialogue.728FAD8B413B4FDBBB921F982BDDF8C9_06FC410: You know what. I don't care what you think, we're coming to save you.
Dialogue.F30A57A34CDCF44A0D4F3C9B7A46CFC1_06FC410: You know what. I'm starting to not like these people.
Dialogue.9F3CDA4B48A1B228CE7BFFBBEC7F3A0F_724DAF1: You know what... I am ready to change.
Dialogue.FAB2E0C743F2DE52B4C89892F6207C5C_FB122F8: You know what... do what you gotta do.
Dialogue.0C3AE43241889520DA1DBDABF00E61AC_94F2B66: You know what?  Don't tell me. I've got enough on my mind as it is.
Dialogue.97A016F44A39510337DB159C79A788BD_06FC410: You know what? Both at the same time is totally fine.
Dialogue.5C300BD547AC548A7807DBB5EC4E2A9B_97A9259: You know what? Don't be afraid to break his heart in public, girl. That is ratings gold.
Dialogue.39EA6E0D4006C357CEFEAF8857193293_72190CE: You know what? Everyone, we're opening it together!
Dialogue.FC73293549425566AACC33BC8AD09596_06FC410: You know what? I admire that. It's bold.
Dialogue.A695753A4A23FD7FFA11B9B19CEA66B4_FB122F8: You know what? I apologized to Carlos. I thought we were cool. What happened?
Dialogue.29EE134B4D7E5BE937697A821F29F47D_06FC410: You know what? I don't need adventure. I am content to spend the day with my friends.
Dialogue.39CE8CDB4B08B14E36ABE09367E0605C_72190CE: You know what? I think I'm gonna stay.
Dialogue.AE83708845ED53DB637FB3B64478D612_06FC410: You know what? I think we're fine with getting mauled at this point.
Dialogue.9185B65744EAAA9950DF2BACB77B732C_47CFF90: You know what? I'd like to get a second opinion.
Dialogue.E0FF330A40D206C69304EC8D86F91352_47CFF90: You know what? I'll give you your silver lining.
Dialogue.75C1A2084318979D480DF6B5FA917E0D_5991012: You know what? I've given it some thought. I HAVE met wolves with bad communication skills.
Dialogue.A7E608004B64F912F6D2F6A5E98D1B86_06FC410: You know what? Maybe I just need to get in the mood for love.
Dialogue.9E721C6740C27C84D9D33787B0D7F3A4_EED9CD8: You know what? That's very fair. That's very fair.
Dialogue.F1DC8BA749C63B0F875C0FBA2B4430E9_F130B8E: You know what? You deserve this, I'm proud of you.
Dialogue.A2244F764D4E1480FD55E2B8BEF3ED94_06FC410: You know where this is going...
Dialogue.56E1D0F44D29C7D47638F3ABEB86C6A1_A96EA86: You know you can loosen up if you want?
Dialogue.EB9C304343D4A7161EF04B8717A86E72_06FC410: You know you can't stay with us, Dire.
Dialogue.5B14CA7349CF7465FCA43981D09358E6_06FC410: You know, Commander. I don't say it enough... but you truly are an inspiration.
Dialogue.3AFB76254C8FF1B186FB26B9A9366226_181CD3E: You know, Dukes and Lords. Fancy balls. Drama about your estate and lands!
Dialogue.F0F2B806440A2B898DCDBF85CD10CD2A_06FC410: You know, I didn't think so? But it is not out of the realm of possibility that I am just really good at jar recognition.
Dialogue.040ADBDD4A5CB2C5E79AE284F464F279_06FC410: You know, I never thought story problems would come in handy.
Dialogue.5C92BB2840DE932AA3DD36BA326532D5_B25EA52: You know, I see these people getting injured or killed...
Dialogue.259A456445CD98403BA3E8A0B84C90EC_06FC410: You know, I think they were going to stock a homebase.
Dialogue.200ECA2D4D4AED186F040DB23E7DD9D2_FB122F8: You know, I think whatever is happening in the sky...
Dialogue.97DD7CEE4E2958EDA2F4B4921AB011C5_06FC410: You know, I want to make fun of this, but honestly they're Homebase's happiest couple.
Dialogue.C41B187F4FD970EBE7465A82E8448512_06FC410: You know, I'm really starting to like this plan.
Dialogue.151B9E4A466859121699FD9A72138141_181CD3E: You know, I've been rewatching the old Morpho Gear Gang cartoon. First time since it was on the air.
Dialogue.320EF78743803A101F2549B66BF42981_9801E98: You know, Lars. Anthony's a screw up, but at least he cares about someone other than himself.
Dialogue.235D34674919EB4DCAF112B4599247F9_89ED452: You know, Lok, if you don't have any secrets that's okay.
Dialogue.D2845DC240051DBF03C9A69B9C938AFD_06FC410: You know, Penny, sometimes you just gotta let a husk be a husk.
Dialogue.8F3A9ACA4443739EE6FA53949EEA68DA_47CFF90: You know, as a brief aside... I think we might want to talk about your name, Blake.
Dialogue.0B6EE8354E3F492F78CAC1B325B36243_FB122F8: You know, blaze of glory has its perks, but I think I'm a bunker man.
Dialogue.C993D36947158E200E32879253857D47_5991012: You know, for the glamorous chicken pictures.
Dialogue.7119AF094ABD57BA68A8C8A5D9C0F4CE_FB122F8: You know, from way up here in the van, it's not looking good.
Dialogue.ED30AB7D4648FC697C2491B60208B701_47CFF90: You know, if you keep this up, we might be able to explore other areas beyond Homebase.
Dialogue.FB6F19614840B9393EFE6BB1506EC8A3_97A9259: You know, in a way, I envy Brainstorm.
Dialogue.87646CD3404C2D8A1905F8AB7B40BE77_06FC410: You know, in my life so far I have had like nine people say that to me.

Dialogue.6B5582974E91F1908FA375AFBB958BAF_FB122F8: You know, maybe building's your thing. We could teach you.
Dialogue.9BAE304C4A71513C5BADA49AA99EDBF4_910A467: You know, maybe that’s my bad for putting that there.
Dialogue.B0B7D51C4870711F99F369901DE594E8_06FC410: You know, maybe you can help him get over whatever's going on.
Dialogue.69ECA4654C9CE8238DDE03A0EA2E6FC4_97A9259: You know, not present in the current design, believe it or not...
Dialogue.A3A581904ADC4346E90F84AB8639F983_06FC410: You know, once, I heard that objectives hate being destroyed. True story!
Dialogue.2B4E5D134944AA9DB6F9178CEEEFDD61_181CD3E: You know, one of the things critics always said was that the Morpho Gear Gang didn't have good enough villains.
Dialogue.ECF2653D4AFBF16F5E282A815D7748E4_87F0BBB: You know, some cultures had vocabularies made up of only a few words.

Dialogue.9EE228BF49E39FADEC0119B493494687_FB122F8: You know, this might be the bee venom speaking but, uh... you seem kinda down.

Dialogue.7A1FFE624E1EB3DA0182E0BEDC38E876_97A9259: You know, we both lost a lot of credibility with that ghost tape reveal.

Dialogue.617B325D40E3127181D5358ECF6619E7_06FC410: You know, you have my sympathy...
Dialogue.E3BDA4554BEF5D6EC7A7D19982FCB27B_6E5AC35: You know, you have the power to stop this.
Dialogue.9F5BF8F34FC8AE223563B19C431A717B_87F0BBB: You know. What do you get for the guy who's got all the rice?
Dialogue.CFA36AED49DD0BF92741E399CDA74A63_181CD3E: You know. You make a good action lawyer.
Dialogue.90DB98E44D783EE33C57F88C435B8205_861A10F: You know... I don't know really.
Dialogue.0BE9F4B1406E11C3BF78D7BB38C2F0A7_06FC410: You know... I'm going for that glory. Although, denial is very comforting.
Dialogue.ABB4BC08423EA9B04C9E05B8987CBEAA_7D086D9: You know... If I understood what was happening I never would have left.

Dialogue.61F2E43B4438B0A7DE152C9045959FFA_4731F06: You know... actually, yeah. I'd like that.
Dialogue.660281184EC3D126BBB8AC81716F379F_06FC410: You know... in a way, it's nice to know that love still makes a fool of us all, even at the end of the world.
Dialogue.4FB804384C40117DC82DB5899A63A77F_47CFF90: You know... rather than framing it as "democracy building" or "spreading freedom."
Dialogue.DB47F08F4A7004A0DEFA04BFFE43593E_7D2960E: You know... thank you for thanking me. That took restraint.
Dialogue.B4ACE34F44DBF4775A7DA4AC59A9621F_9801E98: You know... with the constant exposure to the storm, I'd expect to see more corrosion on these scopes.

Dialogue.7B6A417B4A5740CA62D821968F28567B_B222EAD: You made sure Keelhaul was safe! (laughter)

Dialogue.DD052D444B30CEE9B1A0318E950D3A96_06FC410: You made us all look like jerks.
Dialogue.3BDD9FA346D19DCF833D8B93DFD729C7_97A9259: You make a fair point, Metal Chicken.
Dialogue.50FB417C4C461AC48AC802AE77B09BF8_0A979DB: You make it look so easy.

Dialogue.37D4C3F149C305FAFE78B28B610C796E_06FC410: You may be wondering why I summoned the top two builders in homebase...
Dialogue.1ABB47EE4BF3E44F1F3EE9B13C46F027_FB122F8: You may call it a hole, but I think of it as an accessory window.
Dialogue.0A40DBF04928982008C892B06AB6EB05_97A9259: You may know me, but I don't know you yet.
Dialogue.98007BB3451CEDE172A82BA3064666E8_1D2FE88: You may not know this, but every dungeon dreams of becoming a Grotto.

Dialogue.75EFC5614C492C04A6A44DA0D93B9472_06FC410: You may want to collect resources before starting to build.

Dialogue.250775824B3E76B5154A0586B1A6CB3B_06FC410: You may want to focus on weapons with a low crafting cost.

Dialogue.4468B8574610F6979A41849F26FA49E2_FB122F8: You said I'm allowed to sit in the van whenever you're spiralling.
Dialogue.D0D71E6E41C779991FD4929CEB2BFBA0_94F2B66: You said if I told you you have what it takes to become a hero... you'd believe me.
Dialogue.49C7155A419CCE5EA5E97583EE96CD00_06FC410: You said she remembers. What does she remember?
Dialogue.832FA03D4ADC6911FDB4FDBAE0D74A84_21C1927: You said shut up and be me, and I did, and who I am is Jilly Sippin' Teacup! Tea party expert!
Dialogue.999616AB4250D6788999FDBA2AD81D53_06FC410: You said that I'm creepy, and that what Dr. Vinderman did after you left was creepy.
Dialogue.CD575DC444073FE149D3A6854673BFC6_4731F06: You said that to me once before...
Dialogue.F73E8E8D4C159F887717328335CB1AEC_21C1927: You said the Director wanted to get in shape before winter's over, right?
Dialogue.7F144D584788CA7D6FEEC7A269ADC2FA_B222EAD: You said to write what you know.
Dialogue.DBD44F474C9B5CE799393DBC35400DF2_5991012: You saw how she chomped on that wooden guy, right? Like, (imitating chomping).
Dialogue.90FF6B874D6E3A8754B19CACA7F3BD61_0A979DB: You say it all the time.
Dialogue.0BB7FD2B4F45F62B7D959CBB88A7A749_06FC410: You scared me, Lars. A warning that you wake up cranked to eleven would have been nice.
Dialogue.42EBE47441868F3E576890BD446ADF20_47CFF90: You scratch behind my ears, I'll scratch behind yours.
Dialogue.1C14058B4C84FDBB16078BBBB4B779AD_06FC410: You see it too, don't you?
Dialogue.E57DEB954700247A5D86F0943924424C_06FC410: You see that husk too, right?
Dialogue.38FD41DC4C0ADC285A3DACBA96E9F6F1_861A10F: You see that structure? It's a maze, and yours to haunt all you like.
Dialogue.5AB3A4EC42DD024B22D04FB4CB0B1393_C2C5A2E: You see them out by the wall of the storm.
Dialogue.7F281D044750B7328261C6ADD7BD237A_89ED452: You see what I mean with everyone getting weird about this secret telling stuff?
Dialogue.9B22499A4FF1076822174584CBA0707A_9D00593: You see, things get a bit quiet when the holidays wrap up.
Dialogue.B9151EE0436A20B74ABD63BF8066241F_9D00593: You see, this year's exceptional Christmas so thoroughly sated my appetites, I want for nothing save perhaps a sandwich and a glass of water.
Dialogue.9C0C46EC486266DC0359F788CAB04513_CC240C1: You seem awfully comfortable with haunted electronics.
Dialogue.E84AED104251C4046DDF2A93F843CCB7_FB122F8: You seem cool and all, but sometimes things in my head get a little... Whew! Eh hehe...
Dialogue.E0A789F443E2274139EC3D976B21FB0E_910A467: You seem frustrated. Would you like to yell at me?
Dialogue.15853041490C406B4AB5B78327240B7B_97A9259: You seem mad, so... I'd really love some clarity.
Dialogue.4C1BB3B34D44679FA9F2EB94591BAF4E_2DD597A: You seem to be making a mistake.
Dialogue.FA54DF2E4CD6EE386814E084C9E5C359_97A9259: You seem to miss out on all the love lobber crush craziness.
Dialogue.A9F0E0034C848036E5B7268D2A033B2F_DB7CBEB: You send the best you get the best, Azzie.
Dialogue.FCE615F14BF88F6F6E840E8CCA4C18EC_06FC410: You sent us on a mad hunt to find socks!?
Dialogue.D03BA58F4AEB1EB70DDCD2A2047D4B61_47CFF90: You sewed her together. You don't trust your own skills?
Dialogue.80E03D9A460714D66D2B70970F937CBD_0BE868E: You shall be our royal subject.
Dialogue.6B1CCB15416BEB1D34DCDC9249A19D8E_1FCF39D: You shall help protect the Winter Kingdom.
Dialogue.7D8A1C654A901F0E2BA298BBD484338E_861A10F: You should be a safe distance away when I flip the switch, Lok
Dialogue.1885CBB345084BB6B644FD93D2FB1D38_9D00593: You should be afraid! You should be terrified!
Dialogue.0072950E4C6477D16D311BB212D67523_06FC410: You should be getting better... and forgetting about this monster nightmare...
Dialogue.F0F3190D41005C9094831EA6C4E6BB3D_B222EAD: You should be, because this place is crawling with zombie chickens.
Dialogue.B99553AB4060FE2B92C04380CB156A08_FB122F8: You should be. There's something rotten in Plankerton...
Dialogue.0B96117745F4E67FACC491B73CC80821_1FCF39D: You should close this rift, peon.
Dialogue.21FB7CC447D1061AF6FA5E828879D690_94F2B66: You should come see him... as soon as you can.
Dialogue.03A45EF14E6752DC7AB70394AE88269B_47CFF90: You should do what he says.
Dialogue.7649C7264FACBEC506BCEC948D0A714A_97A9259: You should drink some organic orange juice and go to sleep for like a month.
Dialogue.A6390F384DA3A18B2D3DAF9558621736_C2C5A2E: You should get mad about it.
Dialogue.28BAE2C5451BF6AC101E6E83145FAAF0_CC240C1: You should go find the princess.
Dialogue.19A0C6014039B9F2346C508F0AC69431_AB3C42C: You should have been collecting pitchforks, not tomatoes.
Dialogue.9919467E488D25E37FE434BBE6432E0D_06FC410: You should let me handle the calls.
Dialogue.AFA4BD7946FCAF173600EFBBFE4C3E43_861A10F: You should probably see it for yourself.
Dialogue.24395E204097E493BCE612BBA5D0DB81_B229E47: You should really figure out what that means.
Dialogue.1A670E864E0095071835EABFF6B305D4_B222EAD: You should run away and never come back.
Dialogue.069CA42E40377ED5B70A6787BFF4F5EA_06FC410: You should say it and get used to saying it, 'cause I want to hear it. A lot.
Dialogue.0C6DBFDF4A7A99847D03C097ECE562EE_FB122F8: You should see this guy, I mean... I honestly envy the dead. This was all for nothing!
Dialogue.2B28D19846ED4BD6CED1E6AE166B64BA_D87E161: You should. I gave your impostor a taste of his own medicine.
Dialogue.74E04BF543A9DD29046492A125D218F9_06FC410: You sing even though you've never gotten near a proper note ever since I've known you.
Dialogue.142F25264EF5F12DACCD14AF06E778E5_FB122F8: You slapped my face, not literally, but with the cruel hand of fate.
Dialogue.458CA16E46ACE8E6E66CD58AB30E3F76_97A9259: You sometimes hear "next month," but you're never gonna hear "next year."
Dialogue.D24F1DE646848A0413BC308170472B0B_B222EAD: You sound like you're out of breath. Is everything okay?
Dialogue.2FBA582B4C4F181FAE296BAEC000C616_AB3C42C: You sound strange. Where are you?
Dialogue.E666118F4DA43915B5FC1A9826CEC95B_1D2FE88: You stand alone. Revive your party with a cursed statue.
Dialogue.CAAB928245251AD5891239AEB3A87355_06FC410: You still can't come in to Homebase, but...
Dialogue.812AB38B47CE4EECBC68A090C481C918_47CFF90: You still have a chance to turn back!
Dialogue.0691A58142AC4F12B96039AD762C2FC4_47CFF90: You still need process. Organization. Storm Shield Defense.
Dialogue.3EA0423A4AD0853F4C148DAE8367D3DE_97A9259: You sure you don't want me to stop?
Dialogue.479F12064DA5AE4BF210E5AE4040A9F9_DB7CBEB: You sure you want to do this?
Dialogue.0DA50C93477F7B1EA5F14A894D1774F7_181CD3E: You sure you've never done this before?
Dialogue.A450DC7E47987ED1524BD0894A608371_94F2B66: You suspect people are failing on purpose?
Dialogue.CFA4BB9043722CE750EA86A459405CA6_47CFF90: You teach us how to better hoodwink the storm, and in exchange you become a member of Homebase?
Dialogue.B0039AC64F08D2E3059A21A2D4ED0529_06FC410: You tell them to walk out into the storm.
Dialogue.E1F68DFD4C2B95E03DA17DAF38BEBF08_21523A0: You there, boy! What day is this?
Dialogue.90837CFA4C3D624F8756D0AAEE67E307_06FC410: You think I could be a business bot?
Dialogue.FA4F671E4529B0692210CCB672988BAE_FB122F8: You think I could get a handful of that coffee?
Dialogue.F9A3CCB842864CDA3E1815B537787987_97A9259: You think I'd try to prove you wrong? Look at you. You're like, the ultimate soldier...
Dialogue.C0D7720D449BE87B21F2C09AEF005123_97A9259: You think of what you want to say.
Dialogue.EEE3521D4F1530E77227BE83AFBAE61C_06FC410: You think the husks... deep down... may be good at heart?
Dialogue.A6507707435CC438C148199DD3DBF205_06FC410: You think they were installed after the storm hit?
Dialogue.07BCEEE449006031F6131A8B54A28388_0A979DB: You think you do, but you don't.
Dialogue.7E9D38B84867711D85988692A927929C_94F2B66: You think you have impostor syndrome?
Dialogue.4D6D4D674FC434CF2AC1B3B5B863FAB3_7712BEE: You think you're better than me.
Dialogue.F08911A04F8683C07A509785529DBA2F_06FC410: You think you're so much better than me, don't ya?
Dialogue.308DE1054A11603ADC665D87DA92F077_0BE868E: You think yourself special? We have seen societies rise and fall.
Dialogue.2297B075449C925F8E98F1ADBC73A8C8_FB122F8: You thinking Dennis Jr.'s dire predictions?
Dialogue.C2123B2744490E31F0059481A2D54FB5_2DD597A: You tickle your mother with that cursor?
Dialogue.92A4FBA64630C0E5CCD545901DC46736_EAAE146: You told me to tell the truth.
Dialogue.BEB122E943448536D5153D9E7F3403C8_84C369E: You transported me into a hurricane of nightmares.
Dialogue.504B8C104E760BB1C1CD62B8387C8417_6E5AC35: You tried. That's all that matters.
Dialogue.E15D4BE1439785F97E2C159ADF505BB0_21C1927: You turned my team against me?
Dialogue.F325CD244A97024618BD4C8F48DC3E9D_06FC410: You two are quiet. Is all that band justice sorted out?
Dialogue.DA73097147578F0417EDE58E8E35C62D_910A467: You two do not make it easy. He wants to destroy. And yet, he wants to not be destroyed.
Dialogue.2A93AB9247C428B32C2F51B0D865DF8D_7D086D9: You used my designs to build a weapon of war.
Dialogue.F1AC96484ADA27947B79559F58B70C94_910A467: You used this health stuff? You gotta try some.
Dialogue.0BACC70C440F5F5E2A7F6A93A3456BC4_EB81C5B: You wanna axe me a question?
Dialogue.DC2CEA6E459898D47366B7BD687B3353_94F2B66: You wanna bet your life on that answer?
Dialogue.055F6E4348D04AC80B0D9C9ED9AF8A7D_21C1927: You wanna make a naughty Christmas?
Dialogue.47ADEA7C4058D4B907812CA4FD759803_9801E98: You wanna see modesty? "Baby, we're just a bar band that got a lucky break!" That's modesty.
Dialogue.2D56BC434584A76ACCA38D8A5502DFA8_D87E161: You want me to ask the people I'm risking my life to save what they think of my performance?
Dialogue.3C4220D146AB646ED3FBDEADBAF2E9A8_FB122F8: You want me to build and deploy a drone fleet to make a map.
Dialogue.1239760441C2D0EE4CB5CDB0DBA981EB_CC240C1: You want me to draw up your will? Why?
Dialogue.EBD47F204642B369B9FE3EBC3BA57FEF_7D2960E: You want me to draw you a picture or something?
Dialogue.7E4A01AC498A449249F0269564715F8A_06FC410: You want me to give her the spiel?
Dialogue.B214C773401C2EF1EFD6B0A5F398C4DE_94F2B66: You want me to hold your hand, pat your little head whenever you do something right?
Dialogue.1D735C1B4914CA6823CF1CB10ED7413F_9D00593: You want me to put tinsel... on that... excuse for a tree?
Dialogue.30981D4A4C08DD90ECC28C81FE661DFD_B222EAD: You want me to share my ghostly secrets?
Dialogue.F9F48C0343BBE39B3C9A3CA87F4DBEE0_C2C5A2E: You want me to take these fools out?
Dialogue.825DBE304F155E43C7DC9E848FC92415_B222EAD: You want me to tell a really scary story?
Dialogue.87F00A9D4D7382DC01F20BAD300E12AF_B222EAD: You want me to use your spirit board? Fine.
Dialogue.66F326FB4ED85565251807B89B333800_97A9259: You want that pulse pounding terror, you gotta LIVE it.
Dialogue.D4ACE505458CFA434E10D6871ACAE20E_84C369E: You want this pencil? It's sharp. You could chuck it at something!
Dialogue.5665B491467FB81806A36795FFC99AD2_06FC410: You want to arrange a husk-slash-human debate?
Dialogue.C637675C48B2ADA7795ABBAE699F63DD_7D086D9: You want to be the one to detonate the bomb.
Dialogue.57EB09C64002954C3FC9579C193F1A73_06FC410: You want to explain it to me?
Dialogue.070723664D07CDC3460A64B8789550F6_97A9259: You want to get out there and do all the big important hero stuff?
Dialogue.F30DFB59421AE0F5CE4E2A8F986EF4D6_47CFF90: You want to have some criminal--
Dialogue.D86698484AB0C693F639FBA649A35445_AB3C42C: You want to pull the art film grift?
Dialogue.728760FE4A163C4E9A1D9EB93AE10CE1_06FC410: You want to risk it? See how far we can push the Storm Shield?
Dialogue.F2C9B0554C688BF678414EB45F37EF38_7D2960E: You want to see more hostility?
Dialogue.BA0BFD924A675F66B9B811B5DA0DD702_06FC410: You want two? I'll push pause on Operation Hospital.
Dialogue.41F3FF5A412374DA8CDF6C8CBC994255_06FC410: You wanted an area of extreme storm corruption...
Dialogue.EC83A3E740B747A046F292818587BCFE_AB3C42C: You wanted me to show you how to be a captain, this is your chance.
Dialogue.F83872D94BB528669495B1A305CBEC23_06FC410: You warm up those pipes, we'll fire up the airwaves.
Dialogue.C39FBE564DED84D34AACE48E5D3CF77F_97A9259: You went through some dark days, but now you're here.
Dialogue.6D3633FE4C666F9A79F0D78491E63512_181CD3E: You were a freak, before the storm hit...
Dialogue.726A43544826C7A4733792BD73D696B1_AFB40E2: You were always pretty good at it, though, once you loosened up.
Dialogue.1521449A49A4A9E3E18ED490E96D4338_E090F2A: You were debating copyright law with a robot.
Dialogue.26F84A03485FC4C36F025BAFF8F44564_FB122F8: You were lucky. All your interventions appear to have blurred the edges, but timelines remain stable for now.
Dialogue.15C999B14CF1DE99F815B4BABE3E371E_CC240C1: You were one of those friends!
Dialogue.7209A9EF4D1827A568755DA1FE29E8BF_861A10F: You were right. I think these trees will make for fantastic structural support.
Dialogue.37EA16CF4950E40D5286C0A1CF54A031_B229E47: You were right. This is bad. We need to develop a plan as quickly as possible.
Dialogue.CC8DC17947524FAB98C030A2199AAD13_9D00593: You were ruining the mood here.
Dialogue.EFBDBD69437A73110F540488B9819712_B68F328: You were too hung up on yourself to see the plain truth.
Dialogue.6262C6ED475BFFDBEA4CD7B69E8E73AB_89ED452: You were! You are! You think I haven't stopped beating myself up every day because of that?
Dialogue.ADACBDF8448F912A786E1E86DF5AD787_7D086D9: You weren't in the room, and I naturally assumed the worst.
Dialogue.6275E4564C51E2F31FD626812A94A3DF_06FC410: You weren't supposed to crash, Lars!
Dialogue.83D149114A2C06D4D8441398B80FAB88_1D2FE88: You weren't supposed to win! No fair.
Dialogue.284937DC4F42318B2A0877A9DD634EFE_0BE868E: You will be but a snack for the ice, troll.
Dialogue.3C45470A44F24EEDAFD774AF55281628_F7FABF5: You will be safe within the walls of my fortress.
Dialogue.D58C10D2440FD3ACA641079165DDADE4_21523A0: You will be visited by three ghosts!
Dialogue.6DEE114A46F1C6DE7B30E7A5A6787F8C_94F2B66: You will beat this thing, son. I know it.
Dialogue.EE44DED34707CD540A32CF88635301D1_9D00593: You will fa-la-la-la-la-llow these holly jolly steps.
Dialogue.FE0FF3C34FB04B5D8706B5936B153982_861A10F: You will hate it. Trust me.
Dialogue.0ABAA01E443D9C4E8F72339C75712566_97A9259: You will hear from our most honorable delegation of boars... Soon.
Dialogue.8BC6BD994E5DD9589D7AAB91D3E8E12A_B222EAD: You will literally wake up exhausted from ALL of the screaming.
Dialogue.E97E5637400691FF1A3EEFA3ADF70462_9D00593: You will meet every one of our demands.
Dialogue.ED4248F64B521BD976E1D7AB0FF8C690_0BE868E: You will not let your Queen die.
Dialogue.5B440CC24FF0B6A099BE4CACAFDB90AA_06FC410: You won't be alone. We'll be taking shifts to keep you company.
Dialogue.881D2A1247BAE1A278039EB4110D4966_CC240C1: You won't last long out in the storm. Maybe stay a bit closer to the burner!
Dialogue.81FC4800499BD4FE65AF64A04703B1E2_1D2FE88: You won, okay? But please don't escape! You don't know my boss, man.
Dialogue.76DEEBFA45A3CDCAF702AFA204F4E865_06FC410: You worked so hard to collect those resources and...
Dialogue.B674548A4121B2903F99CEB12D4F8857_FB122F8: You worried about leaving the fox in the ol' henhouse?
Dialogue.BA0E8EFC4D14850BF272BDA39A2E2621_0BE868E: You would have fallen far before this, we assure you.
Dialogue.AFD1D38C444BE3BD69E0A384C0B0E318_06FC410: You would think that stuffing feathers in a bag would work as a bed.
Dialogue.3BD9453F4E09170351CE38854C0DAC2C_9D00593: You wouldn't be the first to try!
Dialogue.A0C2A1044FD730B378DDBCBF5E98FE0D_97A9259: You wouldn't understand! This is my chance to debut my pirate burger!
Dialogue.E87C406F446CDF891C8BF9845A2D1527_14FBFB1: You'd better head back to Homebase and leave this to us.
Dialogue.4149285541EDDFB1AC88268BAD695692_EAAE146: You'd better. I put a lot of work into this.
Dialogue.05F5F16B473966DA77FB8695BC193896_14FBFB1: You'd have to ask my outerwear designer... the cloakmaster.
Dialogue.DBAE3C2C4D042AC487E4309DDEA6D781_06FC410: You'd sit with me and afterward you'd always have so many questions.
Dialogue.BD20860F44D155021298CD9F258F73DB_06FC410: You'd think we wouldn't have to work so hard to sell the concept of not dying.
Dialogue.024CED57482504ED88DBD5AA61BD5EB0_9D00593: You'd welcome in the holidays with that monstrosity!
Dialogue.87C5361C4E329561ADE4C380196141C2_861A10F: You'll be able to come and go as you please. Like a true holf.
Dialogue.2C82B9724DB76184607EDBBB5F8CF7CF_06FC410: You'll be defending your Amplifier and your Outpost, so make sure all your defenses are ready to rock.
Dialogue.C0081B5B495808CE379C15A4880E4924_07E024E: You'll be dreaming about me later.
Dialogue.ECF79ECC48D8C94D391D9499A78FE3C8_97A9259: You'll be fine, Dire. You're a good actor!
Dialogue.16D2F6454E7666349ED59DA8426D13BB_47CFF90: You'll be fine. You've been able to learn from her leadership style.
Dialogue.400B751F46314E83DB796589D199E575_9D00593: You'll be happy to know that I have stopped spying on Homebase.
Dialogue.449E7E4C447ADFB1E4B28A902B2CF094_FB122F8: You'll be hearing about that in the feedback...
Dialogue.FB98ED644BCAAB7E4EDE10818C7BF911_861A10F: You'll be our beach party eye-in-the-sky? I like it.
Dialogue.A2773FAE411860CC430543B18E433EC8_1D2FE88: You'll be pleased to know that I am up to temp.
Dialogue.F60255ED474A7F9BAF5194B2557527FD_861A10F: You'll be sniffing out whoever abducted those wolves in record time!
Dialogue.35060C984656334A6DF0A7B83F3916BD_87F0BBB: You'll come back now if you know what's good for ya.
Dialogue.8E25E9F74F3FFCD265640FB6DCFE2AB2_06FC410: You'll dead when you're dead, which will be soon if you don't sleep.
Dialogue.CA32629648A41354DEA4FB86E35D71E3_06FC410: You'll figure it out. Even Dennis has a purpose and he thinks meteorology is the study of hamburgers.
Dialogue.32084B8C4E56F43E936729905754D70A_FB122F8: You'll figure it out... it's not hard to miss.
Dialogue.07FFE726466821F91DC43DBA168FE460_06FC410: You'll get confused and you'll embarrass me in front of all the other Rays...
Dialogue.F6BE399F4C647DF97393E69CDEA7C2E8_FB122F8: You'll get used to it, Ghost Girl.
Dialogue.B834267E48DC5A2995FA5ABC8E178298_A2D6E0B: You'll get what's coming to you.
Dialogue.91D1A2F24874449B5AFA17AC1C9B4F64_06FC410: You'll get your voice pack back when you can prove you'll handle it responsibly.
Dialogue.2260FE824544C8D2F89CF78F278FD180_AF0DA39: You'll have to find me first!
Dialogue.2EB13B5341DCB4D54C3EF6A0852D9BAF_FB122F8: You'll have to take it off of smoothie mode. And maybe give it a wipedown...
Dialogue.07C053364D2D3E2D5833929A8BD4BB07_1D2FE88: You'll have to... fight your way out!
Dialogue.F4B9D6CD4229E22AF12474B85861628B_181CD3E: You'll just have to find someone else to design you terrible toys for Christmas. Sorry.
Dialogue.9A3286714C2A7642D4CE7E85D5AEDCE3_06FC410: You'll know it when you're there... that's how coordinates work!
Dialogue.E9D9664F466D2945CEB743AFAD96995D_765440C: You'll need a key to keep exploring.
Dialogue.74B554E0402E724FBFAF1FAB434C329E_1D2FE88: You'll need to fight monsters to find the husk key.
Dialogue.32F1D7F448FCE60518C83EA4EAD414E9_CC240C1: You'll need to find some BluGlo!
Dialogue.C5EEE00D4259B6A0A6136090CA71CC56_14FBFB1: You'll never have to know what you're missing.
Dialogue.B48793F94F24C67D2D33FF832EFDE9E6_06FC410: You'll take damage when you're in the storm, so keep an eye on your health.
Dialogue.A827577D4671A422A0AC54A327EB5B89_B222EAD: You'll thank them. You'll move in with us. And you'll be happy about it.
Dialogue.E994F7AD428E36E7838392BE88726A6B_06FC410: You'll think you died and went to Nedkit heaven.
Dialogue.58D878F442B13471AE8AD5AADB85FF6D_06FC410: You'll wanna get help for this one. It's pretty rough.
Dialogue.BFCE7ECC441273D1969BA893DB09B39B_06FC410: You'll want to build defenses around the balloon's landing site.

Dialogue.6D06DB5C48483848949A97875C4FB3A3_FB122F8: Your first tour probably was gonna be a disaster.
Dialogue.0B4DD6954FF5A1A8E7040091D3722B06_1FCF39D: Your flame is extinguished, never to be thawed.
Dialogue.D3993D384BC18A9825AF7EB3BB00C5C5_1FCF39D: Your flame is extinguished, never to be thawed.
Dialogue.4E4E83E84AE23A29E28FA5AE361163EC_94F2B66: Your fort is saved when you start the mission, and any damage or modifications will be undone after the mission.
Dialogue.CDC279AE468A0EBCE65FFC8D48962417_06FC410: Your fort is taking on husks!
Dialogue.290F094446C4BC28FD17CFB53176DD8F_CC240C1: Your friends left you behind? My friends left me behind once.
Dialogue.1429E2AB493AEF495F9E0BB77EBB8358_1D2FE88: Your friends may want to take advantage of the talisman's protective aura.
Dialogue.E8D7BA7B4F337FAE18CD0791DE332B9E_06FC410: Your friends want your help, but they need to know they can depend on you.
Dialogue.0F82D2CE42349DA82C2279B8298F9800_06FC410: Your future baby, these time skips... how much of this is related to Dennis and Summer's Time Travel Film Festival?
Dialogue.29E520B040FB7B790E596A82EFE76DB6_06FC410: Your ghost friend in the gun? Yeah, that sounds way less important, but bring her along I guess. (grunts) Sorry.
Dialogue.468533B34DA19F453B94678A4B27E67E_06FC410: Your goal is to defend the Hover Tub as it makes deliveries. The more deliveries of goods, the better!
Dialogue.9304325E41CB0BDF49451DBE9323225D_06FC410: Your great-great-grandchildren will cry out, "Who is she and why won't she leave us alone!?"
Dialogue.7A1C5DB64BF48B8E2E2ADB9DBC021671_1D2FE88: Your group has found all of the keys. Now descend deeper into the dungeon.
Dialogue.8EC64D484920F4575C34FBB8E73F4657_1D2FE88: Your group has found all of the keys. Now descend deeper into the dungeon.
Dialogue.EF9039BE4F394D02AAC7F09A18C79A7C_72190CE: Your in over your head, beast.
Dialogue.6AB17EB74C352C9A56BDD596DB0DF124_AB3C42C: Your job is to resolve conflicts, not to let us get robbed.
Dialogue.CD87860843838678FAE5DAAE0C7B2B71_765440C: Your lair is your life. Get a good contractor that uses concrete rebar mesh!
Dialogue.C1BFF705465488F5E2A82AB5A6358475_06FC410: Your lawyer backstory, or your commando backstory?
Dialogue.AA247EDF48DCA8E13F34A6BF3932CE42_7D086D9: Your likes, dislikes, the way you sound when you speak... even your name.
Dialogue.1BB47F8A496A03900DA4409C3F485069_861A10F: Your maze has attracted some guests!
Dialogue.B3F6A4074F3922980976F5B035BE7729_861A10F: Your maze is halfway haunted. Finish off the husks!
Dialogue.108C38EE42831445A8ADA18FE10D66D9_CC5E92B: Your monster friends see that? SEE IT!?
Dialogue.B158B2CE42178F0F1D71FD8D92891926_06FC410: Your new shiny objective is ready and waiting.
Dialogue.C29F506D482B8A49088E74897A36D2D7_F6B1D98: Your nickname's still stupid though. (imitates ghost noises)
Dialogue.38288D77410DBAACE6F8539202F51BD2_06FC410: Your objective is cowering in a corner!  Help it out!
Dialogue.B7CEBFCA4C2CAC3F6CF714874BB7DC32_1D2FE88: Your party is waiting for you at the dungeon's entrance.
Dialogue.4992B3BE47F3170D546588BE9835CFC4_47CFF90: Your principled stand is just a bit too late. I've just made our final map.
Dialogue.6B878DA845C011B306B70EA6605ED6B9_5CE5FC8: Your problem is not your people. It's your mission.
Dialogue.BED653AE4B05B590D1225F87AFB1E3C7_06FC410: Your progress will be saved automatically.
Dialogue.9052E05C466E2E2CC446E0A5B25E3339_B222EAD: Your prowess really knows no bounds.
Dialogue.07F17BA84E9F1AD06218C882F9ED5995_FB122F8: Your romantic cape guys, your hirsute moon weirdos, your creatures from the unremarkable stagnant watersheds.
Dialogue.A7533FDA43F82A18190D5797B7361472_EECA944: Your sense of adventure never left your couch.
Dialogue.A27ECB5D43B4C96E0C7BC388440AAC60_CC240C1: Your sense of isolation would become the defining factor of your life.
Dialogue.3645D8FD4FFE2971B479658E7B0F331F_06FC410: Your seven day snow battle begins...
Dialogue.6F4339B841D737414096BF9D799DAC7F_1D2FE88: Your structures and traps will now burn! (laughs)
Dialogue.49B01680456DCC2656E9A8A85BB2BA75_1FCF39D: Your theft will not be forgotten.
Dialogue.F48ACACF4DECCC1B6CA59588C1A72C80_861A10F: Your time to build is almost up. Keep moving!
Dialogue.F4DBEB6443DB08C19BFA75870ED4D55E_7D086D9: Your track system should do the job.
Dialogue.927B00ED4F02E5A5497A928C8EC907DC_06FC410: Your trap heavy open floor plans.
Dialogue.FE35E73B4AAC22A183DA4D9D7934C350_06FC410: Your window for collecting the tanks is fairly small, a big storm is rolling, and I will have to bring you in before it hits.
Dialogue.E8965D54465DE7F5BD5FABB70C217F02_D87E161: Your worst nightmare is Dennis's tombstone?
Dialogue.2A56CBE8401DC247AB3B52B703D03F85_CC240C1: Your wounds are bad. I'm pulling you out until there's a break in the action.
Dialogue.0D47AAA543904F8779B63FAB9890E923_06FC410: Your zone is covered. Double covered, actually.
Dialogue.CF9BDC404F6EA29A6E1A2EBB6329660E_FB122F8: Your... holiday spirit, encouraged her to take a big creative leap forward.
Dialogue.7623B6754637C4C18E9A9E9FAABC64B4_06FC410: Yours forever in love and marriage, Alister Carpenter.
Dialogue.80C35F564A082647988C109482A85490_47CFF90: You’re a small-time trading vessel returning home from a faraway land.
Dialogue.53E91DBB4FA51253137C6F89A56DE471_FB122F8: Yup, the data is backing up our observations...
Dialogue.AC5682584E3E9969D258049419E2BEB3_FB122F8: Yup. And I stand by the decision.
Dialogue.36E5D26146EA45C57DC4F2A009550E9D_47CFF90: Yup. Take it from the top.
Dialogue.7DD677024E46D837DB830DBC484C99EF_9D00593: Yup. Zipper broke, so I ain't gettin' out of this thing alive.
Dialogue.984411EC48CECEB8C7308AAA9FB0008C_910A467: Y’know... I can see the positives to this experience, but I would also appreciate a hand.
Dialogue.0F3F240B42E7016500D9A1AE486BCD65_06FC410: Zeus, god of melodic speed metal, grant me patience. Because I, like so many idiotic dinner guests before me...
Dialogue.6F96248C45C4A7A761F12CAE78028DA9_94F2B66: [sigh] Once upon a time, dwarf husklings raided the Homebase gold storage.
Dialogue.E074607847B7AE5EA8F59388A00DE319_06FC410: [sigh]... I guess we'll have the quinoa.
Dialogue.5E520CD341BCEEAEDD333FBAD5838FA6_06FC410: and also overcome with emotion because I'm so touched by your stupid beautiful selfless, very bad plan.
Dialogue.785C190C4A5A6CC03308E4A445AB0D77_06FC410: and his particularly gruesome and multistage death at the hands of Vlad's henchmen.
Dialogue.5949B48A427794CC8649DAB0B1607F71_06FC410: and how our Homebase is better than anyone else's...
Dialogue.F39273714BF9770A77DE978E0DFEE991_06FC410: and when they break they release a furious and revenge minded storm.
Dialogue.B446D8E34351D864B6030481E3C38F2B_FB122F8: and, uh, it appears to have gone rogue.
Dialogue.FAD229F349EEC76539C930A054F9A53F_FB122F8: is affecting things on the ground.
Dialogue.6175A6D8426E7115504A519640669348_84C369E: scuse me, pardon me, comin' through!
Dialogue.22A6D1984617849D23D148B01B4B75E2_06FC410: the Rootin-est, Tootin-est, Yippie-kayaa-inest Guidebook Ever Rassled Together.
Dialogue.7EDC48D1452A9796E2CB3D8C2039484F_06FC410: the Rootin-est, Tootin-est, Yippie-kayaa-inest Guidebook Ever Rassled Together.
Dialogue.9D8704BF460D030DD630ED9EB41ECB3A_72190CE: “...doom be upon you." Okay, okay, okay. I got it. I got it.
Dialogue.C8C5E2E14623BD5B40860DBF0CE19A55_47CFF90: “A friend?” you wonder to yourself, full of ignorance.
Dialogue.82BA1C554589DE03888A86BD7721C07C_861A10F: “Almost no supplies on this stupid robot boat. At least the shanties have stopped."
Dialogue.733C0EA7468871477E98F890F16EEB07_94F2B66: “Attack on Jungle’s Reach?” Haven’t seen that one since... Well, never mind!
Dialogue.30EE93384D2ADC5596966DB753234053_47CFF90: “Curing” isn't the goal here, Blake. This will help you “learn to live with” your seasickness.
Dialogue.8CC3EB1F4EBABE7FBBCD47A8AC4E4C73_F6B1D98: “Get out of he-" You really want me gone that bad?
Dialogue.9C594DB54DE5468D3B7A9ABE67B0128E_861A10F: “Had to evacuate, saw my chance on this robot boat. Mum and Dad, if you see this, I'm fine.” It’s signed… “Power Chord.”
Dialogue.A90441F74E9A59E6C7204FB92610975D_051E656: “Hu-usks?” That what you call ‘em? Corr, that’s a little difficult to say don't you think? “Hu-usks.” “Hus-susks.”
Dialogue.79AD6C954D1EDBB8735AF5867174CD98_47CFF90: “Imagine me making a fart sound now to break the mushy vibe. Keelhaul.” Heh. Yes. That sounds about right.
Dialogue.5D0DE3CC421B409D906B458C2E1F3E06_47CFF90: “Lamps?” Hm. Guess we should get to those coordinates and see what we find.
Dialogue.AF0BBCAE4579A46012DA8A9C517D83CD_F6B1D98: “Needle..." That's ringing a bell. Why is that ringing a bell?
Dialogue.064527DA4AFBA0B9BBAA53B8786640D0_72190CE: “No?” Then, why did you send us here?
Dialogue.F2161FB241433E0C7ACC67B5A7CF1890_47CFF90: “Raise anchor,” and come with me, my fledgling scoundrels. We're off to fly some flags!
Dialogue.58DD7D824AE8B0107A901680B21C6B3C_06FC410: “Sup, salt-lickers...” Heh. I'm guessing this is Keelhaul.
Dialogue.E4F03B4C48ACE19DA0A185BC714ED43B_06FC410: “Tell ya when we find it. Keelhaul.”
Dialogue.D0F705C343A75C3362C10EA34BEC37AE_94F2B66: “Western Reach Simulation has not been cleared for use...” I’m sure that’s just boiler plate.
Dialogue.C3B7C50D48619247AE11F69849B4DA6E_B229E47: “Wild Science,” by Steel Wool. I thought that project was never completed.
Dialogue.359756EE4E26FF1301A5CE80523AC11F_72190CE: “Yarr, the chest be heavy and festooned with locks to hold its booty inside."
Dialogue.4D168ECF4807704CD04E638369EF609A_5991012: …With the exception of incidents involving humans experimenting on their own brains, no offense.
